biography: Mr. Bogomil Balkansky is the Founder and serves as President and Board Member at Bulgaria Innovation Hub. Mr. Balkansky serves as Partner, Seed/Early at Sequoia Capital. He had served as an Executive at Lodash. He serves as a Board Member at Chainguard, Chainguard, Release, Bigeye, and SupportLogic. He serves as Advisor at Platform9. He served as a Board Member at StackRox. He serves as a Board Member at Cortex. He holds an MBA degree in General Management from Stanford GSB (2000) and a BA degree in Mathematics from Cornell University (1995).

Mr. Craig Dixon is the Co-Founder and serves as General Partner at Accelerating Asia. He serves as Board Member at InsightzClub. He has founded several startups, including Zumata, a B2B travel tech company that exited its travel business to Rakuten in 2019. As Co-Founder of Zumata, he raised funding from Wavemaker Partners, The National Research Foundation of Singapore, 500 Durians, and Siemer Ventures. Prior to co-founding Accelerating Asia, he was the Entrepreneur in Residence and Program Manager for the muru-D accelerator in Singapore which included startups that received follow-on investment from investors including Sequoia, Omidyar Network and Delta airlines. With his extensive startup investment experience, including over 75 startup investment rounds, he has oversight of Accelerating Asia's Venture Capital fund which invests in pre-Series A startups. Prior to his startup career, he was a high net-worth wealth manager at global investment firms including Citigroup and Merrill Lynch. He holds an MBA from the University of Maryland/HKUST.

Ms. Ann Canela serves as a Board Member at The Recycling Partnership. Previously, she served as Chief Operating Officer at Sequoia Climate Fund. She has done a Bachelor's Degree in English Literature from Hunter College in 1997, a Degree from Boston University in 2015 and an MBA (Master of Business Administration) in Marketing, Business, Entrepreneurship in 2022.

Ms. Cynthia Collins serves as Board Member at Draper. Ms. Collins has been a Draper Board member since 2021. She is the Principal of Cynthia Collins & Associates. Cindy has extensive experience leading healthcare firms as President and/or Chief Executive Officer (CEO) across more than four decades. She served as President and Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Editas Medicine, Inc., from February 2019 to February 2021. Previously, Cindy was CEO of Human Longevity Inc.; CEO/General Manager of General Electric's Healthcare Cell Therapy Business, Lab Businesses and Clarient Diagnostics; and CEO of GenVec. Earlier in her career, Cindy served as Group Vice President the Cellular Analysis Business of Beckman Coulter, now Danaher. Before that, she was President and CEO of Sequoia Pharmaceuticals, Inc.; President of Clinical Micro Sensors for Motorola; and President of Oncology and Vice President of Strategy and Portfolio Management of BioScience for Baxter Healthcare. She is currently a member of the boards of Poseida Therapeutics, DermTech, Certara; Panavance Therapeutics, Nutcracker Therapeutics, and Alanis Therapeutics. She received her bachelor's degree in microbiology from the University of Illinois, Urbana, and her MBA from The University of Chicago Booth School of Business.

primary_position: Co-Founder and Business Strategy & Communications Maven
biography: Ms. Gina Solomon is a Co-Founder and serves as Business Strategy & Communications Maven at Sequoia Strategic Advisors. She is an Angel Investor. She also serves as Board Member at Volos Portfolio Solutions.

Dr. Sashi Reddi is the Founder & serves as Chief Executive Officer at Boss Wallah. Dr. Reddi is the Founder and serves as Managing Partner at SRI Capital. He serves as Board Member at SoftWear Automation. He served as Chairman at ffreedom. He is the founder and serves as a Board Member at IIT Delhi Endowment Fund. He serves as a Board Member at T-Hub. He also serves as Chairman at IndianMoney.com. Notably, he is an Investment Executive at Gabriel Investments, showcasing his success as a technology entrepreneur, business leader, and active angel investor. Among the companies in his portfolio are Glassbeam (specializing in machine log analytics for technology support), ThinCI (a graphics chip design company in stealth mode), Identropy (focused on identity as a service), Edutor (a leading tablet-based e-learning player in India), and iMomentous (a mobile-based talent engagement platform). Before his current roles, he founded and served as the CEO of AppLabs, the world's largest independent software testing company with over 2,500 QA professionals in India, the US, and the UK. AppLabs, funded by Sequoia Capital India, was acquired by CSC in September 2011, resulting in a remarkable 10X return for Series A investors in just 6 years. Following the acquisition, he held the position of VP & GM, Big Data and Analytics at CSC, reporting directly to the CEO. CSC, a $15 billion IT services and consulting company listed on the NYSE, played a crucial role in shaping his career. A serial entrepreneur, he has founded three other companies: EZPower Systems (a web content management pioneer acquired by DocuCorp, eventually part of Oracle), iCoop (a group purchasing dotcom), and FXLabs (a leading Indian game developer acquired by Foundation 9 Entertainment). Actively involved in various advisory roles, he serves on the advisory board of Wharton Entrepreneurship, the board of Ben Franklin Technology Partners, and the board of the Pennsylvania Academy of Fine Arts (PAFA). As a charter member of TiE Philadelphia and TiE Hyderabad, he is deeply engaged in fostering entrepreneurship. Beyond his professional endeavors, he runs a charitable organization, SRI Trust, which supports the educational and overall development needs of 600 children in three schools in India. He has also served as a Board Member at Green India Building Systems & Services and currently serves on the board of ShepHertz Technologies, EdgeTensor, and as an Advisor at Payswiff. Additionally, he serves as a Venture Advisor at WestBridge Capital Partners and has previously been a Board Member at DreamVu. He holds a B.Tech in Computer Science from IIT Delhi, an MS in Computer Science from NYU, and a Ph.D. from The Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania. He served as a Board Member at Glassbeam.

Mr. William Elcock is a Co-Founder & serves as Principal at Sequoia Strategic Advisors. Mr. Elcock is an Investor and serves as Board Member at Volos. He is an angel investor. Mr. Elcock also serves as the Co-Founder and Principal at Sequoia Strategic Advisors LLC. Bill joined Batterymarch Financial in 1984 as an assistant portfolio manager and was subsequently named quantitative analyst, portfolio manager and senior portfolio manager. Bill assumed additional senior management responsibilities as Deputy Chief Executive officer in 2001 and became Chief Executive Officer in 2002. He led this global quantitative equity firm, a pioneer in model-driven investing and independently managed subsidiary of Legg Mason, Inc., through a substantial period of growth to a high of $30 Billion in AUM, 120 employees and $120 Million in revenues. Bill received his BA from University of New Hampshire and an MBA from Sawyer Business School at Suffolk University.

Dr. Naresh Malhotra founded and serves as Chairman at The Family Doctor. He serves as Board Member at Routematic. His concerns on the gaps in the current healthcare ecosystem lead to the conception of the family doctor. In his new role, Naresh's focus is on mentoring the organization to move to the next orbit of growth and customer reach. Naresh has over 42 years of Finance, Marketing, and Consulting, and General Management experience. A large part of his career was spent in the FMCG, Hospitality & Retail industry where he was instrumental in scaling new businesses across India and in other international markets. Naresh has worked with several large companies such as ICI, Unilever, Colgate Palmolive, UB Group, KPMG, and Cafe Coffee Day. Naresh was the Founder/ Partner of KPMG India. He took Cafe Coffee Day from 18 outlets to over 1200 outlets. Before founding the family doctor, he was an Operating Partner at Sequoia Capital. Naresh is a Chartered Accountant. His passion for promoting entrepreneurs and new talent has led him to be an angel investor in several highly successful companies. Naresh also sits on the Board of several large companies.

Mr. Christopher Young serves as Chairman at Bluegrass Angels. He serves as Advisor & Board Member at PowerTech Water. He serves as Board Member at Hera (Drug Discovery). He has been active as an entrepreneur and investor in technology-related startup companies for over 10 years. He started his career in Atlanta, GA working as a sales engineer for Security First Technologies, an online banking technology company. He then moved to San Francisco to join the startup technology consulting firm, Scient. Shortly after Scient went public, he was a founder of two technology-related startups, raising over $60 million in venture capital from investors such as Sequoia Capital, Freeman Spogli & Co., Capital Research & Management, and Oracle Venture Fund. He returned to Kentucky in 2004 and currently serves as Chairman of the Board of Managers of the Blue Grass Angel Venture Fund II and serves on the boards of Transposagen Biopharmaceuticals, Gun Media Holdings, Frogdice, and Float Money. He received a BS in Electrical and Biomedical Engineering from Duke University.

Mr. Harris Barton is the Founder & serves as Managing Director at H. Barton Asset Management. Mr. Barton serves as Partner at Still Capital Partners. He serves as a Board Member at REDF. Previously he was a Managing Director in the Business Development team and is responsible for maintaining and fostering relationships with key clients. He co-founded HRJ Capital in 1999. He became public equity and private equity investor during his football career, most notably with Sequoia Capital in the venture capital arena, beginning with Sequoia Capital VII in the early '90s. The relationships he developed in that process have been instrumental in building the network of top-tier fund managers throughout the financial services industry available to HRJ Capital. Mr. Barton is a graduate of the University of North Carolina, where he received a Bachelor's Degree in Finance.

Mr. Scott Beeton serves as Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director at ARC Funds. He serves as Board Member and Investment Committee Member at Ausbiz Capital. He served as Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director at Sequoia Financial Group and Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director at MDS Financial Group. Mr. Beeton has over 20 years of management experience in the finance sector, where he has held senior executive roles across inter alia, superannuation, funds management, stockbroking, AFSL dealer services, advice & FinTech. He holds several qualifications, including a Bachelor of Business from Newcastle University and industry-specific qualifications, including a Diploma of Financial Services (Financial Planning).

Mr. Uday Khemka serves as Vice Chairman at SUN Group. He also serves as a Board Member at Maini Global Aerospace. He has more than 24 years of investment, investment banking, and entrepreneurial experience in varied emerging markets with a particular focus on India and the countries of the former Soviet Union. Before SUN, he worked with Credit Suisse First Boston and Morgan Stanley in London and New York and then established and led Morgan Stanley's investment banking operation in India. He has been deeply involved in the Group's principal investments in the food and beverage, oil and gas, mining, and real estate sectors and is a Director of SUN Gold. He has also led SUN's investment management activities and the creation of focused fund franchises in SUN's core markets, including joint ventures with Apollo Real Estate Advisors (AREA), Sequoia Capital, and others. He is on the Board of Governors of the Indian School Of Business (ISB) in Hyderabad, the Board of The Synergos Institute in New York, and has been elected a Young Global Leader at the World Economic Forum in Davos. Educated at Eton College, he received his undergraduate and Masters degrees at Cambridge University and received an MBA with distinction from Harvard Business School (Baker Scholar).

J. PAUL MCNAMARA, 74, is the Chairman of Potomac Capital Advisors and the former President and Chief Operating Officer of Sequoia Bancshares, Inc. Mr. McNamara is a current director and a former Vice Chairman of United Bank. Mr. McNamara has been a director of the Company since 2003. Currently, Mr. McNamara is the Chairman of Potomac Capital Advisors, a privately held real estate investment company. Mr. McNamara has spent over 50 years in the banking industry. Mr. McNamara was the President and Chief Operating Officer of Sequoia Bancshares for 15 years. Prior to Sequoia, Mr. McNamara worked for Manufacturers Hanover Trust Company for three years and the National Bank of Washington for 12 years where he held several senior management positions. Mr. McNamara has gained valuable insight through his banking experience in senior management positions into retail banking, commercial banking, bank operations and systems. Mr. McNamara brings this extensive knowledge of the banking industry to his role as a director of the Company, Chairman of the Governance and Nominating Committee, and as a member of the Executive, Compensation and Risk Committees.

primary_position: President, Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Mark Grescovich serves as President, Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at Banner Bank. He joined the Bank in April 2010 and became Chief Executive Officer in August 2010 following an extensive banking career specializing in finance, credit administration, and risk management. He assumed the role and responsibility for FirstMerit's commercial and regional line of business in 2007, having served since 1994 in various commercial and corporate banking positions, including that of Chief Credit Officer. Before joining FirstMerit, he was a Managing Partner in corporate finance with Sequoia Financial Group, Inc. of Akron, Ohio, and a commercial and corporate lending officer and credit analyst with Society National Bank of Cleveland, Ohio.

Mr. Michael P. Fitzgerald, 67, is the former Co-Founder, Chairman, Chief Executive Officer and President of Bank of Georgetown. Mr. Fitzgerald is Vice Chairman and a director of United Bank. Mr. Fitzgerald is the former President of United Bank. Mr. Fitzgerald has been a director of the Company since 2016. Mr. Fitzgerald has over 40 years of experience helping businesses achieve their financial goals through his work in the Washington, D.C. area commercial banking industry. His career prior to Bank of Georgetown included a variety of senior executive roles at some of the region's most prestigious banking institutions. He served as Senior Vice President of Sequoia Bank (and subsequently United Bank post-merger) with responsibilities for all commercial banking operations in Maryland as well as oversight of government contractor banking efforts throughout the region. Mr. Fitzgerald began his banking career with Riggs Bank, where for 15 years he served in several capacities including Corporate Banking, Special Assistant to the Chairman, and President and Chief Executive Officer of The Riggs National Bank of Maryland. He is a former director of the Federal Home Loan Bank of Atlanta.

Ms. Ruzwana Bashir is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Peek (Restaurants, Hotels and Leisure). Ms. Bashir serves as Board Member at SoFi. She previously worked at Gilt Groupe, Art.sy, the Blackstone Group and Goldman Sachs. Ruzwana has an MBA from Harvard Business School, where she was a Fulbright Scholar and a BA in Economics from Oxford University, where she was President of the Oxford Union. Ruzwana Bashir is CEO and Founder of Peek.com, building Shopify for experiences. Peek.com combines an award-winning marketplace for consumers with powerful booking/payment tools for businesses (Peek Pro). Peek.com has had over $2 billion in bookings and raised $50 million in funding from investors such as Eric Schmidt and Jack Dorsey. Forbes named the company "America's next travel unicorn". Ruzwana is also an angel investor and Scout for Sequoia Capital, investing in companies such as Clubhouse and Living Carbon. Ruzwana has been named one of Fortune's Most Powerful Women Entrepreneurs, Fast Company's 100 Most Creative People in Business and was a Finalist for E&Y's Entrepreneur of the Year. She is a Young Global Leader for the World Economic Forum and previously worked at Goldman Sachs and Blackstone. She has an MBA from Harvard Business School, where she was a Fulbright Scholar, and a BA from Oxford University where she was President of the Oxford Union.

Mr. Akshat Kshetrapal serves as Investment Director at dsm-firmenich Ventures. He serves as a Board Member at Phynova. He serves as a Board Member at Octarine Bio. He serves as a Board Member at NutriLeads. He served as a Board Member & Advisor at NC Biomatrix. He served as Director of Health at RockStart. Prior to joining DSM in 2020, he sat on both sides of the table as an entrepreneur and investor. He started his entrepreneurial career by building WTEnergy, India's first carbon-trading platform and advisory services company, after which he embarked on his venture capital career at Sequoia Capital. He has since gained extensive experience investing across the lifecycle of startups, with more than 45 investments totaling over 400 million euros and portfolio management for PGGM Private Equity, Max India, and Rockstart. At dsm-firmenich.com, he is responsible for investments in Europe and Israel in areas related to Nutrition, Health, and Biosciences. An Indian national currently living in Amsterdam, the Netherlands, he holds an MBA from the Indian School of Business and master's degrees from the University of Amsterdam and the Delhi School of Economics.

primary_position: Founder, General Partner & Investment Board Member
biography: Mr. James Adler is the Founder and serves as General Partner and Investment Board Member at Toyota Ventures. Mr. Adler served as Board Observer at May Mobility. He joined Toyota Ventures from TRI, serving as data and business development vice president. Before that, he was vice president of products and marketing at Metanautix, a big data analytics startup funded by Sequoia Capital and Workday that Microsoft acquired. Previously, he was the vice president of data systems and chief privacy officer at Intelius, which was acquired by H.I.G. Capital. In addition, he founded VoteHere, a pioneer in cryptographic secure and secret online voting for public elections that Cisco and HP, among others funded. He started his career as a rocket engineer for Lockheed Martin. He has served on the investment committee of JetBlue Ventures and is a member of the board of directors for several Toyota Ventures portfolio companies, including AutoBrains, Intuition Robotics, Moodify, Revel, and SLAMcore. He is also a board observer for Brilliant Planet, Burro, Joby Aviation, Near Space Labs, and Nori. He previously served on the Toyota Financial Savings Bank's board of directors and the Department of Homeland Security Data Privacy and Integrity Advisory Committee. He received his bachelor's degree in electrical engineering with high honors from the University of Florida, and a master's degree in electrical and computer engineering from the University of California, San Diego.

Mr. Jurgen Hornman serves as a Partner at Shell Ventures. He serves as an Advisor and Investment Committee Member at D2 (London). He served as Chief Financial Officer at Ledzworld. He served as Chairman at SteamaCo. He also served as a Board Member at GreenCom Networks. He served as a Board Member at WonderBill. He serves as a Board Member at Corvus Energy. He heads up the investment team in the UK and is responsible for managing and growing the Renewable Power & Heat portfolio within Shell Ventures, currently comprising over 40 direct investments and several fund investments. He has an extensive international background from investment banking in Merrill Lynch and Sequoia in London and has been actively investing in, managing, and advising global Clean Technology companies since 2009. Apart from his Board Director position at Corvus, he is Chair of the Board of SteamaCo Ltd and a member of the Board of Noova Energy AS' holding company, GreenCom Networks AG, and Net2Grid BV. He also chairs the LPAC of the Denham Sustainable Infrastructure Fund in the US and is an LP representative on behalf of Shell Ventures at Energy & Environment Investment Fund IV in Japan and D2 Fund I in the UK.

Mr. Matthew Carbonara serves as Managing Director, Venture Investing at Citi Ventures. He serves as Managing Director & Board Member at Stream.Security. He served as a Senior Director at Cisco Investments. He serves as Board Observer at Flybits. He is an Angel Investor. He is looking to meet entrepreneurs innovating in Enterprise IT, Cybersecurity, Customer Experience, and Marketing. He strives to create win-win scenarios that provide customer engagement and product feedback for high-potential startups while motivating innovation and business transformation for both Citi and its clients. Prior to Citi Ventures, he was at Cisco where he led investments and acquisitions in the areas of enterprise networking, collaboration, and IoT as well as in the country of Israel. He also has investment experience from Comcast Ventures and TeleSoft Partners. Prior to becoming a venture capitalist, he was employee 10 at Terayon Communication Systems, a Sequoia and Lightspeed-backed startup that went public, where he initially architected and designed application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs) before moving into product marketing and product management. He received his B.S. summa cum laude and M.S. in Electrical Engineering from The Ohio State University. Outside of investing he enjoys basketball, golf (one hole-in-one), wake surfing, and coaching his two daughters in sports.

primary_company: California State University San Marcos Foundation
primary_position: Board Member and Member of the Finance and Investment Committee
biography: Mr. Christian Tresse serves as Board Member and Member of the Finance and Investment Committee at California State University San Marcos Foundation. Mr. Tresse joined Bernstein in 2001 as a financial advisor in San Francisco. In 2005, he was made a principal of the firm and relocated to help launch the San Diego office. Advising families, foundations, and pension plans, Mr. Tresse works closely with clients on critical matters involving wealth management, asset allocation, estate planning, and the sale of privately held businesses. Previously, he was a director at Vividence, an Internet consulting firm venture-backed by Kleiner Perkins and Sequoia Capital, where he managed the strategic accounts division. Prior to that, Mr. Tresse managed the San Francisco office for Baseline Financial Services, an equity research firm serving institutional money managers. He serves as a trustee on the foundation board of Rady Children's Hospital, is a member of the Estate Planning Council of San Diego, and is past president of the La Jolla Estate Planning, Trust & Probate Section. He began his career with IBM as a marketing representative in the firm's New York banking office. Mr. Tresse earned a BS from Fairfield University in Connecticut with a major in computer science.

Mr. Daniel Feder serves as Senior Managing Director of Investments at the University of Michigan. He also serves as a Member of the Investment Committee at the Community Foundation for Southeast Michigan. Mr. Feder serves as a Member of the Advisory Board at Knightsbridge Advisers. Mr. Feder previously served as Managing Director at Washington University Investment Management Company. Mr. Feder served as Senior Investment Manager of Private Equity and Venture Capital at Covariance Capital Management. Most recently, he was the Managing Director of Private Markets for the Sequoia Capital Heritage Fund where he helped develop an endowment-style (multi-asset class) investment management service sponsored by Sequoia Capital. From 2000 to 2008, he was the Managing Director of private equity and venture capital with the Princeton University Investment Company ("Princo") - the investment office for Princeton University's endowment. At Princo, he led the development of a $4.0 billion global private equity and venture capital portfolio. He also led a wide range of private market investments at CIGNA Investment Management and CalPERS after serving as in-house counsel at CIGNA. He holds a B.A. cum laude in Political Science from the University of Massachusetts, a J.D. cum laude from the Boston University School of Law, and an M.A. in Economics from Trinity College. He is a Fellow of the American College of Investment Counsel and has earned the Chartered Financial Analyst designation.
Mr. Markus Giger serves as Board Member at Sequoia Treuhand Trust.

Dr. Anthony Tether serves as a Board Member at Aurora Flight Sciences. He serves as an Advisor at NextWave Ventures. Dr. Tether was the Director of the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) from 2001 to his retirement in 2009. Dr. Tether serves as a Managing Member and Member of the Executive Committee at Ellington Healthcare Partners. He serves as Senior Managing Director at Whitemarsh Capital. He was the Director of the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency (DARPA) from 2001 to his retirement in 2009. DARPA is the principal Agency within the Department of Defense for research, development, and demonstration of concepts, devices, and systems that provide highly advanced new technology capabilities. As Director, he was responsible for the management of the Agency's projects for high-payoff, innovative research, and development. Prior to DARPA, Dr. Tether held the position of Chief Executive Officer and President of The Sequoia Group, which he founded in 1996. Previously Dr. Tether served as Chief Executive Officer for Dynamics Technology Inc., the Vice President of Science Applications International Corporation's (SAIC) Advanced Technology Sector, the Vice President and General Manager for Range Systems at SAIC, and the Vice President for Technology and Advanced Development at Ford Aerospace Corp. (acquired by Loral Corporation). In addition, Dr. Tether also held positions in the Department of Defense, serving as Director of DARPA's Strategic Technology Office and as Director of National Intelligence in the Office of the Secretary of Defense. Dr. Tether also served as Executive Vice President of Systems Control Inc. In 2009, Secretary of Defense Robert Gates honored Dr. Tether with the Department of Defense Outstanding Public Service Medal. In 1986, Director Central Intelligence Bill Casey and Secretary of Defense Casper Weinberger honored him with the National Intelligence Medal and the Department of Defense Civilian Meritorious Service Medal respectively. Dr. Tether is a Life Member of the Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE). He has served on the Army, Navy, and Defense Science Boards, and on the Office of National Drug Control Policy Research and Development Committee.

Mr. Eric Lesieur serves as a Partner at Oloryn Partners. He is a Co-Founder and serves as Board Member at Sequoia. He served as a Managing Partner at EMCap Partners. He has extensive experience both in Private Equity and in managing retail companies. His Private Equity experience includes being a Principal at Apax Partners in Paris in the Retail Consumer Goods practice from 2000 to 2004. With Apax Partners, he worked on a significant number of potential transactions and played a major role in the execution of the Alain Afflelou investment (one of the French leading optical retailers).
Mr. Benjamin Weyerhaeuser serves as Board Member at Sequoia Foundation.
Mr. Brian Boyd serves as an Executive Director and Board Member at Forest Foundation. Mr. Boyd served as Executive Director at Sequoia Foundation.

Ms. Celia Arroyo serves as Board Member at Central Valley Community Foundation. Celia Maldonado-Arroyo has a long and distinguished career in education. She is retired from the position of Associate Dean of the Extended Opportunity Programs and Services (EOPS) at College of the Sequoias. Prior to her work at COS, she held positions with Fresno City College and Fresno Unified School District. Celia currently serves as a trustee of the Tulare County Board of Education, and as a charter member of the Tulare County Latino Rotary. Additionally, Celia has served as the State President of the Association of Mexican American Educators, and a board member of Radio Bilingue, the Tulare/Kings Hispanic Chamber of Commerce and United Way of Fresno, among others. Celia earned her Bachelor of Science degree in Office Administration and Master of Arts degree in Counseling and Guidance from California State University, Fresno.

primary_position: President and Treasurer of the Board
biography: Dr. Gail Weyerhaeuser serves as Board Member at Sequoia Foundation. Dr. Weyerhaeuser serves as President and Treasurer of the Board at Forest Foundation. She also serves as Vice Chairwoman and Treasurer of the Board of Directors at Stewardship Foundation. She also serves as President at Forest Foundation.

Mr. Jeffrey Skoll is the Founder & serves as Board Chair at The Skoll Foundation. He is also a Co-Founder of Capricorn Investment Group. Mr. Skoll is the Owner of Pacific Sequoia Holdings. Previously, he also served as the Chairman. He is a philanthropist and social entrepreneur, working to bring life to his vision of a sustainable world of peace and prosperity. As the first full-time employee and President of eBay, he developed the company's inaugural business plan and helped lead its successful initial public offering and the creation of the eBay Foundation. Over the last 15 years, he has created an innovative portfolio of philanthropic and commercial enterprises, each a distinctive social catalyst. Together, these organizations galvanize public will and mobilize critical resources to accelerate large-scale social impact. He created the Skoll Foundation in 1999 to pursue his vision of a more peaceful, prosperous, and sustainable world. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from the University of Toronto and an MBA from the Stanford Graduate School of Business. He was appointed an Officer of the Order of Canada in 2012. His other recent honors include a career tribute at the Gotham Independent Film Awards (2012) and the John W. Gardner Leadership Award (2012). He is also an Angel Investor.

Mr. Keith Johnson is the Founding Partner and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Sequoia Heritage. He serves as a Board Member at Brookfield Asset Management. Before founding the fund, he was a director at Stanford Management Company, where he managed an $8 billion portfolio of marketable securities and hedge funds. He also serves as Chief Executive Officer & Managing Member at SCHF (GPE). He contributed to the growth of the endowment from $9 billion to over $20 billion at the time of his departure. Before Stanford, he worked at the Toyota North America Pension Plan and as a senior equity research analyst at Bel Air Investment Advisors, a Los Angeles-based high-net-worth wealth advisory firm that managed $5 billion. He received an MBA from the Anderson School at UCLA and a BS in Statistics from Brigham Young University, where he also studied Japanese.

Ms. Anulika Malomo serves as a Board Member at Harbourvest Global Private Equity. She also serves as a Member of the Audit and Risk, Remuneration, Nomination, Management Engagement, and Service Provider Committees. She advises on impact investments across EMEA. She is also an independent non-executive director at Mid Wynd International Investment Trust PLC. She is the Founder of the Sequoia Platform, a leading educational not-for-profit focused on social mobility in the United Kingdom. She is currently a Venture Partner at Sagana Group, Chair of the Board of Governors at the University of East London, a role she has held since November 2019, and a Non-Executive Director at Advantage Creative CIC, an Impact Investment Fund. Before this, she spent 15 years working at several financial services businesses, including the Soros Economic Development Fund, The Carlyle Group, and Goldman Sachs International. In these roles, she gained significant experience in capital raising and investment across a variety of sectors. She has a Master's (MEng) in Medical Engineering from Queen Mary University of London and an MSc in Law and Finance from the University of Oxford.

Dr. Mark Machin is a Co-Founder & serves as Managing Partner at Intrepid Growth Partners. Dr. Machin previously served as President and Chief Executive Officer at the Canada Pension Plan Investment Board. He also co-founded Opto Investments and served as a Board Member at Serendipity Capital and CVC Capital Partners. Prior to joining CPPIB, he had a 20-year career at Goldman Sachs, where he was most recently Vice Chairman of Asia ex-Japan. He has been based in Asia for more than 20 years where, among other roles, he ran the Investment Banking Division of Goldman Sachs in Asia ex-Japan for six years. He studied undergraduate and graduate medicine and holds a BA in Physiological Sciences from Oriel College, Oxford University, and a BM BChir from Downing College, Cambridge University. He qualified as a medical doctor in 1990. After practicing medicine in the UK, in 1991 he joined Goldman Sachs in London in European Corporate Finance. Before founding Intrepid Growth Partners, Mark co-founded and was the founding CEO of Opto Investments, a software platform that raised a $145M series A and is using software to create a new market for investment advisors to access alternative investments. Mark served on the board of Sequoia Heritage and currently serves on GIC's International Advisory Board, Serendipity Capital, and is the Vice Chair of Opto Investments. He serves as Board Member at Skin Analytics.

Mr. Mickey Arabelovic is the Founder and serves as Managing Member at Telescope Partners. He is a Co-Founder of Fathom. He serves as Board Member at Hotel Engine. He served as Board Member at Topbox (United States). He serves as Board Member at Measured. He is the Founder of Telescope Partners. He served as a Board Member at Brandfolder. Mr. Arabelovic served as Partner at Sequoia Capital. Arabelovic focuses on software and services investments and serves as a Board Member at ZirMed. Prior to joining Sequoia Capital in 2007, he worked at Summit Partners where he was involved in investments in the financial services, consumer products and technology sectors. Earlier, he was an investment banker with Brown Gibbons Lang, where he worked on a variety of M&A, equity and debt transactions in the services sector. He has a BBA in Finance from the University of Michigan. He also serves as Board Member at HireVue and Medtrainer. He serves as Board Member at Fundraise Up.

Dr. Sandeep Singhal is a Co-Founder and currently serves as the Managing Partner at WestBridge Capital Partners. He also holds positions as a Board Member at IIT Delhi Endowment Management Foundation, Dealshare, LEAD School, and Fraazo. In the past, he served as a Board Member at DFM Foods Limited, Design Cafe, and Carzonrent India. Prior to these roles, he co-founded Sequoia Capital India and held the position of Managing Director. Additionally, he has served as the Managing Director at WestBridge Capital. Currently, He serves on the boards of Dr. Lal Path Labs Private Limited, Nazara Technologies Private Limited, People Interactive India Private Limited (shaadi.com), and WestBridge Capital India Advisors Pvt Ltd. He has previously served on the boards of Just Dial Private Limited, eClerx Services Ltd, Applabs Technologies Private Limited, Market Rx, Sequoia Capital India Advisors Pvt. Ltd, People Infocom Private Limited, GVK Biosciences Private Limited, What's on Media India Pvt Ltd, Stovekraft Pvt. Ltd, Strand Life Sciences Private Limited, Just Dial Global Pvt Ltd, Celon Laboratories Ltd, Market Rx, and Reametrix. Before his venture into the world of venture capital, he worked at The Boston Consulting Group (BCG), where he provided advisory services to several mid-market Indian companies, assisting them with their product and marketing strategies. Prior to his tenure at BCG, he was employed at Hindustan Lever Limited, where he played a pivotal role in launching eleven products targeting Indian consumer segments, significantly contributing to the company's business. He holds an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad, an MS in molecular simulation from the University of Illinois, and a B. Tech. in Chemical Engineering from IIT Delhi.

Mr. Sumir Chadha is a Co-Founder and serves as Managing Partner at WestBridge Capital Partners. He serves as Board Member at Rapido, LeadSquared, DuploCloud and Goldcast. He serves as a Board Member at Innovaccer. He also served as an Advisor at Paraclete Capital. Before this, he co-founded and was a Managing Director of Sequoia Capital India. He currently serves on the boards of SKS Micro Finance Limited and Vistaar Financial Services Private Limited. He has previously served on the boards of Sequoia Capital India Advisors Pvt.Ltd, Strand Life Sciences Private Limited, AppLabs Technologies Private Limited, Times Internet Limited, People Interactive (India) Pvt. Ltd, Minglebox Communications Pvt Ltd, India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd, Quick Heal Technologies Pvt Ltd, Star Health Investment Pvt Ltd, Star Health and Allied Insurance Co Ltd, Westbridge Advisors Private Limited, Cotton County Retail Limited, Intercept Technologies Pvt Ltd, Tarang Software Technologies Pvt Ltd, GlobalLogic Inc, Satellier, Guruji.com, Pangea3 Inc, Saffronart Management Corporation, SCIOinspire Holdings, Inc., Astra Business Services Inc, Workadia LLC, Zavata Inc, Celetronix Inc and Emagia Inc. He was earlier a part of the Principal Investment Area at Goldman Sachs & Co., based in New York and Singapore, where he focused on venture capital investments across the USA and India. He began his career as a management consultant at McKinsey & Co., based in New York and New Delhi. He served as the Chairman of the Indian Private Equity and Venture Capital Association (IVCA) from 2010-12 and currently serves on the India Advisory Board of Harvard Business School and on the Advisory Board of the Princeton Institute for International and Regional Studies. He has an MBA (with Distinction) from Harvard University and a BSE degree in Computer Science from Princeton University. He was a Board Member at Workadia. He also served as an Advisory Board Member at Granite Hill Capital Partners. He is representing WestBridge Capital Partner in Biz2Credit. He is a Board Member at Biz2Credit. He also served as Director of Kiwi General Insurance.

Mr. Todd Cozzens is a Co-Founder and serves as the Managing Partner of Transformation Capital. He serves as Board Member at CodaMetrix, DexCare, Vital, SWORD Health, and Memorial Health. He served as Advisor and Board Member at PatientPing. He was a Board Member of Natera, ZirMed.He served as Board Member at SCIO Health Analytics, PatientPop. He is a Co-Founder and serves as Managing Partner at Leerink Transformation Partners. Before forming LTP in 2016, he co-led healthcare investing at Sequoia Capital. He is a board member of current portfolio partner companies Health Catalyst, Outcome Health, and Kyruus (observer). He is also a board member of StemCentrx. He is a former board member of PerfectServe, MedExpress, and AirStrip. He sits on the executive committee of the InnerCity Scholarship Fund of Boston, as well as the Board of Overseers of Newton Wellesley Hospital. He is a member of the World Economic Forum's Technology Council. He completed a PMD (Professional Masters Degree) from Harvard Business School and a BA (Bachelor of Arts) from Marquette University. He served as Board Member at Memora Health.

Mr. Christopher Rivest serves as Board Member at GeologicAI. He serves as a Partner, at Breakthrough Energy Ventures at Breakthrough Energy. He serves as Chairman at Graphite. He serves as a Partner, of Breakthrough Energy Ventures at Breakthrough Energy. He serves as Chairman at ArkeaBio. He serves as a Board Member at Turntide Technologies. He also serves on the Board of Motif FoodWorks and Sustainable Bioproducts. He also serves as a Board Member at Alpine Bio. He has a particular focus on finding climate-tech companies that leverage modern technology mega-trends to accelerate the rate of development and deployment of innovative technologies and business models. He has 15 years of experience across multiple hardware and software technology startups in a wide variety of fields (solar energy, cancer genomics, synthetic biology, digital media). He has founded three companies, served in a multitude of executive roles (CEO, COO, Board Director, VP of Business Development, Head of R&D), and raised more than $70 million in venture capital from top-tier investors such as Sequoia Capital. A lover of "hard tech", he began his entrepreneurial career by founding Alion, a printed thin-film solar company that grew to more than 60 people and raised more than $50 million in venture capital. He then went on to help found Genome Compiler (acquired by Twist Biosciences), a synthetic biology software design platform for designing synthetic organisms. Most recently, he served as CEO of Life Code (acquired by Medgenome), an innovative cancer genomics company. He received his Bachelor of Science from MIT in Mechanical Engineering.

primary_position: Partner & Member of the Management Committee
biography: Mr. Trevor Magyar serves as a Partner & Member of the Management Committee at Ruane, Cunniff & Goldfarb. He is an analyst on the Sequoia team and sits on the strategy's Investment Committee. In addition, he is a co-Portfolio Manager of our Hyperion Strategy. He began his career as an analyst at Goldman Sachs and an associate at Hellman & Friedman. After business school, he worked as an analyst at Silver Point Capital before joining Ruane Cunniff in 2007. He graduated from Princeton University, Magna Cum Laude, with an AB in Economics and graduated from Harvard Business School with an MBA.

Mr. Brian Salmo serves as Chief Operating Officer at Herman Capital Management. He serves as a Board Member at Sequoia Vaccines. He focuses on sourcing, underwriting, and supporting the organization's direct investments. He serves as a Board Member at Solis Agrosciences. Before joining Hermann, He was an executive at LMI Aerospace, where he held multiple roles, including General Counsel, Vice President of Human Resources, and Business Unit leader overseeing a multi-site profit and loss. He began his career as a corporate attorney at Polsinelli PC, working on mergers and acquisitions, venture capital, and other complex transactions. He serves on the Board of Directors of Great Circle and the Chancellor's Council at the University of Missouri-St. Louis. He earned a BSBA in Finance from the University of Missouri, St. Louis, and a Juris Doctorate from Southern Illinois University.

Mr. Bryant Hayward serves as Managing Partner at North West Quadrant Ventures. He serves as a Board Member at Delwik Group. He serves as a Board Venture Advisor at the Family Office Association. He has served as Senior Vice President at Morgan Stanley was an LP at Sequoia Capital and worked at 500 Startups.

Mr. Giles Somerville serves as Partner at KG Investments. He has over 20 years of experience investing in and directing early stage private companies. Mr. Somerville is a Partner at KG Investments a family office that invests primarily in technology companies via direct investments and secondary loans; notable early stage investments include Facebook, JD.com, Alibaba, Flipkart, Lifelock, Linkedin, Lyft, Unicorn Media, NJOY, Dollar Shave Club and many more. Mr. Somerville is also the Managing Partner at Clearview Investment Partners, which raises institutional capital for niche hedge funds and private equity firms and is an affiliate of Bluesand Securities. He also serves as Partner at Astrol Ventures. Formerly Mr. Somerville was Managing Partner & Co-Founder of Milestone Equity Partners - one of the most successful accelerator/venture funds of its vintage year 2001. Milestone built a portfolio of over 40 early stage companies; notable companies include: Plaxo, Limelight Networks, Trust Digital, Secure Software, Olive Software, Airdesk. Notable follow on investors in portfolio companies: Sequoia Capital, Kleiner Perkins Caufield & Byers, Goldman Sachs Partner Fund, Oak Ventures, Palo Alto Ventures, Charles River, Harbinger, Globespan, Cisco, Comcast, DAG amongst others. Mr. Somerville spent the first ten years of his career working with Wall Street firms including Bear Stearns and Paine Webber. Mr. Somerville has extensive public speaking background and has appeared on both FOX News & ABC News multiple times. He splits his time between Scottsdale Arizona and NYC.

Mr. Kanarath Balaraj is the Founder of KPB Family Trust. Mr. Balaraj serves as Board Member at Aptus Value Housing. He is an Angel Investor. He serves as Executive at Waimea Bay Investments. He was the Co-founder and Managing Director of WestBridge Capital and co-led the firm from inception for almost two decades. He was also the co-founder and Managing Director of Sequoia Capital India from 2006-2010. Before that, he was part of Goldman Sachs where he focused on private equity in Asia. He received his MBA from Harvard Business School and a BSc in Business Management from Brigham Young University, Hawaii, where he graduated as the valedictorian of his class. He completed his schooling at Madras Christian School, Chennai. As an accomplished top-ranked national tennis player, he had represented India at the international level. He currently serves on the advisory board of Harvard University's Mittal South Asia Institute and is an active supporter of non-profit organizations in India focused on underprivileged and orphaned children. He is also an active promoter of Karnataka State Lawn Tennis Association's (KSLTA) Wheelchair Tennis. He was also selected as part of PM Modi's distinguished "Champions of Change", and was honored for his contributions to the growth of venture capital and the startup industry in India.

Mr. Mark Stevens is the Founder and serves as Managing Partner at S-Cubed Capital. Mr. Stevens serves as Board Member, Member of the Audit Committee, and Member of the Nominating and Governance Committee at Nvidia. He is a Co-Owner of Golden State Warriors. He served as a Board Member at Golden State Warriors. He served as a Board Member at Quantenna Communications. He is an Angel Investor. He served as a Board Member at Innovium. He is a special limited partner and former Managing Partner at Sequoia Capital, a global venture capital firm based in Menlo Park, CA. He joined Sequoia in 1989 as an associate and became a partner in 1993. Before Sequoia, he was employed at Intel Corporation from 1982 to 1987 in a variety of sales positions. He began his career as a member of the technical staff at Hughes Aircraft Company from 1980 to 1982. He earned a B.S. in Electrical Engineering and a B.A. in Economics (both magna cum laude) from the University of Southern California (USC) in 1981, an M.S. in Computer Engineering from USC in 1984, and an MBA from Harvard University in 1989.

Mr. Rick Holton served as Chief Operating Officer at Herman Capital Management. He serves as a Board Member at AllWork, Decusoft, and Sequoia Vaccines. He serves as Executive at JAM FINTOP. He served as a Board Member at Bridge Financial Technology. He served as a Board Member at Transactly. He is a founding Partner at FINTOP Capital and COO of Hermann Companies. He serves on the boards of Arch Design, BridgeFT, CoverCress, Decusoft, Denim Social, EmpowerMe, InsurePay, KnowInk, SMArtX, and YPO St. Louis. He also serves as a Board Member at Knowing.

primary_position: Chief Executive Officer and Board Member
biography: Mr. Dirk Brouwer is a Co-Founder and served as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at ASA International. He has since served as the company's Executive Director. He is also the Managing Director of Catalyst Microfinance Investors, which he co-founded in 2006. With over 20 years of experience in investment banking, and 11 in microfinance, he has held several senior and supervisory positions, having acted as a board member of CMI and Founder and Managing Director of Sequoia which he founded in 2002. Prior to this, he spent 14 years working at Merrill Lynch and PaineWebber.

Mr. Joseph Airoso serves as Board Member at AgWest Farm Credit. Mr. Airoso owns and operates Airoso Dairy Farms in Pixley and Tulare, California, where he produces dairy (Registered Holstein and Jersey cows), corn, wheat, alfalfa, and pistachios. He is a Board Member of the California Farm Bureau Federation, Tule Land and Water Trust, College of the Sequoias Ag Advisor, Pixley Irrigation GSA, and Land O'Lakes Region 80 Representative. He also serves on the Southern California Gas Community Advisory Committee and the National Dairy Shrine board.

Mr. Vijay Parikh serves as a Board Member at Global Catalyst Foundation. Mr. Parikh served as Managing Principal at Global Catalyst Partners. He served as a Board Member at KargoCard. He has experience as both a successful start-up CEO and an established company executive. He served as president and CEO of StratumOne Communications, founded in 1997, which Cisco Systems acquired in 1999 for $435 million, Cisco's most expensive acquisition to that date. StratumOne developed framers and layer 2/3 engines for 10G solutions in high-end routing/switching applications and was funded by Sequoia Capital, Brentwood Capital, Institutional Venture Partners, and Redwood Ventures. Following the acquisition, Mr. Parikh served as Cisco's Public Carrier IP Group vice-president and general manager. He was responsible for developing and introducing the 10G solution on the 12416 GSR platform, which drove sales from $400 million in FY 1998 to several billion dollars in FY 2001. Before StratumOne, Mr. Parikh was VP/GM of Conexant's Wireless Communications Division, growing revenue from zero to $180 million in programs comprising all key wireless technologies (GSM, CDMA, TDMA, Spread Spectrum, PHS, DECT, and PDC). He previously held several other VP/GM positions at Conexant, including the Personal Computing Division (programs in software modems, PC audio, and xDSL) and the Global Positioning System Division (multichannel GPS integration with wireless data systems, including those for ARDIS, CDPD, and Mobitex). He also held several management positions at Conexant's Japanese Operations facility. He also holds a BS (Bachelor of Science) in Electrical Engineering from Birla Institue of Technology and an MBA (Master of Business Administration) in Accounting and Finance from the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor.

primary_position: Member Interlink Executive Management and Global Investment Committee
biography: Mr. Safi Qureshey serves as Member Interlink Executive Management and Global Investment Committee at Interlink Group (Los Angeles). He served as Advisor at iSnap. He also serves as Executive Management and Global Investment Committee at Interlink Group. He is co-founder and former Chairman and CEO of AST Research, Inc., which he founded in his garage and took public in 1984. AST Research had over 6,000 employees and sales of over $2.5 billion as a Fortune 500 company and ranked as the 4th largest PC manufacturer in the world before it was acquired by Samsung Electronics in 1997. With over 30 years investment experience, as a private investor where he was a founding investor, together with Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia Capital, Trinity Ventures, and St. Paul Venture Capital, in several companies. Former member of President Clinton's Export Council. Former Regent's professor at the University of California-Irvine and founding member and former president of the Southern California chapter of TIE (The Indus Entrepreneurs). He was named by California Governor Arnold Schwarzenegger to his transition team. An active philanthropist in education and a member of the board of trustees of the Give2Asia Foundation. Mr. Qureshey is a sought after Thought leader on technology and entrepreneurship by governments worldwide.

Mr. Henri Cournand serves as Chief Transformation Officer at Sequoia Benefits & Insurance Services. Mr. Henri Cournand serves as Chief Financial Officer at SemperVirens Venture Capital. He also serves as Board Member at TriWest Healthcare Alliance. He served as Chief Financial Officer & Senior Vice President at Blue Cross Blue Shield of Kansas City. He leads strategic initiatives to drive innovation, enhance operational efficiency, and foster organizational growth. He is responsible for spearheading transformative projects and aligning cross-functional teams to achieve Sequoia's long-term vision.

Mr. Andrew Blazenko is a Co-Founder and serves as Board Member at Eterna Equity. He served as Partner at Sequoia Mergers & Acquisitions. He has dedicated his career to mergers and acquisitions, starting in 2009 with roles in small business valuation and corporate finance at a public company. In 2013, he transitioned to sell-side advisory, specializing in businesses valued between $5 million and $300 million. During this time, he became a partner in the firm, honing his expertise in identifying what makes businesses attractive to buyers. In 2017, while continuing his M&A advisory work, he began acquiring businesses on the side, targeting high-margin, niche opportunities. His investments include a property services company, a mechanical engineering firm, and a first-aid training school. These acquisitions, combined with his extensive advisory experience, led to the founding of Eterna Equity with Michael and Josh. Today, he focuses on acquiring and growing enduring, profitable businesses. He holds a degree from the Beedie School of Business at Simon Fraser University and is both a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) and a Chartered Business Valuator (CBV).

Mr. Anish Jain serves as Chief Executive Officer at Equitane. He serves as Board Member at Sequoia Plantation. He has 20 years of experience. He earned his degree in Bachelor of Arts in Economics and Accounts and completed Master of Business Administration.

Ms. Anjana Sasidharan serves as Partner at L Catterton. She serves as Partner at L Catterton Asia. She serves as Board Member at Curatio Healthcare. She serves as Board Member at Fab Bag. She serves as Board Member at Zenyum. She joins L Catterton after nearly a decade at Sequoia Capital, where she led numerous marquee transactions for the firm. She brings deep expertise in investing in early-stage, fast-growing, and disruptive companies across a number of consumer categories, with particular experience in the healthcare space. Ms. Sasidharan began her career at McKinsey & Company in India. She received an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad and a bachelor's degree in engineering from the National Institute of Technology in Trichy.

Mr. Christopher Brady is a Co-Founder & serves as Partner at Chart National. He served as Director at Genesis Today. He serves as Board Member at Sequoia Holdings (Herndon). He served as Chairman at Chart Capital Partners. He was also a Board Member at IntegriCo Composites, Sequoia Holdings (software and cloud engineering services). He was also a Co-Founder and served as Managing Partner at Chart Venture Partners. He served as a Board Member at PacStar. He founded The Chart Group in 1994. With over 25 years of experience in private equity, corporate finance, and capital markets, Chris focuses on identifying and building portfolio companies through his extensive industry relationships and perspective. Prior to Chart, Chris spent fourteen years in the Corporate Finance and Capital Markets Departments of Lehman Brothers and Dillon Read. He earned his B.A. from Middlebury College and his M.B.A. from Columbia University Graduate School of Business. He has been actively involved in channeling the resources of the business community to assist with DoD-related initiatives. Over the last several years, he has organized a venture capital team with an affiliate of the US Army to commercialize their technologies and bring better commercial technologies to the warfighter; assumed a prominent leadership role with Wounded Warriors/DSUSA, a foundation dedicated to working with injured soldiers; and served as a member of the Transition Team for the US Army Secretary Dr. Francis Harvey. He has served in senior management positions in numerous New Jersey political campaigns.

Mr. Craig Stern serves as General Partner at Riverside Partners. He serves as Board Member at Syner-G BioPharma Group. He serves as Board Member at Sequoia Consulting Group. Prior to joining Riverside, he was Vice President, Corporate Development at Nextag, a technology and e-commerce company, where he was responsible for acquisitions. Before joining Nextag, he was a Vice President at Providence Equity Partners, where he focused on investments in the digital media and online areas. Prior to Providence Equity, he was an investment professional at General Atlantic Partners, where he focused on investments in enterprise software, professional services, and digital media. Before General Atlantic, he worked in the telecommunications group within the investment banking division of Morgan Stanley.

Mr. Guhan Swaminathan is a Co-Founder & serves as Managing Director at Virgo Capital. Mr. Swaminathan also serves as the Managing Director at Sayers Group. He served as a Board Member at Kovair Software. He served as Board Member at Korbyt. He is involved with all aspects of the Firm's investments and leads deal screening and evaluation. Prior to establishing Virgo Capital, Guhan was a Principal at WestBridge Capital Partners (now Sequoia Capital India), a leading private equity fund dedicated to US-India investments. As one of the initial members of the WestBridge team, Guhan led five investments in the outsourced services and technology industries, including in AppLabs, which was acquired by CSC. Previously, Guhan worked in the New York and Tokyo offices of Goldman Sachs and focused on various types of transactions including private equity investments, asset securitizations, and balance sheet optimizations.

Mr. Matthew Mazzeo served as General Partner at Coatue Management. He serves as Board Member at Ranker. He served as Board Member at Waggle. He served as Managing Director at Lowercase Capital. Known in both the media and technology worlds as an accomplished advisor and incubator of talent and ideas, Matt is Managing Director at Lowercase Capital leading a seed and series A investment strategy into consumer web, mobile, and wireless technology start-ups. Focused on helping entrepreneurs build early-stage technology companies, Matt manages a portfolio of over forty investments at the forefront of technology and media including Uber, Twitter, Stripe, Optimizely, Artillery Games, StyleSeat, Mark43, Makespace, and VHX. Prior to joining Lowercase Capital, Matt spearheaded many of his digital and venture efforts at Creative Artists Agency (CAA), the world's leading entertainment and sports agency. Matt helped shape the agency's seed stage investment strategy and played an integral role in the founding of CAA's incubated start-up companies, including Funny or Die, WhoSay, and Moonshark. Along the way, Matt recruited top talent, built out operating models, and helped raise capital from top institutional partners including Greylock Partners, Sequoia Capital, Amazon, Qualcomm, Comcast Ventures, and Tencent. Beyond his work in Hollywood, Matt established much of CAA's presence in Silicon Valley, integrating technology into entertainment, and helping talent navigate the world of entrepreneurship. In the course of that work, Matt became a trusted voice on the evolution of digital media and helped sign and represent many of the world's largest technology brands including Google, Cisco, Tencent, and Amazon. Throughout his career, Matt has represented and advised top talent in television, film, fashion, music, and sports on their content deals in digital, social media, and mobile distribution. As part of these efforts, he has helped broker millions of dollars in financing for original content with major digital platforms including YouTube, Netflix, Hulu, and Yahoo! In addition, for his clients like Phil Defranco, Michelle Phan, and Kevin Wu, he helped extend their massive YouTube platforms into television, publishing, licensing, and endorsement deals. With a unique and diverse background placing him at the juncture of several industries, Matt has been recognized as an innovative force across technology, entertainment, and advertising for which Fast Company named Matt one of the Most Creative People in Business. In addition to making Forbes Midas Brink List in 2014, Matt has been recognized on both Ad Age's 40 Under 40 List in 2013, and The Wrap's Inaugural Innovators List. In 2013, Fast Company featured Matt as one of the "Rebels Saving Hollywood" and he is a powerful voice on the future of technology and media. Matt is a fixture at tech, media, and advertising events and regularly speaks at industry-leading conferences including SXSW, TechCrunch Disrupt, Ad Age Digital Conference, Vidcon, and many others. Matt received his bachelor's degree from Harvard University in 2005.

Mr. Scott Carter serves as an Operating Partner & Board Member at Crux Capital (Dallas). He brings extensive experience in venture capital, private equity, and entrepreneurship. For ten years, he was a General Partner at legendary venture capital firm Sequoia Capital in Silicon Valley where he helped launch and co-lead Sequoia's late-stage venture funds. Before Sequoia Capital, he was a Vice President at Summit Partners, where he specialized in financial services and technology sectors. Earlier in his career, he was an associate in the investment banking division of JP Morgan and served in various staff positions for a United States Senator. He is a private investor and mentor. Since 2023, he has also taught undergraduate finance courses at Vanderbilt University. His diverse background and strategic insight help Uncommon Brands' CEO execute successful investments, build infrastructure, and accelerate growth at emerging brands. He received an MBA from the University of Virginia's Darden School of Business. He also received a Bachelor's Degree in Political Science from Texas A&M University.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Operating Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Adam Rand is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Operating Officer and Board Member at Sequoia Holdings. Mr. Rand business leader and database engineer with over 20 years of experience in the national security sector. He leverages strong communication and people skills to both lead day-to-day administration and operations and also drives new growth.

Mr. Anandamoy Roychowdhary served as a Partner, Surge at Peak XV Partners. He serves as a Board Member & Investor at ChistaDATA. He serves as a Board Member at Qure.ai. He serves as an Advisor at Canary Mail. He serves as an Investment Advisor at Soji. He served as a Technical Advisor at Druva. His role is to advise current startups on their technology issues. Before joining Sequoia Capital, Roy was the head of product development for Zcloud Engineering at Zynga, where he ran a global team of engineers and product management to develop the backend technologies that powered Zynga's private cloud. He also worked at several technology startups in the valley and Boston in the areas of Security and Storage. Roy has a bachelor of engineering degree in Computer Science from the Pune Institute of Computer Technology. Mr. Roychowdhary serves as a Board Member & Investor at ChistaDATA. He served as a Board Member at Mad Street Den.

primary_position: Chief Financial Officer, Company Secretary & Board Member
biography: Mr. Andrew Phillips serves as Chief Financial Officer, Company Secretary & Board Member at Lithium Power International. Over 25 years of commercial, financial, and corporate governance experience internationally. He previously held senior management and board positions in several public and multinational companies including Aristocrat, Allianz, Hoya Lens, and Sequoia Financial Group, and has additional board experience in the small-cap resources sector. He is also the CFO and Company Secretary of LPI.

Mr. Andy Asava serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at SpinSci Technologies. Previously, he served as Chief Strategy Officer at the company. He served as Executive Vice President Global Networks at InfoVista. Over the past 30 years, he has directed global strategic initiatives across the globe, playing a leadership role at a wide range of companies throughout the telecommunications space, from start-ups to major global enterprises. Before Joining InfoVista in 2017, he drove enterprise sales growth at GENBAND as the Senior Vice President of Enterprise Sales. Prior to this, he was the Vice President of Worldwide Sales and Business Development at Sipera Systems, a Sequoia-backed Unified Communication Security company, which was acquired by Avaya.

Mr. Antonius Kufferath serves as Board Member at VitalConnect. Antonius is a partner in Acacia, an investment partnership that invests in private and public equities worldwide. He is also a member of the investment team at Ruane, Cunniff & Goldfarb, the New York-based investment firm known for managing the Sequoia mutual fund. Mr. Kufferath joined Acacia and Ruane, Cunniff in 2014 and focuses on investing in industrial and technology companies in Europe and the Americas. Earlier in his career, Mr. Kufferath worked in strategy & business development for a public US industrial company, and as a consultant for a leading strategy consulting firm. Mr. Kufferath received an M.Phil. with distinction in Modern Chinese Studies from Oxford University. He also received a B.S.F.S. magna cum laude, Phi Beta Kappa, in International Relations from Georgetown University. A native German speaker, he is also fluent in Portuguese and French. He has been published in the Financial Times and the Frankfurter Allgemeine Zeitung.

Mr. Arman Gokgol-Kline is the Founder of The Vale Fox Distillery. Mr. Gokgol-Kline serves as Partner & Member of the Management Committee at Ruane, Cunniff & Goldfarb. He is an analyst on the Sequoia team and sits on the strategy's Investment Committee. He joined Ruane Cunniff in December 2002, after spending two years at Merrill Lynch as an analyst in Alternative Investments and later Global Equity Research. He graduated from Colby College with a BA in Economics and Biology.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer, President & Board Member
biography: Mr. Assaf Resnick is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer, President & Board Member at BigPanda. Mr. Resnick is an Angel Investor. Prior to founding BigPanda, Mr. Resnick was an investor at Sequoia Capital, where he focused on early and growth stage investing in software, internet and mobile sectors. Assaf's time at Sequoia gave him a front row seat into the challenges of IT scale, complexity and velocity that Operations teams faced within companies that were rapidly scaling and accelerating. This is the problem that Assaf founded BigPanda to solve. Assaf Holds a B.S. degree in Business Administration from the Haas School of Business at UC Berkeley.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer, President & Chairman
biography: Dr. Bernard Gilly is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman at BrainEver. iHe s a Co-Founder and serves as Chairman at Prophesee. He is a Co-Founder and serves as Chairman of the Board of Directors at Chronolife. He co-founded and served as the Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at GenSight Biologics. He is a Co-Founder and serves as the Chairman at iBionext. He serves as Chairman & President at Tilak Healthcare. He co-founded and served as President and Chairman at GrAI Matter Labs. He serves as Board Member at T-Heart. He Co-Founded TISSIUM. He launched the iBionext ecosystem in 2012 by successfully co-founding several high-potential healthcare start-ups. He is currently the non-executive chairman of five companies. Prior to that, Bernard was Chairman and CEO of Fovea Pharmaceuticals, a biotech company he founded in 2005 and sold to Sanofi in 2009 for €370m before becoming Senior VP of the Ophthalmology Division of Sanofi until 2012. From 2000 to 2005, Bernard was a Partner at Sofinnova Partners. He founded and invested in several companies, including Sequoia Pharmaceuticals (USA), Faust Pharmaceuticals (France, now Domain Therapeutics), and Cellzome (Germany). Prior to joining Sofinnova, Bernard was President and CEO of Transgene, a company he drove from its early financing round in 1994 to its dual listing on the Nasdaq and the Nouveau Marché (Now Euronext-C) in1998, successfully raising €160m. Before Transgene, Bernard spent 6 years as VP of R&D at Pasteur-Mérieux-Connaught, now Sanofi Pasteur. As a result of his scientific background and his career in the biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and medical sciences as well as in Private Equity, Bernard Gilly has a very wide range of experience to manage iBionext and maximize the fund's value creation. He holds degrees from Université de Rennes and Ecole Nationale d'Agronomie. He previously served as a Board Member at Kala Pharmaceuticals. He serves as Board Member at Domain Therapeutics.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Bradley Menezes is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Superblocks. Mr. Menezes serves as Advisor at Bigeye. Prior to co-founding Superblocks, he was a lead product manager at Yelp and senior director of product management at Datadog, as well as an angel investor in enterprise startups at Sequoia.

Mr. Brian Long is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Adaptive. Mr. Long is a Co-Founder and serves as Executive Chairman and Board Member at Attentive. Prior to founding Adaptive, he started two prior software companies: Attentive and TapCommerce. Under his leadership, Attentive has grown to $500M in annual revenue with more than 8000 customers and 1,000 employees. He raised $900 Million in venture capital from Sequoia Capital and other leading firms. Previously, he co-founded and sold TapCommerce to Twitter, where he worked as a Senior Director. He is a graduate of the University of Pennsylvania and is currently on permanent leave from the NYU Stern School of Business.
Ms. Corinne Dumont is a Co-Founder of Sequoia Bio & Natural Market and he previously served as its Managing Director. He serves as Advisor & Investment Committee Member at The Blueprint VC.

primary_position: Founder, Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Craig Hunter is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Covalent Metrology. He served as a Senior Vice President of Global Sales & Marketing at Intermolecular. He initially worked in corporate development, finance, and strategy, with stints as an M&A banker on Wall Street and as CFO of a small consumer products company. He rediscovered his Silicon Valley roots in 2003, taking a business strategy role at the display division of Applied Materials. In 2005, he became the founding General Manager and later Managing Director of Applied Materials' solar PV factory product ("SunFab"). He joined Sequoia Capital in 2008 as an entrepreneur-in-residence focused on renewable energy technologies, and the next year he joined Intermolecular (NASDAQ: IMI) to establish and lead that company's clean energy technology group. He received an A.B. in East Asian Studies from Harvard College and graduated with high distinction from Harvard Business School.

Mr. Daniel Batelka serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Sequoia Holdings. He is an accomplished leader with over 20 years of experience working in the Defense sector. He focuses on developing and executing strategies to take the company to the next level while navigating the constantly changing national security and defense government sectors.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. David Connors is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at The Swarm. He co-founded and served as Chief Executive Officer at Automately. He also served as the Advisor at Advantary. His prior experience includes Sequoia Capital, he co-founded and serves as CEO at Automately.io (acquired by Sequoia), he also co-founded RevDev.io (Revenue Development advisory)

Mr. David Henshall serves as Chief Financial Officer & Senior Vice President at Sequoia Software. He served as an Advisor at Citrix Systems. He also served as the Board Member at Aspen Technology. He is a board member at Feedzai. Currently, he serves as Co-Chairman at Everbridge. He served as a Board Member at New Relic. He served as Chief Financial Officer & Senior Vice President at XenSource. He joined Citrix in 2003 and oversaw the company's worldwide finance, operations, and administration organizations. This includes corporate accounting, strategic development, planning, treasury, tax, audit, and investor relations. He also leads the information security, IT, business operations, and real estate teams at Citrix. Over the last 13 years, he has focused on building a balanced portfolio of growth investments, maintaining a scalable operational infrastructure, and ensuring disciplined financial decision-making. With 25 years of management experience in the technology sector, he has worked at several of the industry's leading companies. Before joining Citrix, he served as the Chief Financial Officer of Rational Software Corporation, a software company acquired by IBM Corporation in 2003, and also held various finance positions at Cypress Semiconductor and Samsung. He is also a member of the Board of Directors of LogMeIn.

Mr. David Shepard serves as Chief Operating Officer at Marki Microwave. Mr. Shepard serves as Board Member at Ventiva. He had served as Vice President and General Manager, High Performance Solutions Business Unit at pSemi since April 2010. From October 2003 to August 2009, Mr. Shepard served as President and Chief Executive Officer of Sequoia Communications, an early stage company specializing in RF transceivers for mobile handsets. Prior to that, he held various positions at Texas Instruments, including General Manager of the Wireless Infrastructure Business Unit. Mr. Shepard received a B.A. from Lawrence University and an M.S.E.E. from the University of Wisconsin, Madison.Mr. David Shepard serves as Chief Operating Officer at Marki Microwave.

Mr. Don Vieira serves as Board Member at Genuity Science. He is global chief legal officer and partner with Sequoia Capital. He serves as the Board Member at National Venture Capital Association. Before joining Sequoia, he was a partner in the Washington, D.C. office of Skadden Arps Slate Meagher & Flom, where he was recognized as a global leader in the area of national security and regulatory law. Prior to joining Skadden, he founded and led Wilson Sonsini Goodrich & Rosati Committee on Foreign Investment in the United States (CFIUS) and national security practice. He began his legal career as an associate at the law firm of Williams & Connolly, where he focused on litigation, white-collar criminal defense, and Foreign Corrupt Practices Act investigations.

Mr. Eric Winsborrow serves as Board Member at MailChannels. He served as Chief Executive Officer at Distrix. Eric has over 25 years of senior-level Silicon Valley experience introducing disruptive new products and technologies. Most recently, Eric was a founder and CEO of Shadow Networks, a DOD sponsored cyber security company leveraging Software Defined Technology to create a new category of security termed Deception Networks. Previously, Eric was Vice President of Product Marketing for McAfee, where he conceived and executed the most successful product launch in company history, Total Protection Solutions. He also ran Product Management for Symantec's flagship enterprise client and server security, a $450M portfolio introducing Symantec Client Security and other 1.0 security solutions, and led Product Management for Cisco's Unified Communications Software Business Unit in the beginning days VoIP technology. Eric also has extensive startup experience. He was Chief Marketing Officer for a Sequoia Capital startup, Sipera Systems (acquired by Avaya); CMO for Layer 7 Technologies (acquired by Computer Associates); Executive Director of Product Management at Sygate Technologies (acquired by Symantec) and Director of Business Development at Octel Communications (acquired by Lucent). Eric conducted his undergraduate studies in Engineering Physics and Economics at McMaster University in Canada, and completed his MBA in International Business and Marketing at IIST in Japan.

Dr. Fei-Fei Li served as a Board Member at X (Social/Platform Software). Dr. Li serves as Advisor at Waabi. She is a Co-Founder and serves as AI Strategist at Astrocade. She is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at World Labs. She serves as an Advisor at Twelve Labs. Previously, she served as Member of the Compensation & Risk Committee at X Corp. She also serves as a Scientific Partner at Radical Ventures. Dr. Li is a Co-Founder of DawnLight. She served as Chief Scientist, Google Cloud AI and Machine Learning at Google Cloud Platform. She served as an Advisor at Zebra Medical Vision and Vianai. She also serves as a board member at Nimble Robotics. She is a world-renowned technologist and thought leader, bringing her deep expertise in AI, technology and digital healthcare, as well as her decades-long leadership experiences to Dawnlight. Dr. Li is an elected Member of both the National Academy of Engineering (NAE) and the National Academy of Medicine (NAM). She Li is the inaugural Sequoia Professor in the Computer Science Department at Stanford University and Co-Director of Stanford's Human-Centered AI Institute. She served as the Director of Stanford's AI Lab from 2013 to 2018. And during her sabbatical at Stanford from January 2017 to September 2018, she was Vice President at Google and served as Chief Scientist of AI/ML at Google Cloud, overseeing all of Google Cloud AI's R&D and productization. She worked with team members, including Jia Li, to democratize AI technologies to businesses and their billions of customers. She has been a valued advisor to numerous startups, ventures, and Board members of companies. She is also a co-founder and chairperson of the national non-profit AI4ALL aimed at increasing inclusion and diversity in AI education and has been a leading voice in advocating diversity and inclusion in STEM fields nationally.
