Her current research interests include cognitively inspired AI, machine learning, deep learning, computer vision and AI+healthcare. In AI and Healthcare. Dr. Li is a keynote speaker at many academic or influential conferences, including the World Economic Forum (Davos), the Grace Hopper Conference 2017 and the TED2015 main conference. Work from Dr. Li's lab has been featured in a variety of magazines and newspapers including the New York Times, Wall Street Journal, Fortune Magazine, Science, Wired Magazine, MIT Technology Review, Financial Times and more. She was selected as a 2017 Women in Tech by ELLE Magazine, a 2017 Awesome Women Award by Good Housekeeping, a Global Thinker of 2015 by Foreign Policy and one of the "Great Immigrants: The Pride of America" in 2016 by the Carnegie Foundation, past winners include Albert Einstein, Yoyo Ma, Sergey Brin, et al. She also served as Director at Reinvent Technology Partners.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Operating Officer & Board Member
biography: Dr. Gary Altman is a Co-Founder & serves as Chief Operating Officer and Board Member at TeamedOn. Dr. Altman served as Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at Sandstone. He served as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Provista Diagnostics. He served as Chief Executive Officer at IGF Oncology. Dr. Gary served as Chief Operating Officer at Human Longevity. Gary has more than 25 years of experience in leading start-ups and global businesses from concept through commercialization. His experience includes roles as Chief Executive Officer, Chief Operating Officer, Vice President, and General Manager. Gary co-founded and served as Chief Operating Officer of a VC-backed drug discovery company which raised $60M and advanced 2 drug candidates into human clinical trials. As General Manager of a global business within a public corporation, he had P&L responsibility for $200M. Altman has initiated and led highly productive relationships with diverse constituencies including academia, non-profits, and industry. Gary's experience spans a broad spectrum of technologies including cell therapy, therapeutics, and diagnostics. He holds a Ph.D. (Doctor of Philosophy) in Biochemistry and Molecular Biology from the University of Western Ontario. He also has an MS (Master of Science) in Biology from Georgia Tech University. He is an investor, entrepreneur, and leader of large and small scientific organizations. His experiences include senior management positions at Beckman Coulter, Sequoia Pharmaceuticals, and Sandstone Diagnostics as well as an advisor to GE Healthcare, Terumo-CaridianBCT, and GenVec among others. He earned a Ph.D. in biochemistry/virology and held an NSF Post-Doctoral Fellowship in the BioPhysics and McArdle Laboratories at the University of Wisconsin, Madison.

Mr. Hassan Baqar serves as Chief Financial Officer at Insurance Income Strategies. Mr. Baqar is a Co-Founder & serves as Partner at Fundamental Global. Mr. Baqar has over 20 years of experience within financial services and other industries focused on corporate development, mergers & acquisitions, capital raising, investments, and real estate transactions. Mr. Baqar has served as the founder and managing member of Sequoia Financial LLC, a financial services and advisory firm, since January 2019. Mr. Baqar has also served as Chief Financial Officer since August 2021 and Executive Vice President since December 2021 of FG Financial Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: FGF) (formerly known as 1347 Property Insurance Holdings, Inc.), which operates as a reinsurance and asset management holding company, as Chief Financial Officer of Insurance Income Strategies Ltd., a former Bermuda based reinsurance company from October 2017 to December 2021, as a director of GreenFirst Forest Products Inc. (TSXV: GFP) (formerly Itasca Capital Ltd.), a public company focused on investments in the forest products industry from August 2019 to December 2021 and as Chief Financial Officer of GreenFirst Forest Products Inc. from June 2016 to December 2020, as a director of FG Reinsurance Ltd., a Cayman Islands reinsurance company since June 2020, as director, treasurer and secretary of Sponsor Protection Coverage and Risk, Inc., a South Carolina captive insurance company since October 2022, and as a director and Chief Financial Officer of Unbounded Media Corporation from June 2019 to September 2023. Since October 2021, Mr. Baqar has also served as the Chief Financial Officer and a member of the board of directors of FG Acquisition Corp. (TSX: FGAA.U), a Canadian special purpose acquisition company that has completed its initial public offering and is focused on searching for a target company in the financial services sector. Mr. Baqar served as a director of FG Merger Corp. (Nasdaq: FGMCU) from December 2021 to August 2023, a special purpose acquisition company that merged with iCoreconnect Inc. (Nasdaq: ICCT), a market-leading, cloud-based software, and technology company focused on increasing workflow productivity and customer profitability through its enterprise and healthcare workflow platform of applications and services, and as Chief Financial Officer of Aldel Financial Inc. (NYSE: ADF) from January 2021 to December 2021, a special purpose acquisition company which merged with Hagerty, Inc. (NYSE: HGTY), a leading specialty insurance provider focused on the global automotive enthusiast market. Mr. Baqar served as a member of the board of directors of FG Financial Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: FGF) from October 2012 to May 2015. He also served as the Chief Financial Officer of United Insurance Holdings Corp. (NYSE: UIHC), a publicly held property and casualty insurance holding company, from August 2011 to April 2012. His previous experience also includes director of finance at Itasca Financial, LLC from 2008 to 2009 and positions held at Lumbermens Mutual Casualty Company (a Kemper Insurance company), a diversified mutual property-casualty insurance provider, from June 2000 to April 2008, where he most recently served as a senior analyst. Mr. Baqar earned a Master's Degree in Business Administration from Northeastern Illinois University in 2009 and a Bachelor's Degree in Accounting and Business Administration from Monmouth College in 2000. He also holds a Certified Public Accountant designation.

Mr. Ian Small serves as Board Member at SnapDocs. He served as Senior Consultant at White Stratus. Ian Small has spent more than 30 years in Silicon Valley since graduating from the University of Toronto, working in tech companies ranging from three-person startups to 100,000-employee multinationals. He first worked as a software engineer, and spent time in software engineering management and software product management before transitioning into a range of business leadership roles. Ian currently serves on the boards of Lumentum (NASDAQ:LITE, one of the world's leading manufacturers of lasers and photonic devices) and Snapdocs (a venture-backed startup driving mortgage automation). Ian has worked with a number of Sequoia Capital portfolio companies, including working as CEO of Evernote (personal productivity software), CEO of TokBox (video platform-as-a-service), and a lengthy stint with MarkLogic (NoSQL database). Ian also served as Global Chief Data Officer at Telefónica, following its acquisition of TokBox, served on the advisory board to Loon (a Google X Labs spinout), and started his Silicon Valley career in the Human Interface Group at Apple Computer. Ian's experience in Silicon Valley includes fundraising, tech mergers and acquisitions (both as buyer and seller), and tech spinouts. Ian graduated from the University of Toronto with a B.A.Sc. in Engineering Science (Computer Science option) and an M.Sc. in Computer Science, and is a holder of more than 10 patents.

Mr. Jack Herrick is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at WikiHow. Mr. Herrick co-founded and served as Chief Executive Officer of BigTray. He served as a Management Consultant for McKinsey & Company. He serves as a Director of BigTray, Inc. He has an MBA from Dartmouth's Tuck School and a BA from Stanford University. He started and self-financed wikiHow from its inception to its current position as one of the most popular sites on the web receiving over 25 million unique visitors per month. Prior to wikiHow, Jack was co-CEO of eHow. With Josh Hannah, Jack purchased eHow in 2004. Between 2004 and 2006 eHow grew 30x in traffic and revenue and became the largest pure-play how-to site on the web. Demand Media acquired eHow in 2006. In 2002 he co-founded Luminescent Technologies with Dan Abrams, Eli Yablonovitch, and Stan Osher. Luminescent is a computational semiconductor lithography company that has raised over $25 MM in venture capital. From 1999-2001 he was CEO and co-founder at BigTray, a Sequoia-funded e-commerce company. BigTray was sold in 2001 and remains the largest online vendor of restaurant equipment and supplies.

Mr. James P. Bick, Jr. serves as Board Member at Sequoia Vaccines. He is an attorney based in Clayton, Missouri and is co-owner of the firm Bick & Kistner PC. He has concentrated his practice in the representation of individuals and small and medium businesses. He's handled a wide variety of civil and corporate litigation in state and federal courts as well as corporate transactional work including contracts, employment matters, asset acquisitions and dispositions, entity formation and maintenance, succession planning and trusts and estates. James is also an owner and serves as Chairman of the Board of Bick Holdings, Inc. which is a data center and critical facilities company with offices in four states doing business throughout the US.

Mr. James Long serves as the Chief Executive Officer at Didja. He was a Board Member at PlantSense. He serves as a Board Member at POPS Worldwide. He served as a Partner at Gabriel Venture Partners. He joined Gabriel as a Venture Partner in early 2007 and drives new investments as well as advises existing Gabriel portfolio companies. After doing software and product marketing at Hewlett Packard and getting his MBA, He joined Fred Adler Ventures in 1982. In his four years at the firm, he was acting CEO at several turnarounds and worked with veteran VCs Jim Swartz and Arthur Patterson before them founding Accel Partners. Over the years, He has also done projects with venture firms Accel Partners, Crosspoint Venture Partners, IT-Farm (Japan), and Sequoia Capital. His venture experience also includes interim CEO jobs and "turnarounds" at companies such as Linkware (acquired by Ungermann-Bass). As an angel advisor/investor, He has been involved with several leading startups, including TiMetra (acquired by Alcatel), Manageware (acquired by Computer Associates), Ruckus Wireless (WiFi video leader), Ready Systems (acquired by Mentor), and Jibe Networks (acquired by Citrix). He received his MBA from Harvard University (with distinction) & BS in Electrical Engineering and Computer Science from UC Berkeley.

Dr. Jean Balgrosky serves as Chief Information Officer at MD Revolution. She previously served as Board Member in the company . She is a Co-Founder of Bootstrap Venture Partners. She served as Chief Information Officer at MintHealth. She served as Senior Advisor at Catalyst Healthcare Adviors. She serves as an Advisor & Investor at Elation Health. She has overseen investments in more than 20 seed and early-stage companies. She serves as a Board Member at Perceivant. She holds board positions with Sequoia Consulting Group. She also teaches graduate-level healthcare IT courses at the UCLA Fielding School of Public Health, where she earned a Ph.D. in Health Policy and Management. Before Bootstrap, she served for more than 20 years as CIO of large, complex healthcare organizations, including Scripps Health in San Diego, CA, and Trinity Health System (formerly Holy Cross Health System) in South Bend, IN. As CIO, she designed and implemented strategic IT plans and enterprise-wide systems such as electronic health records (EHR). She served as a Board Member at Doctible.

Mr. Joe Anderson serves as Board Member at Sequoia Holdings. He is a visionary leader with unparalleled global experience. Following a successful career in the US Army where he commanded Infantry units from company through Corps-level, he gained additional business and management experience with Wynnchurch Capital, Beacon Global Strategies, McKinsey & Company, Dataminr and SOS International. He has a well-earned reputation for driving results and managing complexity while building teams and networks along the way. A graduate of the United States Military Academy, he also earned a Master of Science degree in Administration from Central Michigan University and a Master of Arts degree in National Security and Strategic Studies from the US Naval War College. Additionally, he attended the Senior Executive Education Course at the University of North Carolina's Kenan-Flagler Business School. He is a visiting professor at Northwestern University's Medill School of Journalism and the George Washington Library Leadership Institute. His situational adaptability was evident as he fulfilled military roles that were equivalent to civilian Chief Operating Officer positions. His leadership experience is recognized internationally for honor, merit, service, peacekeeping and defense cooperation. His selfless service continues as a Director for the Tragedy Assistance Program for Survivors, Patton Veterans Project, Feherty's Troops First Foundation and TRIBAL App.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer and Board Member
biography: Mr. John Cooper is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at BrightWire. He serves as Board Member at Tangent Data Services. He is the Chief Executive Officer and Founder of Coverago and is responsible for the direction and strategy of the company. He has over a decade of experience in finance and software and was most recently an Investment Banker with Bear Stearns & Co. in their Technology, Media, and Telecommunications group. Prior to that, He held engineering and sales management positions with Plumtree Software. He was with Plumtree from the company's early stages as a Sequoia-backed start-up through its IPO and subsequent acquisition by BEA Systems. He began his career with Sun Microsystems in their Best-of-the-Best program as a Software Engineer. He received his BA in Computer Science from Gettysburg College and MBA from Columbia Business School.

Mr. John Ferring serves as Board Member at Arch Grants. Mr. Ferring serves Chairman at PLZ Corp. He is a Co-Owner at Custom Pak Products. A 1975 graduate of Brown University he joined the Bank of Boston in mergers and acquisitions after graduation. He has been with Plaze since 1979. He served as Board Member at Sequoia Sciences.

Mr. John Laing serves as Board Member at Amava. He served as a Board Member at Verdiem. He served as the Chairman and Co-Chief Executive Officer at Inxight Software. He has a 35-year history in the technology industry, having held senior management positions with industry leaders in multiple markets: content discovery with Inxight; security with Symantec; desktop operating systems with Apple; and document printing with Xerox. While serving as the executive vice president of worldwide sales for Symantec from 1989 through 1997, he managed revenue growth from $15 million to $600 million and orchestrated several high-profile acquisitions, which helped to advance the company to its current successful position. As president and CEO at Inxight, John was instrumental in a company turnaround, growing revenue by 65 percent and expanding its worldwide channels. Throughout his career, he has raised money from respected venture institutions including Vantage Point Venture Partners, Accel Partners, Sequoia Capital, and Reed Elsevier Ventures among others.
Most recently, he served as CEO of Reactivity, a provider of XML-enabled networking solutions. In less than a year he restructured and positioned the company for sale. In March of 2007 Reactivity was sold to Cisco for $135 million. He also serves on the board of Verdiem, Workshare, and Grid Net, and is the new Chairman of the Board for JobTrain, a non-profit organization in Silicon Valley.

Dr. John Suh serves as Vice President & Founding Director at Hyundai CRADLE. He also serves as an Analyst at Sequoia Capital. He serves as Board Member at Mojo Mobility. Prior to joining Hyundai, he worked at General Motors, Xerox, PARC, and several startups where he had roles in corporate investing, product management, and R&D. He has a BS degree in electrical engineering from Kettering University, and MS and PhD degrees in mechanical engineering from Stanford University.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Product Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Jonty Knox is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Product Officer and Board Member at Openline. He is an Angel Investor. Mr. Knox is a natural leader after cutting his teeth closing $1B+ contracts with BT while at Huawei, he went on to build a number of product and tech teams in the communications space that built $100M's of value. Prior to founding Openline, he exited Voxbone in a $500M+ acquisition and then setup another startup Otto which was selected for Sequoia Arc's first ever batch in 2022. He brings experience from previous roles at Pioneer Fund, Kennek, WeKall and Otto. Jonty Knox holds a 2017 - 2017 Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

Mr. Joseph Conran serves as Board Member at Sequoia Sciences. He is a litigation attorney at Husch Blackwell. Joe is a former executive board member and former co-chair of Husch Blackwell. Joe handles antitrust disputes, class-action litigation, consumer-fraud allegations, securities violations and other cases. Joe represented Monsanto (now Bayer) in a patent-infringement trial against DuPont over technology for herbicide-resistant soybeans. A jury in St. Louis, Missouri federal court returned a $1 billion verdict on behalf of Monsanto. Joe defeated class certification in litigation against Express Scripts, which consisted of more than 20 cases from jurisdictions across North America. Joe also won summary judgment on key issues, affirming the core business functions of Express Scripts. Joe currently serves as Chair of the Board of Trustees of Saint Louis University and is a member of numerous other nonprofit boards. Joe was one of the organizers of the Trial Practice Institute, an annual three-day seminar that trains young lawyers in development of a comprehensive, well-organized approach to litigation. He also has lectured on trial advocacy at Saint Louis University School of Law and the University of Virginia School of Law. Before entering private practice, Joe was a captain in the U.S. Air Force, serving as a judge advocate. He was a chief prosecuting attorney for Travis Air Force Base in California, one of the busiest court-martial jurisdictions in the world.

Ms. Joylita Saldanha is a Co-Founder & serves as Board Member at Infinyte Club. Ms. Saldanha served as Vice President, Product & Community at Sequoia Capital India Advisors. Joy has over 15 years of experience in Product and Design roles in products spanning from top-grossing Mobile Casino Games to Enterprise SaaS to Consumer Tech to Investment/ VC Tech. She has strong credentials in product management, tech, design, building communities, go-to-market strategies. Most recently, Joy was leading Product, Programs and Community at Surge and Sequoia India + Southeast Asia.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Executive Vice President, Consulting Services & Board Member
biography: Mr. Judd Robins is a Co-Founder and serves as Executive Vice President of Consulting Services and Board Member at TekStream Solutions. Before co-founding the company, he was a Director of Business Development for Enterpulse/Idhasoft responsible for 220% growth of the business. In his early career, he spent 8 years with Plumtree Software from the company's early stages as a Sequoia-backed startup through its IPO and subsequent acquisition by BEA Systems, Inc. (acquired by Oracle, Inc.). He filled a variety of roles including Southeast Area Sales Manager, Sales Engineering Lead and Implementation Consultant, where he provided license sales, process and technical consulting services for the design, development, and implementation of business solutions. His 10-year tenure in this space has created trusted relationships with Oracle and customers leveraging Oracle technologies. In 2007, BEA named him Salesperson of the Year in his region. He is experienced in building revenues and increasing market share in very competitive software and services industries through experienced sales and management expertise. Proficient at new product rollouts in startup environments, he has previously worked with enterprise companies including The Coca-Cola Company, Cox Enterprises, InterContinental Hotels Group, Southern Company, SunTrust Banks and Turner Broadcasting Systems. He earned a Bachelor of Science degree from Virginia Tech in Management Information Systems.

Mr. Justin Ho is a Co-Founder & serves as Chief Executive Officer at Sage Care. He as Board Member at USC Credit Union and FRAYT. He Co-Founded & served as the Chief Executive Officer at rideOS. He serves as Partner at Ethos VC. He is the former co-founder and CEO of rideOS, an enterprise software co powering mobility-as-a-service technologies for a variety of dispatch, optimization, and routing use cases. rideOS raised $34M of capital from Sequoia and next47, before Gopuff acquired rideOS for ~$175M. At Gopuff, the inventor of the instant needs category, He led a team of ~150 technologists to build products to serve Gopuff's delivery partners, operations associates, and increase the company's profitability. Prior to rideOS, he led the ideation and creation of Uber's self-driving and mapping business units. He has also worked for Citadel as an investor, managing a $1B long/short equity portfolio focusing on transportation and automotive stocks, and at Goldman as an investment banker.

Mr. Keith Robinson is an serves as an Advisor at Payhawk. Mr. Robinson served as an Advisor at Gospel Technology. He served as Chief Strategy Officer at The Sage Group (Financial Software). He joined Sage in 2016 as EVP for Strategy, becoming the Chief Strategy Officer in September 2018. He serves as an Advisor at SenseOn. He is an Investor and serves as an Advisor at Model ML. He previously co-founded Lamond Capital Partners, a San SanFrancisco-basedd technology-focused fund; led all Software investment acquisitions. Before that, he was a Managing Director at Arma PLondon-baseddon technology M&A advisor; advised on cross-border software transtally several billion dollars in aggregate value. He also spent strategy/technology consulting with Gartner and Sequoia-backed start-up) In the US and Japan, an investment banking firm t JPMorgan Chase in New York. He has an undergraduate degree in Finance and Entrepreneurial Management from the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania and an MBA from INSEAD.

Dr. Kevin B. Bacon has been a director and our President and Chief Executive Officer since April 2023. Prior to joining Sequoia, Dr. Bacon served as the Chief Executive Officer of Abcentra LLC from 2020 to 2023 and President and Chief Executive Officer of SMA Therapeutics Inc. from 2017 to 2023. Dr. Bacon was also acting Chief Executive Officer of Raft Pharmaceuticals, LLC from 2018 to 2020, Chief Scientific Officer, Head of Research and Development, and Founder of Actimis Pharmaceuticals Inc. from 2004 to 2018, and the President of Axikin Pharmaceuticals Inc. from 2008 to 2017. Dr. Bacon was the VP of Respiratory Diseases Research for Bayer Healthcare AG from 1999 to 2004. Prior to joining Bayer AG, Dr. Bacon held positions of increasing responsibility at Neurocrine Biosciences, Inc., in San Diego, was a Visiting Scientist at the DNAX Institute for Molecular Biology, and started his industry career at the Glaxo Institute for Molecular Biology (latterly Merck-Serono) in Geneva, Switzerland. Dr. Bacon received his Bachelor of Science, with Honors, in Pharmacology from King's College at the University of London and his Ph.D. in Pharmacology from the University of London, is an author of over 100 original manuscripts, book chapters and reviews in the field of drug discovery and inflammation biology, and a co-author on numerous issued and filed patents.

Mr. Kirill Sheynkman serves as Board Member at GridGain. Mr. Kirill Sheynkman was a Co-founder & served as Managing Partner and Investment Advisor at RTP Ventures. He served as a Board Member at Koding and HYPR. He, with Leonid Boguslavsky, started RTP Global's U.S. operations in 2011 as RTP Ventures. He served as Board Member at WorkFusion. He is focused on developing all aspects of the firm's investment strategy and activity in the United States, building the firm's investment team, and creating a portfolio of vertically-focused B2B companies in FinTech and Healthcare IT as well as infrastructure companies focusing on Cloud Infrastructure, Security, and industrial IoT. He is a 30-year software industry veteran, who has spent 10 of those years as a CEO of software startups. He is a three-time founder of venture-backed enterprise software companies, including an early relational OLAP vendor acquired by IBM in 1995 and Plumtree Software (NASDAQ: PLUM), the creator of the corporate portal market, acquired by BEA/Oracle in 2005. His companies were twice backed by Sequoia Capital where he was also an Entrepreneur in Residence. His experience building companies, not just financing them, has become invaluable to many of the early-stage companies he has backed and that is the investment stage he enjoys most. He served as a Board Member at Tinfoil Security.

Mr. Kyle Williams serves as President at Bootstrap Venture Partners. He serves as Chief Executive Officer at MD Revolution. He served as Board Member at VisualAssay. He served as a Board Member at Catalyst Healthcare Advisors. He served as a Board Observer at Freedom Meditech. He served as a Board Member at Sequoia. He is an experienced leader overseeing all operations and business activities to ensure they produce the desired results and are consistent with the company's overall strategy and vision. He works closely with our Board of Directors and is the main link between the operational teams. He loves the challenge of integrating people, processes, and technology. He provided strategic guidance and financial management for Bootstrap's early-stage companies. Prior to Bootstrap, he served as Director in Merck's corporate strategy office, where he planned and executed enterprise-level strategic change programs. Prior to Merck, he held positions with E&J Gallo Winery, ABHOW, a senior living, and healthcare provider, and MedAssets, a healthcare business intelligence software provider. He currently serves on the Board of Directors for Perceivant, Label Independent, Interactive Lifestyle Management, LoyaltyGenerator, Sequoia Consulting Group, Freedom Meditech (observer), and WellTrackONE. He holds an MBA from the McCombs School at the University of Texas and a Biomedical Engineering bachelor's degree from Vanderbilt University.

primary_position: Founder, Managing Director and Board Member
biography: Mr. Lee Parry is the Founder and serves as Managing Director and Board Member at Sequoia Health.

Mr. Marvin Ammori serves as Chief Legal Officer at Uniswap. He serves as an Executive at Plural VC. He is a Co-Founder of Silica Labs. He is also a Board Member at Engine Advocacy. He serves as a Partner at Carrot Capital. He has invested in startups in debt-relief, drug discovery, and healthcare-delivery drones alongside or preceding Sequoia, Andreessen Horowitz, and other top investors. An experienced general counsel and startup executive, he spent the early part of his career as the nation's leading advocate for freedom-of-speech online and for net neutrality. He graduated from Harvard Law School, continues to serve on the boards of four nonprofits, and was an advisor to HBO's Silicon Valley. He is also a Term Member of the Council on Foreign Relations and a member of the Council's Term Member Advisory Committee. He holds JD in Business from the Harvard Law School in 2003 and a BA in English from the University of Michigan in 1998.

Mr. Michael Holmes serves as Board Member at Sequoia Vaccines. He is the Chairman Emeritus and Founder of Rx Outreach, America's largest non-profit pharmacy providing affordable medicine to people throughout the country. Michael negotiated and led the spin-off of the business from Express Scripts in 2010, converting the ownership into a non-profit organization to better serve the needs of individuals and families who otherwise might not be able to afford their medication. Prior to the spin-off, he was an Executive Vice President at Express Scripts with responsibility for Strategic Planning, all domestic Emerging Markets businesses, Research and Clinical Services, Human Resources, and many of the corporate staff functions. Michael began his career in the Human Resources function working for Monsanto and Pepsi and then Automated Data Processing where he rose to the position of Chief Human Resources Officer. In 1995, Michael joined Edward Jones as a Partner and Chief Human Resources Officer with a focus on building the company's human capital infrastructure for growth while preserving the organization's core values. While there, the company tripled in size and became the "Best Company to Work For" in America for two consecutive years. Michael served on both the Management and Executive Committees overseeing the firm's direction. He serves on the BJC HealthCare board of directors, the National Council for the Brown School at Washington University, the Rx Outreach board, and the Enterprise Financial Services board of directors. Michael is also the past Chairman of the board of the Sickle Cell Disease Association of America and past Chairman of the board of Mary Institute Country Day School in St. Louis. Michael and his wife Gail have also Co-Chaired the Charmaine Chapman Society for the United Way. Michael graduated from Washington University in 1979. Michael completed the Coro Fellows program in 1980 and then a Master's in Business from Webster University.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Michael Jones is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at Thrive Farmers. After exiting a healthcare services company in January of 2011 that he had started ten years prior, Michael had planned to spend some long-needed time with his family while deciding what his next course in business would be. It was during this time that he was revisiting a conversation with his father-in-law, a long-time Blue Mountain coffee farmer in Jamaica, about the severe disadvantages in the value chain of coffee, that ultimately led to the creation of THRIVE Farmers - an innovative platform to change the world of coffee and align the interests of producers and consumers for the first time. Michael is the quintessential entrepreneur, having founded and operated several privately held companies. He has managed high growth companies and has been successful in building significant market value for shareholders. Most recently, Michael founded Implantable Provider Group (IPG), a provider of market-based medical implant solutions that is delivered to payors, manufacturers, providers and patients. In his role as President/COO, Michael was named one of Atlanta's top 25 entrepreneurs by Catalyst Magazine in 2008. Jones was selected because of his role in founding IPG and turning it into one of the country's fastest-growing businesses. In 2008, Inc. Magazine ranked IPG as the sixth-fastest growing healthcare company in the country and the 138th fastest-growing overall. FORBES Magazine recently ranked IPG at 5 in its list of 100 Most Promising Companies in America. Michael has been instrumental in raising capital from high profile private equity firms including Sequoia Capital, arguably the most revered venture capital firm in recent history due to its investments in Apple, Atari, Oracle, Cisco, Yahoo, Paypal, Google and others, who invested in IPG in early 2010. Michael's background prior to IPG includes an early career in the financial services industry in corporate finance. He then segued into healthcare in the mid 90's pursuing two other ventures.

Mr. Michael Laven serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Currencycloud. Mr. Laven serves as a Board Member at Stravito. He served as a Board Member at VoxSmart. He serves as an Advisory Board Member at Savant Growth. He served as Chairman at Yobota. He was the Chairman of FRS Global (a Kennet II portfolio company) which was acquired by Wolters Kluwer in September 2010. He serves as an Advisor at Fog City Capital. He has had an extensive career in building and leading successful venture-backed software companies in Silicon Valley and London. For seven years he was the COO of Traiana, a financial network company, based in San Francisco and London. Traiana was backed by Sequoia and acquired by ICAP, a UK brokerage, in 2008. He has been the CEO of venture-backed companies in London (Iris Financial, KWI) and Silicon Valley (Cohera, Infinity Financial & Coronet). He has also assisted a number of technology companies as a Board member or Advisor including Almonde (Paris), and EasySoft (Lisbon). In his early career, he spent six years in Asia working for the United Nations and aid organizations. He has a B.A. in Anthropology from Wesleyan University, an M.A. in International Affairs from The School for International Training, and an M.Ed. from Harvard University.

Mr. Michael Mertz serves as Board Member at Sequoia Sciences. Michael J. Mertz is the Co-President, Partner Solutions at First Data Corporation. This is a $2.8 billion revenue segment of First Data. First Data was acquired in July, 2019, by Fiserv for $22 billion. Michael has been actively involved in the business of financial technology and payment solutions since 2003 when he founded MertzCo. Michael sold his company, MertzCo, to CardConnect in 2017 and he became one of the largest individual shareholders of CardConnect. CardConnect was acquired by first Data for $750 million. Michael was instrumental in this sale to First Data. Michael is an active commercial real estate developer and investor. He is currently invested in early stage companies Bluestone Lane, RhinoDox, Honeybrains and Top Ya! Michael was one of Sequoia Sciences' first investors, and he has invested in the majority of its financing rounds. Michael is a current member of the Chicago Board of Trade where he traded the 30-year bond futures from 1993-2003

primary_position: Co-Founder, President, Chief Operating Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Michael Smith is a Co-Founder and serves as President, Chief Operating Officer & Board Member at aspenify. Mr. Smith serves as Managing Partner, COO and General Manager at Sequoia Worldwide. Before joining Sequoia Worldwide, Mike was an executive at Hewlett Packard where he led strategic end-to-end growth initiatives for the Enterprise Servers, Storage and Networking business by accelerating service revenues. Prior to this he was VP & GM within the Business Critical Systems Division responsible for Quality, Customer Satisfaction and Technology Transitions, and Support. In this capacity he led technology, consulting, partnership, technical marketing, and customer-facing support functions. In addition, Mike worked in IT management and SW engineering for HP managing data centers and developing leading-edge systems and processes in the US and Europe. Mike holds a Bachelor's degree in Economics and Computer Applications from the University of Notre Dame and a Masters of Science in technology Management from Pepperdine University. He brings experience from previous roles at WhitespaceX, Santa Clara University Leavey School of Business, Presidio and Sequoia Cloud Solutions. Mike Smith holds a 1994 - 1996 MS in Masters of Science in Technology Mngt from Pepperdine Graziadio Business School. With a robust skill set that includes Cloud Computing, Software Integration, Operations Management, Strategic Planning, Customer Experience and more.

Ms. Natasha Kehimkar serves as Board Member at Lingo Live. Ms. Kehimkar served as Chief People Officer at App Annie. She also served as the Chief People Officer at Fandom (San Francisco). As Chief People Officer, Ms. Kehimkar lead App Annie's global People and Talent team. With cross-industry experience in global HR, talent acquisition and organization effectiveness within both start-up and large enterprise companies, Ms. Kehimkar is responsible for managing strategic initiatives focused on culture, people operations and talent at the company. Prior to App Annie, Ms. Kehimkar served as the VP, People at Guardant Health, a Sequoia-backed biotech start-up company. Prior to that, she was VP of People and Culture at OpenTable where she oversaw all operational and strategic aspects of People Operations & Talent Acquisition for the company. This was preceded by more than 15 years of HR experience at Pfizer and Johnson & Johnson. She holds a BA in Sociology from McGill University and a Master's in Human Resources & Labor Relations.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Ms. Pallavi Chakravorty is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Anko. She served as growth investor at Sequoia Capital and financial consultant at BCG. Focuses on strategy, business and customer pain point identification.

Mr. Paul Hammond serves as a Board Member & Advisor at Yardarm Technologies. He is currently the CEO of VirtualPBX.com a leading Business cloud hosted PBX solution which he helped co-found. With over 30 years of strategic, operational, sales, and marketing management experience, Paul has successfully guided the emergence of such companies as Silicon Vision, Specialix, Siemens/Pyramid and, most notably, BEA Systems. As the Vice President of Business Development and Alliances for their ECI Division, Paul helped BEA achieve $1 billion in annual revenue faster than any other software company in the history of the industry. Paul sits on the boards of Iamfine.com and Yardarm Technologies. He has previously held advisorary board seats at CastIron Systems an integration appliance company funded by Sequoia Capital and Norwest Ventures (sold to IBM) and Network Shell (IPO under the name Bladelogic and then sold to BMC) His non profit board work includes; CASA, a child advocacy group in Northern California and the West Valley Business School. Paul holds a BABS in International Business and Corporate Decision Making from Kingston University of London, England.

Mr. Paul Hammond serves as Chief Executive Officer & President at Virtual PBX. Mr. Hammond serves as Board Member at Yardarm. As the chief business visionary at VirtualPBX, Mr. Hammond has helped take the company from a cool side project to a market leader. With over 30 years of strategic, operational, sales, and marketing management experience, Paul has successfully guided the emergence of such companies as Silicon Vision, Specialix, Siemens/Pyramid, and, most notably, BEA Systems. As the Vice President of Business Development and Alliances for their ECI Division, Paul helped BEA achieve $1 billion in annual revenue faster than any other software company in the history of the industry. He currently sits on the Board of Directors for VirtualPBX and IAMFINE.com in addition to being a Board advisor to Yardarm Technologies. He has previously held a board seat at CASA, a non-profit child advocacy group in Northern California, as well as a role on the Advisors Board for West Valley Business School and Cast Iron Systems, an integration appliance company funded by Sequoia Capital and Norwest Ventures. Paul holds an Honors Bachelor's Degree in International Business from Kingston University of London, England.

Mr. Peter Wexler is the Founder and serves as President at Forest Avenue Technology Group. Mr. Wexler is an Investor & serves as Board Member at GLYNT.AI. He Co-Founded and served as Board Member of SpiderCloud Wireless. He is an Angel Investor. He also served as a Board Member at BridgeWave Communications. Mr. Wexler led the engineering team in the development of the initial system. Before SpiderCloud, Mr. Wexler was the vice president of engineering and product operations at Stoke, Inc., a Kleiner Perkins and Sequoia Capital-funded company. Before Stoke, Mr. Wexler was with Juniper Networks where he held the position of vice president of engineering. During his tenure at Juniper, he grew the engineering organization from 17 to 600 and helped lead the company from the initial product through the delivery of multiple generations of high-performance routers. Subsequently, he managed Juniper's Mobile Business and was a director of the Ericsson-Juniper joint venture, J20 GGSN. Mr. Wexler has also held engineering and management positions at Bay Networks, Wellfleet Communications (which became Bay Networks through the merger with Synoptics), Xylogics, and Siemens. Mr. Wexler has an MBA from Boston University, an MSE from the University of Illinois, and a BSEE from SUNY Stonybrook.

Mr. Pierre Labbe serves as Board Member, Member of the Audit and Risks Committee & Governance and Nomination Committee & Chairman of the Human Resources Committee at Osisko Gold Royalties. He served as Chief Financial Officer & Investor Relations at IMV (Biotechnology). He has more than 30 years of progressive financial leadership roles in various industries. He was Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Leddartech Inc. from April 2015 to March 2017 and was Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of the Quebec Port Authority (October 2013 - April 2015). He also has experience in the resource sector, having served as Chief Financial Officer of Plexmar Resources (2007-2012), Sequoia Minerals (2003-2004), and Mazarin Inc. (2000-2003). Mr. Labbe, in his role as senior financial officer, has participated in the development of strategic plans and in mergers and acquisitions (over $1 billion in transactions). Mr. Labbe was a nominee to the Osisko Board by Virginia Mines Inc. as part of the Osisko-Virginia business combination in 2015. Mr. Labbe holds a Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration and a license in accounting from Universite Laval, Quebec City. He is a member of Ordre des comptables professionnels agrees du Quebec, the Chartered Professional Accountants of Canada and the Institute of Corporate Directors. Public Board Membership in the past 5 years and Interlocking Directorships- Agility Health Inc. (2013 - 2018).

Mr. Pierre Lamond serves as Board Member at MindRhythm. Mr. Lamond is a pioneer in the semiconductor industry. He started his career in 1957 as an engineer at Transitron Electronics before joining Dr. Gordon E. Moore's R&D team at Fairchild Semiconductor. While at Fairchild, he oversaw the development of advanced high-frequency transistors and the first generation of digital integrated circuits. He left Fairchild in 1967 to cofound the National Semiconductor Corporation (NSM), where he was vice president and general manager, of Integrated Circuits. In 1981, he joined Sequoia Capital as a general partner, where he played a pivotal role in the expansion of the semiconductor, systems, and software portfolios. While at Sequoia, he was chairman of the board at Cypress Semiconductor (CY), Microchip Semiconductor, Vitesse Semiconductor, Open-Silicon Inc., Redback Networks, Verisity, and Plumtree. He left Sequoia in 2009 and joined Khosla Ventures in 2010. He spent four years as a general partner at Khosla Ventures, serving on the boards of SkyboxImaging (Google), Cogenra (SunPower), SEEO (Bosch), Avogy, SeaMicro (AMD), and HeartVista. In 2015, he joined Eclipse Ventures where he served on the boards of Cerebras, Light, Flexlogix, SwiftNav, and Oxide. He left Eclipse in mid-2021. He now invests his own funds and focuses on seed investments in high technology and medical device companies.

Mr. Rajiv Sabharwal serves as Non-Executive Director and Board Member at Tata Cleantech Capital. He serves as Managing Director, Chief Executive Officer and Board of Director at Tata Capital. He also serves as Chairman at TATA Asset Management. He also serves as Chairman of Tata Capital Financial Services and as Board Member at Tata Capital Housing Finance. He served as a Partner at True North (Managers). He also served as an Executive Director at ICICI Home Finance. He served as a Director at ICICI Bank. He served as Executive Director at ICICI Bank. He has done his Mechanical Engineering from Indian Institute of Technology Delhi and Management from Indian Institute of Management Lucknow. He has over 18 years of experience in the Banking/Financial Services industry. He joined ICICI Group in 1998 and has held leadership positions in credit policy, collections, business analytics, mortgage finance, consumer loans, credit cards, rural and microfinance lending, and financial inclusion. His contribution to the growth of the mortgage and retail business is widely acknowledged in industry circles and within the ICICI group. He also has considerable knowledge relating to the securities and portfolio management business segments as he has been on the investment advisory committee of ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company's Real Estate Portfolios since 2007. Prior to joining ICICI Group, he worked in the Consumer Durables Marketing, Commercial Finance, and Retail Finance businesses at Godrej, SRF Finance, and GE Capital. In January 2009 he joined Sequoia Capital, a leading venture/growth capital company, and worked as Operating Partner focusing on the financial services sector. There he led new investment decisions as well as represented Sequoia on the board in existing investments. He then rejoined ICICI Bank Limited in April 2010.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Co-Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. V. Rama Kumar is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at Tarang. Mr. Kumar served as Board Member at Omnyway. He stepped into the shoes of an entrepreneur in the year 2000 when he successfully founded Tarang. Prior to this he worked with Wipro for 18 years. He commenced his career as a software programmer at Wipro writing software for banks and insurance companies. He rose to become Chief Executive of Wipro's Solutions and System Integration business in 1995. He was Corporate Vice President for the Six Sigma initiative reporting to the Chairman of Wipro in 1996. He was responsible for launching Six Sigma across Wipro and re-engineering several critical business processes. He later became Chief Executive of Wipro's E-Commerce, CRM and Data Warehousing business in 1998. Rama has been able to nurture Tarang from its start-up days to its current position. He raised USD 5.5MM funding and brought in GIV and Sequoia as Investors. He built an excellent team of professionals and has taken Tarang to leadership in two domains - Payments and eLearning. He made an acquisition CyberCash Inc in 2001 and launched Tarang into Payments. He helped acquire marquee customers for Tarang in Verisign, First Data Management Systems, eOne Global, Volvo, Teligence Communications, Wipro and Infosys among others. Rama has led Tarang into becoming a fast-growing and profitable company. He holds a B.Tech degree from Madras Institute of Technology and an MBA from IIM Ahmedabad.
Mr. Randy Ditzler is the Owner at Private Investor. He also serves as Board Member at CloudShare. Previously, he served as a Partner at Sequoia Capital.

Mr. Ravi Garikipati is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Davinta. He serves as Board Member at Axis Asset Management Company. He is an entrepreneur & technologist with over 30 years of experience mostly in technology and executive leadership roles. He is a board member and advisor to many late-stage startups and an active angel investor in deep tech, fintech and consumer tech startups. Prior to co-founding Davinta, as a CTO at Flipkart, defined and executed a technology vision and roadmap to transform commerce. Also founded Fintech as a new vertical with a mission to offer financial products to 100s of millions of underserved and unserved Indians by leveraging data, digital distribution and Technology. Prior to Flipkart, he was President and Chief Technology Officer at 247.ai Innovation Labs, a Sequoia-funded company where he led global product and technology groups to build one of the largest omnichannel customer acquisition & engagement platforms. He also held various senior engineering management positions at Oracle and Covansys, where he gained extensive experience in building scalable enterprise application architectures and services. He served as Chief Technology Officer and Head of Fin-Tech at Flipkart. He served as a Chief Executive Officer at Andale. He also serves as the President of Innovation Labs 24/7. He joined [24]7 in 2009 and has been instrumental in the development of industry-leading Px technologies and solutions. He brings a wealth of knowledge to our team with over 20 years of technology and management experience in building teams that deliver high-quality web-scale software and services in databases, predictive analytics, business intelligence, eCommerce and enterprise application areas. Before joining [24]7, he was Senior Vice President & Managing Director of Vendio, a large third-party e-commerce service provider for small businesses. Under his leadership, Vendio grew to have more than 2 million online sellers and generated millions in annual revenues. Prior to that, he held various senior engineering leadership positions at IBM and Oracle where he led technology initiatives in building scalable enterprise software architectures and services. He holds a Master's in software engineering and an MBA from the Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani, India.
Mr. Rishabh Verma is a Co-Founder & serves as Board Member at ShopDeck. He served as Board Observer at LocoNav. He served as Investment Analyst at Sequoia Capital India.

Mr. Robert Cohn serves as Board Member at AcureX Therapeutics. Mr. Cohn is a seasoned entrepreneur and venture capitalist with over 30 years of leadership in the tech and communications industries. He founded and served as CEO of Octel Communications, pioneering voicemail technology, and led the company for 15 years to its number 1 position worldwide in all sectors until it was acquired by Lucent Technologies, where he became an Executive Vice President. Following Lucent, Mr. Cohn was an investing partner at Sequoia Capital for 3 years. Mr. Cohn has served on a variety of public and private boards, was a Governor of NASDAQ and a member of the Stanford GSB Advisory Board. He has been active with Business Executives for National Security for over 30 years and served in the Defense Reform CEO Panel under Secretary of Defense William Cohen. With a BS in Mathematics and Computer Science from the University of Florida and an MBA from Stanford University, he continues to advise and mentor CEOs of tech companies.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Co-Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Robert Kershner is a Co-Founder and serves as the Co-Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at OneTogether Solutions. Robert has worked as a Physical Therapist, Program Director and Administrator in both inpatient and outpatient settings. He was Director of Sequoia Hospital Center for Sports Medicine, Director of Rehab Services at North Valley Rehab Hospital, a 126 Bed LTACH facility with 6 outpatient rehab clinics, and he was CEO of Cornerstone Orthopedics. More recently, he has focused on health care delivery and payment reform initiatives with a special emphasis on tribal health and wellness program development.

Mr. Robinson Hill serves as Co-Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at True Sync Media. Record-setting exits at Greylock, Sequoia, Warburg Pincus & Francisco Partners portfolio companies. Fast-grow execution expert. Former pro athlete. B.S.E. Princeton University. He has led sales, marketing and operations at VC and PE-backed companies for 25+ years, focused on selling and delivering $10-40MM complex deals-from software to services to SaaS to turnkey implementations. A demonstrated history of bootstrapping companies, driving individual sales and delivery teams, and closing game-changing contracts. Grows businesses with a keen focus on execution and customer satisfaction. Previous experience in marketing, building a global #1 sporting goods brand, management consulting and playing on the professional squash tour.

Mr. Ronald Hose co-founded and served as Head of Products at Playdex. He serves as Board Member at PCX. He Co-Founded and served as Chief Executive Officer at Coins.ph. Prior to coins.ph, he was a Founding Partner and Advisor of Innovation Endeavors. He co-founded TokBox (acquired by Telefonica), a consumer video conferencing company that was backed by Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital, Stanford University, and some of Silicon Valleys' best-known angel investors. He holds a Bachelors's and Masters's degree from Cornell University, where he graduated at the top of his class. Ron is also an active investor and adviser to several Silicon Valley startups.

Mr. Sandeep Kapoor was the Founder and served as the Managing Partner at Algo Legal. He also serves as a Board Member at Exprs. With the pace technology is disrupting industries around India and the world, he leads a team that is highly proficient in advising innovators and investors across the private equity, venture capital, technology, and other internet-related business sectors. Before Algo Legal, Sandeep spent 9 years at Sequoia Capital, where he was Sequoia's first legal hire globally.

Mr. Sandeep Kher serves as a Board Member at K12 Techno Services. He serves as Director and Board Member at StashAway. He is a Director at Sequoia Capital India and SEA, and has diverse experience in varied businesses like pharmaceutical manufacturing, and non-banking financial and life insurance companies. He has over 20 years of experience in the field of finance and risk. He has served as Chief Risk Officer on the board of Max Life Insurance Company Limited. He serves on the Board of consumer and SAAS companies in addition to his role as an advisor to the Sequoia India/SEA portfolio companies. He is a Chartered Accountant from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India. He has played vital roles in several companies such as Wyeth Lederle Limited, Kotak Mahindra, Max New York Life Insurance, and SBI Cards.

Mr. Satinder Singh serves as Board Member at Sequoia Plantation. He served as Chief Executive Officer at the company. He has 28 years of experience as corporate leader and agro forestry experience across Africa, South America and Newzeland. He earned a Bachelor of Engineering degree and completed a Master of Business Administration.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Sean Spector is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Dropoff. He is a Co-Founder of Poker Skill. He has spent his career driving growth and innovation for leading technology and media companies. Prior to Dropoff, he co-founded GameFly, which pioneered the video game rental subscription business and was backed by Sequoia Capital and Tenaya Capital. There, he led marketing, business development, mobile strategy, digital distribution, ad sales, content, and M&A efforts. He was previously an Online Producer at The Walt Disney Company and a New Media Agent at Creative Artists Agency. He attended the University of Southern California and holds a B.A. in Film Theory and Criticism from San Francisco State University. He is an Angel Investor.

Mr. Shridhar Gupta is a Co-Founder and serves as Board Member at LocoNav. He has over 8 years of experience building technology and trading businesses across South Asia. In the past, he has built a healthcare trading business founded in 2009, serving a clientele of over 1000+ hospitals and clinics. He was also on the founding team of Fitho, India's leading fitness tech platform acquired by Practo in 2015. In 2015, before founding LocoNav, he led sales and partnerships at ClearTax, India's first Y-Combinator product, backed by SAIF Partners and Sequoia Capital.

Mr. Shvetank Jain is a Co-Founder and serves as Executive Chairman at Collimator. Mr. Jain is an Angel Investor. He is a Co-Founder, Co-Owner and serves as Chairman at RudderStack. He is a Co-Founder and serves as a Board Member at Panther. He serves as a Partner at S28 Capital and Clerk. He also served as a Board Member at District Capital and Acquire. He is a serial entrepreneur and has been building companies over the last decade in Silicon Valley. He served as Advisor at Lightup Data. He was involved in Playdom (a Facebook gaming company backed by Lightspeed Ventures) and Kiwi (a mobile entertainment company backed by Sequoia Capital). Playdom was acquired by Walt Disney for $750M in 2010. He is grateful that he went from a garage startup in Menlo Park to a hyper-growth startup in Silicon Valley to the mothership, Walt Disney, in 5 years, helping him gain a unique perspective. He led investments in Mattermost, Gravitational, Acquire.io, CaptivateIQ, Reflektive, Lookback, and Perpetua. He has also helped get companies off the ground from scratches such as Aurora Solar, RudderStack, and Panther Security. His primary interest is in product-led companies. He led our investments in Mattermost, Gravitational, Acquire.io, CaptivateIQ, Reflektive, Lookback, and Perpetua. He holds an MBA in Business from Stanford Graduate School of Business and a Master's and B.Tech in Computer Science from the University of Toronto and the Indian Institute of Technology. He serves as General Partner at Teleport.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Financial Officer, Chief Operating Officer, Chief Revenue Officer & Board Chairman
biography: Mr. Skip Sanzeri is also a Co-Founder of Quantum Thought, where he serves as its Board Member. He Founded and served as a Strategic Advisor at Multiverse Capital. He is also a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Financial Officer, Chief Operating Officer, Chief Revenue Officer and Board Chairman at QuSecure. He heads up corporate strategy for 3C, the nation's leading strategic cannabis consulting firm, where he is responsible for branding, PR, marketing, and partnerships. Recently He raised $7.6m in the capital for a cannabis sensor company and spearheaded the effort to take the company public. Heis a Silicon Valley entrepreneur who has helped a variety of startups launch, grow, and successfully exits. In addition, he has founded and launched his own companies. He started his entrepreneurial career at an early age buying a Gold's Gym in the San Francisco Bay Area expanding to a total of six clubs before exiting via a sale of the franchise to 24-Hour Fitness. He then helped grow the IAC division of Ziff-Davis publishing to $250 million, after which he helped sell to Thomson Publishing. He continued his entrepreneurial career with Sequoia Capital-backed Quote.com which was acquired by Lycos. He then founded and funded the first open-source strategy firm - Open Source Group, which was sold to Olliance, Inc. Throughout his career, He has helped other startups, launch, grow, and exit. He earned his bachelor's degree from Claremont McKenna College, and then followed with a Master's in Public Administration from the College of Notre Dame. He has worked on many volunteer projects and is a Distinguished Fellow and on the Board of Governors of the New Westminster Society, a global organization providing educational scholarships for those in need.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Stephen Hanney is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at aspenify. Mr. Hanney is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Cloud Officer and Managing Partner at Sequoia Worldwide. He has significant experience in technology solutions, strategic business development, professional services, outsourcing, solutions development, marketing, consulting, practice management, and service delivery. In his current role, he provides a unique portfolio of enablement services to leading IT vendors and their strategic channel partners. With a passion for solutions-led sales and services, he is uniquely positioned to help accelerate sales and delivery of products, services, and solutions in the emerging cloud era. Prior to forming Sequoia Worldwide, he was vice president of professional services at NetApp. In addition, he spent 15 years at Hewlett-Packard, where the majority of his time was spent within HP Services and Global Industry Sales. Prior to joining HP, he held various leadership positions at Prime Computer, Inc. and Apollo Computing. He brings experience from previous roles at NetApp, Hewlett-Packard and Senaryo Services Ltd. Steve Hanney holds a 1984 - 1989 B.Sc. Hons in Computer Science from Coventry University. With a robust skill set that includes Cloud Computing, Solution Architecture, Solution Selling, Cisco, NetApp and more.

Mr. Stephen Notestine serves as Board Member at Sequoia Vaccines. Stephen Notestine has been in the commercial real estate and development business for 30 years. Currently, he is a founding partner of Quadrant Properties, a development company active in Denver and Dallas. He has invested in over a dozen start-up and technology businesses in recent years. He has been a strong proponent and active fundraiser for Sequoia since its inception in 1999 and also serves as its Board Member.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Financial Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Steve Trampe is a Co-Founder & serves as Chief Financial Officer and Board Member at Geniecast. Mr. Trampe has founded or co-founded seven different companies in various industries, including cosmetics, manufacturing, medical diagnostics, retail and fish farming. He currently serves as chairman of Sequoia Sciences, a plant-based drug discovery company and as the director of Elemental Enzymes, a stabilized enzyme company involved in the agricultural industry. He is also the founder of Owen Development, a real estate development company focused on unique development opportunities. Steve is chairman of the St. Louis Building Arts Foundation, which has the largest collection of architectural artifacts in the United States, and the vice-chairman of Opera America. He is a long-time executive board member of Opera Theatre and is a past director and president of Circus Flora, a one-ring European-style circus. He has previously served on the board of Craft Alliance, the St. Louis Film Festival and the Arts & Education Council. He has judged numerous business plan competitions, mentored many start-up companies and has heard and reviewed hundreds of investment proposals.

primary_position: Chief Executive Officer, President & Board Member
biography: Mr. Steven Skolsky serves as Chief Executive Officer, President & Board Member at Sequoia Pharmaceuticals. He has served as a director at Fennec Pharmaceuticals since August 2011. He also serves as a Board Member at Clinipace Worldwide. With a distinguished career spanning 30 years in the life sciences, Mr. Skolsky is a recognized industry leader who has held numerous international general management and executive leadership roles in the pharmaceutical and biotech sectors with a principal emphasis on commercialization, product strategy, and new product development. He was recently appointed to the position of Global Head of Clinical and Data Operations at Quintiles Transnational after serving as Principal of EXPIS Partners, a strategic life science consultancy. Mr. Skolsky also currently serves on the Board of Basilea Pharmaceutica, a Swiss based biopharmaceutical company where he previously served as Vice Chairman of the Board. Mr. Skolsky is the former President and Chief Executive Officer of Sequoia Pharmaceuticals, a privately held company specializing in novel antiviral therapeutics. Prior to his appointment at Sequoia, he held the position of Chief Executive Officer at Trimeris, Inc., a publicly held company that discovered and commercialized Fuzeon®, a first- in-class HIV therapeutic in collaboration with partner F. Hoffmann-La Roche. Previously, Mr. Skolsky served over 20 years at GlaxoSmithKline in a range of senior leadership roles, including Senior Vice President of Global Product Strategy and Clinical Development, Managing Director of GSK's operations in Australia and New Zealand and Head of Glaxo Wellcome's Division of HIV/Oncology. Mr. Skolsky received his Bachelor's Degree in Biology from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill. He serves as Board Member at Huma.AI.

Mr. Timothy Lee serves as Board Member at Level AI. Mr. Lee is an Angel Investor. He founded and served as Board Member at Avid AI. He served as Board Member at App Annie. He is a Founder and also serves as Chief Executive Officer of Avid AI. He serves as Board Member at Fite. Mr. Lee served as a Partner at Sequoia Capital. He works with mobile, cloud, and software companies. Prior to joining Sequoia Capital in 2009, he worked at Google where he managed European marketing and product launch strategy. While at Google, he also conceived the YouTube Symphony Orchestra. Earlier, he worked at McKinsey & Company in London and at microprocessor IP company, ARM, in Cambridge UK. Mr. Lee has a master's in Electrical and Information Engineering from Cambridge University and an MBA from Stanford University's Graduate School of Business.

Mr. Tom Moss serves as Chief Corporate Development at Skydio. He is an Angel Investor. He serves as Board Member at Hidden Level. He is a Co-Founder and serves as a Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Nextbit Systems. He He served Accel as an Entrepreneur-in-Residence. Previously, Tom was co-founder and CEO of Three Laws Mobility (3LM), a start-up acquired in 2010 by Motorola Mobility, which was later acquired by Google. Tom continued his role as CEO of 3LM through both acquisitions. Prior to 3LM, Tom was an executive on the Android team at Google. At Google, Tom served as Worldwide Head of Business Development and Partnerships for Android. While at Google, Tom was also the recipient of a Founders Award, the highest employee award at Google, given for extraordinary entrepreneurial achievement by a team at Google (in this case, the Android team). Prior to Google, Tom was an attorney specializing in intellectual property transactions, and represented a diverse set of clients including LinkedIn, SAP, Intuit, ICANN, SunPower, Hitachi, Sequoia Capital, AT&T, Walt Disney and JP Morgan. Tom received a Juris Doctorate from the UCLA School of Law, and a baccalaureate degree (with honors) from the University of Oregon. While at UCLA School of Law, Tom served as Editor-in-Chief of the Pacific Basin Law Journal, was a finalist in the Roscoe Pound competition, and represented UCLA at the Jessup International Law Moot Court competition. He serves as the Board Member at Cynogen. He also serves on Board of Nextbit.

primary_position: Founder, Chief Education Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Uday Philar is the Founder and serves as Chief Education Officer & Board Member at Sequoia Bio.

Mr. Victor Belfor serves as Advisor at rollApp. He serves as Board Member at Greater Farallones Association. He serves as Board Member at Heirloom Computing. He served as Vice President, Partnerships and Distribution Strategy at OpenSesame. He also served as the Director of Business Development at Centrify. He serves as Advisor at rollApp. He is an investor and an executive. He is focused on telecom and cloud computing and especially the area where the two overlap. Today, he also holds the position of the VP of Strategic Alliances at RingCentral, where he runs the company's partnerships business in the US and Internationally. RingCentral is the leader in cloud business telephony and is funded by Sequoia, Khosla and SCALE. Prior to this, Victor ran IP licensing in North and South America, India, Israel, Korea and Japan at Coding Technologies which was acquired by Dolby in 2007 for $280M. He is working on his MBA from the Wharton School of Business and frequently writes on topics of investment and entrepreneurship. He was also a Mentor at7 500 Startups.

primary_position: Founder, Co-Owner, Chief Executive Officer, President & Chairman
biography: Mr. Vimal Kavuru is the Founder & Co-Owner and serves as Chief Executive Officer, President and Chairman at Rising Pharma Holdings. Mr. Kavuru serves as Board Member at Acasti Pharma. He is a Co-Founder & serves as Board Member at Celon Labs. He is also an Angel Investor. He was a Co-Founder of Grade Therapeutics and also served as its Chairman. He was a Founder and served as Chief Executive Officer at Citron Pharma. He is an experienced Pharmaceutical Executive with a successful track record of business leadership, business development and creating niche life science/Pharma companies. Mr. Kavuru graduated with B.S. in Pharmacy in 1989 and is a registered Pharmacist in New York. A serial entrepreneur, he co-founded Celon Labs Ltd. a Sequoia Capital-funded specialty pharmaceutical company. Celon focuses on Oncology and Critical Care segments in India and over 20 semi-regulated markets. He founded Gen-Source RX in 2008, a leading national distributor of generic pharmaceuticals to independent and Long-Term Care pharmacies by acquiring Cedardale Distributors. Under his leadership, Gen-Source RX significantly grew revenues and its customer base in six years and was successfully divested from Cardinal Health in 2014. He is the Founder of Casper Pharma LLC, an emerging specialty brand and injectable pharmaceutical company, and Director of Cronus Pharma LLC, an animal health pharmaceutical company.

Mr. Walt Pounds serves as Board Member at California Safe Soil. Mr. Pounds serves as Board Member at CaraSolva. Mr. Pounds serves as Board President at Imagine Foundation. Mr. Pounds is an Angel Investor. He served as the Board Member at Presidio Graduate School. He served as the Integration Consulting at Deloitte & Touche. He served as President at Solbourne Computer. He worked in the information technology industry for over 30 years in financial and general management roles. Early in his career he was employed at Digital Equipment Corp. and Storage Technology Corp. However most of his experience has been early stage companies. He worked as CFO at two venture capital backed start-ups funded by Mayfield; Kleiner, Perkins and Sequoia. Walt joined Solbourne in 1994, initially as CFO and four years later negotiated the purchase of Solbourne from Panasonic. As President he worked closely with Geoff Moore, author of Crossing the Chasm, redirecting the strategy to provide IT consulting services to the Oracle Applications market. After growing the company to 130 employees Walt negotiated the sale of the business to Deloitte Consulting in 2008. He completed a transition contract with Deloitte in 2011. Other board member roles include Board President of the Imagine Foundation (serving the needs of the disabled in Boulder County Colorado), CaraSolva, past President of Financial Executives International Denver Chapter. He is a member of Social Venture Partners, Investor Circle and Social Venture Network. Walt received his MBA from the University of Colorado and BS from the University of Northern Colorado.

Mr. Willem Van Biljon serves as Board Member at TallOrder. He graduated from the University of Cape Town with a degree in Computer Science. He held engineering and research positions at LinkData, the Institute for Applied Computer Science and the National Research Institute for Mathematical Sciences. He co-founded Mosaic Software. Mosaic built the Postilion payment system, the first high-end payment transaction switch for commodity hardware and operating systems (Windows). Mosaic's investors included GE and Paul Maritz. The company became one of the top three payment processing software vendors in the world and was sold in 2004 to S1 Corp. He worked for Amazon.com where he, along with Chris Pinkham and Christopher Brown, led the team that developed Amazon's Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2). He built the business plan for the service and was responsible for product management and marketing for the public cloud service. In 2006, he left Amazon Web Services and later started a venture with Chris Pinkham. The company, Nimbula, was focused on Cloud Computing software and was funded by Sequoia Capital and Accel Partners. In March 2013, Nimbula was acquired by Oracle Corporation. After Nimbula, he joined takealot.com, the largest e-commerce retailer in South Africa where he served as Co-CEO and CTO from 2014 to 2017. He is also an advisor and board member to a number of technology companies. He co-authored seven patents in cloud computing including "Managing Communications Between Computing Nodes", "Managing Execution of Programs by Multiple Computing Systems".

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. William Butler is a Co-Founder and serves as the Chief Executive Officer and a Board Member at Journey Sales. He serves as President at iPipeline. Mr. Butler is an accomplished executive with more than 20 years experience growing technology companies in Content Management, Marketing Automation, Compliance, Security, and Social Networking. His unprecedented track record of revenue achievement is based on the ability to hire, train, and motivate top performers coupled with leading edge sales processes designed to provide a competitive advantage. He has worked with many of the top venture firms including Kleiner Perkins, Benchmark, Integral Capital, Sequoia Capital, and Norwest. He has grown firms from startup to over $250M in revenue leading to both public offerings and profitable acquisitions. He has managed worldwide teams including direct sales, channels, inside sales, marketing, & professional services. In 1993, he joined Documentum with the release of version 1.0 and closed the majority of customers in the early years allowing Documentum to "Cross the Chasm" in the Pharmaceutical Industry. Over the next 8 years, he led the Sales Organization into multiple industries, worldwide expansion, a successful IPO, and left in 2001 with revenues of $250M. From 2001 to 2008, he worked with a number of early stage software companies including MarketSoft, Visible Path, and Orchestria. He has an undergraduate degree from the Pennsylvania State University and an MBA from Boston College. He works with local and international charitable organizations helping families transition from welfare to self sufficiency.

Mr. Aaref Hilaly serves as Partner at Bain Capital Ventures. He also served as a Partner at Arjula Capital. He also serves as a Board Member at Decagon,Clari, Cleanlab, Guardant Health. He serves as a Board Observer at ReCharge Payments. He previously served as a Board Member at Notable, Duck Duck Moose, LightStep, Keen (IO), MobileIron, Remix, Skyhigh Networks, Truera, and Validere. He served as a Board Observer and advisor at ThousandEyes. Previously he also served as Partner at Wing Venture Capital. He joined Sequoia Capital, in April 2012 and served as a Managing Member of Sequoia Capital Operations from January 2015 to June 2018. He also served as Vice President of engineering at Symantec Corp. from June 2011 to April 2012. He served as the Chief Executive Officer of Clearwell Systems, Inc. Before that, he was the founder and Chief Executive Officer of CenterRun, Inc. He holds an M.B.A. degree from Harvard Business School, an M.A. in Economics from McGill University, and a B.A. from Oxford University.

Amanda Reierson was appointed as a director in October 2022. She is a marketing veteran with over two decades of experience, including significant management experience in home services and property and casualty insurance. Ms. Reierson served as Chief Marketing Officer at Avant, a financial technology company that provides access to innovative financial solutions, including personal loans and credit cards, and is focused on reaching consumers wherever they may be on their financial journey. Prior to joining Avant, Ms. Reierson served as Head of Marketing at Sequoia-backed Thumbtack, overseeing all branding/creative efforts, media, CRM, and product marketing. Ms. Reierson was also previously Chief Growth Officer at Farmers Insurance, where she led the company's digital marketing and product transformation. Throughout her career she has also served in a variety of B2C and B2B marketing roles at Yahoo, DIRECTV, and the Los Angeles Times. She received her B.A. in Political Science from the University of California, Los Angeles.

Anulika Malomo will be appointed to the board as an independent non-executive director with effect from 24 October 2024. Anulika advises on a portfolio of investments across EMEA and is a non-executive director at HarbourVest Global Private Equity Limited, appointed in May 2022. She has extensive investment experience having held private equity roles at Sagana, Carlyle and Soros Fund and investment banking roles at Lehman Brothers and Goldman Sachs. Anulika founded The Sequoia Platform, an educational charity focused on social mobility for young people in the United Kingdom and was formerly chair of the board of governors at the University of East London.

Mr. Ariel Emanuel serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Endeavor. Mr. Emanuel serves as Chief Executive Officer & Chairman at TKO Group. He serves as Advisor at OTOY. He also serves as Board Member at Applecart. He is an Angel Investor. He also serves as Chief Executive Officer at WME IMG. He was also an Advisor at The Raine Group. He serves as Executive at WME-IMG and Sequoia (Joint Venture). He was a Partner at InterTalent and a Senior Agent at International Creative Management. He began his Entertainment Industry Career as an Agent Trainee at Creative Artists Agency. He is an Environmental and Political Activist. He was a Promoter of Live Music Events and Entertainment Venue Management Company. He serves as Member of Endeavor Talent Agency (also known as William Morris Endeavor Entertainment), a California-based talent agency, which he founded in 1995. He also served as the Co-Chair of the 2002 Earth to L.A. biennial fund-raising event for the Natural Resources Defense Council.
Bethann Colle, Partner, Sequoia Group Executive Search Consultants.

Mr. Brian Halligan is a Co-Founder and serves as Partner & General Partner at Propeller. He served as Advisor at OneScreen.ai. Mr. Halligan serves as Senior Advisor, Growth at Sequoia Capital. He serves as Board Member at Novy. He has pioneered the partnership with its fund strategy and is the ultimate CEO coach to its founders. He is the co-founder and Executive Chairperson of HubSpot, a customer relationship management (CRM) platform. HubSpot was founded in 2006, was first listed on the NYSE in 2014, and has grown to over $1 billion in revenue serving more than 100,000 customers worldwide.
