Prior to starting HubSpot, he was a Venture Partner at Longworth Ventures, was VP of Sales at Groove Networks (acquired by Microsoft), and a Senior VP of Sales at PTC. He also served on the board of directors of Fleetmatics Group, a global provider of fleet management solutions, until its acquisition by Verizon Communications in November 2016. He is a senior lecturer at MIT's Sloan School Of Management where he teaches Course 15.392 called "Scaling Entrepreneurial Ventures." He has a BSEE from the University Of Vermont and an MBA from MIT's Sloan School Of Management. He's a member of the corporation at the Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution where he focuses on climate change.

Mr. Carl Eschenbach serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Workday. Mr. Eschenbach serves as Board Member at Kumo. He serves as Venture Partner, Growth at Sequoia Capital. He serves as a Board Member at Retool. He serves as Board Observer at Cohesity. He serves as Board Member at UiPath. He had served as an Executive at Lodash. He serves as a Board Member at Salt Security, Cresta, and Grafana Labs. He served as a Board Member & Member of the Compensation Committee at Snowflake. He is a managing member at Sequoia, where he focuses on infrastructure technologies, cloud, and SaaS. He also provides operating expertise to Sequoia's portfolio companies. Before Sequoia, he was President and COO of VMware, where he helped grow the company from $31M in his first full year to $7B in revenues and from 200 people to 20,000. Before joining VMware, he was Vice President of North American sales at Inktomi and held various sales leadership positions with 3Com, EMC, and Lucent Technologies. He currently sits on the boards of Zoom, Aurora, Armis, Snowflake, UiPath, Palo Alto Networks, Workday, and ThousandEyes. He is passionate about the leadership, culture, and values of both teams and companies.

Mr. Decio Alves is the Founder of Sequoia Logistica e Transportes. Mr. Alves worked for the Playcenter group, again in the operations area. In 2007, he joined the logistics division of B2W Digital, where he remained until 2010. In 2010, he co-founded the company Sequoia Solucoes Logisticas. Between 2018 and 2021, he joined the Enjoei Pro Operations area at Enjoei S.A. He has not suffered any criminal conviction, any conviction in CVM administrative proceedings or any final and unappealable conviction, at the judicial or administrative level, which has suspended or disqualified him from practicing any professional or commercial activity.

Mr. Glenn Kelman serves as Chief Executive Officer, President & Board Member at Redfin. He serves as Board Member at Ridwell. He served Board Observer & & Board Member at Pro.com. He was a Board Member at Taproot Networks. He is a Mentor of TechStars based in Seattle. He served as Vice President of Product Management and Marketing at Plumtree Software since March 1998. He co-founded San Francisco-based Plumtree Software, a Sequoia-backed, publicly traded company that created the enterprise portal software market. In his seven years at Plumtree, Mr. Kelman at different times led engineering, marketing, product management and business development; he also was responsible for financing and general operations in Plumtree's first two years. Mr. Kelman served as a senior product manager at Informix Software, a company he joined via the acquisition of Stanford Technology Group, from 1995 to 1997. As a product manager for On-Line Analytical Processing software following Informix Software's acquisition of Stanford Technology Group, Mr. Kelman was involved in designing and launching a major release of Informix Software's On-Line Analytical Processing product line. Mr. Kelman worked as one of the first employees at Stanford Technology Group, a Sequoia-backed start-up acquired by IBM. He serves as an Advisor at Far Homes. He holds Bachelor of Arts degree in English.

Mr. Jeff Hargroves serves as Chairman of the Greater Kansas City Community Foundation and has been a member of our board of directors since June 2018. He serves as a Board Advisor at Falcon Creek Capital. In July 2001, He founded ProPharma Group, where he served as a Board Member until its sale in September 2020. He serves as a Healthcare Advisory Board Member at Riverside Partners. He also serves as a Board Member at Sequoia. Mr. Hargroves served as a board member a Orbis Biosciences. He was the President and Chief Executive Officer of ProPharma Group from its inception until May 2018. Previously, he served as the Director of Production at Ivy Animal Health (a subsidiary of Elanco) from 1999 to 2001, and before that, as a Director at ALZA (a subsidiary of Johnson and Johnson) from 1996 to 1999. He earned both his Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering and Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from the University of Missouri. We believe that Mr. Hargroves' experience in product launch and commercialization in the pharmaceutical industry, along with his extensive knowledge in financial management and corporate development, qualifies him to serve on our Board of Directors.

Mr. Jonathan Bridel serves as Board Member at The Renewables Infrastructure Group. He also served as perPETual Global Technologies. Mr. Bridel (Director, appointed 14th June 2013), aged 53, currently serves across various listed and unlisted companies as a Director or non-executive Chairman. These include Alcentra European Floating Rate Income Fund Limited, Starwood European Real Estate Finance Limited, Sequoia Economic Infrastructure Income Fund Limited and Funding Circle SME Income Fund Limited, as well as DP Aircraft I Limited, Fair Oaks Income Limited and Phaunos Timber Fund Limited which is currently being wound up. Jon previously worked as Managing Director of Royal Bank of Canada's investment businesses in the Channel Islands and in senior management positions in the British Isles and Australia in banking, specializing in corporate and commercial credit and in private businesses as Chief Financial Officer. Graduating from the University of Durham with a degree of Master of Business Administration in 1988, Jon also holds qualifications from the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales where he is a Fellow, the Australian Institute of Company Directors and is a Chartered Marketer. Jon is a member of the Chartered Institute of Marketing, a Chartered Director and Fellow of the Institute of Directors and a Chartered Fellow of the Chartered Institute for Securities and Investment. Jon is a resident of Guernsey.

Ms. Katharine Weymouth serves as Board Member at Republic Services. She is an Angel Investor. Katharine B. Weymouth has been on Republic's board of directors since October 2018. She is Chief Operating Officer of ShineTogether, a start-up platform for parents of struggling and at-risk teens. She is also Senior Advisor to ChefMarket, an on-demand delivery service for restaurant chefs, and previously held numerous leadership positions at The Washington Post, including Publisher and Chief Executive Officer from 2008 through 2014. Ms. Weymouth sits on the boards of directors of Cable One, Inc., Xometry, Inc., Sequoia Mutual Fund, and Graham Holdings Co. She also serves as a trustee of the Philip L. Graham Fund, and is Chair of the Board for The Greater Washington Community Foundation. Ms. Weymouth graduated from Harvard University and earned her law degree from Stanford University.

primary_position: Board Member, Chair of the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee & Member of the Audit Committee
biography: Ms. Katharine Weymouth serves as Board Member, Chair of the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee & Member of the Audit Committee at Xometry. She is the Co-Founder and Senior Advisor of The Chef Market (formerly DineXpert), an on-demand platform for restaurants. Previously, she was the Publisher and Chief Executive Officer of the Washington Post. Since January 2015, she has also served as a Trustee of the Philip L Graham Fund. Ms. Weymouth is a board member of Republic Services, Inc, Cable One, Inc., Sequoia Mutual Fund, and The Graham Holdings Company. She received a B.A. in English Literature from Harvard University and a J.D. from Stanford Law School and joined the Xometry board in October 2020.

Dr. Laurence Dutto serves as Board Member at Sierra Bancorp. Laurence S. Dutto, Ph.D., was appointed to the Boards of the Bank and of Sierra Bancorp effective September 15, 2016, at which time he was also appointed to serve on the Governance Committee and the Insurance Committee, which became the Risk Committee in 2019. Dr. Dutto, a resident of Visalia, California, is a retired college administrator with extensive hands-on agricultural experience. His decorated 30-year career at College of the Sequoias in Visalia, California includes service as Provost of the Tulare College Center, Dean of Academic Services, Dean of Technical Education, Agriculture Division Chair, and Faculty Academic Senate President. His prior experience includes 15 years working on his family's dairy farm, and he currently is in a partnership with his sister growing almonds. He was appointed to the Board due in part to his management and administrative expertise and his community connections, and to help strengthen the Bank's ties to the local agricultural community.

Mr. Li Li serves as Board Member at Adagene. Mr. Li has approximately 10 years of experiences in Healthcare industry and related Venture Capital & Private Equity investment, and is currently a vice president of Sequoia Capital China. He received his Bachelor Degree in Natural Sciences from University of Cambridge in UK. He was a Clinical Research Associate at Otsuka Beijing Research Institute a fully owned subsidiary of Otsuka Pharmaceutical (TYO:4578), an analyst and then an associate of the China Everbright Limited (00165.HK) Medical & Healthcare Fund, an associate of Sequoia Capital China. During the time at the China Everbright Limited Medical & Healthcare Fund, he participated the investments in BGI (300676), Amcare, Betta Pharma (300558) and Jida Pharma.

Mr. Li Likai serves as Board Member at NewSight Imaging. He is founder and partner of Guangsheng & Partners Attorneys-at-law (G&P) and managing partner of Ennohub Venture. Dr. Li is chairman of Ennohub Technology and a managing partner of Ennohub Venture, an investment fund for startups. Dr. Li has been appointed by the Chinese government as one of the board members of the Organizing Committee of China "Innovation Summit." Dr. Li served as government legal counsel in the PRC Ministry of Commerce for many years. He became a limited partner of Sequoia Capital China in 2007. Mr. Li teaches executive courses as adjunct professor for EMBA students in leading universities in China. He has written two books: Open Innovation: Massive Collaboration Changes the World and Technological Startup: Built to be Great. Dr. Li holds a PhD from Queen's University, Canada.
Mr. Lifeng Yu serves as board member at CSD Water services. He served as Partner at Sequoia Capital.

Mr. Matthew Miller serves as Partner of Growth at Sequoia Capital. He is the Founder of Evantic. He served as a Board Member at Tecton. He serves as a Board Member at dbt Labs. He served as a Board Member at HireVue. He serves as a Director at Evantic Capital. He served as a Board Member at Graphcore. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Finance from Brigham Young University. He serves as a Board Member at Carbon Black and Graphcore. He started building computers and writing code at 12 years old in his mother's kitchen. He has worked as an entrepreneur, an advisor and now an investor. At Sequoia, he has led investments in Docker, Skyhigh Networks, Nimble Storage and Barracuda Networks. Before Sequoia, he worked at Goldman Sachs and graduated from Brigham Young University. He serves as Board Member at Grafana Labs. He serves as Board Member at Yokoy.

Mr. Michael Chermak serves as Executive Chairman and Board Member at Reticulate Micro. He has 40 years of experience in leadership roles in the healthcare industry and has raised over $200 million for his various enterprises, both private and public. Michael founded Makena Investment Advisors, LLC., a firm focused on assisting emerging companies in accessing equity capital markets. He serves as an officer and/or director for a few select public and private entities. Previously, he was the founder and CEO of Healthdemographics, Inc., a company in the healthcare predictive data and decision support business, with over 1,200 clients worldwide and was regularly sourced by the Wall Street Journal for articles on the healthcare industry. He sold the company in 1997 to Medirisk. In 1998, he was the co-founder, initial investor, and original Chairman of Medibuy.com, an Internet healthcare supply vendor. Medibuy raised over $140 million in its first 18 months of operation backed by leading VCs such as Kleiner Perkins, Sequoia, Oak, and institutional investors including Allianz. Medibuy acquired the e-commerce initiatives of two leading GPOs, Premier and Columbia HCA, that at one time accounted for nearly 70% of healthcare product expenditures in the US. Medibuy was sold to GHX (Global Health Exchange), an e-commerce company founded by General Electric, Abbot, Baxter, and Medtronic. Becton-Dickinson, Braun, Guidant, Tyco, Siemens, and others.
He worked in China for over 6 years and was the former Chairman and CEO of Bridgetech Holdings International (OTC: BGTH), which focused on introducing Western medicine into China. He has served on the Board of Directors and as an Audit Committee member of Beijing Origin Seed (NASDAQ: SEED), a Chardan Capital SPAC.
He graduated from the University of New Mexico, Anderson School of Management.

Mr. Michael Moritz serves as a Board Member at Instacart. He serves as a Board Member at PhenomeX. He is an Angel Investor. He served as a Partner & Board Member at Sequoia Capital. He served as a Board Member at Stripe and PopSugar. He also serves as a Board Member at SCHF (GPE). He serves as a Board Member at WireScreen. He serves as President & Chairman at Klarna. He is a Founder & serves as President, Chief Financial Officer & Chairman at Crankstart Foundation. He serves as a Board Member at Pocket Outdoor Media. He was a Board Member at Flipagram. He served as a Board Member at LinkedIn. He currently serves on the board of directors for a number of public and private companies, including Stripe, Green Dot Corporation, Sugar, and [24]7.ai Customer. Previously, he was a member of the board of directors at various public companies, including Google, PayPal, Red Envelope, Saba Software, Flextronics, Yahoo!, and Zappos. He is a venture capitalist at Sequoia Capital, focusing on software and services investments. Prior to joining Sequoia Capital in 1986, he served on the boards of Flextronics International, Google, Yahoo!, and PayPal. He is the co-founder of Technologic Partners, a publications and events firm that was acquired by Dow Jones & Company. He was also the former Bureau Chief of The Times, San Francisco. He serves as Secretary & Treasurer at the Kelson Foundation. He also serves as a board member at Luxim Corporation and Magic. He holds an M.A. in Modern History from the University of Oxford. He holds other degrees from the Wharton School and the University of Oxford. He also served as a Board Member at Charlotte Tilbury Beauty. He serves as Board Member and Advisor at Watershed.

Mr. Neil Nanpeng Shen is a Co-Founder and serves as Board Member at Trip.com. He is the founding managing partner of Sequoia Capital China. He served as our president from August 2003 to October 2005 and as Chief Financial Officer from 2000 to October 2005. He also co-founded and served as non-executive co-chairman of Homeinns Hotel Group, a leading economy hotel chain in China, which commenced operations in July 2002. Currently, he also serves as a director of a number of public and private companies, including Noah Holdings (NYSE: NOAH), Pinduoduo (Nasdaq: PDD), Meituan Dianping (SEHK: 03690) and China Renaissance Holdings (SEHK: 01911). He received his Master's degree from Yale University and his Bachelor's degree from Shanghai Jiao Tong University.

Peter F. Drake, Ph.D. has served as a director of the Company since October 2003. Dr. Drake is currently the Managing General Partner of Mayflower Partners, a healthcare investment fund. From 1999 to 2002, he served as a Managing Director in the Equity Research Department of Prudential Securities, Inc., after Prudential acquired Vector Securities International, an investment banking firm co-founded by Dr. Drake in 1988. Vector specialized in raising capital for emerging healthcare companies and acted as an advisor in merger and alliance transactions in the healthcare area. Dr. Drake also co-founded Deerfield Management and Vector Fund Management, both of which are healthcare hedge funds. Dr. Drake joined the investment banking firm of Kidder, Peabody & Co. as a Biotechnology Analyst in 1983, becoming a partner in 1986. He currently serves on the board of directors of Trustmark Insurance Co., a healthcare insurance provider, Sequoia Sciences, a private biotechnology company, and Rodman & Renshaw Capital Group, an investment bank that provides corporate finance, strategic advisory and related services to public and private companies. Dr. Drake received a B.A. degree in Biology from Bowdoin College and attended the Wharton School of Business at the University of Pennsylvania. After receiving his Ph.D. in Biochemistry and Neurobiology from Bryn Mawr College, he spent three years as a Senior Research Associate in the Department of Developmental Biology and Anatomy at Case Western Reserve University.

Mr. Pun-Kok Herbert Chia, Aged 59; Director since 29 October 2024; Term of office: 29 October 2024 (appointed) to 2026 AGM; Other positions held with the Group; HKEX - member of Audit Committee, Investment Committee and Risk Committee; Other major offices: Alibaba Cloud Intelligence (North APAC Region) - senior advisor (2024~); Hong Kong Management Association - professor of practice (2023~); Institute for China Business of The University of Hong Kong - adjunct associate professor (2022~); Chow Tai Fook Jewellery Group Limited - independent non-executive director (2021~); Past offices: Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation - board member (2018-2024); Sequoia Capital China - venture partner (2016-2023); Alibaba (China) Co Ltd - vice president (2010-2016); Public service: Common Spatial Data Advisory Committee - non-official member (2023~); Digital Economy Development Committee - non-official member (2022~); Information Technology Services Committee of the Hospital Authority - co-opted member (2021~); Aviation Development and Three-runway System Advisory Committee - member (2021~); Education Commission - non-official member (2021~); Committee on Professional Development of Teachers and Principals - non-official member (2019~); Qualifications: Executive Master of Business Administration (Tsinghua University, PRC); Executive Master of Business Administration (the Institut Europeen d'Administration des Affaires (INSEAD));

Mr. Rajesh Sawhney is the Founder & serves as General Partner at GSF India. Mr. Sawhney serves as Board Member at IndiaMART. He is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at InnerChef. He served as an Advisor at Chizel. He serves as an Advisor at HackerEarth. He serves as an Advisor at Zimyo. He is the founder of GSF Superangels Academy. He previously served as a Board Member at Microland. He served as an Advisor at Silversparro. He serves as a Board Member at DailyRounds and ixigo. He is a Co-Founder at Gastrotope. He has made over 20 investments as an active and engaged angel investor, which include Viki (acquired by Rakuten for USD 225M), Little Eye Labs (acquired by Facebook), Mobstac, Pokkt, Silverpush, HackerEarth, Browntape, Overcart, Flinto, and Timesaverz. He hosts and curates the two leading Tech/Startup conferences in Asia: WhereDoWeGoNow in Bangalore and Global Superangels Forum in New Delhi. His journey has been a continuum of re-invention waves. He brought private radio (Times FM) to India in the early nineties, redefining Indian youth culture. He earned a Bachelor of Engineering in Electrical and Electronics Engineering from Shanmugha Arts, Science, Technology and Research Academy in 1996, followed by an MBA in Marketing from the University of Madras in 1998.

Mr. Gregory McAdoo serves as a General Partner at Bolt. He served as a Partner at Sequoia Capital. He served as a Board Member at Boom. He is focusing on semiconductor and systems investments. Prior to joining Sequoia Capital in 2000 he was President and CEO of Sentient Networks (CSCO). Previously, he held senior engineering and executive level management positions at Cisco Systems, Sourcecom, Micom Communications, and Datability Systems. He also served as President and Chief Executive Officer at Sentient Networks.

Mr. Haim Sadger is a Co-Founder and serves as Managing Partner at S Capital VC. Mr. Sadger serves as Partner at Sequoia Capital. He serves as a Board Member at Wing Security. He serves as a Board Member at Simplicity and Oolo. He is an Angel Investor. He also serves as a Board Member at Indeni, Pecan. He served as Board Member at Run: AI, Wing Security, Simplicity, Pyramid Analytics, Hourly, and Deep AI. He serves as Chairman at Silk. He served as a Board Member at DeepAI. He is a Board Member of Salt Security, StreamRail, and Collective. He is a Board Member and Advisor of Capitolis. He served as a Board Member at Oolo, CB4 & Lemonade. He focuses on mobile, semiconductor, systems, and software investments. Before joining Sequoia Capital in 1999, he held senior engineering and management positions at Intel Corporation. He was the Chairman at Taykey. He has a BS in Electrical Engineering from the Technion-Israel Institute of Technology. He served as Chairman of Silent Communication. He served as a Board Member at Oribi. He serves as a Board Member at Lumana. He also served as a Board Member at Axiom.

Mr. Harshjit Sethi serves as Managing Director at Peak XV Partners. He serves as Board Member at BharatPe. He serves as Board Member at Apna, Smallcase, BharatPe, and Darwinbox Digital Solutions. He serves as Managing Director at Sequoia Capital. He serves as Board Member at LambdaTest.

Mr. Ishaan Mittal serves as Managing Director at Peak XV Partners. He serves as a Board Member at GirnarSoft, Mamaearth, Suburban Diagnostics, and Finova Capital (India). He served as a Board Member at Suburban Diagnostics. He served as a Junior Associate at Sequoia Capital India. Before joining Sequoia Capital India, he was with Boston Consulting Group, where he served clients in telecom, industrial goods, consumer goods, financial services, and healthcare. He holds a bachelor's in Mechanical Engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi. He served as a Board Member at Urban Ladder.

Mr. James Goetz serves as Partner, Seed/Early and Growth at Sequoia Capital. He serves as Board Member and Member of Talent and Compensation Committee at Intel. He served as an Advisory Board Member at HubSpot. He had served as an Executive at Lodash. He serves as a Board Member at Palo Alto Networks, Pocket Gems, Intel, Clari, Appirio, Observable & Drawbridge. Previously, he served as a Board Member at Metaswitch Networks and Chartboost. Prior to VitalSigns, he was the Vice President of Network Management for Bay Networks. Prior to Bay and Synoptics, he held various product and marketing positions at AT&T, AT&T Bell Labs and Digital Equipment. He has led or co-led Sequoia's investments in AdMob (GOOG), Appirio (WIT), Barracuda (CUDA), Clearwell (SYMC), GitHub (MSFT), HubSpot (HUBS), Jive (JIVE), Karma (FB), Okta (OKTA), Palo Alto Networks (PANW), PeakStream (GOOG), Ruckus Wireless (RKUS), Nimble Storage (NMBL) and WhatsApp (FB). He has a BS in Electrical and Computer Engineering from the University of Cincinnati and an MS in Electrical Engineering from Stanford University. He served as a Board Member at YikYak. He is the Founder and serves as Chairman at Casimir Holdings. He is an Angel Investor.

Mr. Jeff Dykan serves as Managing Partner at SCP Vitalife Partners. He serves as Advisory Board Member at Katao Venture Partners. Prior to joining Vitalife, he was recruited by Sequoia Capital to be Chairman and CEO of BitBand. Before arriving at BitBand in 2001, he held several senior financial positions, including a stint as CFO at VocalTec Communications, nine years as Director of Regional Finance for Applied Materials in Israel and four years as VP Finance at Opal. He began his career with Andersen Consulting in New York. He is Chairman of Argo Medical Technologies serves on the board of directors of NiTi Surgical Solutions, Regentis Biomaterials, NovoGI, Avedro, Deep Breeze, Beta-O2 Technologies, and GeneGrafts, and was previously a board member of Colbar Lifescience (acquired by J&J) and Can-Fite BioPharma (TASE: CFBI). He has a B.S. in accounting and management from New York University and an MBA in computer applications also from New York University. Mr. Dykan is also licensed in New York State as a certified public accountant. He served as Board Member at Deep Breeze. He served as Chairman at Trig Medical.

Ms. Jess Lee serves as Partner, Seed/Early at Sequoia Capital. Ms. Lee serves as Board Member of Ironclad. She serves as Board Member at Maven Clinic and Otter. She serves as an Executive at Protégé. She is also a Co-Founder and served as the Chief Executive Officer at Polyvore. She served as Board Member at The Wing. Prior to co-founding Polyvore, she was a product manager at Google, where she worked on Google Maps and launched features like My Maps and draggable driving directions. She has a degree in computer science from Stanford University.

Mr. Jianwei Li is the Founding Partner and serves as Managing Partner at Zhencheng Capital. He served as Non-Executive Director at SAI.TECH Global. He also served as Chairman & Co-Chief Executive Officer at TradeUP Global and TradeUP 88. He served as a Venture Partner at ZhenFund. He served as an Advisor at Virtuix. He served as Chairman & Co-Chief Executive Officer at TradeUP Acquisition. He served as a Vice President at Sequoia Capital. He focuses on investment in the TMT sector. Prior to joining Sequoia Capital in 2011, he was the CFO of a Mobile Internet company, where he was in charge of business strategy and financial affairs. Before that, he had acted as Vice President of Fidelity Growth Partners Asia, with his main focus given to research on technology, financial services, and education. He led Fidelity's investment in Netqin (NYSE: NQ) and played an important role in several investment projects such as Crystal Computer Graphics, KMsocial, Financial Education, and Datou Wireless. Before setting his foot in Venture Capital, he had worked as a consultant in The Boston Consulting Group and had offered advice to major companies in telecommunications, banking, internet, and retail chain industries. He holds a master's degree in Management Engineering and a dual bachelor's degree in Management Engineering and Computer Science from the Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications.

Mr. Kaushik Anand serves as Partner at A91 Partners. He served as Head, India at CapitalG. He serves as Board Member at FinBox. He serves as a Board Member at Aye Finance and Kaar Technologies. Previously, he was Head of India Investments at CapitalG (formerly Google Capital) where he focused on technology and financial services businesses. At CapitalG, he led investments in Aye Finance, Cardekho, Freshworks and Cuemath. He was previously at Sequoia Capital India and McKinsey & Co. He is an alumnus of Harvard Business School and IIT Madras.

Mr. Kevin Chen serves as a Co-Founding Partner at BioTrack Capital. He serves as a Board Member at NuProbe. Previously, he was a Partner at Sequoia Capital China, responsible for healthcare investment. Before Sequoia Capital, Mr. Chen set up the first healthcare fund at Everbright Holdings and served as Head of Everbright Healthcare Fund. He has led investments in over 20 leading healthcare companies in China, including the Beijing Genomics Institute (BGI), Betta Pharma, Yuwell Medical, Zai Lab, and Amcare Hospital. Before Everbright, Mr. Chen served as President of ShangPharma, a leading China CRO company, and was the COO and CFO of ShangPharma and took the company public at NYSE in 2010. He received a B.S. in Chemistry from Nanjing University, an M.S. in Medicinal Chemistry from Tulane University and an MBA from Kellogg School of Management, Northwestern University.

Mr. Konstantine Buhler serves as Partner, Seed/Early at Sequoia Capital. He serves as a Board Member at EDX and CaptivateIQ. He also serves as a Board Member at Kumo.AI and Ethos Life. He served as a Board Member at Data.AI. He serves as a Partner at Sequoia Capital. He served as Principal at Meritech Capital Partners. He joined Meritech in 2016, focusing on data-first enterprise and consumer businesses. Prior to joining the team, he worked at tech startups including RelateIQ and Italia Innovation and also spent time at McKinsey & Company in New York and The Pritzker Group in Chicago. His entrepreneurial journey began at a young age when he founded an internationally recognized emergency management organization. For eight years, he collaborated with companies and NGOs, spoke at conferences, and built software for the U.S. Department of Homeland Security. While serving as the Stanford VC Club President for 4 years, he did technical diligence for early-stage VC firms including Accel, DFJ, General Catalyst, and Redpoint. He conducted key diligence and sourcing for companies including Viz.ai, Tock, Tango, Contrast, and Bubbies. He actively advises several startups in Silicon Valley. He holds a B.S. in Management Science & Engineering with a minor in Art History, an M.S. in Computer Science with an Artificial Intelligence concentration, and an M.B.A., all from Stanford University. He is a recipient of the Terman Engineering Award, and Mayfield Fellowship, and is an Arjay Miller scholar. He is a member of the Tau Beta Pi and Phi Beta Kappa Honor Societies, received the top GPA in his engineering department, and was selected as the Stanford Baccalaureate speaker.

Mr. Kuantai Yeh serves as a Partner at Qiming Venture Partners. He serves as a Board Member at Zego Technology. He has over 20 years of working experience in venture capital, investment banking, and high-tech companies. His portfolio includes Transwarp, SequoiaDB, XSKY, TigerGraph, Insta360, Tongdun Technology, WorkTrans, Tungee, OKKI, Bouffalo Lab, InferVision, Chuhang, ZEGO, Keysino (SZSE:300899), NASN Auto, LANMI, among others. He serves as a Board Member at CIX Technology. He holds two U.S. semiconductor technology patents. Forbes Magazine has recognized him as a top venture capitalist in China. Prior to joining Qiming, he served as Managing Director at Highland Capital Partners and Intel Capital China for nearly ten years. In his portfolio, six companies have gone public, whereas two were acquired by public companies. His notable deals include Tuniu (Nasdaq: TOUR), 6.cn (acquired by SongCheng Entertainment), Gamewave (acquired by Qihoo360), Actions Semi (Nasdaq: ACTS), Montage Technology (SHSE: 688008), VeriSilicon (SHSE:688521), Parade Technology (GTSM:4966), Chipsbank Technology (NEEQ: 830845), and Yeepay. He was a Vice President at Credit Suisse, responsible for the Asia Technology Investment Banking business. He began his career at Cypress Semiconductor, based in Silicon Valley, where he was an R&D Manager and a Wafer Fab Engineering Manager. He holds an MBA degree, a MENG degree in Electrical Engineering, and a B.S. degree in Electrical Engineering and Materials Science, all from Cornell University.

Mr. Kui Zhou serves as Partner at HSG. He serves as a Board Member at Boyaa Interactive and Miyabaobei.com. Before joining Sequoia Capital in 2005, he worked for Legend Capital, leading several successful investments such as SinoCom Software, Shenzhen SkyInfo, VanceInfo, and Kaituo Technology. He also worked for Lenovo Group, where he took charge of business development and investment management. He has years of working experience in small and medium-sized enterprises covering the fields of metallurgy, telecommunication, and manufacturing management consulting. He received his MBA from Tsinghua University and a bachelor's degree in Electric Automation from the Wuhan University of Technology. He is also a director at Sky-mobi. He also serves as a Board Member at Shanghai Hintsoft Software.

Ms. Luciana Lixandru serves as Partner, Seed/Early, Growth at Sequoia Capital. She serves as Board Member at Stripe. She serves as Board Member at RobCo, Upway, and Xentral. She serves as a Board Member at Ledgy and Veed.Io. Previously, she spent 8 years at Accel after 5 years. Before Accel, he was with Summit Partners. He is from Romania and graduated from Georgetown University.

Mr. Luis Robles is a Co-Founder & serves as Portfolio Manager at Viento Ventures. She serves as an Advisor at Decent. He serves as a Board Member at Kegg. He serves as an Operating Advisor at East Los Capital. He also serves as an Advisor at Signalwire. He co-founded and served as Vice President of Marketing at Diamanti. He also serves as a Venture Partner at Breakaway Growth Fund. He was a Co-Founder and served as an Investor at Alchemist Accelerator. He was an early-stage company builder at Sequoia Capital. He is an Advisor of Decent. He was also a Senior Product Manager at VMware, where he helped build out various product and operations initiatives. Previously, he was involved with other Silicon Valley start-ups. He served as the Director of ThousandEyes, Inc. and MongoDB, Inc. He has an M.B.A. from Harvard Business School. He has also received a B.S. and an M.S. degree in Computer Science from Stanford University.

Ms. Lynn Yang served as a Partner at HSG. She serves as Managing Director at Sequoia Capital. She serves as a Board Member at HiFiBiO Therapeutics, Normunity, and Kumquat Biosciences. She served as a Board Member at ProfoundBio. She is a Partner at HongShan, focusing on the healthcare sector, where she has led investments in numerous renowned healthcare enterprises. Prior to joining HongShan in 2015, she worked at the Legend Capital healthcare team. Previously, she served as a Business Development Manager and Product Manager at major multinational companies such as Johnson & Johnson and GE Healthcare. She holds an MBA from Duke University in the United States and a master's degree in clinical medicine from Tongji Medical College of Huazhong University of Science and Technology.

Ms. Maria Cirino is a Co-Founder and serves as an Managing Partner at .406 Ventures. She served as a Board Member at MineralTree. She served as Investor at Compass. She was a Board Member at Vaultive. She served as a Board Member at Jisto and Veracode. She has been building and founding technology businesses for 25 years. Her operational, entrepreneurial, and senior management experience in venture-backed technology companies includes two Massachusetts IPOs of the Year and the founding of two successful companies and a venture capital firm. Before she served as an SVP of VeriSign following its 2005 acquisition of Guardent, the market-leading Managed Security Services provider for $142 million. Guardent was a Sequoia, Charles River Ventures, and NEA-backed IT security company that she co-founded and led as CEO. In this role, she received industry recognition as "Massachusetts CEO of the Year" and "Ernst & Young Entrepreneur of the Year," among others. Before Guardent, she was Senior Vice President responsible for sales and marketing at Razorfish, an IT services company that acquired her previous company, i-Cube, for $1.8 billion in 1999. At i-Cube, she led sales and marketing. Before i-Cube, from 1993 - 1997 she was responsible for North American sales at Shiva, the category-creating remote access leader. Before Shiva, she held sales and marketing roles at Lotus Development Corporation and Software City Inc. She holds an AB in English literature from Mount Holyoke College where she has served as a Trustee and where she currently serves as a member of the college's investment committee.

Mr. Mark Kvamme is a Co-Founder and serves as Partner Emeritus at Drive Capital. Mr. Kvamme is a Co-Founder and serves as Chairman at Eagle Electronics. He serves as a Board Member at Bee6 and Notion AI. He also served as Chairman at Physna. He served as a Board Member at FarmLogs. He also serves as a Board Member and Advisor at Clinc. He is a Founding Managing Director and serves as Chief Investment Officer & Chief Executive Officer at The O.H.I.O. Fund. He formerly served as President. He serves as a Board Member at Tillster. He also served as a Board Member at Trove AI. He is a Board Member at Notion Al and MarkLogic. He served as a Partner at Sequoia Capital for 12 years, where he led investments in companies such as LinkedIn, Cast Iron, and FunnyOrDie.com. Before co-founding Drive Capital, he served as interim Chief Investment Officer and President at JobsOhio, a nonprofit corporation created to run the state's economic development activities. He is a venture capitalist at Drive Capital, which he founded with Chris Olsen in 2013. He currently sits on the board of Gild, Funny or Die, and Mark Logic. He specializes in innovative technology, healthcare, and consumer investments in the Midwest. Before Drive Capital, He was a partner at Sequoia Capital, the chairman and CEO of CKS Group, the director of international marketing at Wyse Technology, president and CEO of International Solutions, and a founding member of Apple France. He has a BA in French from the University of California, Berkeley. He has served as a Board Member at VentureOhio and Roadtrippers. He is a Co-Founder of Color Coded Labs.

primary_position: Head of Business Development & Growth Equity Investing
biography: Ms. Mary Miller serves as Head of Business Development & Growth Equity Investing at Norwest. She serves as a Board Member & Advisor at Notre Dame Venture Capital. She served as Director at SoftBank Investment Advisers. She served as the Principal of Business Development at TSG Consumer Partners. She operates across TSG's investment verticals. Previously, she was a consultant with Sequoia Capital, where she facilitated limited partner communications. Before that, she was with Oaktree Capital Management and TA Associates, where her responsibilities ranged from assisting with fundraising efforts to conducting due diligence on potential investments. She received a BBA in Finance from the University of Notre Dame.

Mr. Matthew Huang is a Co-Founder & serves as Managing Partner at Paradigm (Crypto Fund). Mr. Huang serves as Chairman at Ithaca. He served as a Board Member at Privy. He serves as Board Member at Stripe. He also served as a Board Member at Amber Group. Previously, he was a partner at Sequoia Capital, focusing on early-stage venture investments, including leading the firm's cryptocurrency efforts. He was the founder and CEO of Hotspots, a Y Combinator company acquired by Twitter in 2012. He purchased his first Bitcoin from MtGox in 2012. He holds a B.S. in Mathematics from MIT. He co-founded Moki.TV.

Mr. Michael Goguen is the Founder and Managing Partner at Two Bear Capital. He serves as a Board Member at Novoron Bioscience. He serves as a Board Member at Dymium. Previously, he served as a Managing Partner at Sequoia Capital. He served as a Board Member at Verafi & Truwl.

Mr. Michael Vernal serves as Partner at Conviction Partners. He served as a Board Member at Picsart. He served as Board Member at Census. He serves as Partner at Sequoia Capital. He served as Board Member at Threads and Whisper. He served as Board Member at Blues Wireless. He served as a Board Member at Deno, Census and Statsig. He served as Board Member at rideOS, Rockset and Citizen. Prior to this, he served as Vice President at Facebook. Prior to joining Facebook, he spent nearly six years at Microsoft, first as a product manager and later as a development lead. He also serves as Board Member at Jumpstart. He serves as Board Member at Clay. He holds a BA and an MS in Computer Science from Harvard University.

Mr. Mohit Bhatnagar serves as Board Member at Dailyhunt. He serves as Managing Director at Peak XV Partners. He served as a Board Member at iCafe Manager. He served as a Board Member and Advisor Near. He serves as a Board Member at CleverTap, Cars24, Ideacts Innovations, Zomato, Meesho, Prizm Payments, Comviva, Ujjivan Microfinance, IMI Mobile, Ideacts, Knowlarity Communications, Micromax Mobile, One Assist and Citrus Pay. He also served at OYO Rooms. He served as an Advisor at Bubbly. Before joining Sequoia Capital, he served as the Senior Vice President at BhartiAirtel where he helped scale the business from a few states' operations into a leading national wireless carrier. Earlier, he co-founded Bright Pod, a wireless start-up in the US, by orchestrating a spin-off from Ericsson Mobile Systems. He has received an MBA from UNC Chapel Hill and an MSEE from Virginia Tech. He also served as a Board Member at Jifflenow.

Mr. Nanpeng Shen is a Founding Managing Partner of Sequoia Capital. Mr. Shen is a Founding Partner & serves as Managing Partner at Hongshan Capital Group. He is a Co-Founder of Trip.com Group and serves as its Independent Director. He is also a Co-Founder of Home Inns (NASDAQ: HMIN). He also serves as Director at Noah Holdings. He is a Co-Founder and serves as Chairman at Hong Kong X-Tech. Previously, he served as a Board Member at Brii Biosciences. He serves as a Board Member at LianLian Digitech. He serves as an Advisor at Breakthrough Energy. He has a BS from Shanghai Jiao Tong University and an MA from the School of Management at Yale University. He is also a director at China Nuokang BioPharmaceuticals.

Mr. Omar Hamoui serves as Partner at Mucker Capital. He co-founded HerBabyShower. He served as Board Member at Emotive. He serves as Board Member at Leadrilla. He serves as Board Member at LoudCrowd and Atomchat.io. He focuses on early-stage investments backing entrepreneurs that exhibit unique insights. He serves as Board Member at Clutter. He previously spent 5 years as a partner on the early-stage team at Sequoia Capital. Based on investments he led at Sequoia, he has served as a director of App Annie, PicsArt, Next Trucking, Papaya, Streamlabs, Carnivore, and Kiwi. Prior to Sequoia, he spent 16 years as an entrepreneur, founding several companies in mobile software and services. While working towards his MBA at the Wharton School, he began to think more seriously about the untapped potential of mobile advertising and created AdMob to address this growing opportunity. He served as AdMob's founder and CEO from January 2006 through the company's $750M acquisition by Google in May 2010. He holds a BS in Computer Science from the University of California, Los Angeles. He regularly shares insights on company building with his video series Shorthand for High-Growth Startups. He also holds Master of Business Administration from University of Pennsylvania (Wharton).

Mr. Patrick Grady serves as a Partner, Growth at Sequoia Capital. He serves as Board Member at Harvey. He had served as an Executive at Lodash. He serves as a Independent Director and Member of the Audit Committee at Okta. He served as Board Member at Namely, Marklogic and Prosper Marketplace. He serves as Board Member at Pilot. He is a Board Member at Amplitude, and Mello. He focuses on software and services investments. Prior to joining Sequoia Capital in 2007, he worked at Summit Partners where he was involved in investments in the software, financial services, and healthcare sectors. He served as a Board Observer at Medallia. Earlier, he was an investment banker with Citigroup's Global Corporate and Investment Bank, where he worked on a variety of M&A, equity, and debt transactions in the healthcare sector. He has a BS in Economics and Finance from Boston College.

Mr. Paul Kwan serves as Managing Director at General Catalyst. Mr. Kwan served as Board Member at Onebrief. He served as Board Member at Sequoia Capital. He serves as Managing Director at General Catalyst. He serves as Board Member at Corelight. He serves as Board Member at Awardco and Cobot. He serves as Board Observer at Anduril. He had the opportunity to join Morgan Stanley's Menlo Park office and thrived there for 22 years, including six years running the bank's global internet and software business and six years leading the West Coast team. That continuity became a great asset, because it took time to learn the craft of advising companies on their most important strategic and financial objectives. He serves as Board Member at Anomali.

Mr. Pieter Kemps serves as Partner, Surge at Peak XV Partners. He served as a Board Member at 90 Seconds. He serves as a Board Member at Qoala & Carousell. He serves as a Board Member at HealthEngine. He joined Sequoia in 2014 and advises on investments across Consumer Internet, Mobile, Fintech, and Software companies in Southeast Asia. He currently serves on the Board of Nugit, Funding Societies, Funding Societies, , Fave, and HealthEngine, and also works closely with Zilingo and Sirion Labs. He holds a Master's in Economics from Universidad Carlos III de Madrid, a Master of Business Administration in Venture Capital & Entrepreneurship from the University of Chicago (Booth) (2011), and a Master of Science degree in International Business Studies from Maastricht University (2000).

Mr. Prakash Shukla serves as Managing Partner at Wayfare Ventures. Prakash is a seasoned professional with over 25 years of general management, finance, technology, and entrepreneurial experience. He serves as Board Member at Kheyti. Prakash is a managing partner with seed firm Solarex LLC (family office). Before that, he was a partner with HGM asset management (PE fund) and was a 2013 advanced leadership fellow at Harvard University. He served as senior vice president and CIO of the TAJ group of hotels from 1999-2012. With a background in some of the industry's most venerable corporations- Unisys / Sperry and IBM, Prakash has provided solutions for numerous corporations and financial institutions such as Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, Citigroup, Paine Webber, and Solomon Smith Barney. In addition, Prakash was an early investor and a board member of Speech & Software Technologies (a Tata-promoted company), TravelGuru (Sequoia funded India-centric travel portal sold to Travelocity), and Transerv. Prakash is a graduate of Rutgers University with degrees in electrical engineering and English, and New York University with a master's degree in computer science.

Mr. Prashant Malik is a Co-Founder & serves as General Partner at Tykhe Block Ventures. He co-founded & served as Chief Technology Officer at Limeroad. He is a Co-Founder of Apache Cassandra. He serves as Board Member at Bobble AI. He has 17 years of experience in leading high-impact technology teams and building highly scalable software. He is a Co-creator of Apache Cassandra & one of the early members and leader in the Facebook engineering team. He also serves as Software Advisor at Radom Network. He plays a vital role in all aspects of the fund, bringing in his vast experience of 27 years as an Engineer, Leader, Entrepreneur. Investor and Advisor. He is a world-renowned Technologist. He was amongst the first 50 engineers at Facebook in Palo Alto. Worked with Mark Zuckerberg and the team to build many of the early Facebook features. He is an Ex-Microsoft engineer who holds many patents in various technology fields like DRM, Security, Files systems, Databases, Social platforms etc. He is also the creator of open-source software Apache Cassandra which is a distributed storage system used by the likes of Apple, Netflix, Instagram, Walmart, uber, Airbnb etc. He was also the founder of Limeroad a social e-commerce platform. He is currently into investing, advising and incubating technology start-ups. He is an early investor/advisor in over 50 start-ups, many of them are now unicorns coming out of India like UrbanClap, shadow fax, offbiz, Zomato etc. and some key acquisitions in Israel like Jump by uber, cnvr.io by Intel. He is also an early investor/advisor in many blockchain companies like Coin Switch (funded by Sequoia now), Neo bank Juno (funded by Sequoia now), Bluezelle etc. He is a graduate of IIT Delhi Computer Science.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Prashanth Aluru is a Co-Founder & serves as Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at TMRW. Mr. Aluru is a Co-Founder and serves as a Board Member at Avataar.Me. He served as Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at Aditya Birla Digital Fashion Ventures. He also serves as Advisor at Aditya Birla Ventures. He served as Partner at Kalaari Capital. He was previously the Head of Strategy & Operations for Meta in India and the Founding Investor & Board Member at Avataar (deep-tech AR Commerce company backed by Sequoia Capital and Tiger Global). He has several years of experience in Digital & Technology and was also a Partner at Kalaari Capital and Bain & Company with significant experience of working with several start-ups.

Mr. Prasun Agarwal serves as Partner at A91 Partners. He serves as Board Member at Akshayakalpa Organic, DaMENSCH, GIVA Jewellery and Blue Tokai. He serves as Investment Analyst at Sequoia Capital India. He is currently pursuing his MBA from Harvard Business School, graduating in June 2019. Prior to HBS, he worked at Sequoia Capital India where he was focused on investing in consumer products and education sectors. He has also worked at Bain & Company and is an alumnus of IIT Bombay.
Mr. Qingsheng Zheng serves as Partner at HSG. He serves as a Board Member at Molbase. He served as a Partner at Sequoia Capital.

Mr. Rajasekhar Ramaraj served as Senior Advisor at Elevar Equity. He is an Independent Director at Congurent Solutions. He also serves as Board Member at Madura Microfinance and Iedacts Innovations. He served as Board Member at iCafe Manager. Mr. Ramaraj served as Senior Advisor at Sequoia Capital and is a member of the Global Board of Trustees of TiE (The Indus Entrepreneurs). Previously he co-founded and served as Sify Limited, the pioneer and leader in Internet, Networking and eCommerce Services in India. Sify was the first Indian Internet company to be listed on the Nasdaq National Market in the US (NASDAQ: SIFY). He was recognized as the 'Evangelist of the Year at the India Internet World Convention in September 2000 and voted IT Person of the Year 2000 in the CNET.com poll in India. He was invited by the UN Secretary-General, Kofi Annan to be a member of the UN's Working Group on Internet Governance (WGIG) and is the first Indian to be invited to the Board of Directors of ICANN (Internet Corporation for Assigned Names and Numbers). He holds a B.Tech in chemical engineering from the University of Madras and an M.B.A. from the Indian Institute of Management, Calcutta. He also serves as Board Member at Digital Signage Networks.

Mr. Randall Lloyd is a Founder and serves as a Managing Partner at Grix Venture Capital. He also served as Advisor at Peterson Partners. He serves as a Board Member at ScreenSteps and Tava Health. He serves as a Board Member on Roster. Prior to joining Peterson, he worked at Salesforce via its acquisition of Brighter Option, a SaaS-based advertising technology platform, where he was the first business hire, responsible for driving revenue growth and go-to-market strategy. Prior to Brighter Option, he served as SVP of Global Sales at RockYou, a Sequoia/Lightspeed/First Round-backed digital media company. He also worked in sales strategy and account management positions at both Google and eBay. He serves on the board of Blue Matador. He holds an MBA from the Stanford Graduate School of Business and a B.A. in Organizational Communication from the University of Utah.

Mr. Ravi Gupta serves as Partner, Growth at Sequoia Capital. Mr. Gupta serves as Board Member at Noom, Acelerate, Vise and Meter. He served as Chief Operating Officer & Chief Financial Officer at Instacart. He served as Director, Energy & Infrastructure at Kohlberg Kravis Roberts. He joined KKR in 2005 and is a member of the Energy & Infrastructure business. Prior to this, Mr. Gupta was with KKR Capstone and worked with Toys 'R' Us and Energy Future Holdings (formerly TXU Corp.). He was previously with McKinsey & Company where he worked across a number of industries. He holds a B.S. in Economics from Duke University.

Mr. Richard Borenstein serves as Investment Committee Member at PeakBridge. He serves as Non-Executive Chairman at Buddy Platform. He serves as Chairman at Sequoia Partners, Inc. He serves as a Board Member at Taste-wise. He was President of International Microcomputer Software, Inc. He serves as Investment Committee Member (Newtrition) at PeakBridge Partners. He is a Co-Founder and Chairman at Sequoia Partners, Chairman at Buddy Technologies Ltd, Board Member at Tastewise.io, Board of the Center for Entrepreneurship, U of Michigan, and former President of Wells Fargo Investment Company.

Mr. Rocio Wu serves as Principal at F-Prime Capital. Ms. Wu serves as a Board Member at Toku. He served as Investor at Liquid 2 Ventures. Previously, she was an investor at Liquid 2 Ventures (founded by NFL Hall of Fame quarterback Joe Montana) where she invested in companies like Chipper Cash (an African cross-border payments company) and Overjet (artificial intelligence for oral healthcare). She was also a Sequoia Scout and an angel investor in Inworld.ai (a developer platform for creating AI-powered virtual characters) and others still in stealth. Before investing career, she worked at Google and Amazon in a variety of operating roles such as CorpDev, GTM Strategy, and Marketing across the U.S., Japan, Spain, and China. She is a community builder and is involved in multiple groups that support the involvement of women and minorities in technology, including Xooglers, HBS Circles, and LatAm entrepreneurs. She's physically based in the Bay Area, but you can often find her traveling to LatAm and other parts of the world learning about different cultures and ideas. She holds an M.B.A. from Harvard Business School and a B.A. from Shanghai International Studies University (joint program with Universidad Pontificia Comillas in Spain).

Mr. Roelof Botha serves as Partner, Seed/Early and Growth at Sequoia Capital. He serves as a Board Member and a Member of the Audit Committee at MongoDB. He also serves as a Trustee at Stanford University. He serves as a Board Member at Armis, Retool, Zoom, Unity, and Block. He serves as a Board Member at Blues Wireless. He serves as a Director at Natera. He serves as Chairman of the Board of Directors & Member of the Audit Committee at Unity. Previously, he served as a Board Member at Inside and ThousandEyes. He focuses on the Internet, services, and software investments. He had served as an Executive at Lodash. He serves as a Board Member at Landis, Pendulum Therapeutics, and Mmhmm. He serves as a Board Member and Member of the Compensation Committee at Evernote, MongoDB,(NTRA), Plain Vanilla, Square (SQ), Unity Technologies, and Weebly. He served as a Board Member and Member of the Compensation Committee at Eventbrite. He is also involved with Sequoia Capital portfolio companies, including AssureX and Mapillary. Previously, he was a Director of Whisper, YouTube.com (GOOG), Insider Pages (IACI), Meebo (GOOG), TokBox (Telefonica Digital), Nimbula (ORCL), Tumblr (YHOO), Jawbone, and Xoom (XOOM), and led Sequoia's investment in Instagram (FB). Before joining Sequoia Capital in 2003, he served as the Chief Financial Officer of PayPal (PYPL), an online payments company. Earlier, he worked as a management consultant for McKinsey & Company. He is a certified actuary (Fellow of the Faculty of Actuaries). He also serves as a Board member at Bird. He holds an MBA from the Stanford Graduate School of Business and a BS in Actuarial Science, Economics & Statistics from the University of Cape Town.

Mr. Rohit Agarwal serves as Managing Director at Peak XV Partners. He serves as Board Member at Stockbit. He serves as a Board Member at Multiplier. He serves as Principal at Sequoia Capital India. He serves as a Board Member at Kopi Kenangan and Insider. He received a Bachelor of Technology in Metallurgical engineering from the Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay.

Ms. Sakshi Chopra serves as Managing Director at Peak XV Partners. She serves as an Investment Advisor at Purplle. Raw Pressery and Innovcare Lifesciences. She serves as a Board Member at Bira 91, Paper Boat, Indigo Paints, and HealthKart. She serves as a Board Member at Wakefit. She also served as a Board Member at Go Colors. She also serves as a Board Member at Svarochi. Before joining Sequoia Capital India, she worked at Deutsche Bank in India and Germany with Global Transaction Banking, focusing on Mid Cap clients, and as Executive Assistant to a Member of the Management Board and Head of Private and Business Clients, at Deutsche Bank Group. Earlier, she worked with McCann-Erickson and Mudra Communications. She has an MBA from the Asian Institute of Management in Manila. She also holds a Master's in Advertising and Public Relations from the Indian Institute of Mass Communication, New Delhi, and a Master's in Commerce from the University of Mumbai.

Mr. Sameer Gandhi serves as Partner at Accel. He serves as a Board Member at CrowdStrike Holdings. He also serves as a Board Member at Perplexity. He served as a Board Member at Deserve and Fictiv. He serves as a Board Member at Wonder Group and Aura. He serves as a Board Member at Wizard and UCSF Foundation Investment Company. He served as a Board Member at DecisionLink. He served as a Board Member at Pango and Plex Systems. He serves as a Board Member at Orum, Public, Aura, Crowdstrike, Freshworks, and Yapstone. He joined Accel in 2008 and focuses on early-stage and growth investments in consumer, software, and services companies. He is responsible for investments such as Bonobos, BookMyShow, Collective, CrowdStrike, Dropbox, Dropcam (acquired by Google's Nest Labs), Flipkart, Hailo, Opower (NYSE: OPWR), Plex Systems, Quidsi (parent of diapers.com and soap.com; acquired by Amazon.com), ScaleArc, Sonatype, Sookasa, Spotify, StumbleUpon, Venmo (acquired by Braintree/eBay) and Yapstone. Prior to joining Accel, he was a Partner with Sequoia Capital, where he led investments such as Barracuda Networks (NYSE: CUDA), Dropbox, eHarmony, Gracenote (acquired by Sony), Sourcefire (NASDAQ: FIRE) and Trulia (NYSE: TRLA). He previously worked at Broadview International, an investment banking firm specializing in technology mergers and acquisitions, and at Oracle Corp. He is a board member and former President of the Western Association of Venture Capitalists and has been named multiple times to the Forbes Midas List for Top Tech Investors. He has a BSEE and MSEE from MIT and an MBA from the Stanford Graduate School of Business. He served as a Board Member at Tasting Room.

Mr. Sameer Singh serves as a Venture Partner at Speedinvest. He serves as Board Member at Howbout. He is an Angel Investor. He serves as an Advisor at Nuw (Information Services (B2C)). He serves as an Advisor at Lapse. He served as an Advisor at Anyone. He also served as an Executive at Atomico. He also serves as an Advisor at Norlon, Boyd & Gall. He spent 5 years at App Annie (now called data.ai), a Sequoia-funded, late-stage startup during its hypergrowth phase. There, he led a global, cross-functional team, working across product, marketing, and sales. During this stint, he advised numerous App Annie customers, including Spotify, Shpock, and Trainline. He is an engineer with and MBA in education. He started his career in investment banking, but his interest in technology took him in a different direction. This interest led him to write a widely read blog about mobile and technology businesses, which eventually brought him to London and the startup world. During this time, he became deeply interested in understanding the patterns of successful startups - leading to his love for network effects.

Ms. Sandhya Hegde serves as General Partner at Unusual Ventures. She served as a Investor at Khosla Impact. She serves as Board Member at Goldcoast, Endgame, RimaLabs and Vizcom. She served as Board Member at Mirova SunFunder. She loves working with technical founders who care deeply about design and data. She aims to partner closely with CEOs to build generational businesses that raise the bar for customer and employee experience. She studied Electrical Engineering and Microelectronics at the Indian Institute of Technology, Bombay, graduating in 2007. In 2009, she joined Sequoia Capital India. She is on the advisory board of 3 tech startups in India and is also a Deputy Editor at YourStory.in. She also served as Board Member at BBOXX. She holds dual master's degrees in Business from Stanford GSB and Engineering from IIT Bombay. She serves as Board Member at AirOps.

Mr. Shailendra Singh serves as Managing Director at Peak XV Partners. He serves as a Board Member at Mu Sigma, Smartkarma, and Trusting Social. He serves as Managing Director at Surge. He serves as a Board Member at Carousell. He served as a Board Member at Tokopedia. He served as a Board Member at Zilingo. He served as a Board Member at Gojek. He was a Board Member at SCIO Health Analytics. He has been at the firm for over seven years, including three years in Sequoia Capital's Silicon Valley office. He focuses on Technology, Internet, Mobile, and Services investments, across stages. He has been involved with more than twenty investments at Sequoia Capital. His investments include JustDial, eClerx (NSE: ECLERX), Via, iYogi, GlobalLogic, UnitedLex, InfoEdge (NSE: NAUKRI), Sourcebits, Druva, Freecharge, Pangea3 (acquired by Thomson Reuters), Pine Labs, and Practo. Before Sequoia Capital, He worked at Bain & Co. in New York and was earlier an entrepreneur in Silicon Valley during the dot-com bubble. He is a board member at Druva Software, ONE Championship. He received an MBA with distinction from Harvard Business School and a Chemical Engineering degree from IIT Mumbai. He is also a Kauffman Fellow. He serves as Board Member at Sirion.

Mr. Shailesh Lakhani serves as Managing Director at Peak XV Partners. Mr. Lakhani also serves as Board Member at Zetwerk, Epifi Technologies, Moonfrog, Porter, Avataar.me, SalesKen, Fi Money, ixigo, Capillary Technologies, LocoNav, Girnar Software, HealthKart and Bounce. He served as a Board Member at 1mg. Before joining Sequoia Capital India, He worked at Redknee's India subsidiary as the Managing Director and previously was Head of the Global Professional Services Group and held Product Management leadership roles. Previously, he consulted for Microsoft India and Tata Sons. He received an MBA from the Harvard Business School, and a BASC in Computer Engineering from the University of Waterloo.

Dr. Shailesh Mehta is a Co-Founder & serves as Managing General Partner at Granite Hill Capital Partners. r. Mehta serves as a Board Member at Vistaar. He serves as Chairman of the Board, Independent and Non-Executive Director, and Member of the Audit, Risk Management, Nomination, Compensation, and Corporate Governance Committee at Manappuram Finance. He also served as a Board Member at Netafim Agricultural Financing Agency. He served as Director at SEED Infotech. He is the former Chairman and CEO of Providian Financial, which he built from a small team into a Fortune 300 company - one of the country's top ten credit card issuers. Before Providian, he was Executive VP of AmeriTrust (now KeyCorp), the largest bank in Ohio at the time. Upon leaving Providian in 2000, he joined WestBridge Capital (Sequoia Capital India) as an Operating General Partner, where he invested in India and was on the boards of Indecomm and FirstSource (still current). He then served as GP with Invesco. Prior boards include Providian, MasterCard, PayPal, and Hanover Direct; he is currently on the board of AccountNow (payments startup). He founded the SJM School of Management at IIT-Bombay and was appointed a Trustee of Cal State University. He holds a BS in Mechanical Engineering from IIT-Bombay, a Master's degree in Operations Research, and a Ph.D. in Operations Research from Case Western Reserve. He serves as a Board Member at India Shelter Finance Corporation. He also served as a Board Member and Advisor at Vivriti Capital.

Dr. Shaun Maguire serves as Partner, Seed/Early at Sequoia Capital. He serves as a Board Member at Luminar, Knowde & Gather. He is a Board Member of AMP Sortation, Gather, and Physna. He served as Chairman & Advisor at Vise. Before joining Sequoia in 2019, he was a Partner at GV, where he led their investments in Stripe, Opendoor, IonQ, Spinlaunch, Lambda School, Dandelion Energy, Clutter, and Mode, and sourced their investment in Segment. Before joining GV, he was a Co-Founder and Chairman at Expanse (formerly known as Qadium), a cybersecurity company based in San Francisco that was acquired by Palo Alto Networks (PANW) for over $800M. He was also a Co-Founder of Escape Dynamics, Inc. Dr. Maguire spent two years working at DARPA, through which he deployed to Afghanistan and was part of a team that earned a Joint Meritorious Unit Award from the United States' Secretary of Defense. He earned a B.S. in Mathematics from the University of Southern California, an M.S. in Statistics from Stanford University, and an M.S. in Control and Dynamical Systems and a PhD in Physics from the California Institute of Technology.

Mr. Shmuel Levy serves as Founding Partner at Sequoia Capital. Mr. Levy serves as a Board Member at Mellie. He serves as a Chairman at BigPanda. He serves as Board Member at Ravtech. He served as a Board Member at Behalf. He served as a Board Member at Alooma. He served as a Board Member at Kenshoo. He served as Chairman at Olive Software. He serves as a Partner at Sequoia Capital. He serves as Chairman at Forter. He served as Chairman at Signals Analytics. He sits on the Boards of portfolio company Behalf. He serves as a Board Member at Olive Software. He focuses on semiconductor, software, and systems investments. Before joining Sequoia Capital in 2000, he was the President of Lucent Technologies' Internetworking Systems Division. He joined Lucent following Lucent's acquisition of Lannet where he served as the President and CEO. He joined Lannet as Vice President for R&D. He also served as Vice President of Madge Networks. Before joining Lannet, he held senior technical positions at IAI, Boeing, and Astronautics in the area of Avionic Systems. He has a BS in Electrical Engineering from Ben Gurion University.

Ms. Shripriya Mahesh is a Co-Founder and serves as a General Partner at Spero Ventures. Ms. Mahesh serves as Advisory Board Member at Trehaus. She serves as Board Member and Member of the Risk Committee at eBay. She served as Board Member at SafeTraces, Gencove, Corvus Robotics, and Mati. She served as a Partner at Omidyar Network. She served as a Board Member at PhotoShelter, Koko, and Shelfmint. She has spent over fifteen years as an executive in high-growth technology companies. She has been an active angel investor and board member or advisor to, private technology companies throughout her career. Before joining Omidyar Network, she led product and design at First Look Media. She formerly held several leadership roles at eBay. She was Vice President of Product Marketing where she was responsible for business and marketing leadership of all aspects of Buyer and Seller products, the eBay Developer's Program, and Private Marketplaces. She also led eBay's 70-person Product Management team that was responsible for product design and management for all of eBay's products on a global level. She set up the Product Strategy team responsible for defining eBay's long-term product strategy and a team within Corporate Strategy that was responsible for identifying acquisition opportunities for eBay. Before eBay, she was the VP of eCommerce at NextCard, the then-premier online credit card company backed by Kleiner, Sequoia, Redpoint, and Trinity. She has a deep interest in the visual arts and directed Academy Award® nominees James Franco and Jessica Chastain as part of a collaborative feature that premiered at the Rome Film Festival and opened theatrically. She has an MBA from Harvard Business School, a B.A. in Economics from Stella Maris University, and is an MFA candidate at NYU's Tisch School of the Arts. She served as a Venture Partner at Amasia. She also served as a Board Member at Nana Technologies.

Ms. Sonya Huang serves as Partner of Growth at Sequoia Capital. Ms. Huang serves as Board Member at Zed Industries.She serves as Board Member at Glean. She serves as Board Member Gong. She served as Board Member at Census & Fintual. She had served as an Executive at Lodash. She serves as Board Member at Mercury. She serves as Board Member at Apollo.io.
Ms. Stephanie Zhan serves as Partner, seed/early at Sequoia Capital. Ms. Zhan is an Angel Investor. She serves as a Board Member at Reflection AI, Middesk, Rec Room, Linear and Sunday.

Mr. Tal Morgenstern serves as a Partner at Lightspeed Venture Partners. He serves as a Board Member at Buildouts. He also serves as Partner at Lightspeed Venture Partners Israel. He co-founded World-class eLearning. He served as Board Member at Bond. He joined Lightspeed in 2016 and focuses on the firm's investment efforts in Israel. Before joining Lightspeed, Tal spent 4 years at Sequoia Capital as a partner in Israel and led investments in consumer marketplaces, SaaS and Fintech companies. Prior to Sequoia, Tal worked as a strategy consultant for the Boston Consulting Group, primarily focused on financial services.

Mr. Tejeshwi Sharma serves as Managing Director at Peak XV Partners. He served as a Junior Associate at Sequoia Capital. Mr. Sharma serves as a Board Member at Moglix, MedGenome, Whatfix, and Rebel Foods. Before joining Sequoia Capital, he worked at Bain & Company consulting in IT, Telecommunications, and Agrochemicals. Mr. Sharma is a Mechanical Engineering graduate from IIT Delhi, where he was a YES Honda scholar. He graduated from the Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi, with a bachelor's in mechanical engineering and holds an MBA from Stanford GSB.

Mr. Timothy Connors is the Founder and serves as Managing Partner at PivotNorth Capital. He serves as Advisor at MOGL. He serves as a Board Member at Matter. He served as Board Member at Darkstore. He served as a Board Member at FastAF. He serves as a Board Member & Advisor at Notre Dame Venture Capital. He served as Board Member at Flyte. He served as a Board Member at Thatch, Upwave, Ritual, and Getlabs. He is also a Co-Founder and the Founding Investor of Platform Studio. He also serves Board Member at Ombre. He funds world-class computer scientists who want to disrupt important markets. He has been a VC for the last 17 years, founding PivotNorth after apprenticing for twelve years with legendary VCs. He has been a part of three companies that have had $1B+ exits. He serves as a Board Member at Quantbiome, ChairmanMe, OpsPanda, Accredible, x2AI, 4INFO, Nimble, Jiseki Health, and Loved (Financial Software). He focuses on business and consumer internet services companies. Before USVP, he was a Partner at Sequoia Capital. His operating experience spans seven years in engineering, marketing, manufacturing, and sales roles at successful high-growth start-ups like C-Cube Microsystems and large companies like Tandem Computers. He is currently a Director of 4info.net, Blekko.com, Guidewire Software, Media6Degrees.com, M-Factor.com, and Right90.com. He conceived and co-founded Spoke.com. Previously, he was a Director of Adify (acquired by Cox Enterprises), ClickShift.com (acquired by WebTrends), Redline Communications (LSE: REDL), StorePerform (acquired by Red Prairie), and SupplierMarket.com (acquired by Ariba). He serves on the Board of TomothAdvisors of the Gigot Center for Entrepreneurship at Notre Dame. He also co-founded Parable Sciences. He received a B.S. in Electrical Engineering from the University of Notre Dame, an M.S. from Stanford University, and an M.B.A. from Harvard Business School. He serves as an Advisor & Board Member at Jiseki.

Mr. V.T. Bharadwaj serves as a General Partner at A91 Partners. He serves as a Board Member at THE HOUSE OF RARE. He served as Managing Director at Sequoia Capital. He serves as a Board Member at Ninety-One Cycles. He is on the boards of Vasan HealthCare, Prataap Snacks, Lovable, Celon Labs, Go Colors, and Genesis Colors. At Sequoia Capital, he spearheads investments in the Consumer, Retail, and Healthcare sectors. He served as a Board Member at Suburban Diagnostics. He was previously associated with McKinsey & Company where he advised senior management in energy, consumer, retail, and manufacturing companies on key strategic and operational issues. He is an alumnus of IIM-Ahmedabad where he was awarded the President's Gold Medal and an alumnus of BITS Pilani. He also serves asa Board Member at Go Fashion.

Ms. Vidya Raman serves as Partner at Sorenson Ventures. She serves as Board Member at Vendia. She served as Board Member at Garden. Prior to Sorenson Ventures, she has built and grown enterprise businesses as a product leader in several industry verticals ranging from enterprise software, industrial IoT, networking and health tech. Most recently, she led product management for Cloudera's AI platform, where she was responsible for making AI at scale a reality for customers spanning industries such as autonomous driving, biotech, and banking to governments. Prior experience includes eMeter (Sequoia-funded, acquired by Siemens), Silver Spring (Kleiner funded and IPO exit), and Medtronic (healthcare). Her all-time favorite career accomplishment was to have found product-market fit without having to write a single additional line of code. She received her MBA from Duke University's Fuqua School of Business, a Masters in Biomedical Engineering from the University of Alabama at Birmingham and a Bachelor's in Electronics and Telecommunication Engineering from Bangalore University.

Dr. William Coughran serves as Partner, Seed/Early at Sequoia Capital. Dr. Coughran serves as Board Member at Alkira and Quantum Circuits. He serves as Kumo. He serves as Board Member at Lilt. He serves as Board Member at Graphiant. He Managing Partner at Sequoia Capital is a business partner to growing companies and a coach to founders and teams. After getting his PhD in computer science, he went to Bell Labs. Some of the work he was involved with-core modeling and computer systems work-shaped his thinking about how to build large-scale systems and designs for many years, and it's something that has served him well at Google. There, he had the opportunity to work with some of the most sophisticated systems at that time. After his time at Bell Labs, he co-founded Entrisphere in late 2000. That company was acquired by Ericsson after he left. He soon joined Google in 2003. What he brings is intellectual breadth and pragmatic organizational psychology, coupled with a lot of operational experience. He's overseen a wide range of technologies, from semiconductors up to large distributed systems, search, security, and other web and mobile services. He serves as a Board Observer at Cohesity.

Mr. William Price is the Co-Founder and serves as General Partner of Next Frontier Capital. He served as Board Member at SiteOne Therapeutics. He serves as Board Member at LumenAD, Tagboard, and Advisr. He serves as Board Member at OptioSurgical. He served as Advisor at Optionsurgical. He founded Next Frontier Capital to partner with mission-driven, talented entrepreneurs to build Montana technology companies of impact, utility, value. He serves as the Board Member at National Venture Capital Association. His career spans venture capital investing as well as operational, transactional and advisory roles at both public and private companies. With a Montana family history dating to the 1870s, He is passionate about investing in the state's promising future. Prior to Next Frontier Capital, he served as CEO of Flite, an advertising and analytics platform. During his six year tenure, he built a market leading organization capable of serving and analyzing billions of ad interactions, sold enterprise customers such as Procter & Gamble, The New York Times and LinkedIn, raised $24m from leading venture capitalists, including Sequoia Capital, General Catalyst and strategic customers Conde Nast, Jive Software and Publicis. He continues to serve on the board of Flite. Previously, He served as a Managing Director at Hummer Winblad Venture Partners, where he focused on SaaS and open source. He helped lead investments in Mulesoft, Sonatype, SlideRocket, Flite, among others. He joined Hummer Winblad from Pequot Capital, where he focused on software investing. Earlier in his career He worked for Morgan Stanley in NYC, Hong Kong and the ASEAN markets focused on the privatization of state-owned assets. He graduated from Harvard College, studied Mandarin at Nanjing University and earned his M.B.A from Northwestern University, where he graduated at the top of his class. He writes about venture, leadership and entrepreneurship on LinkedIn.

Mr. Yinglan Tan is a Founding Managing Partner of Insignia Venture Partners. He serves as Board Member at Eezee, Ritase & Float Foods. He serves as Board Member at Tonik. He serves as Board Member at Rainforest and Carousell. He serves as Board Member at Carro and Fazz Financial. He served as Board Member at Janio. He was the Advisor of Datx. He also served as Advisor at RateS. He also served as Board Member at Tokopedia. He previously served as Investment Advisor, Partner, and Chief Executive Officer at Sequoia Capital India. Prior to joining the firm, he headed the National Framework for Innovation and Enterprise, investing in high-tech growth ventures in the Prime Minister's Office in Singapore. He is a Co-Founder of 3i VentureLab China. He previously served as a Director in the Company. He received an MS in Management Science and Engineering from Stanford University and finished two Bachelor's Degrees (ECE and Econ) at Carnegie Mellon and graduated top of his class as the William L. Everitt Scholar.

Mr. Yoav Shaked serves as Partner at Sequoia Capital. Mr. Shaked also serves as an Partner at Sequoia Capital. He serves as Board Member at Orasis Pharmaceuticals & AIVF. He works with healthcare and medical device companies in Israel. Prior to joining Sequoia Capital in 2011, he worked at YMed, a company he founded and ran as President & CEO until its acquisition by C.R. Bard. Prior to YMed, Yoav co-founded a medical device distribution company, and served as a Vice President of XTechnologies (Guidant Corp). He serves as Chairman at Vibrant. Yoav has a BA in Biology from The Hebrew University of Jerusalem. He served as Board Member at Endospan.

He served as a Partner at Sequoia Capital. He is a Board Member at Baraja and Tuniu.
