Prior to this, he worked at Walden International, Vertex Management, and CIV Venture Capital, where he was in charge of number of investment projects. He was also among the first group of employees of Seagate Technology China, where he held several managerial posts successively. Mr. Ji received his MBA from China Europe International Business School and a bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from Nanjing University of Aeronautics and Astronautics.

Mr. Zhifeng Zhou serves as Managing Partner at Qiming Venture Partners. Mr. Zhou is an experienced technologist and company-builder. He focuses on investments in frontier technologies (such as artificial intelligence, robotics, autonomous driving), enterprise software, semiconductor, auto tech, etc. He has worked as board director/observer with entrepreneurs at unicorn companies - UBTech, Birentech, ROX Motor, Viewtrix, Unisound, and Tongdun Technology - and other high-growth startups such as Roborock (SHSE: 688169), Mech-Mind, Yunji Technology, Axera, Houmo.ai, HyperStrong, Chaitin (acquired by Alibaba), IDsManager (acquired by Alibaba), TigerGraph, XSKY, Sequoia DB, Transwarp (SHSE: 688031), NVXClouds, Shenzhen DST, Frontis, etc. Prior to Qiming, he worked for KPCB (Kleiner Perkins). Before beginning his investment career, he worked for HP (Hewlett-Packard) and oversaw the company's data storage business unit in China. He also co-founded a big data startup company. He is currently serving as a member of the Industry Advisory Committee of the Beijing Stock Exchange. He is also on the management committee of the China Rural Revitalization Entrepreneur Support Program, which is jointly initiated by Qiming Venture Partners and China Foundation for Rural Development, a project committed to training and empowering rural industrial entrepreneurs and social enterprise entrepreneurs. He holds an M.B.A. degree in Finance and Entrepreneurship from Columbia University and a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Harbin Institute of Technology.

Mr. Akhil Gupta serves as Independent Director & Chairman at 360 ONE. He serves as Vice Chairman at Bharti Enterprises. He serves as Board Member at Eutelsat OneWeb. He has led the formation of various partnerships for Bharti with leading international operators including British Telecom, Telecom Italia, Singapore Telecom and Vodafone in addition to induction of leading financial investors like Warburg Pincus, Temasek, KKR, Qatar Foundation Endowment, AIF and Sequoia among many other Private Equity funds. He has been instrumental in raising several billion dollars by way of project finance for the Group over the years from global banks, bond markets and Export Credit Agencies (ECAs). He has also spearheaded the successful public listings of Bharti Airtel (2002), Bharti Infratel (2012) and Airtel Africa (2019). He is currently the Chairman of TAIPA (Tower and Infrastructure Providers Association), President of TSSC (Telecom Sector Skill Council), a member of the Advisory Committee on the Service Providers of Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India, a member of the Sub Committee of the Insolvency Law Committee, Government of India, and a member of CII Task Force on Insolvency and Bankruptcy 2020-21. He represents the Indian Telecom Industry and Bharti regularly at various forums in India and abroad. He is a Chartered Accountant by qualification and is the recipient of numerous awards which include ET Telecom Lifetime Achievement Award, Voice&Data Lifetime Contribution Award, EY Entrepreneur of the Year Award as an Entrepreneur CEO, CA Lifetime Achievement Award by ICAI, Lifetime Achievement Award by Amity University, CEO of the Year award at National Telecom Awards, CA Business Achiever award by ICAI, Asia Corporate Dealmaker award at the Asia Pacific M&A Atlas Awards, Best CFO awards in multiple categories by CNBC-TV18 and induction to Hall of Fame by CFO India. He serves as Board Member at Zepto.

Mr. Saj Huq serves as Chief Commercial Officer at Plexal. He served as Chief Commercial Officer at the London Office for Rapid Cybersecurity Advancement. He leads Plexal's Innovation team and specializes in building collaborative ecosystems between startups, government, industry, and academia to solve strategic challenges. He has extensive experience working with startups at the intersection of national security and emerging technologies, and leading high-profile global initiatives, including LORCA and the NCSC Innovation Partnership. He is a member of HMG's National Cyber Advisory Board, chaired by the Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster, and his previous roles include an eclectic mix of consulting, startup, and military experience.
Ms. Sheikha Mozah is the Founder of WISE. Ms. Mozah owned Qatar Luxury Group.

Dr. Vijay Reddy served as Chief Scientific Officer, Agricultural Genomics at SciGenom Labs. He holds a Doctorate Degree in Rice Functional Genomics from University of Hyderabad. His expertise includes genomics, molecular biology, molecular genetics, bioinformatics and applied aspects of agricultural research for crop improvement. He has worked at various levels with Vibha Seed Group like DGM, General Manager and Sr. General Manager. His contribution includes establishment of various divisions in biotechnology like Molecular Diagnostics, Marker Assisted Selections, Candidate Gene Identification, Gene Cloning, Construct development, Genetic Transformation etc. More than 150 Markers have been established by him, which are being extensively utilized in various breeding programs and more than 30 commercial hybrids were developed using these technologies. He was instrumental in attracting several funding bodies like DBT, USAID in collaboration with CIMMYT, ACPFG, ICRISAT in his earlier organization. He has more than 7 years of experience in Biotechnology. He also serves as the Chief Scientific Officer at AgriGenome, Agricultural Genomics.

primary_position: Managing Director, Health Care Consulting Group
biography: Mr. Bert Orlov serves as Managing Director of, Health Care Consulting Group at EisnerAmper. He has 25 years of experience as a management consultant in the industry. He specializes in strategy, transactions, operations, and project management for physician groups and hospital systems, as well as not-for-profits. He also has experience with ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs) and in evaluating investment opportunities for individuals and firms. Previously, Bert was a Partner in the boutique firm of Integrated Healthcare (IHC). His work at IHC included valuations and deal structuring for acquisitions of radiation therapy and general radiology practices by hospitals; joint venture launches and ASC acquisitions; turn-around efforts for physician groups, hospital physician practices, and nursing homes, as well as community-based not-for-profit primary care; creation of new physician groups in the community; and, development of hospital employment models of physicians. Bert began his career in health care with APM Management Consultants, focusing on strategy for hospitals and academic medical centers and physician-hospital linkages. Thereafter, he was Director of Operations for the Healthcare Business Process Outsourcing, a division of Computer Sciences Corporation (NYSE: CSC). This division served managed care plans with a full-service back office solution, based on proprietary software. Bert has been published in books and articles. He collaborated with the University of Pennsylvania faculty on strategy for primary care practices. He has co-authored an article in Becker's concerning market transformation in Westchester County, New York.

Mr. Bill Thomas serves as Chief Executive Officer AND Global Chairman at KPMG. He leads and supports people focused on delivering exceptional services to clients throughout the world in many countries. Ensuring everyone at KPMG lives up to and abides by the values that have made KPMG the trusted partner of the business community. He has more than a decade of executive-level leadership experience and previously served as Chairman of KPMG's Americas region, and as CEO and Senior Partner of KPMG in Canada. During each stage of his career, he has propelled the firm's global strategy throughout local, regional, and international geographies, always pairing pragmatism and creativity to deliver concrete results. While Chairman of KPMG's Americas region, He oversaw dramatic efficiency gains across borders, and similarly, as CEO of KPMG in Canada, He reshaped the Canadian firm's culture and rallied the firm to embrace a new direction. He was awarded the Queen Elizabeth II Diamond Jubilee Medal and named a Catalyst Canada Honours Champion in recognition of his leadership in building a diverse and inclusive culture. He strongly believes that businesses can empower positive change and play a role in strengthening the communities they serve. He is a member of the International Integrated Reporting Council (IIRC), Business Roundtable, International Business Council, and His Royal Highness The Prince of Wales Sustainable Markets Council.

Mr. Gregory Hyde serves as Partner at Squire & Company. Mr. Hyde was with PRPR from 2001 to 2018, prior to its merger with Squire. Previously, He was with Deloitte & Touche in Seattle and Salt Lake City. His practice focuses on Federal and state individual and business tax planning and compliance; estate and gift planning and compliance; and charitable and fiduciary income tax planning and compliance. He serves a number of closely-held businesses and their owners, executives and professionals, and high-net worth and high-income individuals. HE has extensive experience with employee stock options. He is an educational speaker to employee groups, and assists numerous option holders with related tax and financial planning, and income tax reporting. He is the past president of the Salt Lake Estate Planning Council, has served on the boards of the IHC Foundation for Homecare and Hospice and Primary Children's Medical Center Planned Giving Committee, and volunteers in various other community and youth organizations. He received his Bachelor of Science and Masters' of Accountancy degrees from Brigham Young University in 1997.

primary_position: Partner in M&A Tax and Regulatory
biography: Mr. Harry Parikh serves as Partner in M&A Tax and Regulatory at BDO India. He has over 17 years of expertise in guiding Indian and multinational clients through transaction tax-related matters. His extensive experience includes advising on various direct tax and cross-border tax issues. Harry's advisory services encompass buy-side and sell-side transactions, comprehensive restructurings, deal structuring (including negotiation), global restructuring, international holding company structures, fund structuring, and more.

Mr. James Chalmers served as Global Assurance Leader at PwC. He took an appointment that he took up on 2 January 2018. In this role, he focuses on further building the PwC network's assurance capabilities and solutions for clients across the globe with particular emphasis on reinforcing trust and confidence in decision-making information, underpinned by quality and insight. James has held various senior management roles in PwC. He was a member of the UK Assurance Leadership from 2002 to 2008 before being appointed to the UK Board in 2008, initially as Head of Strategy and then from 2011 to 2016 as Head of Assurance. In 2013, he became Head of Assurance for EMEA. He has been a member of Global Assurance Leadership since 2011. With over 20 years of experience as a partner, James has worked across many parts of PwC, C, providing multinational audit, acquisition due diligence, and IPO services. This client experience includes leading PwC's global relationships with major listed and SEC-registered clients. He has also had extended secondments to a multi-national banking group providing leveraged finance to private equity transactions and in the healthcare sector, where he worked on a large international merger.

Mr. Paul Gurman serves as Consultant at Gross Mendelsohn & Associates. Mr. Gurman founded and served as Partner at Gurman & Company. He specializes in merger and acquisition planning, sophisticated tax planning, as well as auditing, and business growth consulting for nonprofits and government contractors. He is the CEO and chairman of the Harry & Zoe Poole Foundation Inc. and the past treasurer of SCAN (Stop Child Abuse Now). In addition, he is the past treasurer of the Prince William Regional Chamber of Commerce and the past president of the Prince William Symphony. He holds BS (Bachelor of Science) degree in Accounting from Indiana University.

Mr. Ronald Dreskin serves as Partner & Interim Chief Executive Officer of the Health Care Services Group at EisnerAmper. He served as Principal of Health Care Services at EisnerAmper. With over 30 years of experience in the field, he provides strategic and operations support services to multi-hospital systems, physician groups, faculty practices, ancillary providers (such as surgery centers and imaging centers), as well as entrepreneurial ventures. Conducting transactions (M&A, JVs, and start-ups) is a specialty. Before joining EisnerAmper, he founded Integrated Healthcare (IHC) in 1996 to provide top-flight consulting services to hospitals and physicians. Recently, he has developed collaboration models for physician groups and hospitals (including employment, physician services agreements, and co-management arrangements), as well as deals in radiology, radiation therapy, and ambulatory surgery. He draws on his vast experience from Columbia Presbyterian Medical Center, where he served as CFO. Then, he took leadership of its 340-bed Allen Community Hospital. He has served on numerous healthcare boards. He led a town-sponsored nursing home from bankruptcy and guided a multi-service provider in an underserved community. He serves as Interim Chief Executive Officer at St Christopher's Healthcare Hospital. he served asInterim System Chief Executive OfficerHahnemann University Hospital

Ms. Yelena Talmazan served as Managing Director - Internal Audit at David Landau & Associates. She is a part of the Internal Audit department, where she manages client relationships and internal audit, Sarbanes-Oxley ("SOX") compliance and other consulting services for her clients. She is a seasoned audit and business executive with over 23 years of experience, the majority spent in the financial services, consumer business and technologies industries directing and managing Internal Audits, Internal Controls and SOX Compliance programs. Prior to joining DLA, she served as the Head of Audit, Americas at TP ICAP and Director, Internal Audit - Financial Services at KPMG. While in the industry, she directed and managed Internal Audit, Internal Controls and Sarbanes-Oxley Compliance programs. Her experience includes risk and management consulting, where she delivered and managed internal and external audit services for large multinational organizations, including building and strengthening internal audit functions, IPO readiness and implementation of SOX, Internal Controls Over Financial Reporting ("ICOFR") and Intermediate Holding Company ("IHC") compliance programs. She also supervised audit quality assessment reviews and staffing assessments, integrated and ITGC audits and regulatory compliance engagements. She managed high-profile audit relationships with the audit committees and executive teams and provided enterprise risk management ("ERM") independent assurance services.

Mr. Andrew Noyons serves as Managing Partner at Salica Investments. Mr. Noyons is responsible for distribution and capital raising team. Prior to Hambro Perks, he was in the public side of Equity Capital Markets at Goldman Sachs where he was responsible for the distribution of multiple European initial public offerings including the landmark Siemens Healthineers transaction, Europe's largest public offering in over 10 years. Prior to Goldman Sachs, he was in the institutional equities division at Morgan Stanley. Before joining financial services, He was a Captain in the British Army completing tours of Bosnia and Afghanistan with the Welsh Guards and the Parachute Regiment before serving as Equerry to HRH The Prince of Wales from 2008 to 2009. He is a graduate of Durham University with a degree in Modern History and a Degree from Stonyhurst College.

Ms. Dame Cleverdon serves as Chair of the Board at the National Lottery Community Fund. Ms. Cleverdon has previously chaired Teach First, the National Literacy Trust, and Place Matters - all charities working to tackle inequality in those communities that experience the greatest poverty, disadvantage, and discrimination. She chairs the National Statistician's Committee on Inclusive Data and sits on the EMCCA Inclusive Growth Commission. She is a Co-founder of the # iWill movement supporting young people in social action through volunteering, campaigning, and advocacy. She has served as Board Trustee for the Fair Education Alliance, The Careers and Enterprise Company, the Youth Futures Foundation, Teach for All, and as Patron of Right to Succeed. She began her career with The Industrial Society and served as Chief Executive of Business in the Community for seventeen years before working for the then Prince of Wales as her Special Adviser to the Prince's Charities.

primary_position: Senior Vice President of Business Development
biography: Mr. David Mair serves as Senior Vice President of Business Development at International Hospital Management. He is the newest member of the International Hospital executive team, joining the company as Senior Vice President responsible for business development and international patient programs in 2018. He brings a rich experience to IHC from more than 30 years of working with people seeking medical care solutions outside their home communities. He is a recognized international health medical care risk management, benefits, and insurance executive. He is the founding partner of Soter Healthcare, a global healthcare firm that designs and delivers global medical care, risk management, and insurance solutions for individuals and organizations. At Soter Healthcare, he designed benefit plans and direct contract arrangements for employer groups taking advantage of a global network of hospitals. He brings the blend of international destination healthcare experience, cost control, financial relief, and access to medical centers of excellence to his current role with IHC. He began his executive career with the United States Olympic Committee, where he designed and directed the USOC's health insurance program for America's Olympic athletes for more than a decade. During his tenure, he was responsible for assisting athletes to locate and access medical care around the world. He was involved with the insurance plan for athletes in seven Olympic Games and more than 100 international championship events. He is a former President of the Risk & Insurance Management Society and the Nonprofit Risk Management Center. He is also a published author and accomplished speaker. He testified before Congress and state legislatures on health and risk management issues and speaks at conferences around the world. His comments have appeared in The Economist, the New York Times, the Washington Post, and National Public Radio and have been heard on radio stations in the US, Canada, and the United Kingdom.

Mr. Elias Sahyoun serves as the Chief Financial Officer at Virtuzone. He served as Corporate Finance Director at Transmed. Previously, he served as Assistant Head of Investment Banking at IBL Investment Bank, Director of Business Development at Corporate Finance House, Vice President at Zabeel Capital, Investment Manager at Zabeel Investments, Senior Financial Analyst at TECOM Investments and Senior Auditor at Deloitte.

Dr. Gary Wood is a Co-Founder and serves as Executive Chairman at International Hospital Management. In addition to his activities for IHC, he is the President and CEO of Concorde Companies, a group of investment management and financial advisory enterprises with activities in marketable securities and venture capital, which he founded in 1981. He is also the President and Chairman of the Board of OmniMed, a venture capital investment firm specializing in healthcare industries. He serves on the Boards of Directors of several private companies associated with Concorde Companies. A sixth-generation Texan, he received his bachelor's and master's degrees in electrical engineering from Texas Tech University and went on to receive only the third interdisciplinary Ph.D. awarded by Tech, emphasizing law, business, and statistics in 1977. At the master's level, he specialized in biomedical instrumentation. He was named a Distinguished Graduate in Engineering in 1993. In 1994, he received the Allan J. McDonald International Entrepreneur of the Year Award from the Society of International Business Fellows. He is a director of several private companies and is also active in civic and charitable organizations in Dallas. He is currently a member of the Endowment Foundation Investment Committee and Advisory Board for the Children's Oncology Service of Texas (aka Ronald McDonald House), a board member of Leader Formation International, an International Christian Leadership Development Mission, and a member of Executive Committee of SIBF. In February 2005, he completed six years serving on the board of the Parkland Health and Hospital System (Dallas County Hospital District), where he served on the Pension Investment oversight committee. He has twice served as chairman (in 1988 and 1999) of the Society of International Business Fellows, a leadership organization consisting of 1400 senior business executive level, government officials, and NGO members in four regional networks in 45 countries, where he is a distinguished member. He was the founder and initial chairman of The Health Industry Council (1988-1998) in the Dallas Ft. Worth region, a nine-county industry promoter, and advocacy organization in North Texas, and he served as a board member for the Baylor Medical Research Institute from 1987 to 2000.

Mr. John Stephen served as Director at Max Property Group. He is a Fellow of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors and former Chairman of the English business of real estate advisers, Jones Lang LaSalle. He is a Trustee of the Portman Estate, a Director of the Colville Estate and of Evans Property Group, and an adviser to Exemplar properties and Bonhams fine art auctioneers and valuers. He is a school governor and a property advisor to the Duchy of Cornwall.

Mr. Leonardo Lopez serves as Chief Financial Officer at International Hospital Management. He is leading the corporation's international finance and IT practices. He joined IHC in 2007 as Director of Finance at Hospital CIMA Hermosillo in Mexico and later led the company's regional finance function for Mexican operations before being appointed CFO in 2017. Prior to joining IHC, he served with world-leading institutions such as KPMG and Citigroup in the financial services industry, as well as with Private Equity companies in the manufacturing industry, doing business across North and Latin America and Europe. His responsibilities have included leadership roles in international management, strategy development, transactions structuring and execution, financial management, investment advisory, global accounting, and operations turnaround, among others. He holds an MBA in International Management and Global Finance from Thunderbird, The School of Global Management, and a BS in Accounting and Finance from "Tecnológico de Monterrey" (ITESM) in Mexico. He participates in various civic and charitable organizations.
Mr. Liu Xuewu serves as General Manager at Rongshi International Holding Company.
Dr. Michael Stevens serves as Chief Quality Officer at West Virginia United Health System.
Mr. Niko Kuronen serves as Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director at G42 Services.

Mr. Ravi Deol serves as Chairman & Owner at Inbrew Breweries. He is a serial entrepreneur with a reputation for establishing several pioneering businesses globally. Erstwhile Chairman and co-owner of Adelie Foods, London. Previously In 2007, he launched Special Purpose Acquisition Vehicle (SPAC) - India Hospitality Corp. (IHC), a consumer-focused platform that raised $175mm on London's Alternate Investment Market (AIM). IHC in turn acquired a portfolio of operating Food and Hospitality businesses in India. These included SkyGourmet (Air Catering), Mars Restaurants (restaurant brands), and Gordon House (boutique hotels). SkyGourmet under his leadership, before long became India's largest catering company and was bought out by the global market leader, Swiss giant Gategroup AG in 2011. In 2006, he created India's first global retail joint-venture between Bharti and Wal-Mart. This broke new ground for global retail giants entering then restricted the Indian retail market. He is eponymous as the 'coffee man of India'. In a pioneering attempt, he founded Barista Coffee in late 1999. The orange Barista cafés rapidly became iconic retail landmarks across India. Barista was popularly referred to as India's Starbucks. For the first time, aspiring Indian consumers experienced café bars, thus drawing them to high streets. After rapid scale and enormous success, Barista was acquired by Tata Beverages in 2005 and was later owned by Lavazza S.p.A. of Italy. Earlier in his professional working career, he held various senior-level global positions with Coca-Cola and Wipro Consumer Products. In 2002, he won the prestigious 'Ernst & Young Entrepreneur of the year award. He is an alumnus of London Business School and a member of the Young President Organization.

Ms. Rebecca Barnes serves as Publisher at Prince William Living. Rebecca is also a volunteer for the OWL Volunteer Fire Department, where she serves as a liaison to elected officials and acts as the Public Information Officer during major incidents. Rebecca studied at Northern Virginia Community College in Woodbridge, Virginia. She continued her education at George Mason University, studying History and Secondary Education.

Ms. Sarah Vibert serves as Chief Executive Officer at National Council for Voluntary Organisations. Sarah joined NCVO in January 2020 as director of membership and engagement before becoming chief executive. She's held a number of leadership roles in the voluntary sector, most recently as chief executive of the umbrella charity The Neurological Alliance. Sarah also spent time in senior management roles at Epilepsy Society and In Kind Direct, as well as previously working for (then) HRH the Prince of Wales. She started her career in local government management, including working for the Mayor of London. Sarah is a trustee at Trussell Trust.
Mr. Shahid Jamal is the Founder and serves as Managing Director at Shamal Media Services.

Mr. Jeffrey Smedsrud is an Angel Investor. Mr. Smedsrud co-founded and served as Chief Executive Officer at Pivot Health. He is a Co-Founder of Healthcare.com. He is a results-oriented leader who has built and grown companies from back-of-envelope ideas to multi-million dollar, profitable and scalable entities with a focus on health insurance and other consumer-centric business models. He is a serial entrepreneur who has started several businesses - four of which have been acquired by publicly traded companies. Creative thinker who has been a presenter at dozens of national trade conventions. Active marathon runner and member of Seven Continents Club - one of only 200 or so individuals to run a marathon on all seven continents. Cancer survivor, charity activist and motivational speaker. Previously, Jeff helped create and grow the fully-insured segment at The IHC Group (NYSE:IHC) from $0 to nearly $300 million in revenue in seven years. He led AMIC (NASDAQ:AMIC) to significant direct-to-consumer growth and national recognition.

Mr. Peter Kuttel Co-Founded and served as Principal at Bear & Wolf Salmon Company. He also is an Angel Investor. Mr. Kuttel served as a Board Member at Seattle Bank. Mr. Kuttel joined the board in 2011. In 1989 Mr. Kuttel co-founded Victor Seafoods, a privately owned seafood harvesting and processing company focusing on pollock, cod and crab resources in Alaska. He served as its President and CEO from 1991 until the business was sold in 1999. In 2008 the company was acquired by Trident Seafoods. Mr. Kuttel was a stockholder, and served on the board of, Trident Seafoods until 2010. Mr. Kuttel also served on the board of the Prince William Sound Aquaculture Association from 2004 to 2007. He currently focuses on private equity investments for his family. Mr. Kuttel has a BA in Finance from the University Of San Diego. Mr. Kuttel also serves as Board Member at Illumagear.

Mr. Abdul Al-Halabi serves as Managing Director at Embassy Capital. He also serves as Financial & Investment Advisor at Seed Group. He also serves as Independent Director at Silkhaus. Earlier, he served as Chief Executive Officer at Global Investment House. He also serves as Director at Global Investment House. He has over 19 years of experience in the fields of executive management, corporate financial and advisory with focus on restructuring, M&A and valuations. He started his career with KPMG in London working on debt advisory services and restructuring before returning to Dubai as a COO of Dubailand and has been CEO of Dubai Properties Group and other entities in the Dubai Holding portfolio. For two years, he was a partner at KPMG Dubai co-heading the transaction and restructuring unit in the UAE and Oman whilst still being involved with Meraas on an advisory basis. He returned to Meraas full time in 2013. Mr Al Halabi is also on the board of Dubai Parks and Resorts, a DFM listed entity, Emirates REIT, a NASDAQ Dubai listed entity and several other private enterprises related to Meraas. Mr. Al-Halabi holds a degree in Economics from London School of Economics, and is a Fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales. He served as an Advisor at Global Ventures (Dubai).

Mr. Ahmed Altanani serves as Director, Private Equity at Lunate. He is a Director in Lunate's private equity team, responsible for contributing to the execution of the firm's private equity direct investments strategy. He brings over 22 years of experience to the firm. Prior to Lunate, He served as an Investments Director in ADQ's alternative investments and M&A team, where he led several strategic and financial investments for ADQ in the food and agriculture, financial services, life sciences, and energy transition sectors. Before joining ADQ, He gained almost two decades of investing, operating, and restructuring experience in private equity and industry across developed and growth markets. He holds an MBA from London Business School.

Mr. Ahmed Khalil serves as Partner & Head of Information Technology at Lunate. He oversees cybersecurity and digital strategies. Prior to Lunate, He worked at EFG Hermes, managing IT across 11 countries. He holds a Bachelor of Business Management from Helwan University, Cairo, Egypt, and is pursuing an Executive Certification in Technology and Operations from MIT.

Mr. Al Mawji serves as Director & Head of Internal Audit at Lunate. He is responsible for leading Lunate's internal audit and assurance strategies. He brings 25 years of experience to the firm. Prior to Lunate, Al spent 10 years as Chief Internal Auditor at Brookfield Asset Management, based out of New York and London. He is a Chartered member of the Institute for Internal Auditors.

Mr. Alain Bacos serves as Director of Finance at Lunate. He oversees overall financial planning, processes and strategy development. He brings over 13 years of experience to the firm. Prior to Lunate, he was Head of Finance at Chimera Capital. He holds a Bachelor's degree in International Business from Kingston University.

Mr. Alex Borer served as a Partner at LGT Capital Partners. He is responsible for the firm's Liquid Markets activities. The team is responsible for multi-asset and multi-alternative funds, sustainable fixed-income and equity funds, liquid multi-manager funds, and institutional mandates, as well as asset allocation and research. He first joined LGT at LGT Bank, where he worked from 1992 to 2001 as an equity portfolio manager and head of portfolio management. After, he was a Partner at Trinova Invest before re-joining LGT in 2005 as head of investment coordination within LGT Bank. He moved to LGT Capital Partners in 2007 as an equity portfolio manager responsible for the Asia and Japan region and co-responsible for the USA. In 2008, he joined the Multi-Asset portfolio management team and began heading the team in 2010, before taking on the role of Co-Head of Liquid Markets in 2021. He holds a federal diploma in banking and finance from the Swiss Bankers Association and is a CFA Charterholder

primary_position: Principal and Head of Economic Research
biography: Dr. Alex Durrer served as Principal and Head of Economic Research at LGT Capital Partners. He is responsible for Economic Research at LGT Capital Partners in Pfaeffikon, Switzerland. Before joining the firm in 2001, he spent a decade with Swiss Re Group in Zurich and New York as an economist and financial officer in the areas of Economic Research & Consulting, Financial Products, and Corporate Financial Management. As chief economist at LGT Group and a Liquid Market Committee member, he is instrumental in determining the LGT Capital Partners investment policy. He is responsible for the economic research publications "Investorama" and "Beacon". He has also been in charge of writing and presenting market assessments, as well as the LGT economic and market outlook for over 15 years. He received his Ph.D. in Economics and Business Administration from the University of St. Gallen (HSG).

Mr. Alexander Mills serves as Partner & Co-Head of Credit at Lunate. He is responsible for direct and co-investments across credit strategies. Prior to Lunate, He held senior positions at ADG and ADIC where he focused primarily on financial services and credit strategies. He is a Chartered Accountant (ICAS, UK) and has a Master's degree in Engineering from the Buenos Aires Institute of Technology.

Mr. Alexander Zhuravlev serves as Director, Private Equity at Lunate. He is focusing on direct and co-investments in the private equity team. He has over 16 years of experience in private equity and asset management across the healthcare, pharmaceutical, consumer, and infrastructure sectors. Prior to Lunate, He held leadership positions in RDIF and Chimera Investment. He holds an Executive MBA from INSEAD.

Mr. Alok Elias serves as Principal, Private Equity at Lunate. He is responsible for executing private equity direct and co-investments, as well as select public investments. He has over 10 years of experience. Prior to Lunate, Alok held positions at ADQ, Standard Chartered Private Equity and The Abraaj Group. Alok holds a Master's degree in Management from the University of London and a Bachelor of Arts in Economics from the University of Delhi.

primary_position: Partner and Head of Venture Capital
biography: Mr. Amer Al Ameri serves as Partner and Head of Venture Capital at Lunate. He is an experienced investment professional, having served as Head of Venture Capital & Technology at ADQ. He has extensive expertise in the technology industry and is a board member at several leading technology companies. He is a CFA Charterholder and holds an MBA from the University of Oxford.

primary_position: Director & Co-Head of Private Equity Funds
biography: Mr. Andre Forsterling serves as Director & Co-Head of Private Equity Funds at Lunate Capital. Mr. Andre served as Executive, Private Equity at Abu Dhabi Growth Fund. His responsible for executing the firm's private equity fund-of-funds investment strategy. He brings over 17 years of experience to the firm. Prior to Lunate, he held senior positions at ADG and the UAE's General Pension and Social Security Authority, where he helped establish the private equity, private credit, infrastructure, and real estate portfolios. He also worked at Auda International and MEAG in Germany. Andre holds a joint Master's degree in Business Administration and Computer Engineering from the Technical University of Berlin.

Mr. Andrew Chvatal serves as Partner & Head of Legal at Lunate. He oversees all legal matters pertaining to Lunate's investment activities. He brings over 20 years of experience to the firm. Prior to Lunate, He served as the Chief Legal Officer of ADG. Previously, he held senior roles at an emerging markets private equity firm, as well as at leading law firms in New York, specializing in leveraged buyouts and other private equity transactions. He holds a Bachelor's degree from Boston University and a JD from Georgetown University.

Mr. Ankit Agarwal serves as Principal, Partnerships at Lunate. He is responsible for establishing and managing strategic partnerships on behalf of the firm. He was a Vice President of the venture capital team at Chimera Capital. He previously worked in BDA Partners' investment banking team. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Economics from the University of Warwick.

Mr. Anup Cherian serves as Partner & Director of Compliance at Lunate. He plays a key role in managing the firm's global compliance, fund launches and regulatory requirements. He has over 15 years of experience in compliance, anti-money laundering (AML) and fund administration. Prior to Lunate, He held senior roles at Chimera Capital, Afkar Capital and Northern Trust. He is a Certified AML Specialist and holds a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration from Bangalore University.

Mr. Aseem Gupta serves as Director, Private Equity at Lunate. He is responsible for executing the firm's private equity direct investments strategy. He brings over 19 years of experience to the firm. Prior to Lunate, He held roles at ADQ, Waha Capital, and Deutsche Bank. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering from Purdue University and an MBA from the Jones Graduate School of Business at Rice University.

Mr. Ayman Anwar served as a Board Member at Amoun Pharmaceutical Company. He also serves as Senior Principal, Private Equity at Lunate. Mr. Ayman Anwar served as Director of advisory at Perella Weinberg Partners. Prior to joining Perella Weinberg Partners in 2011, Mr. Anwar was an Associate at Akanar Partners, where he was primarily focused on M&A assignments in Egypt and across the MENA region. His work at Perella Weinberg Partners mainly consists of M&A assignments across various sectors, including financial institutions and industrials. Mr. Anwar received a Bachelor of Commerce from the John Molson School of Business at Concordia University.

primary_position: Senior Partner, Direct & Co-Investments & Member of the Investment Committee
biography: Mr. Aziz Moolji serves as Senior Partner, Direct & Co-Investments & Member of the Investment Committee at Lunate. He is also a member of the firm's Investment Committee. He began his career at Goldman Sachs and has over 25 years of experience in private equity and investment banking. Prior to joining Lunate, he was an Executive Director in the M&A and alternatives team at ADQ. He holds dual Bachelor of Science degrees in Electrical Engineering and Management from MIT and an MBA from the Wharton School, University of Pennsylvania.

Mr. Bo Zhao serves as Senior Principal of Venture Capital at Lunate. He is a member of Lunate's venture capital team, responsible for direct investments in venture and growth stage technology. Prior to Lunate, He spent over a decade working in private equity, venture capital, and M&A in New York, London, and the Middle East at leading investment firms, including ADQ and PIF. He holds an MBA from Columbia Business School and is a CFA charterholder.

Mr. Caesar Maasry serves as Director & Head of Investment Research at Lunate. He brings close to 20 years of experience to the firm. Prior to joining Lunate, He led emerging market and cross-asset research at Goldman Sachs in New York. He is also a regular contributor to CNBC's Squawk Box and Bloomberg's Daybreak programs. He holds a Bachelor of Arts and Bachelor of Science in International Studies and Economics with a concentration in Finance, respectively, from The University of Pennsylvania and The Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania.

Ms. Carolyn Ang serves as Director of Legal at Lunate. She brings more than 18 years of experience to the firm. She works with the private equity team on M&A transactions across a range of sectors and jurisdictions. Prior to Lunate, She worked on M&A at several top-tier international firms across Singapore, the UK, and the Middle East. Carolyn has a Bachelor of Arts and Social Sciences in Political Science and European Studies from the National University of Singapore and a Bachelor of Laws. She is qualified to practice law in England, Wales and Singapore.

Mr. Chye Guan serves as Executive Director at Quantum Asset Management. He has more than 25 years of wealth management experience, Chye Guan is well versed in treasury products, with experiences in National Discount Co. and Bankers Trust Company in 1986 and 1988 respectively. In 1991, he became a Director of Swiss Bank Corporation, and was responsible for advising and managing private clients' portfolios. Between 1994 and 2014, Chye Guan was Head of Private Banking in ABN AMRO, JP Morgan, HSBC, Barclays, Royal Bank of Canada and LGT Bank, providing wealth management and advisory solutions to Asian high net worth and ultra-high net worth clients. He holds a Bachelor of Arts (Hons) in Economics from the University of Calgary in Canada.
Ms. Clelia Zacharias serves as Principal at LGT Capital Partners. She served as Executive Director, LGT Capital Partners at LGT Group. She was previously working as a Associate at AlpInvest Partners.

Mr. Daniel Rauti serves as Partner at LGT Capital Partners. He joined LGT Bank in 1989 and completed an extensive three-year bank training program. Mr. Rauti later left for further studies at the University of Applied Sciences in Chur, Switzerland, specializing in Banking and Finance. He rejoined LGT Group in Hong Kong in 1999 as a portfolio manager responsible for Asia-based clients. In that function he was involved extensively in developing LGT's alternative investment business in the region. Mr. Rauti is a Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)

Mr. Eric Janowak serves as Director & Head of Tax at Lunate. He brings over 19 years of experience to the firm. Prior to Lunate, He was a Managing Director with KPMG US in New York and London, where he focused on tax structuring for asset managers and sovereign investors. Prior to KPMG, he was in-house tax counsel at Ares Management in Los Angeles, the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, and Bank of America Merrill Lynch in London. He holds a Bachelor of Business Administration in Finance from the University of Wisconsin-Madison and a JD from Marquette University Law School. He is a U.S.-qualified attorney and a member of the State Bar of Wisconsin.

Mr. Faisal Al Thani serves as a Member of the Board at Qatar Investment Authority. His Excellency holds several prominent roles in Qatar, including being a member of the Supreme Council for Economic Affairs and Investment, the National Planning Council, and a member of the Supreme Committee for the Preparation of the Third National Development Strategy. Additionally, His Excellency is the Chairman of the Qatar Financial Centre Authority and Chairman of the Advisory Board for the Investment Promotion Agency. He also serves as the Chairman of Ooredoo Group and Lesha Bank and is a member of the Board of Directors of Qatar Airways Group and Qatar Insurance Company. Throughout his career, His Excellency served as the Chief Investment Officer for Asia and Africa at the Qatar Investment Authority, as well as several other leadership roles, including Chief Investment Officer at the Qatar Foundation Endowment from 2014 - 2017. He also played a key role in managing investments at the Qatar Central Bank from 2010 - 2014. He has also served as Chairman of the Qatar Banking Studies and Business Administration Secondary School and as Vice Chairman of Vodafone Qatar between 2013 - 2016. In addition, he has been a board member for several prominent organizations, including Ahlibank, Qatari Diar Real Estate Investment Company, Nakilat, Bharti Airtel, and Siemens Qatar. Mr. Fran Lee serves as Associate Director at LGT Capital Partners. Mr. Lee served as a Senior Analyst at LGT Group.

Mr. Francisco Loranca serves as Senior Principal, Venture Capital at Lunate Capital. He serves as Board Member at Salmon. Prior to Lunate, Francisco was a Senior Investment Manager at Prosus, specializing in fintech investments globally in growth and venture capital. Francisco has also worked as an investment banker in the Financial Institutions Group at Credit Suisse. He holds an MBA from INSEAD.

Hadi Al Rashid serves as Principal, Private Equity at Lunate. He focuses on growth and buyout investments. Previously, He worked in the technology investment banking team at Deutsche Bank in San Francisco. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Electrical Engineering from the University of Waterloo in Canada and an MBA from the University of Virginia's Darden School of Business.

Mr. Hariganesh Muralidharan serves as Principal, Private Equity at Lunate. He is responsible for executing the firm's private equity direct investment strategy. Prior to Lunate, he gained over 12 years of experience in positions at Chimera Capital, Abu Dhabi Ports, KPMG, and PWC. He holds a Bachelor of Commerce from the University of Madras and a Leadership Certification from London Business School. He is a Chartered Accountant.

Mr. Ilias Catsaros serves as Director & Head of Communications at Lunate. He is responsible for Lunate's communications strategy, overseeing media relations, digital and social media, internal communications, and events and sponsorships. He started his career as a media relations and investor relations consultant in London. He has a Bachelor's degree in Human Sciences from Oxford University, a Master's degree in Finance from London Business School, and an MBA from Warwick Business School.

Mr. Jack Macdowell serves as Managing Member & Chief Investment Officer at The Palisades Group. He serves as Chief Investment Officer at Chimera Investment. He has over 15 years of experience in investment management and trading mortgage-backed and asset-backed securities. Before forming Palisades, from July 2009 to August 2012, he served as the chief investment officer at Carrington Capital Management, where he oversaw the teams responsible for investment strategies, quantitative analysis, mortgage credit analytics, valuation, trading, and risk management of residential mortgages. Before joining Carrington Capital Management, he was responsible for analyzing and trading mortgage-backed securities ("MBS") and asset-backed securities ("ABS") at Old Hill Partners from March 2008 to July 2009. Before joining Old Hill Partners, he served as Principal and Head of Capital Markets, Structuring, and Analytics at Carrington Capital Management, where he was responsible for the firm's mortgage credit analytics, securitization activities related to more than $23 billion in acquired residential mortgage loans, and related portfolio hedges. From September 2001 through January 2005, he served as a Vice President in the Asset Securitization Group at RBC Capital Markets. He worked in the Asset Securitization Group at Credit Suisse First Boston from July 2000 through September 2001. He is a holder of the right to use the Chartered Financial Analyst® designation and graduated from the University of Texas at Austin with a Bachelor of Business Administration degree in Finance. He is a member of the CFA Institute, CFA Society of Austin, CFA Society New York, and CFA Society Los Angeles. He serves as an Independent Trustee to Vertical Capital Income Fund, and NYSE-listed closed-end fund.

Mr. Jack Simkin serves as Director & Head of Talent Acquisition at Lunate. He is responsible for leading hiring across all the firm's functions and geographies. Prior to Lunate, He was a Managing Director at an executive search firm focused on alternative investments. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Business Management and Sports Science from Brunel University.

Mr. Jason Loveless serves as Senior Partner, Operations at Lunate. He is responsible for overseeing finance, tax, treasury, fund operations, compliance, and risk. He has over 24 years of experience in asset management, including nine years with Northern Trust, followed by roles at several asset management firms. He is a member of the Association of Certified Chartered Accountants (ACCA).

primary_position: Senior Partner, Fund Investments & Partnerships and Member of Investment Committee
biography: Mr. Joseph Cha serves as Senior Partner, Fund Investments & Partnerships and Member of Investment Committee at Lunate Capital.

Mr. Karim Radwan serves as Partner & Head of Strategic Partnerships at Lunate. Mr. Radwan serves as Head of Fund Investments at ALTÉRRA. Mr. Radwan is responsible for developing key relationships across various asset classes. Prior to Lunate, he served as Chief Investment Officer of Chimera Capital and Executive Director of MENA Investments at RIMCO. He brings over 22 years of experience to the firm, including senior regional positions in corporate and investment banking. He holds an MBA from London Business School.

Ms. Katarina Vitkova serves as Principal, Fund Investments at Lunate. She is responsible for executing the firm's private equity funds investment strategy. Prior to Lunate, She was an Investment Manager at ADQ and a Vice President at Delta Partners, a specialized TMT advisory and investment firm. Ms. Kateryna Taousse serves as Partner & Head of Credit Funds at Lunate. Ms. Taousse oversees the firm's credit fund investments. Ms. Kathryn Matthews serves as a Non-Executive Director at VinaCapital Group. She is on the board of trustees of the Nuffield Trust and is a non-executive member of the Council of the Duchy of Lancaster. She retired as a non-executive director of Hermes Fund Managers Limited in January 2017. She is chairman of the group risk committee.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Managing Partner, Board Member & Member of Investment Committee and Supervisory Committee
biography: Mr. Khalifa Al Suwaidi is a Co-Founder and serves as Managing Partner, Board Member & Member of the Investment Committee and Supervisory Committee at Lunate. Mr. Al Suwaidi serves as Chief Executive Officer at Abu Dhabi Growth Fund. He serves as Vice Chairman at Abu Dhabi Ports. He also served as Director General - Investment Affairs at Abu Dhabi Retirement Pensions & Benefits Fund. He also serves as Vice Chairman, Non-Executive and Board Member at Abu Dhabi National Energy Company. He holds a bachelor's degree in business administration, majoring in marketing, from California State University in the United States and has an executive master's in business administration with distinction from Zayed University.
Ms. Leena Niazi serves as Associate Director at Lunate.

Mr. Marcel Dillier serves as a Partner at LGT Capital Partners. Before joining the firm in 2006, he gained extensive experience in banking, including research, asset structuring, and sales at UBS in Zurich and London for over 14 years. primary_position: Director & Head of Treasury & Capital Markets

Mr. Mazhar Abid serves as Partner and Head of Finance at Lunate. He is responsible for overseeing the firm's financial and regulatory reporting, budgeting, and financial risk management. He is a Chartered Accountant from the Institute of Chartered Accountants of Pakistan.

Mr. Mohamed Hafez serves as Partner & Head of Capital Markets at Lunate. He oversees the promotion of ETFs and the overall rigor of Lunate's ETF ecosystem. He brings more than 18 years of experience to the firm. Prior to Lunate, He held senior positions at Chimera Capital, EFG-Hermes, Union National Bank, and Al Rajhi Capital. Mr. Mohammed AlMualla served as Vice President at Amwal. He has over 12 years of experience in local Retail Banks and Swiss European Banks. Prior joining Amwal, Mohammed was a Relationship Manager at LGT Bank AG in Bahrain. He has also worked for TAIB Bank Bahrain and with HSBC Bank. He has an MBA from McMaster University Canada.

Mr. Mridul Ashok serves as Partner & Director of Investment Operations at Lunate. He is responsible for managing the firm's private and public investment operations. He brings over 15 years of experience to the firm. Prior to Lunate, he held senior positions at Chimera Capital and Northern Trust. He holds an MBA from Bangalore University.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Managing Partner, Board Member & Member of Investment Committee & Supervisory Committee
biography: Mr. Murtaza Hussain is a Co-Founder and serves as Managing Partner, Board Member & Member of Investment Committee & Supervisory Committee at Lunate. Mr. Murtaza Hussain served as Chief Investment Officer - Alternative Investments and Merger & Acquisition at ADQ.

primary_position: Senior Partner, Strategy & Investment Committee Member

Mr. Nader Toutoungi serves as Principal, Private Equity at Lunate. He is responsible for executing the firm's private equity investment strategy. He brings over 10 years of experience to the firm. primary_position: Partner & Head of Human Capital Operations
biography: Ms. Naheed Sheikh serves as Partner & Head of Human Capital Operations at Lunate. She is responsible for providing operational and strategic support to achieve business objectives. Mr. Naush Malik serves as Partner & Co-Head of Credit at Lunate. He is responsible for direct and co-investments across credit strategies. Mr. Nils Hagerstal serves as Director, Partnerships at Lunate Capital. He is responsible for the firm's GP stakes strategy. He brings over 17 years of experience to the firm. Before Terra Firma, he was an Associate in the Corporate Finance & Restructuring group at Bank of America Merrill Lynch. He started his career in Paris as an Investment Banking Analyst at Rothschild & Cie. He holds an MSc. degree from EDHEC Business School in France.

Mr. Oliver Butler serves as Director of Private Equity at Lunate. He is responsible for executing the firm's private equity direct investments strategy. He has over 18 years of experience in private equity, private equity-backed businesses, and M&A. Prior to Lunate, he was Chief Strategy Officer at Moneycorp, a private equity-backed international payments specialist. Previously, he was a Senior Principal at Carlyle. He holds a Master of Arts in Natural Sciences from Cambridge University.

Mr. Omar Mehanna serves as Director, Client Solutions at Lunate. Mr. Mehanna is responsible for raising third party capital. Prior to Lunate, he held senior positions at ADQ, Abu Dhabi Investment Office, NBAD, HSBC, and Bank of America in the UAE and London. He holds a Master of Science in Management from RCSI, Ireland and a Bachelor of Science in Econometrics and Mathematical Economics from the London School of Economics. Mr. Patrice Schuetz serves as Partner & Group Chief Financial Officer at Antin Infrastructure Partners. primary_position: Chief Executive Officer, Board Member & Member of the Executive Committee
biography: Mr. Patrick Ferrari serves as Chief Executive Officer, Board Member & Member of the Executive Committee at Woodman Asset Management. Mr. Paul Nauss serves as Partner & Head of Compliance at Lunate. He is responsible for the oversight and management of the firm's compliance and regulatory matters. Prior to Lunate, he held senior positions in New York, London, Tokyo, and Abu Dhabi, in leading firms, including Abu Dhabi Growth Fund, Carlson Capital, Goldman Sachs, and the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority. Mr. Peter Howley serves as Senior Partner & Chief Legal Officer at Lunate. Bringing over 20 years of experience to the firm. He oversees all aspects of Lunate's legal and company secretarial functions. Prior to Lunate, He held senior positions, in-house and in private practice, including General Counsel at ADQ and General Counsel and Company Secretary at Waha Capital. primary_position: Senior Independent Director & Chairman, Remuneration Committee
biography: Mr. Phillip Colebatch served as Senior Independent Director & Chairman, Remuneration Committee at Man Group. He was appointed to the Board as a non-executive director in September 2007. Mr. Raphael Paglia serves as an Executive Director at LGT Capital Partners. He also served as the Executive, Communications at LGT Group.

primary_position: Chief Executive Officer & Member of the Executive Committee
biography: Dr. Roberto Paganoni serves as Chief Executive Officer, and Member of the Executive Committee at LGT Capital Partners. He also serves as Chief Executive Officer, LGT Capital Partners & Member of the Senior Management Board at LGT Group. He joined LGT Group in 1997 to form the Alternative Investments Group, which is now LGT Capital Partners Ltd. Prior to joining LGT Group, he worked at McKinsey & Company in 1989, where he managed international projects in the areas of industrial goods, airlines, telecommunications, and financial services. He has been based in Zurich since 1993. He completed his mechanical engineering studies at the Technical University of Aachen, Germany. He received a Ph.D. in Business Administration from the University of St. Gallen (HSG), where he also lectures part-time.

Mr. Roger Hilty serves as a Partner at LGT Capital Partners. He joined the firm in September 2004 from LGT Bank AG, where he started his career in January 2000 in the Trading/Treasury division. From 2000 to 2004, his responsibilities involved activities in equity, fixed-income, currency and commodity exchange-traded and OTC products as well as the processing of transactions for Asian, European, and US markets. He was also involved in business management projects for the Trading/Treasury group. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration and an MBA in Finance from the University of Liechtenstein.

Ltd., the merchant bank, after a 17 year career, including a period as Chief Executive of the Hong Kong office with responsibility for China. He also sits on a number of boards and advisory boards of companies throughout Asia, Europe, North America, and the Middle East including those of SETE Technical Services, Alger Associates Inc., and Abdul Latif Jameel Co. Ltd. He is International Adviser to LGT Group Foundation. Mr. Carington's past directorships have included acting as Chairman of the Korea Asia Fund, Chairman of the Schroder Emerging Countries Fund, a Director of the Fleming Natural Resources Investment Trust and the JP Morgan Fleming Smaller Companies Investment Trust plc.

Mr. Ryan Ye serves as Senior Principal, Real Assets Funds at Lunate. Mr. Ye leads the firm's global real estate and infrastructure fund investment strategy. Prior to joining Lunate, Ryan was an Executive Director at Goldman Sachs Alternatives in Hong Kong, where he led real estate investments across the capital structure, and held positions at Blackstone, CPPIB and J.P. Morgan where he worked on real estate transactions across Asia Pacific. Ryan holds a Bachelor of Arts in International Studies and German Studies, and Bachelor of Science Economics with a concentration in Finance, respectively, from College of Arts & Sciences and The Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania.

Mr. Sanjay Surana serves as Principal, Private Equity at Lunate. He is responsible for executing buyouts, private equity, and growth investments. He worked in offices across Hong Kong, Washington DC, and India, focusing on developed and Asian markets. He holds an MBA from London Business School and is a CFA charterholder.

biography: Mr. Seif Fikry is a Co-Founder and serves as Managing Partner, Board Member & Member of Investment Committee & Supervisory Committee at Lunate. He boasts over 17 years of experience in the equities market. He holds a Bachelor of Arts degree in Economics from the American University in Cairo in 1993.

Mr. Sherif Elhalawany serves as Director & Head of Information Security at Lunate. He oversees information and cyber security. Mr. Sherif Salem serves as Partner & Head of Public Markets at Lunate. He oversees the firm's ETF business. Prior to Lunate, He acquired more than 20 years of investment experience at EFG-Hermes, National Bank of Abu Dhabi and Invest AD. He holds a Master's degree from Henley Business School and a Bachelor's degree in Economics from the American University in Cairo.

Ms. Silvia Barbarino serves as Principal of private Equity at Lunate. She is responsible for executing the firm's private equity direct investment strategy. Prior to Lunate, She worked in investment banking at Bank of America. She holds a Master's degree in Finance from Bocconi University.

Mr. Stephan Kind serves as a Partner at LGT Capital Partners. Mr. Kind is responsible for the firm's Liquid Markets activities. For more than fifteen years, he has been responsible for the portfolio management of the LGT Endowment fund. Mr. Kind started at LGT Group in August 1994 and joined LGT Capital Partners in October 2001. He spent a brief spell in LGT Bank's Hong Kong office and started in the portfolio management team for the LGT Endowment fund in 2005. From 2005 to 2013, he was also responsible for selecting and monitoring external managers in particular in the area of emerging markets equities. Mr. Kind holds the Swiss Federal Diploma for Experts in Finance and Investments (AZEK) and is a Certified International Wealth Manager (CIWM). He received a BSc in Business Administration from the University of Applied Science (HTW) in Chur, Switzerland.

Mr. Sultan Al Marzooqi serves as Director of Fund Finance at Lunate. He is a Director in Lunate's fund finance team where he leads finance funding and operation activities. He has over 13 years of work experience. Prior to Lunate, He held senior roles at ADQ, Mubadala, and ADNOC. He holds an MBA from the Canadian University in Dubai.

Mr. Thomas Verling serves as a Partner at SABA Asset Management. Certified EFFAS Financial Analyst. He acts as the Investment Specialist and Portfolio Manager of SABA and started his career with LGT Bank in Vaduz, Liechtenstein as an Equity Trader. Before joining UBS in 2002 he was Deputy Head Trading at Swissfirst Bank (Liechtenstein) AG for 4 years. At UBS he was a Portfolio Manager and Investment Consultant for 13 years. In May 2016 he has been appointed member of the Board of Directors of the social security fund of Liechtenstein.

In 1996, he co-founded LGT's third-party hedge fund activities. He completed his intermediate examination in business administration at the University of Cologne and received an MBA in Finance from Georgia State University in 1986 (which he earned as a Fulbright Scholar). In 1989, he obtained a Ph.D. in Business Administration from the University of St. Gallen (HSG) Switzerland.

primary_position: Director and Co-Head of Private Equity Funds
biography: Mr. Timothy Huijts serves as Director and Co-Head of Private Equity Funds at Lunate Capital. Prior to Lunate, Tim held various roles at ADG and the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, spending a total of nine years in Abu Dhabi before joining Lunate. Tim holds a joint Master of Science and Management degree from the Rotterdam School of Management.
Mr. Turki Almadhi is the Founder and serves as a Chief Executive Officer at Turki Almadhi Ventures. Previously, he served as a Executive Director at Kingdom Holding Company.

Ms. Vani Kalai serves as Head of Human Capital at Lunate. Ms. Kalai worked in various financial services firms such as Bank Vontobel, PIMCO, Bank of New York Mellon, Russell Investments, Goldman Sachs, and Barclays Capital based in Singapore, London, New York, and Seattle. He served as Principal at Alcazar Capital. He is a Principal, with 9 years of experience in private equity, and was previously a Director at Dubai International Capital. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Mathematics with Business Management from Queen Mary University of London and an MBA in International Business from the American Intercontinental University of London

primary_position: Chief Operating Officer & Member of the Executive Board.
biography: Mr. Wicky Meyer serves as Chief Operating Officer & Member of the Executive Board. at Tramondo Investment Partners. Since the founding of the Swiss-Hedge Capital AG asset management company in 2004, he has been a partner and Chief Operating Officer, and from 2013 Chief Executive Officer. The asset management regulated by FINMA was later sold to an international holding company in Luxembourg. He began his career at Deutsche Bank AG in Zurich, where he held various positions, most recently as a stock trader for Swiss equities. He holds a Master of Business Administration from the University of Bedfordshire

Mr. Yazan Mustafa serves as Partner, Investments at Mandeleo. He is responsible for managing all aspects of the investment process, including screening, due diligence, structuring, negotiations, closing, and portfolio management. He also co-leads the Animal Health strategy with a focus on buy & build. He spent 6 years at The Abraaj Group (US$13 billion AuM), beginning as an intern and most recently as an Associate Director. He spent the initial two years learning the technical aspects of private equity including accounting, modeling, and content production as part of a graduate program. The latter four years were spent as an intrapreneur - supporting new investment & fundraising initiatives across the firm including: i) integrating Aureos Capital post-acquisition and establishing four new funds which collectively raised US$1.8 billion, ii) establishing the firm's presence in the US including an office & team in New York, and raising c. US$800 million from first-time investors, and iii) establishing the Growth Markets Health Fund, an impact investment strategy which raised US$1 billion, and the acquisition and integration of 3 hospital groups in East Africa (US$150 million). Prior to Mandeleo, he spent two years consulting fund managers LGT Group (London/Zurich) & RF Capital (Sydney/Dubai) to help build their new investment initiatives, as well as several SMEs across the Middle East to develop growth strategies and raise funds. He has a BA in International Affairs and International Economics from The George Washington University.

Mr. Yousry Kassem serves as Partner & Head of Trading at Lunate. He is responsible for building the firm's trading capabilities and executing trades across markets and asset classes. He brings more than 18 years of experience to the firm. Prior to Lunate, He was Head of Trading at Chimera Capital, having spent many years in financial services roles at EFG Hermes, Al Ramz Capital, and Mashreq Bank. He holds an Executive MBA from Bradford University's School of Management.

Mr. Zirajuddin Shahabuddin serves as Director, Finance at Lunate. He oversees FP&A, management reporting, policies, finance change management, and the IFRS desk. Prior to Lunate, He acquired 20 years of experience in financial services, alternative assets, and M&A, working at ADG, Atlas Mara, Investcorp, and KPMG. He holds a Bachelor's degree in Accounting from the University of Madras and is an FCCA holder.

Mr. Khalid Almana serves as Vice President of Enterprise Development at Qatar Development Bank. He previously held leadership positions at Royal Dutch Shell and Qatar Foundation. He held international positions in Washington DC and The Hague. Mr. Al-Mana holds a BSc in Finance from King Fahad University of Petroleum and Minerals and has received specialized diplomas from London Business School and the Brookings Institute. He is currently a Board Member-elect at the Middle East Leadership Association (MELA), Chairman of Alshams Advanced Lighting Technologies, and Board Member of ELAN. He holds an MBA from HEC Paris and a BS (Bachelor of Science) from King Fahad University of Petroleum and Minerals.

Mr. Howard Kessler founded and served as Chairman & Chief Executive Officer at The Kessler Group. A leading innovator in the financial services industry and a consummate dealmaker, Howard Kessler pioneered the concept of the affinity credit card with MBNA in 1982. Howard has spent the ensuing decades building businesses focused on delivering win-win solutions to the most critical problems faced by senior executives in retail financial services. Deals and partnership programs created by Howard have literally reshaped the landscape of the payments industry- resulting in the creation of billions of dollars in value for shareholders. Howard has been at the forefront of innovation in credit cards and has developed concepts and techniques that have been exported to financial services firms around the world. As a lifelong entrepreneur, Howard excels in the relentless pursuit of out-of-the-box answers to intractable problems, especially in deal making and in the crafting of alternative solutions in "workout" situations. This unique combination of tenacity and creativity has made him a trusted advisor to the most senior leaders in the fields of politics and financial services, and these relationships give him unparalleled insight into the strategic objectives and needs of major financial institutions. Howard and his wife, Michele, are active philanthropists supporting a wide range of national and global causes, such as the William J. Clinton Foundation, the American Red Cross, the American Ireland Fund, the Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, the Prince of Wales Trust and Partners HealthCare, a not-for-profit, integrated healthcare system founded by Brigham and Women's Hospital and Massachusetts General Hospital. Howard has been the recipient of numerous public service awards, including the United Way Emerging Corporate Philanthropist Award, the Red Cross Lifetime Achievement Award, the Palm Beach Police Foundation Award for Community Service and the Carolyn and Peter Lynch Award for entrepreneurs who have made a significant difference in the lives of children. He is a recipient of the Ellis Island Medal of Honor.

Mr. Glenn Johnstone serves as Chief Investment Officer at Lesha Bank. Mr. Glenn Johnstone served as Principal, Direct Investments at Qatar Foundation Endowment. Previously, he served as an Executive Director at Goldman Sachs.
Mr. H.E. Khaldoon Al Mubarak served as Chairman, Board Management Committee at First Abu Dhabi Bank.

primary_position: Chief Strategist Middle East & Asia & Head, Investments
biography: Mr. Hans Goetti served as Chief Strategist Middle East & Asia & Head, Investments at Banque Internationale à Luxembourg. He previously served as Chief Investment Officer at Finaport. Prior to assuming the role of Chief Investment Officer of the Finaport Group, Hans Goetti acted as Chief Investment Officer Asia at LGT Bank Singapore, Head of Research Services Group at Citi Private Bank and Senior Portfolio Manager at Citigroup Aset Management in Singapore. Before becoming a resident of Singapore in 1996, Hans worked as a financial analyst and investment advisor in Zurich and Geneva. Among other tasks, he built a new portfolio management department for a Japanese bank in Zurich. Hans acts as a Certified Financial Analyst of the New York Institute of Finance and holds a degree from Zurich Business School.

Ms. Jo Kenrick serves as Chairman of the Board at The Co-operative Bank. She also serves on the Values & Ethics and Nomination Committees. Ms. Kenrick is an experienced Non-Executive Director who has worked across multiple sectors in her executive and non-executive careers. Her early career included roles at Mars Confectionery, Pepsi and Asda, followed by executive roles at Wilson Connolly (a large national housebuilder), Camelot Group plc (operators of the National Lottery), B&Q plc and Homebase Ltd. She was also CEO of Start, a Prince of Wales charitable initiative. She has held previous non-executive roles at Principality Building Society and Safestore Self-Storage Ltd, and was the former Chair of PayM and of the Current Account Switch Service for Pay.uk. She is also Senior Independent Director and Remuneration Committee Chair for Welsh Water, Remuneration Committee Chair for Sirius Real Estate, and Consumer Duty Champion for Vitality Health and Life Insurance.

primary_position: Executive Director and Head of Sustainable Markets
biography: Mr. Joop Hessels serves as Executive Director and Head of Sustainable Markets at ABN AMRO Bank. In his current role as head of Green Bonds, he structured and arranged ABN AMRO's award-winning green bond program and supports the further development of sustainable markets via the development of the world's first sustainable shipping loan for Anthony Veder and CBI-certified OVG green real estate loan. He is supporting several FIG and Corporate issuers like DKB, Berlin Hyp, SEB, and TenneT as a green bond advisor. He is a Founding Member of the GRESB Green Bond working group and represents ABN AMRO as a Member of the Green Bond Principles. He is an active member of the Energy Efficient Mortgage Action Plan and the European Green Securities steering committee. Prior to his focus on Sustainable Finance, he worked for many years as FIG DCM origination at ABN AMRO and ING. He holds a Master of Business Administration from the University of Groningen and is based in Amsterdam and attended the Prince of Wales Business and Sustainability Programme of the Cambridge Institute for Sustainability Leadership.

Mr. José Maté is a Co-Founding Partner and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Tressis. Mr. Maté serves as Executive - Management Team at Arada Capital Partners. Until May 2000, he was Director General of BSN BANIF. Experience in Marketing, Products, Analysis, and Commercial areas. He began his career as an investment analyst at Banco Banif in 1988. He has held the positions of Director of Analysis, Director of Financial Innovation, Product Director, Commercial Director, and Director of Marketing and Products at Banco Banif, BSN Private Banking
Mr. Mounir El Majidi served as Director of Representative SIGER at Attijariwafa Bank.

Mr. Muad Saud Al-Osaimi Board Member since 2014 Member of the Board Executive Committee, the Board Audit and Compliance Committee and the Board Investment Committee Mr. Al-Osaimi earned his BSc in Finance from George Mason University in the US in 2001. Mr. Al-Osaimi has served as a non-executive board member at Ahli United Bank in Bahrain since 2023 and Chairman of Kuwait Finance House (Malaysia) Berhad since 2017. He has also been a board member of numerous companies including Kuwait Gate Holding Company from 2004 to 2014, Kuwait Financial Center Company from 2008 to 2011 and Al-Raya International Holding Company from 2005 to 2009.
