Additionally, he completed an 18-month specialized training program for graduates at Kuwait Investment Authority (KIA) in 2001 and worked in the Investment Department of Aayan Leasing and Investment Company in 2002.

primary_position: Board Member & Member of the Corporate Social Responsibility Committee
biography: Mr. Satitpong Sukvimol serves as Board Member & Member of the Corporate Social Responsibility Committee at Siam Commercial Bank. He serves as a Chairman of the Board & Member of the CSR Committee for Sustainable Development at Siam Cement Public Company. He was appointed as Grand Chamberlain and Private Secretary to His Royal Highness the Crown Prince during 2012-2016 and as Private Secretary to His Majesty King Maha Vajiralongkorn and Grand Chamberlain, Bureau of the Royal Household during 2017-2018. In addition to his positions as Director and Member of the Corporate Social Responsibility Committee of the Bank, he is presently Private Secretary to His Majesty King Maha Vajiralongkorn and Lord Chamberlain, Bureau of the Royal Household; Chairman and Director-General, The Crown Property Bureau; Trustee of H.M. Private Property, H.M. Private Property Office; President Courtier; Board Chairman and Member of the Governance and Nomination Committee of Siam Cement PCL; and Chairman of CPB Equity Co. Ltd. and its groups of companies as being assigned. He received a Bachelor of Arts Degree in mass communication from Chiang Mai University.

primary_position: Chairman of the Board of Directors
biography: Mr. William Waldegrave served as Chairman of the Board of Directors at Coutts & Co. He served as Chancellor at the University of Reading. He was educated at Eton College, Corpus Christi College, Oxford, and Harvard. Having worked in the Central Policy Review Staff in the Cabinet Office between 1971 and 1973, he became Political Secretary to the Prime Minister, Edward Heath. After a spell working in the industry for GEC Ltd, he was elected to the House of Commons as a Member of Parliament for Bristol West in 1979. He was made a Minister in 1981, and served continuously until 1997, including terms as Minister of State at the Department of the Environment, and at the Foreign Office. At the Cabinet level, he served as Secretary of State for Health, Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster, Minister of Agriculture, and Chief Secretary to the Treasury.

primary_company: Eton College Employees (1972) Pension and Life Assurance Scheme
biography: Hon. Lord Waldegrave serves as Provost at Eton College Employees (1972) Pension and Life Assurance Scheme. He serves as Chairman of the Royal Bank of Scotland (Coutts' International business). Between 1990 and 1997 he held the Cabinet posts of Secretary of State for Health, Secretary of State for Agriculture, Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster, and Chief Secretary to the Treasury. He is a director of several companies.

Mr. Constantin Koenigsegg serves as Investment Manager at Vorwerk Ventures. Prior, Mr. Koenigsegg was part of the investment team at the early stage of VC Project A, focusing on early-stage B2B topics in Europe and more specifically the Nordics. During his business development time at the digital health startup Careship, he had hands-on operational exposure to growing a business at speed. Before jumping into the startup ecosystem, he gained his first experience in finance in Private Banking and Asset Management at LGT Group in Hong Kong and later in M&A at the global construction firm CPB Contractors in Sydney. He holds a bachelor's degree in Sociology, Politics, and Economics from Zeppelin University.

Mr. Abdalla Alsaid serves as Corporate Communications Director at Abdulkadir Al Muhaidib and Sons. He has 17 years of experience in branding, advertising and marketing communications, beginning his career with the international agency DDB in its Bahrain office, where he was responsible for accounts such as Volkswagen AG, Zamil Air Conditioners and Gulf Air. In 2004 he set up and ran the 3Points advertising agency's Riyadh office, developing brand strategies and identities for, among others, Petro Rabigh, Sipchem, Nas Air, Kingdom Real Estate, Zamil Industrial Investment, ACWA Holding, King Abdullah City for Atomic and Renewable Energy, and SAGIA. He also managed marketing communications for leading Saudi organizations such as STC, the tourism authority, Almarai, Prince Salman Center for Disability Research, the Disabled Children Association, ACWA Power, SAGIA and Kingdom Holding Company. Abdalla has a BSc in Industrial Management.

primary_position: Secretary, Department of Community and Economic Development
biography: Mr. Rick Siger serves as Secretary, Department of Community and Economic Development at the Pennsylvania Department of Community and Economic Development. He serves as a Board Member at Ben Franklin Technology Development Authority. Before his current role, He served as Chief of Staff and Senior Advisor to the President at Carnegie Mellon University (CMU) in Pittsburgh and led CMU's growth strategy at Hazelwood Green, a former Pittsburgh industrial site re-envisioned as a new model for economic development and translational research. He served President Barack Obama for more than seven years in multiple roles, including as Chief of Staff at the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy (OSTP) and Deputy Chief of Staff at the Department of Commerce. He also worked as former Governor Tim Kaine's Deputy Secretary of Commerce and Trade in the Commonwealth of Virginia. He holds a B.A. in political science from Columbia University.

Mr. Alan Milburn serves as Chancellor at Lancaster University. The former Labour MP for Darlington (1992 to 2010) currently chairs the European Advisory Board for Bridgepoint (a private equity group) and runs his own consultancy, advising governments worldwide. He is also involved in a variety of charitable projects as diverse as working with Tony Blair in Africa, to acting as a trustee for Yorkshire Sculpture Park. Following his graduation with a 2.1 degree, he went to Newcastle University to do a PhD, but did not complete it because he became "ensnared" by left-wing politics. He ran a radical bookshop, became active in the Trade Union movement and took a leading role in a campaign to save Sunderland's shipbuilding industry. He eventually won the Darlington seat next to Tony Blair's Sedgefield constituency in 1992 and was immediately identified as one of the Labour party's modernisers. He went on to serve within the UK Government as Chief Secretary to the Treasury, Secretary of State for Health (1999 and 2003 ) and as Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster, before his unexpected resignation from party politics in 2010, to 'spend more time with his family'. As he says: "I loved my time in politics, but I did 18 years of it and I knew that it was my time to go. I did not want to be in Opposition again and I am now of an age when I can choose." His time in politics has been marked by his energetic commitment to Tony Blair's Modernisation agenda, particularly during his time as Secretary of State for Health, when he was responsible for pushing through hundreds of PFI schemes. His more recent focus has been on social mobility. In 2009, Alan Milburn chaired a governmental commission, the Panel on Fair Access to the Professions. Its report recommended improvements in social mobility by acting at every life stage - school, university, internship and recruitment. This work continues as chair of the newly created Commission on Social Mobility and Child Poverty.

Dr. Claudia Costin serves as Board Member at Qatar Foundation Endowment. Until 2018, Costin was a visiting Professor at the Harvard School of Education. Prior to founding CEIPE, she was a Senior Director for Global Education at the World Bank. Before joining the World Bank, Costin served as Secretary of Education of Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. Her former positions include Secretary of State of Culture at São Paulo and Federal Minister for Public Administration and State Reform. Mr. Faleh Al-Nasr serves as Chief Investment Officer at Qatar Foundation Endowment.

Mr. Ghanim Al-Ibrahim serves as Chief Operating Officer at Qatar Foundation Endowment. He is a certified project manager whose professional career spans 25 years of diversified experience in oil and gas, mega infrastructure, and mixed-use real estate developments with particular experience in managing large programs and mega projects. He is an objective-oriented leader and has strategic ability, social intelligence, commercial acumen, and independent mindset that enables him to deliver fast-track projects and drive changes.

Dr. Ikhlaq Sidhu serves as a Board Member at Qatar Foundation Endowment. He served as a Venture Partner at Xfund. He served as Venture Advisor and Information Technology at ONSET Ventures. He is the Chief Scientist for the Fung Institute for Engineering Leadership in the College of Engineering at UC Berkeley and has been the primary architect of its T-shaped curriculum and applied research program. He joined UC Berkeley in 2005 as the founding Director of UC Berkeley's highly successful Center for Entrepreneurship & Technology, which has grown to become the cornerstone of the Fung Institute. He received recognition as the 2009 Emerging Area Professor of Industrial Engineering and Operations Research at UC Berkeley for his contribution to this new research and teaching area. He brings valuable insight to the Berkeley community by building connections between teaching and current innovation topics within Silicon Valley. Within the industry, he has established new businesses and developed new technologies at U.S. Robotics Corporation, 3Com Corporation, and Cambia Networks. He was 3Com's "Inventor of the Year" in 1999 and has been granted over 60 US Patents in networking technology, IP telephony, and PDA functionality. Technology and intellectual property from his work have been cross-licensed to Palm Computing, 3Com, and UT Starcom. He also designed hardware for the first generation of laser printers at Hewlett-Packard. He received his bachelor's degree in Electrical and Computer Engineering from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, and his master's degree and doctorate in Electrical Engineering from Northwestern University.

Mr. Jim Keating served as a QF Research Division at Qatar Foundation Endowment. Previously, he served as a Senior Associate at IllinoisVENTURES. He brings a combination of chemistry and materials science expertise to the firm. He assists the firm in assessing new investment opportunities as well as managing existing portfolio companies. Prior to Illinois Ventures, Jim was an Analytical Chemist at Abbott Laboratories, working extensively with R&D and new product development. From there he served as an Analytical Consultant to a trust management partnership contributing grant monies for cancer research to worldwide organizations. Jim then joined a start-up consulting firm providing design and analysis services for companies looking to bring the latest technology into their design and manufacturing processes. He holds dual bachelor's degrees in Biology and Chemistry from Valparaiso University, an MS in Materials Science and Engineering from the University of Texas, and an MBA from the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign.
Mr. John McEntire served as Director, Intellectual Property Commercialization at Qatar Foundation.

Ms. Leslie Ferrar serves as Deputy Chairwoman of the Council at Durham University. She joined the Council as a lay member in November 2020. She studied Chemistry at Durham and joined what is now the accountancy firm KPMG. She qualified in 1979, joined the tax department, and became a partner in 1988. In 2005, she became Treasurer to HRH The Prince of Wales and The Duchess of Cornwall. She acts as an adviser and has worked with several not-for-profit organizations, including Digby Stuart College and Roehampton University, Woldingham School, Breakthrough Breast Cancer, and The Queen's Commonwealth Trust.

primary_position: Executive Officer of the Vice Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer Office
biography: Mr. Machaille Al Naimi serves as Executive Officer of the Vice Chairperson and Chief Executive Officer at Qatar Foundation Endowment. She began her career as an attorney at Patton Boggs, a US law firm where she advised both local and international clients. She later joined ExxonMobil Qatar Inc. as Legal Counsel, supporting Qatar Petroleum Joint-Venture projects with RasGas, Laffan Refinery, and Al Khaleej Gas. She also has experience working with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs on the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change (COP 18/CMP 8). As the Chief Legal Counsel and Advisor to the President, she has represented Qatar at multiple negotiations and engagements with global institutions, such as the United Nations Office in New York, the United Nations Secretariat in Bonn, the World Bank, MEF, the White House, and others. She holds a Masters (MSc) in International Business Management from the University of Surrey in the United Kingdom and a Masters (LLM) in International Business Economic Law from Georgetown University in the United States. She also holds an undergraduate degree (LLB) in English law and French law from the University of Surrey in the United Kingdom and Sorbonne University in France and is a qualified attorney certified by the New York Bar.

Mr. Michael Mitchell serves as General Counsel at Qatar Foundation Endowment.

Mr. Omran Al-Kuwari serves as Chief Executive Officer at Qatar Foundation Endowment. Prior to joining Qatar Foundation International, he held several key leadership positions in various organizations such as Qatargas, GreenGulf, and Qatar Foundation. Dr. Al-Kuwari graduated from The George Washington University in Washington DC, obtained an MBA from City University London, and holds a Ph.D. from the Institute for Sustainable Resources at University College of London.

Mr. Rashid Al-Naimi serves as Chief Executive Officer of Investments at Qatar Foundation. He was previously Vice President of Administration, with the overall responsibility for managing all the administrative and operational functions of Qatar Foundation, its staff and its partner organizations, including the shared services areas of Finance, Procurement, Information Technology, Human Resources, Support Services, Business Improvement and Quality Management Systems. He was responsible for developing the ongoing strategy and implementation of all QF's initiatives, working closely with the management team and the Board of Directors to ensure that QF continues to build capacity for Qatar in the key areas of Education, Science and Research, and Community Development. He has been instrumental in creating a platform of innovation within QF, helping to foster a culture of quality and excellence aimed at unlocking the full potential of its staff whilst seeking to maximize shareholder value. Mr Al-Naimi has also frequently represented QF in the media and at numerous launch events. His career has developed over the past 20 years. He is a natural leader and has maintained roles in Senior Management for nearly a decade. Prior to joining Qatar Foundation, Mr Al-Naimi was the Manager of Human Resources for the Qatar energy company RasGas Company Limited. Mr Al-Naimi was responsible for maintaining human capital numbers as the plant executed a major program to increase margins by doubling production and fixing head-count. He is also the residing Chairman for Mazaya Qatar, MEEZA and Gulf Bridge International (GBI). He is also a Board Member representing Qatar Foundation across a number of companies including Vodafone Qatar. He has a Bachelor of Science in Economics from Indiana State University, USA and continues to drive for personal and professional excellence.

Mr. Saad Muhannadi serves as Board of Trustee & Board of Director at Qatar Foundation Endowment. His previous role was the Vice President for Capital Projects and Facilities Management and during the last 15 years, he led the development of the required Qatar Foundation's infrastructure to achieve Qatar's goal of transforming itself from a carbon-based to a knowledge-based economy. Engineer Saad Ebrahim Al Muhannadi was responsible for planning, design, construction and maintenance of all Qatar Foundation buildings and supporting infrastructure in QF's 15 million square meter campus as well as ensuring a healthy and safe living and working environment. Engineer Saad Ebrahim Al Muhannadi and his team played a crucial role in developing the infrastructure not only for QF but also for other related projects such as Al Shaqab, the region's premier equine education resource center, Qatar Science & Technology Park and Qatar Leadership Academy. The department is responsible for ensuring that each project is completed to the highest standards, both architecturally and environmentally. Holding a B.Arch. from the University of Miami, Florida in USA, Engineer Saad Ebrahim Al Muhannadi started his career with the Ministry of Municipality and Agriculture as Head of Design Development, then to an Assistant Manager of the Landmark West Bay development and finally he became the Chief of the Planning Unit. After that, Engineer Saad Ebrahim Al Muhannadi became one of the founding members of QF when he joined the Foundation in 1995 as Project Manager for Capital Projects before being promoted to Assistant Director, Director and then, in 2005, to his previous role as Vice President of Capital Projects and Facilities Management. Engineer Saad Ebrahim Al Muhannadi is also a founding member of the Board of Directors at Msheireb Properties, and on the subsidiary companies at QF.

Ms. Sara Al Thani serves as Manager, Creative Studio at Qatar Foundation Endowment.
Mr. Sheikh Salman Al-Thani serves as Chief Financial Officer at Qatar Foundation Endowment.

Ms. Sheikha Hind Al Thani serves as Chief Executive Officer & Vice Chairwoman at Qatar Foundation. She has also served as Vice Chairperson and Chairperson of the Executive Committee of the Supreme Education Council (now the Ministry of Education and Higher Education), and as a member of the Governing Council of Interpeace, an international organization dedicated to developing innovative solutions to building peace.

Ms. Sheikha Moza Nasser is a Co-Founder and serves as Chairperson at Qatar Foundation Endowment. She has been actively engaged in education and other social reforms in Qatar for many years and has played a major role in spearheading national and international development projects. In addition to her work at Qatar Foundation, she served as the Vice Chair of the Supreme Council of Health from 2009-2014 and as the Vice Chair of the Supreme Education Council from 2006-2012. In these roles, she helped enact major top-down reforms of Qatar's public schools and healthcare system. More recently, she chairs Sidra Medicine, a new training and research hospital that opened its doors in 2016 and is set to become a leading institution for women's and children's specialty care. Internationally, she launched Education Above All (EAA) in 2012 global initiative that aims to foster development and generate a global movement, with a particular focus on areas affected by poverty, conflict, and disaster, the needs of children, and the empowerment of youth and women. She also launched the Silatech initiative in 2008 to address the growing challenge of youth employment in the Middle East and North Africa, which followed her appointment by the Secretary General of the UN as an Alliance of Civilizations (AOC) Ambassador. She also plays an active role with the UN to support global education. She was appointed as a United Nations (UN) Advocate for the Sustainable Development Goals in 2016 and was previously a member of the UN Millennium Development Goals Advocacy Group with a special emphasis on Goal 2-universal primary education. She serves as a UNESCO Special Envoy for Basic and Higher Education, through which she launched multiple projects including the International Fund for Higher Education in Iraq. In 2012, she was appointed as a Steering Committee Member of the UN Secretary-General's Global Education First Initiative. The initiative aims to put every child in school, improve the quality of learning, and foster global citizenship. Among her many honors are the Carnegie Medal of Philanthropy and the George Bush Award for Excellence in Public Service. In 2009, she was inducted into the Academie des Beaux Arts de l'Institut de France. In 2007, she was presented the prestigious Chatham House Award for her contributions to improving international relations. She holds a Master of Arts (MA) in Public Policy in Islam from Hamad Bin Khalifa University's College of Islamic Studies and graduated from Qatar University with a degree in sociology. She has also been awarded honorary doctorates from Virginia Commonwealth University, Texas A&M University, Carnegie Mellon University, Imperial College London, and Georgetown University.

Henry Schroder Bank AG, Zurich, first as a Junior and later as a Senior Portfolio Manager and Investment Advisor, and a further 3 years at the equally renowned LGT Bank in Liechtenstein, Zurich, in the same function. Safra Sarasin AG, Zurich, as a Senior Portfolio Manager and Investment Advisor for national and international private clients and headed most recently the Department IAEZ / External Asset Managers in the rank of an Executive Director.

Mr. Maximilian Liechtenstein serves as Chairman of the Foundation Board at LGT Group. He as Board Member at Wefox. He holds an MBA degree from Harvard Business School and a Bachelor's degree from European Business School.

Ms. Chitra Ganesh serves as Board Member at Joan Mitchell Foundation. Across a twenty-year practice, She has developed an expansive body of work rooted in drawing and painting, which has evolved to encompass animations, wall drawings, collages, computer generated imagery, video, and sculpture. Through studies in literature, semiotics, queer theory, science fiction, and historical and mythic texts, Her attempts to reconcile representations of femininity, sexuality, and power absent from the artistic and literary canons. She often draws on visual forms from the South Asian subcontinent, including mythology, comics, and graphic art, and is currently negotiating her relationship to some of these images with the rise of right wing Hindu fundamentalism in India. Her work has been widely exhibited in the United States and internationally, including solo shows at Brooklyn Museum, NY; MoMA PS1, NY; The Kitchen, NY; The Rubin Museum of Art, NY; The Andy Warhol Museum, PA; Gothenburg Kunsthalle, Sweden; and Times Square, NY. Her work has also been exhibited in important group exhibitions at The Walker Art Center, MN; the Baltimore Museum of Art, MD; The Queens Museum of Art, NY; The Asia Society, NY; The Bronx Museum, NY; The Contemporary Arts Museum, Houston, TX; the Berkeley Art Museum and Pacific Film Archive, CA; the Museum of Contemporary Art San Diego, CA; the Boca Raton Museum of Art, FL; the Hayward Gallery, London, UK; Saatchi Museum, London, UK: Fondazione Sandretto Re Rebaudengo, Italy; Instituto Valenciano de Arte Moderno, Italy; the ZKM Center for Art and Media, Germany; Göteborgs Konsthall, Germany; Arthotek Kunstverein, Göttingen, Germany; the Museum of Contemporary Art, Shanghai, China; the Gwangju Contemporary Arts Centre, Korea; the Prince of Wales Museum, Mumbai, India; Indira Gandhi National Centre for Arts, New Delhi, India; Devi Art Foundation, India; the Kochi Biennial, India; and the Dhaka Art Summit, Bangladesh, among others. Her work is represented in the collections of the Museum of Modern Art, NY; San Francisco Museum of Modern Art, CA; the Whitney Museum of American Art, NY; The Brooklyn Museum, NY; The Art Institute of Chicago, IL; Smithsonian American Art Museum, Washington, DC; The Ford Foundation, NY; University of Michigan Museum of Art, MI; The Pennsylvania Academy of Fine Arts, PA; the Devi Art Foundation, India; Kiran Nadar Museum, Delhi, India; the Ishara Foundation, Dubai; the Saatchi Collection, London, UK; the Tai Kwun Foundation, Hong Kong; and Deutsche Bank, among others. She is the recipient of fellowships and awards from numerous foundations and organizations, including the New York Foundation for the Arts, Printed Matter, the Art Matters Foundation, the John Simon Guggenheim Memorial Foundation, the Joan Mitchell Foundation, the Lewis Center for the Arts at Princeton University, the Pollock Krasner Foundation, and the Ford Foundation. Her experience working with artist-centered organizations is rooted in the queer and South Asian communities, including serving on the Board of Directors of the South Asian Women's Creative Collective (1998-2004) and as a member of SLAAAP! Sexually Liberated Asian Artist Activist People (1999-2002). She currently serves on the Board of Governors at the Skowhegan School for Painting and Sculpture (since 2003). She received a BA in Art-Semiotics and Comparative Literature from Brown University, Providence, RI in 1996. She attended the Skowhegan School of Painting and Sculpture in 2001 and received her MFA in Visual Arts from Columbia University, NY in 2002.

biography: Mr. John Studzinski serves as Member of the Board of Trustees at J. Paul Getty Trust. He formerly served as Senior Managing Director & Vice Chairman of investor Relations and Business Development at The Blackstone Group. He was previously the Global Head of Blackstone Advisory Partners as well. Mr. Studzinski joined Blackstone in 2006 as Global Head of Blackstone Advisory Partners, which he ran for a decade. A graduate of Bowdoin College, he also has an MBA from the University of Chicago. He joined Morgan Stanley in New York in 1980 and since then has spent much of his career in London, where he served as Head of European Investment Banking and Deputy Chairman of Morgan Stanley International before moving to HSBC in 2003 as a member of the Group Management Board. Mr. Studzinski is a Non-Executive Director of the Home Office of the UK Government and serves as Chair of the Risk, Audit, and Compliance Committee in addition to chairing the Prime Minister's Business Against Modern Slavery initiative. He is the Founder and Chairman of the Genesis Foundation, a UK-based charitable foundation that nurtures the careers of outstanding young artists, and Chairman of Create London. Mr. Studzinski serves on the U.S. boards of The J. Paul Getty Trust, Scholars at Risk, Tate Americas Foundation, Signature Theatre, and the Foundation for Art and Preservation in Embassies (FAPE). He is the Director Emeritus of Human Rights Watch and is Co-founder and Chair of the Arise Foundation, which partners with local networks to stop human trafficking. Mr. Studzinski is also Vice Chairman of The Atlantic Council and a member of The Council on Foreign Relations. Mr. Studzinski holds the Papal honors of Knight of the Order of St. Gregory and Knight Commander of Saint Sylvester and in 2004 was awarded the Beacon Prize for Philanthropy. He received the Prince of Wales Medal for Arts Philanthropy and the Prince of Wales Ambassador Award for his work with the homeless. In 2007 Mr. Studzinski was voted Banker of the Year by The Bank of England. In 2008, the Queen's New Year's Honours List named him Commander of the British Empire (CBE) for services to the Arts and Charity.

Dr. Vartan Gregorian serves as Trustee at Carnegie Corporation Of New York. He also served as the President at Carnegie Corporation Of New York. He was the twelfth president of Carnegie Corporation of New York, a grant-making institution founded by Andrew Carnegie in 1911. Prior to his current position, which he assumed in June 1997, Gregorian served for nine years as the sixteenth president of Brown University. He received his elementary education in Iran and his secondary education in Lebanon. In 1956 he entered Stanford University, where he majored in history and the humanities, graduating with honors in 1958. He was awarded a Ph.D. in history and humanities from Stanford in 1964. Gregorian has taught European and Middle Eastern history at San Francisco State College, the University of California at Los Angeles, and the University of Texas at Austin. In 1972 he joined the University of Pennsylvania faculty and was appointed Tarzian Professor of History and professor of South Asian history. He was founding dean of the Faculty of Arts and Sciences at the University of Pennsylvania in 1974 and four years later became its twenty-third provost until 1981. For eight years (1981-1989), Gregorian served as the president of the New York Public Library, an institution with a network of four research libraries and eighty-three circulating libraries. In 1989 he was appointed president of Brown University. Gregorian is the author of The Road to Home: My Life And Times, Islam: A Mosaic, Not A Monolith, and The Emergence of Modern Afghanistan, 1880-1946. A Phi Beta Kappa and a Ford Foundation Foreign Area Training Fellow, he is a recipient of numerous fellowships, including those from the John Simon Guggenheim Foundation, the American Council of Learned Societies, the Social Science Research Council, and the American Philosophical Society. He is a Fellow of the American Academy of Arts and Sciences and the American Philosophical Society. In 1969, he received the Danforth Foundation's E.H. Harbison Distinguished Teaching Award. He serves on the boards of the Institute for Advanced Study, and the National September 11th Memorial and Museum. He served on the boards of the J. Paul Getty Trust, the Aga Khan University, the Qatar Foundation, the McGraw-Hill Companies, Brandeis University, Human Rights Watch, The Museum of Modern Art, and the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation. He has been decorated by the French, Italian, Austrian and Portuguese governments. His numerous civic and academic honors include over sixty honorary degrees, including those from Brown, Dartmouth, Drew, Johns Hopkins, University of Pennsylvania, the Jewish Theological Seminary, the City University of New York, Rutgers, Tufts, New York University, University of Aberdeen, the Juilliard School, the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, Fordham University, San Francisco State University, University of Notre Dame, Carnegie Mellon University, and most recently, Keio University, University of Miami, and the University of St. Andrews. In 1986, Gregorian was awarded the Ellis Island Medal of Honor and in 1989 the American Academy and the Institute of Arts and Letters' Gold Medal for Service to the Arts. In 1998, President Clinton awarded him the National Humanities Medal. In 2004, President Bush awarded him the Presidential Medal of Freedom, the nation's highest civil award. In 2009, President Obama appointed him to the White House Fellowships Commission. He has been honored by various cultural and professional associations, including the Urban League, the League of Women Voters, the Players Club, PEN-American Center, Literacy Volunteers of New York, the American Institute of Architects, and the Charles A. Dana Foundation. He has been honored by the city and state of New York, the states of Massachusetts, Texas, Pennsylvania, and Rhode Island, and the cities of Fresno, Austin, Providence, and San Francisco.

primary_position: Board Member & Chairman of Remuneration Committee
biography: MR. Heinz Nipp serves as Member of the Investment Committee at Seed X Liechtenstein .Mr. Heinz Nipp serves as Board Member & Chairman of Remuneration Committee at Castle Private Equity. He completed a banking apprenticeship and training as a financial analyst which was later followed by executive management studies at Stanford University. Prior to joining LGT Bank in Liechtenstein in 1982, Mr. Nipp spent several years abroad to gain practical banking experience. He was the CEO of LGT Bank in Liechtenstein until 1 January 2001 when he was appointed member of the group executive committee of Liechtenstein Global Trust, now known as LGT Group Foundation. In October 2006, Heinz Nipp was appointed executive chairman of wealth management Asia of LGT Group Foundation. He retired from his functions at LGT in 2008. He was elected to the board in 1997 and was re-elected at the general meeting held on 15 May 2013 for a term ending at the 2014 annual shareholders' meeting.

Dr. Konrad Bächinger serves as Deputy Chairman at Castle Private Equity. Dr. Bächinger received a Ph.D. in law from the University of Zurich. He was admitted to the bar in 1977. He subsequently acted as legal counsel for the St. Gallische Creditanstalt and as head of the legal department of Adolph Saurer AG. In 1984, he joined LGT Bank in Liechtenstein as general counsel. In 1989 he was appointed managing director and head of legal matters and project department. In 1990 he became a member of the bank's executive board, heading commercial banking and legal matters. In 1998 he became chief executive officer of LGT Capital Management. In April 2001 Dr. Bächinger was appointed to the group executive committee of Liechtenstein Global Trust, now known as LGT Group Foundation.

primary_company: Crown Premium Private Equity Technology Venture
biography: Dr. Konrad Bächinger served as an Executive at Crown Premium Private Equity Technology Venture. He qualified as a Doctor of Law from Zurich University and was admitted to the Swiss Courts in 1977. He joined LGT Bank in Liechtenstein in 1984. From 1998 to 2001 He was the chief executive officer of LGT Capital Management. From April 2001 to September 2006. Dr. Bächinger was a member of the group executive committee of Liechtenstein Global Trust (known as LGT Group Foundation since April 2001). Dr. Bächinger retired from his offices within LGT Group before the end of 2010.

Mr. Marc Oetiker serves as Vice President at StepStone Group. Mr. Oetiker is a member of the private debt team. Before StepStone, Mr. Oetiker completed an internship in Investment Communications at LGT Private Banking and an internship in Process Development and Support at Swissmedic. Mr. Oetiker received his MA in Banking & Finance at the University of St. Gallen, Switzerland, and his BSc in Business and Economics at the University of Basel, Switzerland.

primary_company: U.K. Department of Health & Social Care
biography: Mr. Alan Milburn serves as Leader of the Board at the U.K. Department of Health & Social Care. He was a Member of Parliament from 1992 to 2010. He served as Chief Secretary to the Treasury from 1998 to 1999, Secretary of State for Health from 1999 to 2003, and Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster from 2004 to 2005. He was the independent reviewer on Social Mobility and Child Poverty under the coalition government and became chair of the Social Mobility and Child Poverty Commission between 2012 and 2017. He is currently Chancellor of Lancaster University, chair of the Social Mobility Foundation, and runs his own consultancy firm AM Strategy Ltd.
Mr. Corey Stewart is a Co-Owner of Prince William County.
Mr. Jeff Kaczmarek served as Executive Director at Prince William County.
Mr. King Mohammed VI served as Executive at Government of Morocco.

primary_company: The Department of Premier and Cabinet (DPC
primary_position: Deputy Secretary, Justice and Public Administration & Board Member
biography: Mr. Joshua Puls serves as Deputy Secretary, Justice and Public Administration & Board Member at The Department of Premier and Cabinet (DPC). Mr. Puls's previous role in the Victorian Government was Official Secretary to the Governor of Victoria between 2016 and 2022. Prior to this appointment, he was Executive Director of the Cabinet Office in DPC, after having overseen the Anzac Centenary for the Victorian Public Service (VPS) as Director of DPC's Veterans Branch. Mr. Puls's list of professional achievements also includes being the first Australian to hold the position of Assistant Private Secretary (Commonwealth) to TRH The Prince of Wales and The Duchess of Cornwall (now TM The King and Queen Camilla), based at Clarence House in London. Before joining the VPS, Mr. Puls was Special Adviser to the Vice-Chancellor of the Australian Catholic University and Executive Officer of ACU's Institute of Legal Studies. He holds qualifications in law, arts, education, and theology as well as the degree of Executive Master of Public Administration from the Australia and New Zealand School of Government and the University of Melbourne. He has a Certificate IV in Teaching English to Speakers of Other Languages and is a Graduate of the Australian Institute of Company Directors. Queen Elizabeth II made Mr. Puls a Member of the Royal Victorian Order in the Queen's Birthday Honours list in 2016.

Ms. Michelle Ogburn served as Board Member at Henrico County Public Schools System. She represents the Three Chopt District, and in January 2016 became chair of the Henrico School Board. Mrs. Ogburn graduated from Longwood College with degrees in elementary education and history education. She has been a teacher for more than 20 years in pre-K, second, fifth, and sixth grades in Charleston, West Virginia, and in the Virginia counties of Culpeper, Prince William, Fairfax, and Henrico. Mrs. Ogburn was an intervention teacher at Henrico County's Short Pump Elementary School for seven years prior to her election to the School Board. She has been an active PTA board member at Short Pump Elementary School, Short Pump and Pocahontas middle schools, and Deep Run High School. Mrs. Ogburn has also been an active community volunteer with several youth sports associations, school-based sports booster organizations, the Salvation Army Angel Tree program, and her neighborhood homeowner's association.

primary_position: Secretary of State for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
biography: Mr. Steve Barclay serves as Secretary of State for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs at HM Treasury. He was previously Secretary of State for Health and Social Care between 25 October 2022 and 13 November 2023. He held the same role between 5 July 2022 and 6 September 2022. He was previously appointed Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster and Minister for the Cabinet Office between 15 September 2021 and July 2022. He was previously Chief Secretary to the Treasury from 13 February 2020 to 15 September 2021 and Secretary of State for Exiting the European Union from 16 November 2018 to 31 January 2020 and Minister of State for the Department of Health and Social Care from January to November 2018. Steve was also Economic Secretary to the Treasury from June 2017 to January 2018. He served as a Government Whip (Lord Commissioner of HM Treasury) from July 2016 to June 2017. He was elected Conservative MP for North East Cambridgeshire in May 2010. He studied law at the College of Law, Chester.

Mr. Steve Desroches serves as Councillor and Deputy Mayor at the City of Ottawa. He was first elected to City Council in 2006 for the Gloucester-South Nepean ward and was re-elected in 2010. He honoured his pledge to his community and family not to seek a third term in 2014. He was successful in returning to the City Council in 2022. During his time at City Hall, Councillor Desroches delivered a number of key infrastructure projects to serve the rapid residential growth in south Ottawa, including upgraded roads and cycling lanes, new parks and transit park-and-rides. Under his leadership, Findlay Creek's largest central park, Diamond Jubilee Park, was opened. He also championed the construction of the Vimy Memorial Bridge, which has helped improve transit connections and support local businesses. From his first days in office, he rallied for the construction of a north-south rapid transit rail network. He has helped build a clean and green city by planting over 10,000 trees in the ward and by acquiring and protecting the ward's first large urban woodlot. He is a career federal public servant within several departments, including Agriculture and Agriculture-Food Canada, the Privy Council Office and the Canadian Food Inspection Agency. He was awarded the Diamond Jubilee Medal in 2012 for his local community service. In 2015, he was awarded the Minister of Veterans Affairs Commendation for his work to honour and support veterans. He was also the recipient of the Sovereign's Medal for Volunteers in 2018 for his extensive community and not-for-profit volunteerism. In 2024, he was awarded the King Charles III Coronation Medal. He recently served on the Ottawa Region Métis Council and the St-John Ambulance Ontario Council. He holds an MA (History) from the University of Ottawa and an MA (Public Administration) from Carleton University. In 2014, he was awarded the Bissett Alumni Award for Distinctive Contributions to the Public Sector by Carleton University's School of Public Policy and Administration.

Mr. Christian Quintero serves as Senior Partner at DaGrosa Capital Partners. He serves as Chairman at Tero Holding. At DCP, he is primarily responsible for real estate development. Prior to joining DCP, he built more than $7 billion in commercial, hospitality, infrastructure, mixed-use, residential, retail, and stadium projects in the Middle East and United States. In addition to his 20+ years in real estate development, he spent over a decade investing as Chairman and Founder of Tero Holding. Prior to DCP, he was the Senior Project Manager on the Qatar Foundation Stadium that hosted matches during the 2022 FIFA World Cup QatarTM . Additionally, he played a pivotal role in the project management of the 8 stadiums and more than 32 training sites built for the tournament. He was the Project Manager of the bid committee that won the rights to host the 2022 FIFA WorldCupQatarTM . Prior to his role on the Qatar 2022 Bid Committee, he served as Principal at Design Management Construction Consulting; Client Representative at MB Development; Project Manager at Borges + Associates; Project Coordinator at GVP Structural Engineers; and Superintendent at Intercoastal Contracting.

Ms. Imane Sahib serves as an Executive, Investor Relations at InfraVia Capital Partners. Ms. Sahib has a solid track record in both investment and transaction advisory through her experiences at Credit Suisse and Al Mada. She spent two years at Al Mada within the investment team and three years at Credit Suisse advising both corporate clients as well as financial sponsors on various M&A transactions. Throughout these years, she worked with a wide range of clients and gained experience in several different sectors including Transportation and Utilities. She graduated from EMLYON Business School.

Ms. Jeanne Schläfli serves as Investment Associate at Helvetica Capital. Previously, she worked for three years at EY Switzerland in M&A advisory mainly for Swiss SMEs and was also involved in financial due diligence. She gained further professional experience in the hotel industry in Switzerland and abroad as well as at LGT Bank. She holds a Bachelor of Science in International Hospitality Management from the Ecole hôteliere de Lausanne as well as a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration and a Master of Arts in Accounting & Corporate Finance from the University of St. Gallen (HSG).

Mr. Coghlin served as General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer at HealthCor Management. He joined the HealthCor Group in July 2007. Mr. Coghlin advises the HealthCor Group on deal structures, transactional documentation, regulatory compliance, and day-to-day legal and risk management issues. Prior to joining HealthCor Group, Mr. Coghlin served as a Senior Vice President of Citizens Financial Group. Prior to joining CFG, Mr. Coghlin served in a variety of capacities in the Legal and Private Equity sectors. Mr. Coghlin began his career in 1991 as an associate at Rogers & Wells where he practiced corporate law focusing on cross-border finance. Mr. Coghlin left the law firm in 1994 to become general counsel of a private international holding company and from there served as a principal at CIBC Capital Partners and MMC Capital.

Mr. Murray Harrington serves as Executive Director at Genesis Capital. Prior to joining Genesis, he was a Partner of PwC for 13 years. More recently he was the successful turnaround CEO of a technology company for a two-year period. He has or has had ownership interests in a wide range of private or private equity backed companies over a twenty-year period. He has also had a six year period working internationally in the oil and gas industry. He has a keen interest in governance, is currently NZ VP and a Director of Chartered Accountants Australia and New Zealand, a Director of IHC NZ and CORDE and is founding Chair of the recently developed Opuke Hot Pool complex in Methven. He currently sits on the Audit and Risk Committee of the NZ Infrastructure Commission.

Mr. R Venkataramanan serves as Advisor at Blue Ashva Capital. He is an independent consultant and a venture capital advisor. His current assignment is with Reliance Industries, India's largest private sector company wherein he is engaged as an Advisor in establishing social enterprises, especially in the areas of Healthcare and Agriculture. Venkat till recently was the Managing Trustee of the Tata Trusts and was responsible for the operations, oversight, and co-ordination between the various Tata Trusts The Tata Trusts are public charities and are the principal shareholder of Tata Sons, the parent company of the Tata Group, India's largest conglomerate. In his role as the Principal Executive Officer of the Tata Trusts, Venkat was engaged in redefining the Tata Trusts' strategic approach to make it relevant and responsive to the current needs of society while remaining within the mandate established by the Settlors. He till recently was directly overseeing three large initiatives within the Trusts viz "Lakhpati Kisan - a program that aims to significantly enhance rural prosperity in underprivileged and deprived communities, redefining Cancer Care across the country and the nutrition project. He has over 23 years of business and operations experience in the areas of finance, business support, and strategy. From early 2007 to the end of 2012, he was Executive Assistant to Mr. Ratan N. Tata, the former Chairman of the Tata Group. He continues to support Mr. Tata in the office of the Chairman Emeritus, Tata Sons. During his stint in the Chairman's office of Tata Sons, Venkat was part of several significant projects including the Tata Motors acquisition of Jaguar Land Rover, the launch of the small car Nano, the creation of several Joint Ventures, responses in operating companies during the financial crisis, etc., and was also privy to several leadership transitions and change management processes in the Tata Group. On behalf of the Chairman, he was the key point person to several entities in India and abroad. Before his association with Mr. Tata, Venkat was Head of Business Support at the Qatar Foundation, a not-for-profit entity engaged in Education, Science, and Community development based in Doha, wherein he played a key role in establishing partnerships with several leading US universities.

primary_position: Senior Partner, Chairman, and Member of the Investment Committee
biography: Mr. Saâd Bendidi serves as Senior Partner, Chairman, and Member of the Investment Committee at Mediterrania Capital Partners. He holds an Engineering degree from the Ecole Centrale de Paris, a Master's degree from Sciences-Po Paris, and a degree from HEC Paris. Before joining MCP, he held several leading positions in various sectors, including Director of the Department of Strategy and Planification of the former Wafabank (1985-1987), Managing Director of Magetex and CIB (1988-1992) and of the Moroccan Fund " Moussahama "(1992-1997). He was also Chairman of Meditelecom (1999 -2005), Vice President of Finance.com (2001- 2005), and Director of Participations and Investments of BMCE Bank (1997-2000). From 2005 to 2008, he was the Chairman of the ONA Group and administrator of ONA International, SNI, Attijari Wafabank, Managem, Centrale Laitière, Cosumar, Lesieur, Nareva, Optorg, Marjane, Acima, Bimo, Sonasid, Lafarge Maroc, CIMR, AttijariBank, Manatrade and CBAO. He is currently Chairman of CNIA Saada (Saham) a leading insurance company in Africa and he holds the position of Non-Executive Chairman of HWM, the exclusive distributor of Haworth, Figueras, Bontempi, and SitLand in Morocco, Algeria, and Tunisia. He also acts as an independent board member of several companies. He has acquired extended knowledge of the Maghreb region's economic landscape through his experience in various positions. He has a large network of entrepreneurs and key players in the Maghreb region and Africa, strong investment and managerial experience in highly competitive markets at different levels, and relevant exposure to various industries, in particular Telecoms, Dairy industry, and Banking. He is currently a member of the Board of two of MC I portfolio companies: CIM Haier, Bitaka, and First Telecom.

Mr. Cyrill Mathis serves as Partner & Senior Client Advisor at Entrepreneur Partners (Zurich). During his career, he worked in various functions in Private Banking at LGT Bank Ltd. in Liechtenstein and Hong Kong, most recently as a Senior Relationship Manager looking after very high net worth individuals, families and foundations. Cyrill Mathis holds a Bachelor of Science FHO in Business Administration specializing in BankAssurance from the University of Applied Sciences HTW Chur, Switzerland. He is a Certified International Wealth Manager (CIWM®) and an ESG Client Advisor (AZEK).

primary_position: Principal, Co-Chief Executive Officer (Europe) & Senior Partner
biography: Mr. Heinz Gotschmann serves as Principal, Co-Chief Executive Officer (Europe) & Senior Partner at LHG Capital Management. He currently serves as the Company's Co-CEO and a member of the Senior Management team, advising many of LHG's strategic relationships. Based out of our Zürich office, he is responsible for developing and managing our client and commercial strategies across Europe. Prior to joining LHG, Mr. Götschmann spent 20 years in senior roles in wealth management at UBS, Credit Suisse and LGT Bank. Mr. Götschmann founded Höhe Trust AG in 2017, a Zürich-based Multi-Family Office that serves ultra-high-net-worth clients across Switzerland and Western Europe. Mr. Götschmann is a Zürich local and is fluent in German, English and French. He also holds an MBA degree from ETH Zürich

Mr. Luis Ott serves as Managing Director at Independent Fund Management. He also serves as Partner and Non-Executive Director at Quorus Asset Management. He also serves as a Partner & Board Member at Principal Asset Management. He has a comprehensive background in banking acquired with the LGT Bank in Liechtenstein Aktiengesellschaft. After completion of his training, he started his professional career as a trader with Banque Romande in Geneva. He later joined Deutsche Bank Capital Markets in London, where he traded derivative instruments at the rank of a senior manager. He then worked for Crédit Lyonnais Euro-Securities in London as a senior derivative instruments trader. He was also a sales trader with Gerrard & National in London and later a sales trader in the rank of an Assistant Director with Roderick Sutherland & Partners in Edinburgh. He holds a Swiss degree in financial analysis and portfolio management; he is a Certified European Financial Analyst. He has 20 years of experience in the investment business.

primary_position: Portfolio Manager & Equities Day Trader Executive
biography: Mr. Michael Stevens serves as a Portfolio Manager & Equities Day Trader Executive at AG Capital (South Africa).

Mr. Simon Casutt served as Chief Compliance Officer at ISPartners Investment Solutions. Mr. Casutt's background is in compliance and risk management. After undergraduate studies in politics at the University of Zurich, he worked as a Junior Portfolio Manager at VZ VermögensZentrum in Zurich from 2007 to 2008. From 2008-2012, he worked as a Compliance Officer at LGT Bank, and until 2013, he was a Senior Compliance Analyst at Royal Bank of Canada (RBC). In 2013, he joined Bank Vontobel's asset management and performed several functions in risk and financial management. He obtained the Diploma of Advanced Studies Hochschule Luzern/FHZ in Compliance Management in 2016. Mr. Casutt joined ISPartners in August 2015 as Chief Compliance Officer (CCO).

Mr. Harry Djanogly is an Angel Investor. Mr. Djanogly is a British textile manufacturer with a particular interest in Art and Education. In 1936, his family made Nottingham their home where he has sponsored the Djanogly City Academy, the Djanogly Gallery at the University of Nottingham and much more. In 1983 he was awarded Commander of the British Empire and in 1993 he was invested as Knight Batchelor. In 2014, he and Lady Djanogly received the Prince of Wales Medal for Arts Philanthropy.

primary_position: Founder, Chief Executive Officer & Managing Director
biography: Dr. Lina Noureddin is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer & Managing Director at Lamar Holding. As the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Lamar Holding, Dr. Lina is a key member of the company's executive committee and leads the development vertical of the organization. She is responsible for the critical task of driving Lamar Holding's global expansion efforts, overseeing the development and execution of the company's strategic plans and operational initiatives. Dr. Lina is a highly proficient C-suite executive with over 20 years of experience in financial, economic, and management consulting. Her extensive knowledge and expertise have enabled her to progress into leadership positions, including the role of Secretary General for the Economic Consultative Council in the Royal Hashemite Court of Jordan, Vice President of the Social Security Corporation under the guidance of His Majesty King Abdullah II, and Director of the Jordan Education Initiative under the patronage and chair of Queen Rania Al Abdullah. Dr. Lina's vast experience and proficiency in these domains have established her as a respected leader and valuable asset to any organization.As she currently leads Lamar Holding, Dr. Lina collaborates in close partnerships with key clients such as Saudi Aramco, government entities, and major international funds. Her leadership has resulted in the organization's reinforced upstream leadership position, as it continues to expand its reach in delivering Public-Private-Partnership infrastructure projects across Saudi Arabia and the GCC region. Under her guidance, Lamar Holding's strategic initiatives and operational plans have enabled the company to achieve sustained growth and success in all regions. In addition, Dr. Lina possesses significant expertise in joint ventures, having steered Lamar Holding through various lucrative joint ventures and extended partnerships with influential government stakeholders throughout the GCC region. Dr. Lina obtained a bachelor's degree in chemistry from the University of Jordan, followed by a master's degree in financial markets and a PhD Degree in finance, both from the University of Banking and Financial Sciences in Jordan.

Mr. Lord Strathclyde serves as Chairman at Hampden Group. He serves as an Advisory Board Member at Abercross Holdings. He has almost 30 years of senior government experience in the UK. He entered the House of Lords in 1986, becoming Minister for Tourism in 1989. Between 1990 and 1992 he was Minister for Agriculture and Fisheries in the Scottish Office. In 1995, Tom was sworn in as a member of the Privy Council which advises Her Majesty the Queen. In 1998 he was appointed as Leader of the House of Lords for the Conservative Party. Under his leadership, the House of Lords Act 1999 passed and he was elected as one of the 92 hereditary peers to remain in the House of Lords. He won Channel 4 Peer of the Year 2000, and Spectator Peer of the Year 2004. Mr. Strathclyde became Leader of the House of Lords and Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster, with a seat in the Cabinet in May 2010. On 7 January 2013, Mr. Strathclyde announced that he would be stepping down as Leader of the House of Lords and resigning from the Cabinet to pursue a second business career. He has served on the Boards of the Scottish Mortgage Investment Fund, Marketform, Hampden Agencies Ltd, and other businesses.

primary_position: Group Chief Financial Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Mohammad Ramahi serves as Group Chief Financial Officer & Board Member at Al Faisal Holding.
Mr. Neak Meng serves as Chief Executive Officer & Chairman at Royal Group Cambodia.

primary_position: Investment Analyst, Mergers and Acquisitions (Private Equity/Venture Capital
biography: Mr. Rafay Mushtaq serves as Investment Analyst, Mergers and Acquisitions (Private Equity/Venture Capital at Al Faisal Holding.

full_name: Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani
biography: Mr. Sheikh Faisal Bin Qassim Al Thani is the Founder and serves as Chairman at Al Faisal Holding. Mr. Bin Qassim Al Thani also serves as Chairman of True Smile Works Dental Network.

Dr. Eduardo Padron serves as Executive, Impact Investments Strategy at Human Capital Development. He is the President Emeritus of Miami Dade College (MDC), having served as its President for almost 25 years. He is credited with elevating MDC, the largest degree granting institution in America, into a position of national prominence among the best and most recognized U.S. colleges and universities. An economist by training, he earned his Ph.D. from the University of Florida. In 2018, he was elected a Fellow of the American Academy of Arts & Sciences, one of America's oldest and most prestigious organizations. In 2016, President Barack Obama awarded him the Presidential Medal of Freedom, the highest civilian honor in the U.S., for being a prominent national voice for access and inclusion in higher education. In 2020 the Florida Council of 100 awarded him the "2020 Grand Floridian" Prize. In 2009, TIME magazine included him on the list of "The 10 Best College Presidents." In 2010, Florida Trend magazine placed him on the cover of its inaugural "Floridian of the Year" issue. In 2011, The Washington Post named him one of the eight most influential college presidents in the U.S. Also in 2011, he was awarded the prestigious 2011 Carnegie Corporation Centennial Academic Leadership Award. In 2012, he received the Citizen Service Award from Voices for National Service, the coveted TIAA Hesburgh Award for Leadership Excellence, and the Aspen Institute Ascend Fellowship. In 2015, he was inducted into the U.S. News & World Report STEM Hall of Fame. He was awarded the Harry Truman Award from the American Association of Community Colleges. His energetic leadership extends to many of the nation's leading organizations. He is the past chair of the board of directors of the American Council on Education (ACE) and is a past chair of the board of the Association of American Colleges and Universities (AAC&U) and former chair of the Business Higher Education Forum (BHEF). During his career, he has been selected to serve on posts of national prominence by five American presidents. Internationally, President his accomplishments have been recognized by numerous nations and organizations including the Republic of France, which named him Commandeur in the Ordre des Palmes Académiques; the Republic of Argentina, which awarded him the Order of San Martin; Spain's King Juan Carlos II, who bestowed upon him the Order of Queen Isabella; Spain's Prince and Princess of Asturias, Felipe and Letizia, who presented him with the Juan Ponce de Leon 500th Anniversary award; Morocco's King Mohammed VI, who appointed him Honorary Consul in Florida of the Kingdom of Morocco in 2016, and the Amicus Poloniae from the Republic of Poland. His pace-setting work at Miami Dade College has been hailed as a model of innovation in higher education. He is credited with engineering a culture of success that has produced impressive results in student access, retention, graduation, and overall achievement. MDC enrolls and graduates more minorities than any other institution in the United States, including the largest numbers of Hispanics and African-Americans. Under his leadership, Miami Dade College has received national recognition for its longstanding involvement with its urban community, its catalytic effect for social and economic change, and the marked difference the College has made in student access and success through pace-setting initiatives. He has served on several national commissions including Aspen Institute, Council on Foreign Relations, Woodrow Wilson Foundation, Knight Foundation, Ford Foundation, Mellon Foundation, Century Foundation, National Science Foundation, National Governors Association, American Bar Association, Lumina Foundation, and others. He currently serves on the boards of the Council on Foreign Relations; Urban Institute; Spencer Foundation; Education Trust; ACT; College Promise (Chair); National Commission on Inclusive Capitalism; Dream.US; Concordia Leadership Council; Milken Center for Advancing the American Dream and World Strategic Forum (Chair). In past years he has held leadership positions on the boards of the Federal Reserve Board of Atlanta, Miami Branch (past Chair); the Carnegie Foundation for the Advancement of Teaching; Achieving the Dream; Hispanic Association of Colleges & Universities (Chair); the Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts; the White House Commission on Educational Excellence; Campus Compact; Congressional Hispanic Caucus Institute; The College Board; and the White House/Congressional Commission of the National Museum of the American Latino. He is the recipient of numerous honorary doctorates and prestigious awards.

Ms. Katerina Kimmorley serves as Head of Commercial and Investments at Boundless. Ms. Kimmorley served as Board Member at Allume Energy. She served as Investment Committee Member, Climate Tech Fund at Investible. She was a Chevening Scholar at the London School of Economics where she studied Environmental Economics and Climate Change. Katerina is an international advocate for climate finance and was recognised in the Australian Financial Review's 100 Women of Influence. She was the London School of Economics Entrepreneur of the Year and was awarded the Prince of Wales Young Sustainability Entrepreneur Prize.

Dr. Katharina Sommerrock serves as Head of Investor Relations at Lightrock. She is fascinated by the leverage capital, markets, innovation, and entrepreneurs can have in solving global challenges. She has also held positions at LGT Group in sustainable and impact investing. Before joining LGT, she was a project leader at Bain & Company, focused on financial services, private equity, and social impact. In 2009, she received a Ph.D. for her dissertation on entrepreneurship. She holds a Master's in International Business Administration from the University of Eichstätt-Ingolstadt. She loves spending time with her family in the mountains or on the water, alternates between high-intensity training and a yoga mat, and never has enough time to read.

Dr. Min Sung Park serves as an Advisor at Infusion 51a. He serves as CSO at Sanimed Group, IHC and is the Founding Director, UAE National Genome Program. He holds a Ph.D. (Doctor of Philosophy) degree.

Dr. Rodolfo Bogni served as a Board Member at Lightrock. Dr. Bogni served as a Board Member and at LGT Group Stallergenes. He is Chairman of Northill UK, a director of Waypoint Capital Holdings, and a trustee of the Prince of Liechtenstein Foundation. He is also a member of the Governing Council of the CSFI (Centre for the Study of Financial Innovation), a member of the Advisory Board of Oxford Analytica, and of the Council of Shakespeare's Globe Theatre. He holds a Ph.D. (Doctor of Philosophy) in Economics and Business Administration from Bocconi University.

Ms. Elizabeth Buchanan served as Non-Executive Director at The National Farmers' Union Mutual Insurance Society. She is a Special Adviser to Waitrose, Saputo UK, and McDonald's. She is a Fellow of the Royal Agriculture Societies, Vice President of the Rare Breeds Survival Trust, President of The South of England Agricultural Society, Senior Associate of the Cambridge Institute of Sustainability Leadership and Trustee of the Smith School for Enterprise and the Environment at Oxford University. She also sits on the BBC Rural Affairs Committee, is a Trustee of the Prince's Countryside Fund and also manages her family's 300-acre organic livestock farm. Until March 2023 she was a non-executive Board member of DEFRA and until December 2009 Elizabeth was the Private Secretary to His Majesty The King, then The Prince of Wales, and previously served as a Press Secretary to former Prime Minister Lady Thatcher.

Ms. Haya Almana served as Group Chief Administrative Officer at Qatar Insurance Company. She is a graduate of the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Paris Master in Strategic Business Unit Management. Most recently she was with Aspire Foundation and Qatar Foundation, bringing with her many years of major experience in Human Resource, Marketing, Training & Development, Facility Management, Business Support and Communications & Public Relations. She has been awarded an UK Associate Professional from Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development (CIPD).

Ms. Doris Di Marzio serves as Managing Partner at PLEXUS Investments. Before she joined PLEXUS, she spent twelve years working in various investment roles at LGT Capital Partners and in the Marketing department of the LGT Group.

primary_position: Chief Executive Officer, Global Head of Sustainable AI & Digital Finance and Board Member, Member of the Executive Committee
biography: Mr. Rupesh Madlani serves as Chief Executive Officer, Global Head of Sustainable AI & Digital Finance and Board Member, Member of the Executive Committee at Bankers without Boundaries. Prior to this, Mr. Madlani worked at PwC in the corporate finance practice. He is a chartered accountant and Freeman of the City of London. He is an expert reviewer in various publications with the World Economic Forum, the OECD, the Prince of Wales Sustainability unit, and the United Nations relating sustainable development.
Mr. Wolfgang Eisl serves as Chief Executive Officer at LGT Bank Austria.

Ms. Jacqueline Leung serves as Board Member at Sun Hung Kai & Company. She was appointed as an Independent Non-Executive Director of the Company on 1 November 2014. Ms. Leung is currently the president and managing director of Leighton Investments Limited and Leighton Textiles Company Limited. She was with Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu from February 2001 to August 2014. Prior to that, she worked at the mergers and acquisitions department of Oppenheimer & Co. Inc. in New York City. Ms. Leung is an active community leader and volunteer and has served as a member of the Vetting Committee for the Allocation of Sites and Start-up Loan for Post-secondary Education Providers under the Education Bureau of the Government of HKSAR since 2010. Over the years, she held various positions in charitable organizations in Hong Kong, such as the fundraising chairman for the Hong Kong Cancer Fund and a director at Po Leung Kuk. On 1 January 2016, she was appointed as a member of the Exchange Fund Advisory Committee (EFAC) Financial Infrastructure Sub- Committee of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority and on 1 April 2017, she was appointed as a member of the Hospital Governing Committee of Prince of Wales Hospital. Ms. Leung holds a Bachelor of Arts Degree in Economics and a Bachelor of Science Degree with honours in Engineering from Brown University in the United States.

Mr. Jean Ergas serves as Chief Economist at Tigress Financial Partners. He produces Macro-Economic analysis, including currency, interest rate, political, trade, counterparty, credit risk and asset allocation strategy. He has over 20 years' experience in global finance and risk management in which he has both held senior positions in the corporate world as well as advising sophisticated global investors. He is a specialist in energy/commodities, global capital markets and insurance/reinsurance. Prior to Tigress, he worked for the A.M. Best Company as an Assistant Vice President in the Global Financial Services Group, at Swiss Bank Corporation in the capital markets group, raising financing for sovereign and non-sovereign borrowers at ENI, as the Assistant to the Managing Director of Hydrocarbons International Holding Company in Zurich, as well as the Credit Risk Manager of Enichem International in Zurich.

primary_position: Senior Advisor, Investment Banking and Strategic Advisory
biography: Mr. Jonathan Knee serves as Senior Advisor, Investment Banking and Strategic Advisory at Evercore Group. Mr. Knee is a senior advisor in the firm's strategic advisory practice, with over 25 years of relevant experience. Mr. Knee is also the Michael T. Fries Professor of Media and Technology at Columbia Business School. Notable transactions/clients include advising S&P Global on its acquisitions of SNL Financial and The Climate Service and its sale of McGraw-Hill Construction, McGraw-Hill Education, Businessweek, and S&P Securities Evaluations; Nasdaq on its acquisition of Verafin and its sale of BWise and PR Solutions; the Scripps family on the sale of SNI Networks to Discovery, the merger of the broadcast operations of The E.W. Scripps Co. and Journal Communications, the spin/merge of their corresponding newspaper operations and the purchase of ION Media; Hearst on its multiple investments in Fitch; and Advance on its acquisitions of Turnitin and Examsoft and its sale of 1010data. Prior to joining Evercore, Mr. Knee was managing director and co-head of the media group at Morgan Stanley. He was previously publishing sector head in the communications, media and entertainment group at Goldman, Sachs & Co. He is a member of the Council on Foreign Relations and serves on the boards of directors of the National Women's Law Center and New Alternatives for Children. Mr. Knee holds a J.D. from Yale University, an MBA from Stanford University, an M.Sc. from Trinity College Dublin, and a B.A. from Boston University.

primary_position: Director, Building Products & Homebuilding Investment Banking
biography: Mr. Michael Phipps served as Director, Building Products & Homebuilding Investment Banking at RBC Capital Markets. He also serves as the Director of Strategy and Business Development for Accelerated Oil Technologies, an oil and gas joint venture with KKR. Prior to Centerboard, Mr. Phipps was a Vice President at Goldman Sachs & Co. within the Investment Banking Division covering the Industrials and Natural Resources sectors. Before joining Goldman, he was an Associate at Bank of America Merrill Lynch focused on the Chemicals sector. He has executed over $50 billion of M&A and capital raising assignments, including the acquisition of Royal Group Technologies by Georgia Gulf and the sale of Solo Cup to Dart Container Corporation. Mr. Phipps received a Bachelor of Science summa cum laude in economics and political science from Vanderbilt University in 2005.

Mr. R. Michael Stevens serves as Senior Vice President & Wealth Advisor at David A. Noyes & Company. He believes that the key to working in financial services is to understand, to serve and to advise the most important asset of all; the client. He joined the firm over 25 years ago.

primary_position: Managing Director, Preferred Securities Sales & Trading
biography: Mr. Michael Stevens served as Managing Director, Preferred Securities Sales & Trading at Incapital.

Mr. Nadim Azar serves as Director at QInvest. Mr. Azar joined in 2011 and was a key member of the team which built the QMAP platform. He is responsible for building a range of quantitative fund valuation and risk monitoring models. Prior to joining QInvest, Nadim had spent time with both Credit Suisse and Merrill Lynch as an intern where he studied different financial products they offer and helped to build diversified multi asset class portfolios. Nadim has experience in the project management where he worked for 3 years as a project engineer for MIDMAC, a subsidiary of QIPCO. During his time there his key focus was on estimation and project management and was involved in the development of some key projects, such as the Texas A&M University in Qatar. Nadim holds an MSc in Advanced Finance from IE Business School, Madrid. He also holds a Bachelor of Engineering degree from the American University of Beirut. He has completed the CISI IFQ Certificate in Islamic Finance.
Mr. Nicholas Klein served as Succession and Acquisition Associate at Raymond James Financial. Previously he was a Staffing Manager at SNI Companies.

Mr. Toma Ziegler served as Director, Advisory at Perella Weinberg Partners. He focuses on advising clients in the Consumer and Retail sectors. Mr. Ziegler has more than six years of investment banking experience assisting companies on a wide range of strategic matters. During his tenure at Perella Weinberg Partners, he has advised Majid Al Futtaim on the acquisition of Retail Arabia; Mayhoola on the acquisition of Balmain; and Mondelez/Jacobs Douwe Egberts on its disposal of Carte Noire. Prior to joining Perella Weinberg Partners in October of 2014, Mr. Ziegler was at Lazard (Paris) from 2012 to 2014, where he began his career as an Analyst. At Lazard, he actively worked with clients in the Business Services, Gaming, Energy and Building Materials industries. Mr. Ziegler earned a Master in Business from ESCP Europe and a Master in Law from Evry University.

Mr. Tommaso Lillo serves as Managing Director, Consumer Group at Houlihan Lokey. Mr. Lillo has advised numerous European companies across various sectors on M&A transactions, complex equity and debt capital raises, and financial restructurings. Previously, Mr. Lillo was a Director at Leonardo & Co., which entered into a joint venture with Houlihan Lokey in Italy and now operates under the Houlihan Lokey brand. Prior to joining Leonardo & Co., he worked at Capitalia S.p.A. in the M&A department (now merged into UniCredit Group). Mr. Lillo actively collaborates with LUISS Guido Carli University on its Real Estate Finance course and with UniVertis on its Master's program for Financial Analysts. In the past five years at Houlihan Lokey, Mr. Lillo has advised on more than 30 transactions in the food and beverage sector, including the sales of Nutkao to Teralys (Al Mada), Dolciaria Acquaviva to Vandemoortele Group, Hi-Food to CSM Ingredients (Investindustrial), Parker Food to Investindustrial, and Eat Natural to Ferrero, as well as the acquisitions of Salpa & Cherubini by Apheon and Fox's by Ferrero. Mr. Lillo holds a degree in Economics from LUISS Guido Carli University in Rome.

primary_company: The Private Office Of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan Bin Mohammed Al Nahayan
biography: Mr. Adam Ladjadj served as Chief Investment Officer at The Private Office Of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan Bin Mohammed Al Nahayan. Mr. Adam Ladjadj Co-Founded and served as the Executive Chairman at The Private Investment Group. Holding a number of key positions throughout the world as a Board Member, Director, and CIO, he drove the Investment arm of the company with tenacity and strategy.
Mr. Amnat Jiramanimai serves as Board Member at The Crown Property Bureau.

primary_position: Senior Partner, Shareholder, and Managing Partner
biography: Dr. Clemens Gregor serves as Senior Partner, Shareholder, and Managing Partner at Finad Group. He was born in 1962 and grew up in Frankfurt am Main and Vienna. In 1987, he successfully trained as a commodities trader at Metallgesellschaft and worked for several years as the CEO of a private, globally active trading house. With two partners, he founded his own commodities trading house, based in Vienna. After thirteen years as a trader, he sold his firm and entered the private banking field. For two years, he looked after private endowments and high-net-worth clients at Constantia Privatbank in Vienna. Afterward, he moved to UBS in Zurich, where he was responsible for the key client division for high net worth individuals in Austria and Central Europe. In 2006, he took up the post of Managing Director at LGT Bank in Liechtenstein. In this position, he was responsible for southern Europe and emerging markets sectors and managed 80 staff across five different sites. He has been a managing partner at Finad since 2009. He went to school in Vienna, gained his doctorate in law and a degree in law at the University of Vienna in 1984, and subsequently worked as a management consultant at Arthur Andersen in Frankfurt.

Mr. David Gibson-Moore serves as Director at Dalma Capital. He served as Advisor at Sarwa. He is President and CEO of Gulf Analytica. He is additionally Senior Advisor to the LGT Group Foundation, Member of Global Advisory Board of LGT Capital Partners and Managing Director of Stentor Resources, Biarritz Limited and Grosvenor Properties. He has had a career in corporate finance, investment banking and private equity. He was Chief Executive Officer of LGT Bank covering the GCC countries and before that Managing Director and CEO Middle East for the Robeco Group with responsibility for institutional asset management business in the GCC region. He was previously 15 years with JP Morgan Chase where he was Chairman of the Boards of the bank in Switzerland, Luxembourg and Jersey and Swiss country manager. In addition, he was also responsible for business development for Global Investment Banking based in New York.

Mr. Davide Lazzarotto served as Chief Office Manager at KTS Capital Management. In 2011, Davide accepted a new challenge as a Relationship Manager for the Intermediary Desk at LGT Bank AG, Vaduz, Liechtenstein. In his role as Vice Director, he gained a great deal of experience in finding various investment solutions for his clients.
Mr. Kasem Wattanachai served as Board Member at The Crown Property Bureau.

primary_position: Group Chief Executive Officer, Managing Director, Board Member, & Member of the Investment Committee
biography: Mr. Khaldoon Al Mubarak serves as Group Chief Executive Officer, Managing Director, Board Member, & Member of the Investment Committee at Mubadala Investment Company. Mr. Al Mubarak serves as Vice Chairman of the Board and Member of the Executive, Nomination and Remuneration Committee at MGX. He also serves as Chairman of Nawah Energy Company. He also serves as Chairman of the Executive Affairs Authority. He has led the company's significant evolution for two decades. In addition to his commercial responsibilities, he holds several UAE Government and Abu Dhabi Government responsibilities, including being a member of the Abu Dhabi Executive Council since 2006; a Founding Member of Abu Dhabi's Supreme Council for Financial and Economic Affairs; Presidential Special Envoy to China since 2018; and Founding Chairman of the Executive Affairs Authority, which provides strategic policy advice to His Highness Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, President of the United Arab Emirates. He is the Chairman at Aldar Properties. He served as the Chief Executive Officer at Aldar Properties. He is the Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Executive Affairs Authority, which provides strategic policy advice to the Chairman of the Abu Dhabi Executive Council, of which he is also a member.
