He is Chairman of the Emirates Nuclear Energy Corporation, Abu Dhabi Motorsports Management, the Abu Dhabi Media Zone Authority, and Emirates Aluminum (EMAL). He is also Deputy Chairman of the Urban Planning Council, a member of the Abu Dhabi Council for Economic Development, and a board member of First Gulf Bank, Ferrari Spa, Group 42, and ALDAR Properties. He is also a member of the New York University Board of Trustees. Mr. Al Mubarak holds a degree in Economics and Finance from Tufts University, Boston, USA.
Mr. Krit Kanchanakunchorn served as Board Member at The Crown Property Bureau.

Mr. Nikolaus Nicolaus is the Founder and serves as Partner at Kronos Advisory. He is a trained banker and business economist and has worked in international banking since 1997. After completing his training at Deutsche Bank in Munich, he worked for many years in Frankfurt in the Quandt family's family office and in asset management for international corporations. He has lived in Austria with his family for over 13 years and has held various senior relationship positions in international private banking at Credit Suisse and for almost nine years at LGT Bank Austria. Nikolaus is a partner and co-founder of KRONOS & Partner Family Office GmbH.

Mr. Sal Rabbani serves as Partner at Ciel Capital. He served as Managing Partner, Advisory Services at Business Development Bank of Canada. He focuses on firm-wide governance, investment themes, and supporting portfolio companies' evolution into national champions. He brings over two decades of experience in professional services, entrepreneurship, and public leadership to CIEL's investment approach. Prior to CIEL, he spent his career in transaction advisory at a global professional services firm and as a senior development banker, advising over 1,000 Canadian businesses on growth, succession, and transformation. His work spanned multiple sectors with a deep focus on strengthening small and medium-sized enterprises across Canada. He is the Immediate Past Chair of the Board of Directors of the Empire Club of Canada, recognized as the first two-term President and Chair in the institution's 121-year history. He previously served on the Toronto District School Board and was awarded the King Charles III Coronation Medal in 2025 for his service to Canada. He holds a Bachelor of Business Administration from the Schulich School of Business at York University.

primary_company: The Private Office Of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan Bin Mohammed Al Nahayan
biography: Mr. Salem Salmeen serves as Chief Executive Officer & Chairman at The Private Office Of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan Bin Mohammed Al Nahayan.
Mr. Satitpong Sukvimol serves as Chairman of the Board at SCG Chemicals. He holds a BA in Mass Communication from Chiang Mai University.
Mr. Satitpong Sukvimol serves as Director General at The Crown Property Bureau.

primary_company: The Private Office Of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan Bin Mohammed Al Nahayan
biography: Mr. Sheikh Hamdan Al Nahayan is the Founder of The Private Office Of His Highness Sheikh Hamdan Bin Mohammed Al Nahayan. He is known for his active participation in national and social events, his keenness to preserve the heritage of the UAE, and his support for all events and heritage events. has a unique style that is based on providing a framework for transforming the idea into a great business, through all phases of establishment, growth and financing in an efficient and unconventional manner, while maintaining continuity in order to gain profit and achieve financial independence through the development of an emerging company that creates familiarity, positive impression on customers, suppliers and investors. He is keen to use the unique ideas and projects, which will move the wheel of development by entering into partnership with several leading international companies and attract these companies to the UAE. The efforts of him, through his special office, which includes a distinguished administrative staff that supervises all its work from management to design and development, as all employees in the office are highly qualified and experienced including the legal dept. and specialists in the field of investment, development, and strategic studies, are crowned with success in supporting diverse sectors, in various areas, such as support more than one company in the construction industry, several real estate companies, health care projects, more than three food manufacturing projects, advertising companies, international banks and investment companies, about three companies in the entertainment industry, services sector, and other sectors, such as retail, technology, manufacturing and energy. He has always been keen on his presence in events that are interested in entrepreneurship, in search of local and international talent. He has the passion and aspiration for pioneering work and facing difficulties. He continues to seek the promising entrepreneurial opportunities in the UAE market, where competition has increased in the presence of foreign investment companies.

Mr. Somchai Kanchanamanee serves as Board Member at The Crown Property Bureau. Mr. Kanchanamanee serves as Board Member & Member of the CSR Committee for Sustainable Development at Siam Cement Group. He holds a Bachelor's in Political Science from Chiang Mai University.
Mr. Thamnithi Wanichthanom serves as Senior Deputy Director & Board Member at The Crown Property Bureau.

Mr. Allan Serrano serves as Attorney & Executive, Personal Injury Practice Group at Gordon Feinblatt. He received his Bachelor of Arts from Duke University and his Juris Doctorate from Washington University in St. Louis School of Law. While in law school, Allan was a member of the Civil Justice Clinic and served as President of the Latino American Law Student Association. Allan also served as an Associate Editor for the Washington University Journal of Law and Policy. Allan works with both personal injury cases and worker's compensation cases. He enjoys his role as an advocate and litigator who ensures that clients are fairly compensated for damages, pain, suffering, and losses that result from traumatic accidents caused by the negligence of others. Allan focuses his practice on clients who have suffered losses in Virginia, including Fairfax County, Arlington, Prince William, Loudoun, and the City of Alexandria. Prior to law school, Allan worked for three years as a compliance specialist advising international companies on compliance with regulations from the FDA, USDA, and other government agencies.

Mr. David Heems serves as Partner & Advocaat at Houthoff. He has a broad dispute resolution practice with a focus on commercial, finance, and insolvency litigation, including proceedings about directors' liability and annual accounts proceedings. He is regularly involved in cross-border restructurings, such as the litigation concerning Dümmen Orange, Steinhoff, Royal IHC, Oi, and OSX.

primary_position: Partner & Chairman of the Financial Services Division
biography: Mr. David Hunt serves as Partner & Chairman of the Financial Services Division at DAC Beachcroft. He served as Board Member at Global Risk Partners. He joined the firm in 1965 and became a partner in 1969. He specializes in regulation and spent much of 2009 conducting an independent review of legal services regulation on behalf of the Law Society of England and Wales. He was also instructed by the Commerce and Industry Department of the States of Guernsey to review both insurance and banking on the island. In 2008 he completed a successful independent review of the Financial Ombudsman Service. In recent years he also led the legal teams on the ABI's Raising Standards Initiative, the establishment of the PPIAB, the creation of AIFA, and the setting up of the Pensions Advisers Support system. He was awarded the MBE in 1973 and elected Member of Parliament for Wirral from 1976-83 and then Wirral West 1983-97. He has been a member of the Privy Council since 1990. From 1979-95 he was a member of the UK government, including Cabinet posts as Secretary of State for Wales, Secretary of State for Employment and Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster. He was Treasurer of the Queen's Household from 1987-89. He stepped down from the Cabinet after five years in July 1995 to become a senior partner.

Mr. David Wales served as Partner at Jones Day. He is the practice leader for Jones Day's worldwide Antitrust & Competition Law Practice and has extensive antitrust experience in both the private and public sectors. He represents foreign and domestic clients in a wide range of industries on all aspects of antitrust, including mergers and acquisitions, criminal grand jury investigations, dominant firm conduct, distribution arrangements, licensing, and competitor collaborations. Dave has the unique experience of serving as a senior official in both U.S. antitrust agencies. He spent three years at the Federal Trade Commission and, from 2008 to 2009, oversaw all of the agency's antitrust enforcement as acting director of the Bureau of Competition. Dave was involved with many industries at the FTC, including pharmaceuticals, health care, energy, chemicals, defense, retail, consumer products, and high-technology. Major matters handled during his tenure included Whole Foods' acquisition of Wild Oats, CCC's acquisition of Mitchell, lawsuits against Cephalon and Solvay Pharmaceuticals for exclusion payment agreements, and Inova's acquisition of Prince William Hospital.

Mr. John Guarin serves as Managing Director at DLA Piper. He advises these companies on setting up international holding company structures; IP migration; regional operation headquarters; offshore procurement centers; nearshoring; legal entity elimination projects (liquidations, mergers, strike-offs); and/or review and realignment of supply chain structures.

primary_position: Partner & Head of Litigation & Senior Counsel
biography: Mr. Kenneth Fraser served as Partner & Head of Litigation & Senior Counsel at Dentons Hamilton Harrison & Matthews. Mr. Fraser specializes in commercial litigation, particularly banking and insurance in the High Court, Court of Appeal, and Supreme Court. He holds Degree from Prince of Wales School in Nairobi.

Ms. Leen Al-Alam serves as Partner, Associate Corporate & Attorney at Duane Morris. She advises private equity and corporate clients in a variety of transactions, both domestic and cross-border, including mergers and acquisitions, divestitures, and joint ventures, as well as in general corporate governance matters. Her clients span a wide range of industries, including technology, chemicals, mining, healthcare, and life sciences. Prior to becoming an attorney, Ms. Al-Alami served as a communications analyst and strategist in the Office of King Abdullah II of Jordan. She also served as a project manager for government communications in the Executive Council of the Government of Dubai, as well as a press and information officer for the European Union Delegation to Jordan. In these capacities, Ms. Al-Alami devised and helped execute communications strategies in connection with foreign visits and milestones, oversaw press-related matters, and advised on crisis response strategies and issues involving policy and political landscape. Ms. Al-Alami is a 2013 graduate of the University of Pennsylvania Carey Law School, where she was associate editor of the Journal of Business Law. She holds a B.A., cum laude, and an M.A., both from Harvard University. She is a native speaker of English and Arabic and is fluent in French and conversational in Hebrew.

Ms. Magdalena Wielgosz served as a Junior associate at KWKR. She has drafted submissions in litigation concerning real properties, business cases (cases for damages for unpaid dividend, cases for revocation of a resolution of the general meeting, claims for damages against a brokerage house offering bonds, claims of a company's creditor vis-a-vis the management board under Article 299 of the Polish Code of Commercial Companies and Partnerships), labor law (employee claims for unpaid remuneration), inheritance law, cases concerning violations of personality rights, and in administrative proceedings concerning real properties drafted and submitted reports on concentration of enterprises to the President of the Polish Office of --Competition and Consumer Protection taken part in due diligence reviews concerning real property law, labor law, civil law, and administrative law taken part in a due diligence review of a large international holding company that concerned personal data protection developed, as part of day-to-day advisory to the Law Firm's clients, procedures in terms of monitoring the financial liquidity of enterprises, drafted legal opinions in terms of labor law (limiting the employer's costs of employment during the COVID-19 pandemic) and insurance law (application of the Polish Law on Insurance Distribution to a courier company offering parcel insurance), as well as contracts, terms and conditions of provision of electronic services, teleworking regulations, and legal information concerning CHF loans drafted, at the Students Legal Advice Bureau, a legal opinion with respect to the obligations of an enterprise operating in the form of an online intermediation platform, considering the provisions of the Polish Law on the Provision of Electronic Services, international jurisdiction, and the governing law, and an opinion concerning the cancellation of co-ownership of real property, as well as submissions in court and enforcement cases Professional qualifications and licenses
Mr. Michael Stevens served as a Consultant at Cripps.
Mr. Michael Stevens serves as Partner at Alston & Bird. He has extensive experience with compensation issues in M&A and other corporate transactions.

Mr. Michael Stevens serves as a Partner at ArentFox Schiff. He has experience in a variety of industries, including technology, real estate, health care, professional services, education, publishing, television, communications, nonprofit organizations, government contracts, automobile, hospitality and leisure, sports and entertainment, food products, fashion and retail, parking, building services, and manufacturing. He represents clients in both the private and public sectors.

Mr. Samer Sarkis serves as Partner at Eversheds Sutherland. He served as Senior Associate at Eversheds International. Samer advises on employment, real estate, and corporate and commercial matters with particular emphasis on mergers and acquisitions, joint ventures, restructuring, company incorporation, funds, IPOs, and listings. He also has significant experience advising banks and financial institutions on their corporate and security documents as well as industrial and manufacturing companies on their licensing and incorporation process. Samer previously advised: Barwa Bank on its proposed IPO and listing; Barwa Bank on its simultaneous acquisition of the First Finance Company (listed company), The First Investor and First Leasing Company; Qatar Investment Authority on their US$ 1bn joint venture with NYSE Euronext in respect of Qatar Exchange and its restructuring; Al Khalij Commercial Bank on the merger with International Bank of Qatar; and the existing shareholders of Bawabat Al Shamal Real Estate, including Qatar Islamic Bank and Aqar Real Estate Investment, on a joint venture with Al Futtaim to construct a US$1.6bn state-of-the-art entertainment and retail complex in Qatar.

Mr. Chris Carsley serves as Managing Partner, and Chief Investment Officer, at Kirkland Capital Group. He is the Founding Member & serves as Managing Partner at Arch River Capital. He serves as a Partner at Liquid River Capital. He co-leads the finance structuring and heads the capital partnership strategies of the Fund including regulatory and reporting compliance practices with the various outside advisors of the Fund. Previously, he was Managing Director of Bluewater Global Ltd., an international holding company. He brings over 25 years of experience in business operations efficiency, enterprise valuation and due diligence practices, corporate and venture finance, regulatory compliance, portfolio management, arbitrage trading, and hedging. Before co-founding ARC, He was an active execution trader for futures, options, and OTC-based trades at Paloma Securities (2000-2008). He was also a senior hedge fund security and finance team member, assisting in trade strategies, margin treatment, and short coverage transactions. He earned his Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA) designation in 1998, Chartered Alternative Investment Analyst in 2011, and holds a BBA from the University of Portland.

Mr. James Donnelly served as Underwriter, Risk at Herio Capital. James was responsible for underwriting, credit analysis, due diligence, and structuring loan offers via Herio Insight. James also assisted in managing the firm's offshore development team. Before coming to Herio, James worked as an Underwriting Support Specialist at IHC Risk Solutions, an insurance company. He has a Bachelor's of Business Administration degree in Business Economics from Loyola University.

primary_position: Chairman of the Board of Directors, Board Engagement Committee, Board Engagement Committee, and Audit & Risk Committee
biography: Mr. Michael Peat served as Chairman of the Board of Directors, Board Engagement Committee, Board Engagement Committee, and Audit & Risk Committee at CQS (UK). Senior non-executive director of Evraz plc, non-executive chairman of GEMS Education, and non-executive director of Arbuthnot Latham & Co Ltd. He previously held various senior positions in the Royal Household, including Keeper of the Privy Purse and Treasurer to The Queen, Receiver General of The Duchy of Lancaster, Principal Private Secretary to The Prince of Wales and Duchess of Cornwall, and Chairman of The Prince's Charities Foundation. He joined the Royal Household in 1993 after initially working on secondment from KPMG, where he had conducted a consultancy study on the management and finances of the Royal Household in 1986-87. He retired from the Royal Household in 2011. Earlier in his career, he became a partner at KPMG in 1985. He studied law at Trinity College, Oxford, where he is now an Honorary Fellow. He also qualified as a Chartered Accountant with Peat, Marwick, Mitchell's London office and attended business school at INSEAD in France. He received the 2018 Outstanding Achievement Award from the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales. He holds a degree in Law from Trinity College, as well as an MA and an MBA.

Mr. Richard Steer serves as Chairman at Gleeds. Richard worked in Oman and Egypt before returning to the UK to set up Gleeds' overseas operations in the Far East, America and Europe. His growth strategy has seen both new offices and new markets for Gleeds, with a focus on providing services for all stages of the property lifecycle. Maintaining close contact with clients in new regions or those facing unique challenges, Richard strongly believes that as an independent business, Gleeds is able to provide clients with the best quality advice.
Richard is passionate about design, education and the environment and under his direction, Gleeds works closely with third party organizations such as the RIBA, RICS and CIOB, as well as local and national governments to help drive change in the construction industry. Richard has hosted events with senior key figures such as HRH Prince of Wales, Frank Gehry, Lord Richard Rogers, Lord Norman Foster, Kevin McCloud and Boris Johnson.

primary_position: Member of Supervisory Board & Chairman of the Risk Committee
biography: Mr. Stefan Orlowski served as Member of the Supervisory Board & Chairman of the Risk Committee at LeasePlan. He has over 20 years' experience in global and local brand and portfolio management, as well as commercial fields such as sales and distribution. After beginning his career as an attorney in Australia with Arthur Robinson & Hedderwicks, Mr Orlowski has spent the majority of his career with various affiliates of Heineken N.V., including as regional president of the Americas in New York City and a member of the executive committee until 2015. In 2015, he moved to a European role with Heineken and currently is based in London, England. Mr Orlowski currently serves as a member of the Supervisory Board of Żywiec S.A (a Polish brewer controlled by Heineken), where he was previously employed as a vice-president, and as a member of the Supervisory Board of Brauw Holding International GmbH & Co KgaA. Previous board positions include roles as Vice-Chairman of Compañía Cervecería Costa Rica, Director of Compañía Cervecería de Colombia, and Chairman of the Marketplace Committee for Business in the Community, a charity under the patronage of the Prince of Wales.

primary_position: Advisor, RiverRock Italian Hybrid Capital Fund
biography: Mr. Ugo Fiaccadori serves as Advisor, RiverRock Italian Hybrid Capital Fund at RiverRock European Capital Partners. He has 15 years' experience in strategic consulting, most of which with Bain Italy as Associate Partner, member of the Private Equity WW practice and responsible for the boating industry. As a strategic consultant, he has extensively assisted PE firms both in the acquisition phase carrying out over 70 business due diligences in several different industries, and in the post-acquisition phase; furthermore for Italian SME's clients he has performed strategic plans, portfolio management and organization deployments, performance improvements, business plans and project/programme management projects. Furthermore, he has 10 years' management experience in SME's such as FIAR, Santavaleria, Bertram Yacht as Executive VP and Board Member, Selle Royal Group as General Manager. He received a MBA from SDA Bocconi, a MSc in Aerospace Engineering from Politecnico di Milano. He is a Licensed Engineer in Italy and FSA registered in UK.

primary_position: Chief Operating Officer & Board of Director
biography: Mr. Georg Pfister served as Chief Operating Officer & Board of Director at Kieger. He is responsible for Operations which includes Fund Administration, Data Management and IT & Security, has 16 years experience in the financial industry. After working for Winterthur-Versicherungen and Credit Suisse Private Banking (Management Accounting), he moved to LGT Group where he held the positions of Funds Services Team Leader and Deputy General Manager of the LGT fund companies. Georg Pfister is a Swiss certified Expert for Accounting and Controlling (Swiss federal diploma) as well as a Swiss certified Specialist for Fiduciary Business (Swiss federal certificate).

Mr. James Berkeley is the Founder and serves as Managing Director at Ellice Consulting Group. Mr. Berkeley is a consultant, coach, and speaker, who helps executives and organizations dramatically improve their operating performance in high-growth markets. He has helped organizations such as Travelers, AON, Jiangtai Insurance Brokers, Now Health, CKE Restaurants, Hilton Worldwide, Carlson, Ericsson AB, Caesars Entertainment Corporation, ConAgra Foods, ASIMCO Technologies, Zabeel Investments and more than 30 other leading organizations profitably grow and expand.
Mr. Michael Stevens serves as Chief Executive Officer at Reizmann.

Ms. Roberta Cleary serves as Marketing Director at Fort Dearborn Partners. She has over 30 years of business and sales experience. She was in the packaging field in outside sales for the duration of her career and grew her account base from zero to over $2 million in revenue. She was awarded "Woman of the Year" by Women in Management and "All-Around Sales Person of the Year" from The Royal Group, a corrugated box manufacturer. Roberta received her B.S. with Honors from DePaul University. She currently sits on the President's Club Advisory Council at DePaul University.

Mr. Ryan Gramm served as Vice President, Business Development at SolomonEdwardsGroup. Previously, he served as Director, Business Development at Riveron Consulting. Previously, he served as a Business Development Manager at Advaion. He s responsible for practice development and relationship management at Riveron. With almost 20 years of experience, he brings depth of expertise in project and asset management in accounting and technology. Ryan's solution oriented practice pairs seamlessly with the team of intelligent people at Riveron to help serve a diverse base of growing clients. He has performed numerous engagements assisting clients preparing for Merger & Acquisition activity or an IPO, as well as, restructuring and implementing growth strategies for companies experiencing hyper-growth. His industry experience includes technology, manufacturing, retail and financial services. Ryan earned a Bachelor of Business Administration degree, with a concentration in Marketing, from James Madison University's College of Business. Prior to joining Riveron, he was a Business Development Director at Advaion. He has also served as a Managing Director for SNI Companies and Business Development Manager for Experis.

Ms. Saadia Slaoui-Bennani serves as Chief Executive Officer & President at Valyans Consulting. A graduate of ESSEC, she joined Valyans Consulting more than 19 years ago as a consultant. After many years of experience in the consulting profession, she was appointed Associate Director in 2006 and then Deputy Managing Director in 2012. She has held the position of President and CEO of the firm since January 2018. She has led several missions, particularly in the field of strategy. She has thus participated in the development of strategic plans for large national companies. She has also contributed to the definition of sectoral strategies on behalf of the Public Sector (Tourism, Construction, IMM, National Education, etc.). She has also worked on the development strategies of large companies and their operationalization, particularly on an African scale, which has given her a detailed knowledge of the challenges of the continent. She was appointed in 2019 by His Majesty King Mohammed VI as a member of the Special Commission on the Development Model (CSMD). In addition to her professional responsibilities, She is Vice-President of the CGEM and President of the "Responsible and Citizen Enterprises" Commission. As part of her commitment, she is also President of the Al Ikram Association, a recognized public utility association working in the field of education and professional integration.

Mr. Seddik Fihri serves as Managing Director & Partner at Boston Consulting Group. He is based in Casablanca, where he supports many major private equity firms, principal investors, multinationals, and pan-African companies. Before joining BCG in 2011, Mr. Fihri held different positions within the Kuwait Investment Authority, the Moroccan conglomerate ONA-SNI (now Al Mada), and PwC.

Ms. Valerie Perlowitz served as Partner, Chief Strategy, and Business Development Officer at Cyber Capital Partners. She brings more than thirty years of expertise in the oversight, development, and management of public and private companies including start-ups, turn-arounds, growth, maturity, and exiting. She brings both technical and management experiences to bear with degrees in Electrical, Computer, and Cybersecurity, and an MBA from Harvard University. She has been the CEO/Founding Partner of International Holding Company, a management consulting firm, Senior Vice President and Director, ATS Corporation, an Information technology company, Chairman, CEO, and President of Reliable Integration Services, a cybersecurity and information technology company. Prior experience was as a technologist for various companies including AT&T, IBM, Sikorsky Aircraft, and the MITRE Corporation. She holds her M.S. in Engineering, Cybersecurity, Policy and Compliance from George Washington University, B.S. in Electrical and Computer Engineering from Northeastern University where she is a member of the Corporation and is an alumnus of the Harvard Business School (EMBA/OPM).
Mr. Andrew Sullivan serves as Executive at Royal Group Funds.

Mr. Christoph Bachmann serves as Client Director, Private Equity at Schroders Capital. Before joining Adveq in early 2012, he worked as an advisor for Key Client Solutions and as a relationship manager at Clariden Leu. From 2007 to 2010, he was a relationship manager at LGT Bank, responsible mainly for Swiss private banking clients. Before that, he worked in the Strategic Business Development department at SIX Swiss Exchange. He holds an Executive MBA from the University of St. Gallen (HSG), Switzerland.

Mr. Hamad Al Humaidi serves as the Chief Executive Officer Consultant, Investments at National Investments Company. He graduated in 1999 with a BBA in Finance from Seattle University, Washington, USA. He has started his career as a Financial Analyst in the Research Department at NIC. On the other hand, he has served in several key positions and has been involved in many key decision-making activities. He has played a leading role in developing many of NIC's investment products, including Investment portfolios, establishing & managing investment funds, which are Al Wataniya, Al Safwa, Al Darij, Zajil, Mawarid, and Al Mada fund. Previously, he was a board member of First Education Company (2009-2012) and Boubyan International Holding Company (2004-2016), Gulf Investment House (2011-2014), and First Investment Company (2014-2018)

Ms. Jill May serves as Non-executive Director at JPMorgan Claverhouse Investment Trust. She is a Council Member atthe Duchy of Lancaster. She also served as a Board Member at Alpha FMC and Ruffer. She has had 24 years of experience in investment banking, 13 years in mergers and acquisitions with SG Warburg, and 11 years as a Managing Director at UBS, where Ms. May was responsible for Cross Business Strategy. She is a Panel Member of the Competition and Markets Authority and a non-executive Director of the Institute of Chartered Accountants (ICAEW).

Mr. Dave Worthington serves as Managing Director & Board Member at Verco Advisory Services. Dave is a leading advisor on organisational carbon management, building integrated renewables, energy services and sustainable building design providing input to low carbon building policy development via work for DECC and the Zero Carbon Hub. He is also involved in the manufacturing and industrial sectors advising multi-national clients on energy services and FM procurement as well as supply chain carbon reduction. Dave is on the Institute of Mechanical Engineers' Renewable Power Committee, the UK-GBC's Policy Committee, the Zero Carbon Hub's Energy Working Group, and is a regular speaker on the CRC, zero carbon buildings, and energy efficiency in non-domestic buildings. Recent projects include; working with British Land since early 2009 on the management of their CRC liabilities as well as a district energy study for Broadgate Estates; the provision of strategy advice on energy and climate change to Crest Nicholson and the Duchy of Cornwall; the assessment of low carbon potential in the public sector in England for DECC, the development of a Low Carbon Workplace standard for the Carbon Trust; and technical and financial businesses planning for various renewable energy projects. He has also worked on a number of projects for clients in China and South East Asia including the Jinshan One Planet Community, a zero carbon 5,000+ mixed-use project near Guangzhou in southern China.

Mr. Eric Keen serves as Chairman at HDR. Mr. Eric became CEO in 2017 after previously serving as president and chief operating officer and engineering company president. As CEO, he led the company through eight acquisitions and oversaw continuous revenue growth and the addition of more than 2,600 employees. A civil engineer by training, Eric has spent his career helping develop and deliver some of the United States' most notable transportation infrastructure projects, including the Whittier Access project in Prince William Sound, Alaska; the Legacy Parkway project in Salt Lake City, Utah; the Arthur Ravenel Jr. Bridge in Charleston, South Carolina; and the world-renowned Hoover Dam Bypass. Eric joined us in 1993 in our Alaska office, where he became involved with major public-private and design-build projects and developed a passion for the use of alternative contracting methods. He was instrumental in establishing the firm's transportation alternative delivery practice, which has since been involved in many high-profile projects such as the Oregon Bridge Delivery Program and the I-69 P3 Project in Indiana. In 2004, Eric was named the transportation business group director. Under his leadership, the transportation practice grew its planning, program management, design-build and management consulting services to complement an already strong design practice. A graduate of the University of Iowa, Eric is active in many professional and civic groups. In 2012, he led the creation of the HDR Foundation, an employee-funded and administered charitable giving organization that benefits the communities where the firm's employees live and work by supporting activities that align with the company's values and areas of expertise.

primary_position: Founder, Director, Fund Manager, Chief Executive Officer
biography: Mr. Thomas Hugger is the Founder & serves as Director, Fund Manager, Chief Executive Officer at Asia Frontier Capital. Mr. Hugger has spent 27 years in private banking where he specialized in managing portfolios of listed and unlisted equities. He has been investing in Asian and African Frontier Markets since 1993. He is the former Managing Partner, CFO & COO of Leopard Capital; and was previously a Managing Director and Head of Portfolio Management at LGT Bank in Hong Kong. He also held senior investment positions at Bank Julius Baer in Zurich and Hong Kong. Mr. Hugger was the founding shareholder of one of the largest brokerage companies in Bangladesh. He is also a Certified Financial Investment Analyst (CFIA) and Investment Adviser (Switzerland) and a Certified European Federation of Financial Analysts Societies (EFFAS) Financial Analyst.

Mr. Abdulmajeed Alhaqbani serves as a Board Member at Kingdom Holding Company. He graduated from King Fahd University of Petroleum and Minerals with Bachelor degree in Finance in 2004, in addition to several specialized courses in accounting, credit and financial analysis, risk analysis and asset management. During his career he managed the Assets in the local investment port- folio for the Public Investment Fund in 2018, as well as numerous leading positions in banks, private sector of local and international origins, including Vice Chairman of Qassim Cement Co. between 2019 and 2020. He held several positions at HSBC Saudi Arabia, including: General Manager for Asset Management Dept. between 2016 and 2018, and Head of Investment at the Asset Dept. between 2016 and 2017, Head of the Procurement Research between 2014 and 2016, Senior Research Analyst between 2012 and 2014, and Director of Equity Research between 2008 and 2012. He also worked as a Senior Credit Analyst at the Saudi Industrial Development Fund between 2005 and 2008.

primary_position: Executive Director, International and Private Equity
biography: Dr. Adel Al Sayed served as Executive Director, International and Private Equity at Kingdom Holding Company. He has more than 25 years of experience in financial advisory, asset management and private equity investments. His last position was the CEO of United Gulf Investment Corporation (UGIC) a Bahrain-listed Company focused on promoting and investing in industrial projects in the Gulf region. He previously worked for Kuwait-based Gulf Investment Corporation (GIC), which is one of the largest and oldest private equity players in the region owned by the GCC countries, where he was responsible for all business development activities in the six GCC countries, and he played a key role in managing and exiting all of GIC's direct investments in Saudi Arabia.

primary_position: Executive Director, Finance and Administration & Board Member
biography: Mr. Adel Alabdulsalam serves as Executive Director, Finance and Administration & Board Member at Kingdom Holding Company. He is a multidiscipline professional with vast experience in Finance, corporate governance, information systems, strategy, and business development, and has a track record of accomplishments over his 20 years of working experience in local and international conglomerates. He holds a bachelor's degree in accounting and a Master's in Business Administration with honors.

Mr. Ahmed Al Dehaim served as Director at Chimera Investments. Mr. Al Dehaim has a wealth of experience working in the public and private sectors, having previously worked in portfolios including private equity and real estate investments. His professional career is composed of working in the Crown Prince's Court and at Royal Group. Mr. Al Dehaim is also currently a Board Member in Nshama. He holds an MSc in Economics and Public Policy from University College London and an MSc in Economics and International Relations from SOAS University of London.

Mr. Ahmed Halawany serves as Board Member at SIGMA Capital Holding. Mr. Halawany is the Executive Director for Private Equity at Kingdom Holding, one of the largest private investment companies in the world. Prior to his current position, he has served as Executive Director for Al-Azizia Commercial Investments, one of Kingdom Holdings' companies. His previous work experiences include the World Bank as well as Procter and Gamble. Halawany is an alumnus of the McDonough School of Business at Georgetown University.
Mr. Al Waheed serves as the Chief Executive Officer at Kingdom Holding Company.

Mr. Alan Milburn served as Chairman of the Advisory Board Member at Bridgepoint Advisers. He was a member of the UK Parliament for the Labour Party from 1992 to 2010. He served for five years in the Cabinet, firstly as Chief Secretary to the Treasury from 1998 to 1999 and subsequently as Secretary of State for Health from 1999 to 2003. He was also Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster from 2004 to 2005. He is the Chair of the UK Government's Social Mobility and Child Poverty Commission. He serves as a Board advisor to Mars Incorporated and chairs PwC's UK Health Industries Oversight board. He is Chancellor of Lancaster University. He sits on the board of Bridgepoint portfolio company Diaverum AB and is a Board member of Apos Therapy.

Mr. Alexander Kempe is the Founder and serves as a President at 37celsius Capital Partners. He is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer, President & Manager at Novir. He also served as Advisory Board Member at VasoGnosis. He spent eighteen years working for GE, the last fourteen years of which were with GE Healthcare (GEHC) in a number of Strategic, Operational, and Financial leadership positions in the U.S. and Europe. He is the former Director of Strategic Alliances & VP of Home Health at GEHC and, during 2010-2014, drove the development of a new segment (Home Health) through the creation of a Joint Venture between GEHC and Intel Health (Care Innovations $250 million). Additionally, he managed GEHC's investment portfolio (20 companies / $500 million) and created the office of External Funding, securing a contract with Qatar Foundation in 2013. Based on his extensive industry relationships and strong strategic and operational expertise, Mr. Kempe will focus on deal sourcing for 37celsius and business expansion and integration of its portfolio companies. He served as Board Member and Member Advisory Board at Genia.

primary_position: Founder & Chairman of the Board of Directors
biography: Mr. Alwaleed al Saud is the Founder and serves as Chairman of the Board of Directors at Kingdom Holding Company. He serves as Chairman at Rotana Holding. He earned BS degree in Business Administration from Menlo College in 1979 and Master's in Social Sciences from Syracuse University in 1985.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer, President and Shareholder
biography: Mr. Bassim Hokimi is a Co-Founder & Shareholder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and President at Atlamed. He also serves as Board Member at Sofrenor. He is a graduate of Ecole Polytechnique Paris, Telecom Paris and Stanford University. A graduate of École Polytechnique Paris, Télécom Paris and Stanford University, he has more than 35 years of experience in operations, consulting and finance. Bassim Jaï Hokimi is a director of various large companies (AL MADA, MANAGEM, SMI, WANA CORP-INWI), former director of Bank-Al-Maghrib and former Chairman of the SNI/ONA group (AL MADA).

Mr. Cees J. de Bruin served as Operating Partner at Charterhouse Equity Partners. Mr. Cees de Bruin is the Founder of Indofin Group. He is a graduate from the Erasmus University of Rotterdam, as well as a chartered accountant. He started his career at IHC Holland, an engineering and construction company for the dredging and offshore industry. Subsequently he joined Heerema, an offshore construction company.

Mr. Christopher Howes served as Board Member at Marcol Group. Mr. Howes previously served as an advisor to Three Delta. He was formerly Chief Executive of the Crown Estate for the UK, an appointment made by the Queen. He is currently an advisor to Barclays Capital, a member of the Advisory Board of Barclays Private Bank, Director of the Howard de Walden Estate and a member of HRH The Prince of Wales Council. A fellow of the Royal Institution of Chartered Surveyors and an honorary fellow of the Royal Institute of British Architects, Sir Christopher has many other business, academic and charitable interests. He remained Non-Executive Director of Compco when it was de-listed by Marcol in 2003.

Ms. Deanna Zhang serves as Investment Director at Circularity Capital. She served as Vice President at L-GAM Advisers. Prior to joining L-GAM, she was an Investment Manager with LGT Impact Ventures, the growth capital and social finance arm of LGT Group, where she managed and executed investments in Latin America. Before that, she was a management consultant at the Boston Consulting Group, working across the firm's Southeast Asia, Munich, and Dubai offices in the automotive, consumer, telecommunications, energy, healthcare, and public sectors. She holds an MBA from the Wharton School of Business, an MPA/ID from Harvard University, and a dual BA degree in Human Biology and International Relations from Stanford University in the United States.

primary_position: Partner, Managing Director & Co-Head of Southeast Asia
biography: Mr. Dominic Picone serves as Partner & Co-Head of Southeast Asia at TPG Capital. Mr. Picone serves as a Board Member & Member of the Risk Committee, the Nominating Committee, and the Remuneration Committee at Singapore Life. Mr. Picone served as Board Member at PropertyGuru. Mr. Picone serves a Commissioner at PT BFI Finance Indonesia. He serves as a Partner, Managing Director & Co-Head of Southeast Asia at TPG, based in Singapore. Dominic has lived and worked in Asia since joining the firm in 2005 and his involvement with current and past TPG portfolio companies includes XCL Education, Apollo Towers, Grand Royal Group, 8990 (Deca Homes), BFI Finance, and Bank BTPN. n in Melbourne. He holds a Bachelor of Commerce (Honours) and a Bachelor of Laws from the University of Melbourne.

Mr. Driss Bennani serves as Deputy Director at Fipar Holding. Since March 2020, he has been Senior Investment Director at CDG Invest in charge of the Fipar-Holding fund. In this capacity, he holds director positions and is a member of strategic and audit committees in several portfolio companies. He has nearly 25 years of professional experience in finance, investment and development. After a 6-year career in audit and corporate finance at PWC and 2 years in Private Equity at the Attijariwafa Bank Group, he held financial and development management positions in multi-business group holding companies (Somed and Al Mada) from 2006 to 2011. He then joined a private Moroccan group operating in the microfinance and financial services sectors, where he held various general management positions and governance bodies for 8 years. He is a graduate of Paris Dauphine University and holds the French chartered accountant diploma.

primary_position: Founding Principal, Co-Chief Executive Officer & Managing Partner
biography: Mr. Egon Durban is a Founding Principal & serves as Co-Chief Executive Officer & Managing Partner at Silver Lake. Mr. Durban serves as Board Member at Verily Life Sciences and Dell Technologies. He serves as Board Member at Qualtrics. He joined Silver Lake in 1999 as a Founding Principal. He serves as Chairman of the Board of Directors of Endeavor Group Holdings. Mr. Durban served as Board Member at G42. He also served on the board of directors of City Football Group, Group 42, Motorola Solutions, Qualtrics, Unity Software, and Waymo. He currently serves on the Business Council and Business Roundtable. Before Silver Lake, he worked in Morgan Stanley's Investment Banking Division. Previously, he served on the board of MultiPlan, Pivotal Software, SecureWorks, Twitter, UFC, VMware, and Skype, where he was Chairman of the operating committee, and served on the supervisory board and operating committee of NXP. He graduated from Georgetown University with a B.S.B.A. in Finance.

Mr. Evangelos Papadopoulos serves as a Board Member and Member of the Nomination, Remuneration, and Executive Committee at Oman International Development and Investment Company. Evangelos. He is currently the Head of Investments at AlManar Financial Investments SPC and has more than 10 years of experience in management consulting and finance. Since 2019, he has been working as an investment professional responsible for establishing, implementing, and managing investment strategies in line with investment committee visions regarding asset allocation, risk thresholds, and expected returns. Following his tenure at Royal Group LLC as an investment manager, he joined the Omani investment firm AlManar Financial Investments SPC as Head of Investments. In his current role, he is responsible for all investments that are a combination of traditional asset classes and alternatives. He holds a Bachelor's Degree in Economics and a Master's Degree in Finance from the Athens University of Economics and Business. He also holds a Master's Degree in Business Administration from Cornell University.

Mr. Franz Schall currently serves as Investment Manager at Liechtenstein Group. Mr.Schall is responsible for analyzing and evaluating new investments, conducting due diligence processes, and preparing and developing business plans for companies and investments of the Liechtenstein Group. Previously, he worked for the pan-European investment broker Kepler Cheuvreux, the private bank M.M. Warburg & CO, as well as the consulting & auditing firm Deloitte. He holds a Master in Management (MSc) from the Vienna University of Economics and Business Administration.

Dr. Hans Haumer served as Senior Partner at LPC Capital Partners. He has years of experience in the financial sector and as CEO of three decades of financial institutions. Haumer Hans started his career at First Bank and as an economist at the IMF. From 1977 to 1989, he directed the first bank and then took over as CEO in the same position of the line Girozentrale to 1994. From 1980 to 1998, Dr. Haumer served as a director of LGT Bank in Liechtenstein, most recently as President. In 1997, he founded Capital Life, an innovative life insurance based in Liechtenstein, which he sold ten years later with success in Swiss Life. In 2006, he was a cornerstone investor in the first private equity fund of LPC, where he was a senior partner in 2009. Dr. Haumer has numerous Supervisory Board and member of the boards, including in the Financial Market Authority of Liechtenstein. He has published numerous articles and speeches and published five books on business, management and ethics. Hans Haumer studied in Vienna and Tübingen law, economics and social sciences.
Mr. Hassan Ouriagli serves as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman at Al Mada. He serves as a Board Member at Optorg.

Mr. Hisham Al Habib serves as Independent Board Member at Kingdom Holding Company. He is the Deputy Chairman of Business Development and Executive Board Member of Dr. Suleiman Al Habib Medical Group. He was the Director of Business Development at Dr. Sulaiman Al Habib Medical Group, a board member of Asala Holding Company, a member of the Health Committee, Riyadh Chamber of Commerce, a member of the National Committee of Hospitals, and a member of Tharwat Foundation as family businesses since 2009. He holds a bachelor's degree in finance in Business Administration, from the American University of Sharjah.

Mr. Injaz Al-Maghrib served as Executive at Al Mada. Al Mada is the strategic reference partner and founding member of the association Injaz Al-Maghrib. Founded in 2007, Injaz Al-Maghrib, a recognized public utility association, has set itself the mission of contributing to the emergence of a new generation of entrepreneurs. To this end, it involves voluntary corporate executives in public educational establishments, from college to university, to run training programs in entrepreneurship.
Mr. Jacobo Blanquer serves as an Executive at Arada Capital Partners. He serves as CEO at Tressis Gestion SGIIC.

Mr. James Holland formerly served as Partner at Trinity Hunt Partners. He has served as President and CEO of Unity Hunt and Hunt Capital Group since 1991 and is a Principal at Easton Hunt Capital Partners. Mr. Holland is currently a Director of two public companies as well as several private companies. Mr. Holland has served on over 80 Board of Directors during his career. Previously, Mr. Holland was chairman and CEO of Nedinco, a large diversified, international holding company involved in investments, computer software, technical consulting, retail and real estate management services. Prior to joining Nedinco, he was President and Director of KSA Industries, a private, diversified company involved in entertainment, health care, retail, energy and investment businesses. Mr. Holland began his career with Booz-Allen & Hamilton, Inc., a major management consulting firm, where he was a principal in the mergers and acquisitions practice. He received a B.S. in Chemical Engineering from Oklahoma State University with honors and an M.B.A from the Graduate School of Industrial Administration of Carnegie Mellon University with honors.

primary_position: Chairman of the Nominations Committee & Member of the Conflicts Committee, of the Remuneration Committee and of the Valuation Committee
biography: Mr. James Leigh-Pemberton serves as Chairman of the Nominations Committee & Member of the Conflicts Committee, of the Remuneration Committee, and of the Valuation Committee at RIT Capital Partners. He also serves as a Board Member at CAF Nominees. He also serves as Chairman of the Council at the Duchy of Lancaster. He joined UK Financial Investments (UKFI) in October 2013 as Chief Executive, and in January 201,4 he was appointed Executive Chairman. On 1 April 2016, he became the Non-Executive Chairman of UKFI. Following the merger of UKFI and UK Government Investments (UKGI), he became Deputy Chairman of UKGI. Before joining UKFI, he was Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Credit Suisse in the UK, based in London. In this role, he was responsible for developing the Bank's client relationships in Private Banking, Investment Banking, and Asset Management in the UK. He was also a member of the Credit Suisse Europe, Middle East & Africa (EMEA) Operating Committee. He joined Credit Suisse First Boston (CSFB) in 1994. Prior to joining CSFB, he was a Director of S.G. Warburg Securities, where he worked for 15 years. In the 2019 New Year Honours List, he received a knighthood for services to financial services, British industry, and government. He previously served as an independent non-executive Director of RIT from 2004 to 2013. He served as the Director of Shepherd Neame Limited until September 2016.

Mr. Jason Barnes serves as Board of Director at Chugach Alaska Corporation. He has served on the Chugach Board of Directors since 2024. He resides in Cordova and works for the Native Village of Eyak as a Non-Clinical Social Worker and serves as President/Director of Prince William Sound Living Inc.

Mr. Javier Puig serves as an Investor & Advisory Partner at Arada Capital Partners. He has 12 years experience in the generation and coordination of M&A transactions and in the technical analysis thereof; and in strategic consultancy. He holds an MBA from IESE.
Mr. Johannes Meran served as Partner at Motion Equity Partners.

Mr. Jon Nieman serves as Board Member at NewSpace Capital. He served as Head of Private Equity of the Investment Management Division at Saudi Aramco. Previously, he served as a Managing Director at Redline Partners LLC. He serves as Senior Vice President and Head of Investments at G42, where he leads corporate investments, mergers and acquisitions, business development, and strategic partnerships. With over 30 years of experience in private market investments across a range of industries and asset classes, he has a long-standing track record of building and managing high-value portfolios. Before joining G42, he held senior roles at prominent institutions including the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority, Saudi Aramco, and State Street. Across these positions, he was instrumental in establishing new investment categories and managing multi-billion dollar portfolios. He began exploring AI-powered private market investing in 2014, positioning himself at the forefront of innovation in the field. In 2025, he joined the Board of NewSpace Capital Partners as a non-executive member. He holds an MBA from the University of North Carolina's Kenan-Flagler Business School and a BBA in Finance from Eastern Michigan University.

Dr. Jorge Fernandez Vidal serves as Managing Director at Liechtenstein Group. He serves as a Board Member at PowerPollen and Acclym. He joined the Liechtenstein Group in 2021 and is the Managing Director of the Agriculture & Food portfolio. He is a member of the Boards of Directors of the portfolio companies Parelmo, Agritask, NTG/Green Universe Agriculture, N-Drip, PowerPollen, and Valle del Guadiana. He is also an Adjunct Professor of Strategy at IE Business School in Madrid. Prior to joining the Liechtenstein Group, he was Senior Vice President at McKinsey & Co., led the business transformation efforts of two multinationals, and worked as an investment professional at the European Investment Bank and LeapFrog Investments. He holds a Bachelor of Commerce from the University College of Cork, a Bachelor of Science in Applied Accounting from Oxford Brookes University, a Master's degree in Strategic Studies from the University of Santiago de Compostela, an MBA from INSEAD, and a PhD in Business Economics of the University of Alicante.
Mr. Juan Hornedo serves as Director of Investments at Sherpa Capital. He also serves as an Advisory Team Member at Arada Capital Partners.

Mr. K. B. Chandrasekar founded and served as Chief Executive Officer at Asiabridge Capital. Mr. Chandrasekar founded the firm in 2007. Previously, he served as a Senior Adviser, Asia Pacific at McKinsey & Company, Inc from 2006 to 2010. From 1999, he took over responsibility for Corporate Strategy and Development at HSBC Asia in which role he lead managed many acquisitions and strategic investments including China. In 1994, Mr. Chandrasekar was appointed Chief Operating Officer of Group Private Banking at HSBC's International Private Banking and Trust business and also served as Group Head of Asset and Liability Management covering over 70 countries. He joined HSBC Group in 1978, where he held many senior positions including Senior Manager Corporate Banking; Head of IT, India and Global Head of Asset and Liability Management based in Hong Kong and London. Prior to this, Mr. Chandrasekar served at Tata Group in India for a few years. He is a Member of the Board of Trustees of LGT Group. He is a Member of the Association of Corporate Treasurers, UK. Mr. Chandrasekar is a Member of the Asian Regional Advisory Board of Aviva plc. He is also a Member of the Association of Corporate Treasurers, United Kingdom. He received a Certificate in Managing Corporate Control and Planning from Harvard University. Mr. Chandrasekar received an M.B.A. from the University of Madras and B.Com. from Loyola College.

Dr. Khalid Abdullah Al-Souhem served as Deputy Chairman & Independent Board Member at Kingdom Holding Company. Dr. Khaled Al Souhem, is a member of the Company's Board of Directors. He was born in 1959. In 1996, he earned a Ph.D. in human resources administration from the University of Wales (Cardiff, UK). He also received a higher diploma in Social Sciences from the same university in 1993, as well as a degree in Communications from King Saud University, Saudi Arabia, in 1986.

primary_position: Independent Board Member Deputy Chairman of the Board of Directors
biography: Dr. Lama Al Sulaiman serves as Independent Board Member Deputy Chairman of the Board of Directors at Kingdom Holding Company. She is a Shareholder and a Board Member of Rolaco Holdings, KSA and LUX, and a board member of the committee for the development of Jabal Al Laith. Currently she is a member of Coutts Bank advisory board, UK, and before that she was a board member of Club Med, France, and a former board member of Foras Investment, Saudi Arabia. This year 2021, she joined the Saudi Tennis Federation as a board member and was a board member of Saudi General Entertainment Authority between 2016 and 2021. For the past 10 years, she has been actively involved in a wide range of non-profit organizations in KSA, where she led the Saudi delegation at ILO to represent the Employers group and participated in L20 and B20 in France, Mexico, Turkey, Australia, Germany, and Argentina. A member of the B20 Executive Committee hosted in Saudi Arabia, and now she is a member of the Employment and Education Task Force. She is an advisory board member of Effat University and was a member of the fundraising campaign board at King's College London. She was the vice-chair and a Board Member of the Jeddah Chamber of Commerce in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, and she was a board member of the Khadijah Bint Khuwailed Lobbying Center for Women. She holds a PhD in health and nutrition from King's College of London.

Mr. Lipin Unnikrishnan serves as Financial Director at Chimera Capital. He served as Director, Finance at Lunate. He is responsible for proprietary investments. Prior to Lunate, he was the Head of Finance at Chimera Capital. He is a Fellow Chartered Accountant and holds an Executive MBA from the Indian School of Management & Studies.

Mr. Lorenzo Dávila Domecq serves as an Advisory Team Member at Arada Capital Partners. He served as a partner at Candor Equity. He served as Director at Realza Capital. He joined Realza Capital in May 2010. He previously worked as an Investment Analyst of Thesan Capital, a Private Equity firm focused on special situations (restructurings & turnarounds) in Spain. Prior to that, he worked as an Analyst in Private Equity (currently Trilantic Capital Partners) and Leveraged Finance divisions of Lehman Brothers in London. He holds a double degree in Law (2005) and Business Administration (2006) from Universidad Pontificia Comillas (ICADE) in Madrid. He earlier served as a Board Member at Grupo Plénido, Quimi Romar, and Gestión Tributaria Territorial as well as a Board Observer with Quimi Romar.

Mr. Majed Odeh served as Director at Chimera Capital. As Group CFO of Royal Group, He oversees the company's financials and is responsible for its strategic and business financing activities. Prior to joining Royal Group, He worked with PricewaterhouseCoopers as a Director. He holds an MBA with a concentration in Accounting and Finance from Southwest Missouri State University in the US.

Ms. Maria Osyka serves as Director of Agriculture Investments, AgroProsperis at NCH Capital. She joined NCH in 2007. She is responsible for managing NCH's agribusiness portfolio and for identifying new investment opportunities in Ukraine. Prior to NCH, She was the Ukraine Country Manager for Monsanto Europe, the international agribusiness company. In this capacity, she led new market initiatives, company mergers, restructurings, financial reporting, and strategic planning for several business lines, while establishing long-term partnerships with Ukrainian agricultural authorities, including the Ministry of Agriculture. She has also worked with HELM AG and May Seed Group as a management consultant, leading their sales and marketing efforts. She received an MA in Economics from Central European University in Prague and an MBA from Goizueta Business School at Emory University.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Partner, Chairman of ESG Committee, Investment Committee Member, & Director of Management Company
biography: Mr. Mark Bezos is a Co-Founder and serves as Partner, Chairman of the ESG Committee, Investment Committee Member, & Director of Management Company at HighPost Capital. He serves as a Board Member at Robin Hood Foundation. He started his career at global redoubtable agencies such as DDB, Saatchi & Saatchi, and Lintas. In 1999, at the age of 29, he chose to start his marketing firm in the highly competitive arena of NYC - Bezos/Nathanson Marketing Group (BNmg). Despite the dot-com recession, under his leadership BNmg was able to compete for and win business, establishing itself as an award-winning marketing boutique. The agency focused on brands in consumer categories such as airlines (Swiss, Sabena), hotels (Ramada, Howard Johnsons, Travelodge), spirits (Johnnie Walker, Talisker, Cardhu), fashion retail (KemoSabe), and others. Mr. Bezos was able to successfully sell the agency to an international holding company in 2006. He serves as Board Member at Spotter.
Mr. Mehdi Guedira serves as Investment Manager at Al Mada.

Ms. Mirian Massoud serves as Head of Private Equity at Chimera Capital. She also served as a Non-Executive Board Member at Beltone Financial Holding. She also serves as Partner & Co-Head of Private Equity at Lunate. She is responsible for investing third-party capital across various private equity strategies globally. She has over 17 years of experience in private equity and investment management. Prior to Lunate, she held senior positions at Chimera Capital and Waha Capital. She holds an MBA from INSEAD and a Bachelor's degree in Economics from the American University of Beirut. She serves as Head of Private Equity and Board Member at ChimHaeres.

Mr. Mohamed Fahmy served as Chief Financial Officer at Kingdom Holding Company. He is highly accomplished with 18 years of progressive track record of achievements in leading initiatives that enhance financial performance and productivity. He began his career in Cairo in Corporate Banking in 1995 with Commercial International Bank. After receiving the Chase Manhattan Bank's Credit Training Program, he graduated as a Senior Credit Analyst where he worked for 2 years in the corporate banking department. In 1998, he moved on to work in Investment Banking for a combined period of 10 years working for major Egyptian / international institutions such as Flemings CIIC, EFG Hermes, and Doha Bank. In 2005 he became the Head of Investment Banking for Calyon in Egypt where he launched Calyon's investment banking operations and worked on various mergers and acquisitions of local/regional companies. Over his 10 years as an investment banker, he worked on various capital market and M&A transactions worth over US$4 billion. During this period he completed Calyon's formal investment banking training course. His career moves progressed further when he joined Palm Hills Developments as CFO where he assisted in negotiating the sale of a 10% stake in the company to Goldman Sachs resulting in a US$ 120 million deal and raising a total of LE 1.3 billion syndicated debt and equity financing for the company. He also was instrumental in the process of taking the company public raising US$320 million in equity and listing the company both on the Egyptian and London stock exchanges. Following Palm Hills, he joined as Group CFO for Hassan Allam Holding and Pioneers Holdings. Among his academic achievements, which included an MSc. in International Securities Investment & Banking from Reading University in England, he was awarded the Chevening scholarship offered by the British Council in Egypt to study towards a Master's degree in England as well as receiving a Fulbright Scholarship to complete the Program on Investment Appraisal and Management from Harvard University.

Mr. Mohammed Al Haj serves as Chief Executive Officer at Mubarak & Brothers Investments. Previously Mr. Al Haj served as the GM of the OBS Group. He is on the board of Ajman Holding, Universal Paints & Chemical Industries and Capital Club, and is also a member of the Service Council in Abu Dhabi Chamber of Commerce.

Mr. Moritz Assmann served as an Investment Associate at Liechtenstein Group. He joined the Liechtenstein Group in 2022. As part of the investment team, he is responsible for analyzing and evaluating new investments, conducting due diligence processes, and preparing and developing business plans for companies and investments of the Liechtenstein Group. Previously, he worked for APL Europe in Munich as well as for several years for Bank of America in Frankfurt. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration with a specialization in Finance & Accounting from the Vienna University of Economics and Business Administration.

primary_position: Executive Director for Domestic Investment & Board Member
biography: Mrs. Nada Alateegi serves as Executive Director for Domestic Investment & Board Member at Kingdom Holding Company. She is the Chief Executive Officer of Kingdom Investment and Development. Previously, she was the General Manager of Kingdom Centre and has ranked the Top 20 Saudi and Gulf Businesswomen.

Mr. Nasser Al Misnad serves as Board Member at Qatari Investors Group. He holds a Bachelor in Business Administration from University of La Verne, State of California, USA in year 2019. He currently holds the following positions; Board Member of Qatari Investors Group (Q.P.S.C.), representing Al Misnad Company LLC, Board Member of Vodafone Qatar, representing Vodafone and Qatar Foundation LLC. Additionally, he worked for three years at Barzan Holding in the field of strategic procurement.

Mr. Nicholas Hofgren served as Advisory Board Director at TLG Capital. Mr. Hofgren served as Advisor at Kingsley Capital Partners. Mr. Hofgren is a partner of Tangent Ventures, a business focused on creating value within the Tangent Group of Companies, which generates approximately $2 Bn each year through energy related manufacturing and service businesses. In 2008, Nick co-founded WHP, a private equity fund raising business with a focus on emerging strategies and emerging markets based in Dubai, London and New York. Nick was previously a Managing Director at Brunswick Capital where he helped the business form and capitalise the largest independent freight car leasing business in Russia. Nick joined Brunswick in 2004 having headed the EMEA Private Fund Group at JP Morgan Chase. He was responsible for founding and building the team that capitalised private equity funds worth billions of US dollars. Prior to JP Morgan Chase, Nick created a direct investment business in Russia focused on the roll-up of assets in Oil and Gas equipment and automobile parts. Nick sits on the board of Prince Street Capital Management, a leading hedge fund that invests in frontier markets and FOTW, a leading UK business in the streaming media sector. He is on the development committee of The Prince's Teaching Institute (PTI), an education charity founded by HRH The Prince of Wales.

primary_position: Managing Director, Commercial Real Estate Origination Europe
biography: Mr. Nico Weber serves as Managing Director, Commercial Real Estate Origination Europe at Lone Star Funds. Mr. Nico Weber served as Managing Director, Investment & Asset Management at Henderson Park Capital. He has 19 years of experience investing in and delivering real estate projects in both principal and advisory roles in the UK, Europe, Middle East and Australia. Between 2014 and 2016 he was at Valad Europe, a pan European investment and asset manager with c.€5 billion assets under management, managing all separate account opportunistic investments across the UK, continental Europe and the Nordics. Prior to Valad, he was a Director responsible for business development at Manhattan Loft Corporation, a leading central London hotel and residential investor and developer and a Development Manager for the Royal Group, a group of major real estate firms controlled by a member of the Abu Dhabi Royal family, responsible for new acquisitions and delivery of major commercial projects internationally. He started his career as an Account Manager at ANZ Bank, Sydney in the Real Estate and Construction Finance division. He holds a Bachelor of Property from the University of Auckland, New Zealand.

Mr. Omar Laalej serves as Managing Director at Al Mada. He serves as Managing Director at Al Mada Ventures. Previously, he served as Senior Manager at Africinvest. He joined AfricInvest with over seven years of international experience in the private equity sector. As an Analyst at Graham Partners, a leveraged buy-out firm focused on acquiring middle-market manufacturing businesses, he sourced and evaluated new investment opportunities and provided ongoing support and supervision for several of Graham Partners' portfolio companies. After two years at Graham, he joined VWR International (NASDAQ: VWR) - a former Madison Dearborn Partners portfolio company - which is a laboratory supplier and distributor with worldwide sales of over $4.3 billion in 2014. At VWR, he was an M&A Strategist managing all aspects of the acquisition process. In 2012, he moved to San Francisco for a Finance Manager position at Elo Touch Solutions, a Gores Group portfolio company that designs, develops, and manufactures touch products and technologies for the industrial, medical, retail, hospitality, transportation, and automotive sectors. After three years in Silicon Valley and a stint spent consulting another Gores Group portfolio company, the Tweddle Group, he joined AfricInvest as a Senior Investment Manager. He earned his B.A. with a double major in finance and accounting from Drexel University, where he was Captain of the Men's Varsity Tennis Team. He was born and raised in Morocco, where he was a member of the Moroccan Davis Cup Team.
Mr. Ouafaa GHAOUAT served as Manager at Al Mada.

Mr. Paul Adams served as Investment Manager Board Member at Oriens Capital. Paul Adams CNZM, is a civil engineer based in Tauranga and Managing Director of Carrus, one of the largest private land development companies in New Zealand. He is a founding director and life member of Priority One (a Tauranga business development entity), a trustee of Te Kura (NZ Correspondence School), a Director of Kordia, a member of NZ Initiative and a Chartered Fellow of the Institute of Directors. He is also closely involved with the philanthropic sector, including IHC, Riding for the Disabled and Waipuna Hospice.

Mr. Paul Colangelo served as Advisor at Mill Point Capital. He currently serves as the Chief Executive Officer of Avenu Insights & Analytics ("Avenu") and as the Vice Chairman of Vehicle Management Solutions. With a track record as a trusted advisor at the state and local levels, He leads the operations, strategy, and growth of Avenu. He previously served as President and Chief Operating Officer at Library Systems & Services, as well as President of Appriss, where his strategic vision led to the portfolio revenue growth and diversification. Before Appriss, He served as Vice President of Convergys Global Business Unit, managing client services programs in government, automotive and transportation markets. As part of his ongoing commitment to serving state and local communities nationwide, he serves as an active member on the Blessings in a Backpack, and Vice Chairman, Prince William County Service Authority Board of Directors. He earned a B.A. from Seton Hall University.

Mr. Ramón Carranza serves as an Advisory team at Arada Capital Partners. +9 years of international experience in Financial Restructuring and Private Equity. Extensive experience in the design and structuring of corporate purchase operations Experience in the evaluation, implementation and supervision of investment opportunities

Ms. Rasha El-Hoshan served as Board Member at Kingdom Holding Company. She joined Kingdom Holding Company on January 30, 2012, as an independent board member and a member of KHC's audit committee. She is the General Manager of El-Hoshan Furniture, she is also an executive committee member and a board member of El-Hoshan Group. Eng. She holds an M.S in interior design from Pratt Institute in New York and received her Bachelor in Political Science - Middle East from The American University in Washington, DC.

Mr. Rashid Al-Naimi serves as Board Member at Qatari Investors Group. He served as the Chief Executive Officer at Qatar Foundation. In 2015, he was honored by the Arab Economic Forum with the "Achievement in Leadership Award". In his previous role as Vice President of Administration at Qatar Foundation, he managed the Shared Services Organization in Qatar Foundation that included the Finance, Human Resources, Business Process Improvement, Information Technology, Procurement, and Support Services Directorates. Prior to joining Qatar Foundation, He was the Human Resources Manager at RasGas Company Limited.

Ms. Reem Asaad serves as an Independent Board Member at Kingdom Holding Company. She has seventeen years of experience in Financial Management & Invest Funds with many published articles in economics. She has worked in the Financial & Investment sector for the development of product investment and individual investment management. She lectured on Finance & Financial Markets at Dar Alhekmah University. In 2017, she joined Maaden Co., as the first Saudi lady to chair the Shareholders Relations. Currently, she chairs the Shareholders Relations in Al-Taaunia Co. She is also passionate about financial and investment awareness for Arabic speakers in 'Reem's Advice' on Twitter. She has participated in many events as a spokesperson in international forums and conferences on women's financial empowerment.

Ms. Runa Alam is a Co-Founder and serves as Partner & Chief Executive Officer at Development Partners International. She serves as Board Member at CARE Enterprises. She also served as a Board Member at AVCA. She serves as a Board Member at Cooperative For Assistance And Relief Everywhere. She served as a Board Member at Food Concepts. She has 29 years of investment banking, emerging market entrepreneurship and private equity experience. Before DPI, She was CEO of KZAM, a joint venture between Zephyr Management of New York and Kingdom Holding Company, which managed PAIP-PCAP, sponsored by the International Finance Corporation and the Commonwealth Secretariat. She also acted as CEO of ZMAIF (known as the New Africa Fund before Zephyr Management took over the management in 2000 and her involvement), sponsored by the Overseas Private Investment Corporation, where she helped implement a successful turnaround of the fund. She was formerly a director of the AIG Africa Infrastructure Fund, managed by Emerging Market Partnership in Washington, and has "on-the-ground" management experience in emerging markets having founded and managed both Peregrine Bangladesh and Union Capital Bangladesh in the 1990s. She started her career in New York working for investment banks including Morgan Stanley and Merrill Lynch in mergers and acquisitions and corporate and tax-exempt finance. She serves on the Eaton Towers Holding LLP, ETW Africa Holdings UK Limited, Guaranty Trust Assurance plc and Touax Africa SAS boards of directors, and has previously served on the Liberty Star Consumer Holdings (Proprietary) Limited, United Bank of Africa plc, Letshego Holdings Limited and Celtel boards of directors. She is Chair of the African Venture Capital Association and a member of the Emerging Market Private Equity Association advisory board and its Africa Council. She is also a member of the Millennium Promise's UK board and is on the advisory board of The Tony Elumelu Foundation. She sits on the advisory council of Princeton University's Woodrow Wilson School for Public and International Affairs, her Alma Mater. She holds a BA in International and Developmental Economics from Princeton University and an MBA from the Harvard Business School. She was also a Harry S. Truman Congressional Scholar.

Mr. Shahm Al-Wir serves as the partner of Foursan Group. He serves as Board Member at Siniora Food Industries. He serves as Board Member at Jo Academy. He also served as Board Member at Jordan Dubai Islamic Bank. He served as Board Member at Zalatimo Sweets. Prior to joining Foursan, he was with Debevoise & Plimpton in New York, a leading global law firm, having spent six years focusing on US and Middle Eastern mergers and acquisitions and capital markets transactional and advisory work. He is a Member of the Economic Policies Council chaired by His Majesty King Abdullah II of Jordan. He is also a Director of the Central Bank of Jordan. He is a Director of Foursan Capital Partners I and Siniora Food Industries and a Trustee of the Amman Baccalaureate School, the King Hussein Cancer Foundation and the Shoman Foundation. He is an attorney admitted to the New York Bar. He received a Juris Doctorate in Law from the University of Virginia School of Law and a Bachelor of Arts in Government, magna cum laude, from Harvard University.

Mr. Sheikh Mansour Al Nahyan is the Owner of Abu Dhabi United Group. Mr. Al Nahyan served as Chairman of the Board of Directors at International Petroleum Investment Company. He serves as Chairman of the Board at Mubadala Investment Company. He also served as a Board Member of the Abu Dhabi Investment Council. He is also the Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Presidential Affairs of the UAE. As Chairman of the Board, he heads the Board of Directors which is responsible for overseeing the affairs of the Emirates Investment Authority. He serves as Chairman of Mubadala Investment Company. He also serves as the Chairman of the Board of Directors at the Abu Dhabi Fund for Development.

Ms. Sheri Buretta serves as Chairwoman of the board at Chugach Alaska Corporation. She has served as Chugach's full-time chair for 15 years. In addition, Sheri served as Vice Chairwoman, Board of Regents at Alaska Federation of Natives, Alaskans Standing Together, Tatitlek Corporation, Foraker Group governance board, and ROSSIA (Russian Orthodox Sacred Sites in Alaska) & University of Alaska Fairbanks Endowment. Sheri was born in Anchorage, Alaska, and her family is from the Native Village of Tatitlek located in the Prince William Sound. Sheri holds an accounting degree from the University of Alaska and a business degree from Gulf Coast Community College in Florida.
