She has previously served on the Prince William Sound Regional Citizens Advisory Council, the Exxon Valdez Oil Spill Public Advisory Group, and Anchorage's Sister City Commission, as well as co-chaired the transition team for former Anchorage Mayor Mark Begich. She is also the Vice Chairwoman, Board of Regents of the University of Alaska Fairbanks.

Mr. Slobodan Djukic serves as Investment Manager at Oak Valley Capital. He began his career as an Analyst at Ernst & Young and Merrill Lynch Global Principal Investments in Southeast Europe before serving as a Senior Manager at Zabeel Investments in Dubai.

Mr. Sofiane Lahmar serves as a Partner at Development Partners International. He also served as an Advisory Board Member at Farlap Capital and KELIX Bio. He also serves as Executive Chairman at Biopharm (Algeria). He joined DPI in April 2010 and has extensive finance experience spanning private equity investing, M&A investment banking and options trading. Prior to joining DPI, he was a Partner and co-Chief Investment Officer at Kingdom Zephyr Africa Management, a Pan-African private equity investment firm majority-owned by Kingdom Holding Company, the investment vehicle of HRH Prince Alwaleed bin Talal bin Abdulaziz Alsaud, a member of the Saudi Royal family and international investor. Prior to joining KZAM in 2005, he was a Vice President in the M&A group at JP Morgan in New York, where he helped advise on over US$25 billion worth of M&A transactions. He started his career on the foreign exchange options trading desk of FleetBoston in Boston. He currently serves and has served on the boards and board committees of the companies in which he has invested. He was named as one of the Financial News 100 Rising Stars in 2008, as one of the Africa Private Equity Managers of the Year by Jeune Afrique in 2010, and as one of the Africa Leaders of Tomorrow by Jeune Afrique in 2013. He holds an MA in International Economics & Finance from Brandeis University's International Business School (Boston) and a Maitrise in Management from Dauphine University (Paris).
Ms. Sonsoles Santamaría serves as Executive at Arada Capital Partners. She is a Chief Business Officer and founding partner of Tressis.

Mr. Stefan Mühlemann serves as Board Member at Radicant. He has worked for Schweizerischer Bankverein and LGT Group in Switzerland and abroad and is a Serial entrepreneur in finance and tech. He has dome MBA from Tuck School of Business at Dartmouth and London Business School. He is also Member of the Board of Directors of Swiss Fintech AG and enshift AG, Advisory Board at Found Global AG and Expert Council Digitalisation Canton Graubünden

Mr. Taher Mohammad Omar Agueel serves as Independent Board Member at Kingdom Holding Company. He holds Bachelor and Master's degrees in industrial engineering from the University of Texas, USA (having received his master's degree in 1984).

Mr. Talal Al Kaissi serves as Advisor & Non-Executive Board Member at NewSpace Capital. Mr. Al Kaissi joined G42 after 2 years at the UAE Space Agency as an Advisor to the Director General on Strategic Projects. Among several duties, one of his core functions was supporting the activation of the UAE Space Agency Investment Promotion Plan, and the development of a holistic national space economy with an emphasis on attracting space startups and investments to the UAE. Additionally, he provided strategic support to both the Policy & Regulatory Directorate, as well as Space Missions Management Directorate. He also serves as the UAE representative to the World Economic Forum Council on Space Technology. Prior to his role at the Agency, he served at the UAE Embassy in Washington DC for nine years as a Senior Advisor for Commercial Affairs at the UAE Trade & Commercial Office and also led US/UAE Space Affairs. The role entailed bilateral trade policy and commercial issues to advance the UAE's interests in the US and attract FDI into the UAE. On the Space Affairs front, he worked closely with the UAE Space Agency to put together a Framework Agreement with NASA and build ties with US government stakeholders, Academia, and Industry. He also worked in the Energy sector at KBR where he led Business Development efforts for the GCC region in the downstream petrochemical segment and was based between Houston (USA), Dubai (UAE), and Khobar (Saudi Arabia). He graduated from California State University in Long Beach with a Bachelor of Science in International Business in 2006. He also holds an executive certification from the International Space University. He serves as a Board Member at Takalam Online Counseling.

Mr. Talal Al Maiman serves as Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at Kingdom Holding Company. He also serves as Chairman of the Board at Five Capital. He also serves as Vice Chairman at Banque Saudi Fransi. He joined in 1996, and he holds the responsibility of overseeing KHC's investment and operations, as well as identifying future private and public investment opportunities locally, regionally, and globally. In addition to sitting on the Board of Directors of KHC as well as being a member of the Investment Committee and Chairman of the Board of all domestic subsidiaries, he is also a Board Member and Executive Committee Member of National Industrialization Company, a multi-billion dollar publicly listed petrochemical diversified investment company, a Board Member and Executive Committee member of NAS Holding, a leading aviation company which owns NAS Jet (ex. NetJet Middle East) and NAS Airlines, one of the leading regional low-cost carrier. He also serves as a Chairman of the Board of Kingdom Real Estate Investment Company ("KRED"), the domestic arm of KHC as well as Chairman of Kingdom Investment and Development Company ("KIDC"), a newly formed closed joint-stock company with oversee assets in excess of USD 1 billion and as Chairman of Five Capital Fund I, a newly formed private equity fund with lead sponsors KHC and the investment arm of the French Sovereign Fund, CDC International Capital ("CDC") in addition of being a Board Member of Five Capital Advisors (DIFC), a regulated investment advisory firm jointly owned with CDC. He has served previously as a Board Member of Savola, a multi-billion industrial and retail listed company, and Saudi Research and Marketing Group, a leading listed media company in the MENA region. Prior to joining KHC, He was Director of Information Systems at the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency (1986-1996) and Director of Operations and Maintenance at the Saudi Arabian Ministry of Interior (1979-1986). He holds a BS in Electrical Engineering from the University of Evansville and has completed an Executive Management Program at Harvard Business School. In 2009, he completed his MBA at the University of Liverpool.

Mr. Tamim Jabr serves as Chief Investment Officer and Board Member at Kingdom Holding Company. He also serves as Board Member at Deezer. He has been the Executive Director of International Investments at Kingdom Holding Company and a member of its Investment Committee since 2019. Prior to that, he spent 16 years at Deutsche Bank in a number of senior leadership positions, including as Chief Executive Officer of Deutsche Securities Saudi Arabia and Head of Corporate & Investment Banking. He is also a Board Member of Five Capital, a joint venture between Kingdom Holding and Bpi France. He holds a BA degree from Emerson College and a Master's degree from Boston University. He serves as Board Member at Five Capital.

primary_position: Board Member & Chairwoman of the Supervisory Board
biography: Ms. Tatjana Lattorff serves as Board Member & Chairwoman of the Supervisory Board at Liechtenstein Group. She is the CEO of the Prince Liechtenstein Philanthropy Foundation and has been involved for several years in various advisory boards of European educational initiatives, including the European Advisory Council of Teach for All, Sindbad Austria, Teach for Austria, and Hobby Lobby. Additionally, she is the President of the Board of Trustees of the Prince Franz Josef Foundation and Princess Gina Foundation in Liechtenstein. She holds a Master's degree in Business Administration from the European Business School (EBS) Madrid.

Mr. Thomas Galbraith serves as Advisory Board Member at Shield Group. He is a long serving member of Parliament and was Leader of the House of Lords and Chancellor of the Duchy of Lancaster until January 2013. Under his leadership, the House of Lords Act 1999 passed reforming its operation. Under the Act, he was elected by other peers as one of the 92 hereditary peers to remain in the House of Lords. He then became a Director on Supervisory Board of Trafigura Beheer BV, Trafigura Group PTE Ltd. and related hedge fund manager Galena Asset Management. He has served as a longtime member of Lloyd's of London, and an Advisor to the AECOM Corporation. He plays an active role with SG|Capital and its captive insurance activities.

Mr. Tijs Akkerman serves as Partner, Investment Partner & Managing Partner at Nordian Capital Partners. Mr. Akkerman is responsible for the investments in IHC Merwede, Delta Wines, Inter Access and Orffa. After a traineeship at ABN Amro Corporate Finance, he started beginning 2005 as a M&A advisor at Rabo Securities Corporate Advisory. In 2006 Mr. Akkerman worked temporarily for Rabobank International M&A in New York. Mr. Akkerman holds a degree in Economics from the University of Groningen.

primary_position: Fund Manager & Senior Managing Director, BX Private Equity Strategies - New York
biography: Mr. Viral Patel serves as Fund Manager & Senior Managing Director, BX Private Equity Strategies - New York at Blackstone. Mr. Patel serves as a Board Member at Hidrovias do Brasil. He serves as a Board Member at Blue Yonder (Arizona). He serves as a Board Member at Sema4. He also serves as Senior Managing Director, Chief Executive Officer of Blackstone Private Equity Strategies, and Member of the Investment Committee at Blackstone. He served as a Board Member at GeneDx Holding. Since joining Blackstone in 2005, he has focused on structured finance transactions across several industries including financial institutions, consumers, media, and healthcare. Select advisory clients include Bank Of America, Digital Cinema Implementation Partners, Cineplex Entertainment, Empire Theatres, GIC, Qatar Foundation, Morgan Stanley, AIG, Kraf,t and the New York Public Asset Fund. Before joining Blackstone, he was a Credit Suisse and Donaldson, Lufkin, and Jenrette Structured Products businesses member. He graduated magna cum laude from Cornell University with a B.S. in Operations Research and Industrial Engineering. He also serves as a Board Member at Sema4 and FireEye, Inc. He served as a Board Member at PennEngineering and JDA Software Group.

Mr. Yacine Mancer serves as Principal at Lexington Partners. He served as Principal, Investor Relations at BC Partners. He formerly served as Senior Investor Relations Manager at Ardian. Prior to joining Ardian, He worked for two years within Al Faisal Holding in Doha, Qatar. He is primarily engaged in the firm's fundraising efforts and closely involved in the firm's relationships with investors in the Middle East. Moreover, he also worked for two years within investment banks in Paris and London. He graduated from the University of Paris Dauphine with a masters in finance

Mr. James Chalmers served as Vice President at Campbell Lutyens. James is a member of the Campbell Lutyens secondary advisory team. Prior to joining Campbell Lutyens, James worked as an analyst in the Advisory and M&A division of DVB Bank, part of the DZ Bank Group. James holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Mathematics from the University of Warwick.

James Larner served as Associate at Threadmark. He joined Threadmark in 2013 from J.P. Morgan. As a Vice President in the Private Bank, he had responsibility for business development, capital raising and relationship management across a broad client base. Whilst at J.P. Morgan, James was actively involved in raising capital for numerous funds including mezzanine, energy, real estate, sector focused buyout, mid market buyout and distressed debt. He joined J.P. Morgan from a family office where he held a business strategy and project management role. Prior to this James spent five years serving as an officer in the British Army's Welsh Guards. During this time he deployed on operations to Iraq and Kosovo, and he latterly served as an Equerry to HRH the Prince of Wales. James holds a Bachelor of Laws degree from the University of Birmingham, an MBA from Warwick Business School.

Mr. Nicholas Hofgren serves as Partner at Westly House Partners. He is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Financial Officer at Quoherent. Prior to forming WHP, he had held the position of Managing Director at Brunswick Capital. He started his career by joining the launch of an investment bank in Miami and Lima. There he restructured eleven companies over five years in the FMCG, transportation, communications, and manufacturing sectors. Later he was hired by Bank of America to develop a new business, which was sold to JP Morgan Chase, heading EMEA and building a platform for raising private equity and real estate funds. He was hired as Managing Director in 2004 at Brunswick Capital (UBS), during which time he formed businesses for the shareholders including freight stock leasing and property development. He was hired as CIO of Immo Industry Group in 2007 where he led the formation of private funds and the building of new logistics facilities for leading companies across Europe. He was a partner of Tangent Ventures from 2008-2013, advising on restructuring a portfolio of nine companies including the world leader in electrical submersible pumps for oil extraction and the regional leader in gas pipeline valves. He has been a board member since 2010 of Prince Street Group funds, a leading frontier markets hedge fund manager with ~$1.1B assets under management. Since 2011 he has been a member of the development committee of the Prince's Teaching Institute, a charity organized by the Prince of Wales. He is a founder in Westly House, which secured the sale of a significant European wind farm. He is the founder of GFG Group Limited, GFG Limited and GFG Fund PCC Limited, which he grew to ~$500M of assets under management between 2014 and 2019. He has successfully led several MiFID main board securitizations at GFG. He was CEO and Chairman of Vordere plc for three years from 2016 to 2019, where he grew AUM from ~$1.5M to ~$150M (100x growth) and grew AUM per share by 260% via 13 acquisitions. He earned a bachelor of arts from Emory University in 1991. He earned his graduate degree in hyperinflationary finance from IESA in 1994. He studied at Columbia University, transferring to Emory University to complete a BA double major. He earned his post-graduate degree in Hyper-inflationary Finance from IESA.

Mr. Rayan Hasan serves as Managing Director at FGS Global. A graduate of the University of Jordan, King Abdullah II School of Information Technology, he holds a degree in Business Information Systems. He is a father of two and lives with his family in Dubai.

primary_position: Chairman of the Board of Directors
biography: Mr. A. Fahd bin Nafl serves as Chairman of the Board of Directors at Al-Hilal Club. He chaired the Al-Hilal Club Board of Directors from 2019 to 2023, before being nominated as Chairman of the Al-Hilal Club Sports Members Foundation. In addition, he has served as a member of the Board of Directors for several local and international companies. His professional journey also includes holding various leadership positions at Kingdom Holding Company, culminating in his role as Executive Director of Business Development. He completed his Bachelor's in Business Administration and Entrepreneurship from the University of Miami, USA.
Mr. A. E. Kips served as Board Member of IHC Merwede.

Mr. Abdul Manaf is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Easysoft Technologies. As a hardcore fan of Bill Gates, Mr. Manaf started the dreams of building something great in future when he was doing his higher secondary education in 2002 and with inspiration from Microsoft, he named his future company as "Easysoft". It was not just a wild dream, but o ne, which would define the very objective of his life in years to come. In 2005 Easysoft becoming a real life business when Manaf and his class-mate Shamal Chandran started with freelance static web designing services, which led to them eventually dropping out of their course and starting Easysoft Technologies in 2006. In 2009, he started the association with Padma Shri Mammootty for re-designing his official website and this association turned into a lifetime partnership. In 2012 Abdul Manaf co-founded "Movie Gear" with Mammootty, a digital marketing company with prime focus on celebrity management and films. Over the next years MovieGear worked with various superstars like Dulquer Salmaan, Fahadh Faasil, Nivin Pauly, Unni Mukundan, Dileep, Jayasurya etc. From 2009 onwards, Abdul Manaf working as the Social Media Manager to Mammootty. From 2012, he started working with Facebook India officials as a strategic partner in public contents, he worked with all the celebrities, politicians, media companies from Kerala as their Social Media Consultant.
Mr. Abdulelah Alatabani serves as Chief Executive Officer at Seed Group.
Mr. Abdullah Yousef Al-Babtain served as Chief Executive Officer & Vice Chairman at Al-Themar International Holding Company.

Dr. Abigail McElhinny serves as Chief Scientific Officer at AOA Dx. She is an experienced leader in bringing together science, technology, teams and product development processes to launch complex diagnostic assay systems that make an impact in the field of oncology For close to two decades, she has led R&D teams across the continuum from the earliest phases of research and technology transfer, through regulatory submission and approval of products focused on improving the lives of patients with cancer. These technologies include global launches of immunohistochemistry (IHC)-based assays used to select patients for various targeted-therapies (companion diagnostics); next generation sequencing (NGS)- based panels and associated bioinformatics software for molecular profiling of tumor tissue and liquid biopsies; and multi-omic assays with machine learning (ML) for the early detection of cancer signals in the blood from otherwise healthy individuals. She specializes in leading diverse, cross-functional teams to also include manufacturing scale-up, clinical validation, and on-market support She received her PhD at Northeastern University in Boston, followed by post- doctoral fellowships at the University of Arizona focused on understanding the molecular assembly of muscle proteins during development. She is passionate about helping to build capabilities in R&D, manufacturing, data science and bioinformatics/software engineering and seeing teams achieve shared goals.

Mr. Adam Latimer serves as Managing Director at Intercounty. He brings experience from previous roles at Purplebricks.com, Simpson & Partners Estate Agents and HARRISON MURRAY ESTATE AGENTS LIMITED. Adam Latimer holds a 1999 - 2002 Prince William Upper School, Oundle. With a robust skill set that includes Property Management, Negotiation, Leadership, Strategic Planning, Investment Properties and more.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer, Managing Partner & Board Member
biography: Dr. Adel Alsayed is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer, Managing Partner and Board Member at Pinnacle Capital. Dr. Alsayed holds a BSc. in Civil Engineering from King Fahad University of Petroleum & Minerals, an MSc. in Engineering Management from Milwaukee School of Engineering, and a Ph.D. in finance from George Washington University. He has more than 27 years of experience in financial advisory, asset management, and private equity investments. His latest position at Kingdom Holding involved managing a private equity portfolio of over $9b that included investments in the banking, technology, and entertainment sectors. Before that, he was the CEO of a Bahrain-listed industrial investment company operating in Saudi Arabia; investments included sectors such as steel, paints, and downstream petrochemicals. Throughout his career, he held senior positions in several leading financial institutions including Samba Financial Group, Bahrain International Bank, Gulf Investment Corporation, and the World Bank. His experience also includes establishing and managing private equity funds targeting the US and Africa, as well as M&A advisory projects in the Kingdom.

primary_position: Director & Member of the Executive Committee
biography: Mr. Adel Mustafawi served as Director and Member of the Executive Committee at Qatar Luxury Group.

Mr. Ahmed Alkhoshaibi serves as Chief Executive Officer at Arada Developments. He also serves as a Vice Chairman at Raimondi Cranes. He serves as Group Chief Executive Officer at KBW Investments. As Group Chief Executive Officer of Arada, he is responsible for all aspects of corporate performance, including the execution of a successful long-term strategy, as well as planning, development, marketing and sales, all of which have added considerable shareholder value. In the short space of time since the company was launched, he has also been responsible for the recruitment of a 1,500-strong team of real estate professionals, each of whom have extensive experience in this field. He is also Group Chief Executive Officer of KBW Investments, founded by HRH Prince Khaled bin Alwaleed Bin Talal. Prior to the formation of Arada, he managed and orchestrated several profitable exits in a number of industries with operations that varied in size and scale. Prior to KBW Investments, he masterminded the successful conceptualization, planning, construction, sales and delivery of a series of residential and mixed-use communities in Sydney, Australia. With practical leadership and executive experience across a number of sectors, his educational background includes a degree in business finance together with an executive MBA.

Mr. Ahmed Ayman serves as Head of Business Development at W Motors. He served as Business Development Manager at W Motors. He served as Senior Manager of International Ventures at The Private Office of Sheikh Saeed bin Ahmed Al Maktoum. He was a Co-Founder and served as Chief Operating Officer at Mont8. He served as Regional Manager at Biopipe. He was a Co-Founder and served as Events Director at Illuminated Events. He served as Account and Activation Director at MMG Eventz. He served as an Engineering Trainee at IGS Foundation Contracting. He served as Account Manager at MMG Eventz. He served as a Freelancer in the Marketing & Advertisement industry. He holds a Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering from the American University of Sharjah.

Mr. Ahmed Nawasrah is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Khareta. he served as Chief Commercial Officer at Mawdoo3. He is a co-founder and CEO of Salma AI starting in August 2021. In the past, Ahmed held positions at Emerson Automation Solutions, where they served as a Sales Leader - Energy Solutions International - Middle East & Africa from May 2016 to May 2018, and as a Corporate Strategic Planning Manager from June 2013 to May 2016. Before joining Emerson, they worked at King Abdullah II Design and Development Bureau (KADDB), where they were an AICSR Project Manager from July 2007 to June 2010, and an Electrical and Electronics Design Unit Supervisor from August 2008 to November 2008. Earlier in their career, Ahmed founded and managed Al-Baheth Electronic Center from April 2004 to August 2008. Ahmed Nawasrah obtained a Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA) with a focus on Operations and Technology Management from the Questrom School of Business at Boston University. Before this, they pursued a Master's degree in Computer Engineering from Jami'at Al-Ulum wa Al-Tiknolojia Al-Urdunia. Ahmed also holds a Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering from Al Jami'at Al-Hashimiyyah. Their education journey began at The Jubilee Institute, where they studied for three years, although the specific degree and field of study during that time were unspecified.

Dr. Alan Flax is a Founding Partner and serves as Ophthalmologist at Southern Ophthalmology. Dr Flax is a comprehensive eye specialist with special interests in refractive cataract surgery, glaucoma and diabetic eye disease. He is a medical graduate of the University of the Witwatersrand, Johannesburg, South Africa and has a Master of Business Administration (MBA) Degree from the Graduate School of Business, University of Cape Town. Prior to specializing in Ophthalmology at the Department of Ophthalmology, the University of NSW at Prince of Wales, St George and Sutherland Hospitals, Dr. Flax held numerous senior management positions in public and private hospitals in South Africa and Australia. He remains actively involved in teaching. He was involved in the establishment of the Outback Eye Service and was the project coordinator of NSW's first teleophthalmology program.

primary_position: Founder, Chief Strategy Officer & Managing Director
biography: Dr. Alastair Martin is the Founder and serves as Chief Strategy Officer and Managing Director at Flexitricity. Alastair is a professional energy engineer with experience ranging from gigawatt-scale coal and nuclear power stations, through industrial energy efficiency, to very small embedded wind, solar and hydro generators. He founded Flexitricity to enable small generators and energy users to improve their own financial position while reducing the environmental impact of the power generation industry.
Mr. Alastair Martin Co-Founded UK Demand Response Association.
Mr. Alberto Carlana serves as Group Information Technology Director at Selle Royal Group. He previously served as Chief Technology Officer at the company.
Mr. Alberto Pat serves as Group Finance Director at Selle Royal Group. He previously served as Group Finance Director at the company.

Mr. Alex Johnston served as Chief Marketing Officer at Amphio. He works across the business, leading the commercial strategy of the company to ensure that Touchpress continues to be at one with the digital market place. Previously, he was an Executive Vice President at Omnicom, a leading international holding company for marketing service agencies whose global clients include Apple and PepsiCo. Alex is currently a Director at Freud Communications, which he co-founded and worked as Creative Director for many years.

Mr. Alexander Johnston is a Co-Founder & serves as Board member at Qiktionary. He founded and served as Chief Executive Officer at Sound Circles. He serves as Board Member at World Wide Web Foundation. He has recently re-joined Freud Communications as a Director. Previously, he was an Executive Vice President at Omnicom, a leading international holding company for advertising and marketing service agencies whose global clients include Apple, MacDonalds and PepsiCo. At Omnicom, he advised on digital and earned media strategies for clients and managed digital incubation initiatives. Prior to joining Omnicom in 2010, Mr. Johnston was a senior communications advisor to PepsiCo. From 2005 to 2008, he was the Managing Partner and Founder of Fleming Media, a rights and media acquisition fund backed by the Fleming family. Mr. Johnston was a co-founder of Freud Communications, where he was Creative Director for many years.

Mr. Alexander van Noort served as Chief Operating Officer at Royal IHC. He is responsible for daily operations in the fields of Mission Equipment, Shipbuilding and Services. Prior to his appointment at IHC, Van Noort worked in various positions at Schlumberger.

Mr. Alexandre Micheloud is a Co-Founder of Ustinov Hoffmann Construction System. Mr. Micheloud joined Cape Capital in March 2022 as an Impact Investment Specialist. Previously he worked for 3 years as a Project Manager at a Single Family Office, building impact-first initiatives and ventures, and advising on impact investing opportunities. Prior to that, he interned at the Ellen MacArthur Foundation and LGT Bank. He serves as an Executive at Ustinov Hoffmann Construction System.

Mr. Ali Dalloul serves as Group Chief Strategy Officer at G42. Mr. Dalloul is a seasoned American technology executive. With three decades of leading and delivering cloud and Al programs at Microsoft, Dalloul brings an exceptional track record that aligns with G42's strategic objectives to drive growth globally. Dalloul, who previously served as Microsoft Vice President of Azure Al Customer Experience Engineering, brings a wealth of operating experience in Al commercialization, enterprise adoption, and product strategy.

Mr. Allan Kirkman serves as Board Member at The IHC Group. Allan C. Kirkman, For more than the past five years, a member of each of the Audit Committee and the Compensation Committee of IHC and Chairman of the Compensation Committee of IHC; for more than the five years prior to his retirement in October 2005, Executive Vice President of Mellon Bank, N.A., a national bank.

Dr. Allen Gown Founded & served as Principal & Associate Medical Director at PhenoPath. He received his MD from the Albert Einstein College of Medicine of Yeshiva University, Bronx, NY in 1975, and then completed his Pathology Residency as well as Pathology Fellowship training at the University of Washington, Seattle, the latter under the aegis of Dr. Earl Benditt. Dr. Gown rose through the ranks to full Professor of Pathology and served as attending pathologist at the University of Washington Medical Center, where he developed and directed the immunohistochemistry (IHC) laboratory. In 1997, Dr. Gown left the University of Washington to found PhenoPath, which has grown to become an internationally renowned specialty pathology reference laboratory. Currently, Medical Director and Chief Pathologist at PhenoPath, Dr. Gown is a pathologist-scientist recognized as one of the world's leading experts in the diagnostic and research applications of IHC. He has developed numerous clinically important monoclonal antibodies employed in IHC laboratories around the world (HMB-45, OSCAR, etc.). Dr. Gown is a member of the editorial boards of many of the major pathology journals. He is a Clinical Professor of Pathology at the University of British Columbia, Vancouver, BC, and an Affiliate Investigator in the Clinical Research Division of the Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center, Seattle, WA. Dr. Gown continues to be at the forefront of clinical investigative studies employing IHC and other modalities with over 300 peer-reviewed publications and as a frequent presenter at national and international conferences.

primary_position: Founder, Managing Partner & Head of Mission
biography: Mr. Alphonse Ateba Noa is the Founder and serves as Managing Partner & Head of Mission at Inter'Activ Consulting. With a 25-year career, Mr. Ateba Noa regularly carries out consulting missions in marketing , communication and digital for entities such as UNICEF, UNDP, FAO, UNCTAD, the European Union, GIZ, ECCAS, CEMAC, WHO, AfDB, Expertise France, etc. He is also associated with professional teaching in several schools and training institutes in the fields of communication , marketing and digital in Cameroon. He was successively Head of Communication for the Multisectoral AIDS Control Program (World Bank Project in Cameroon), and Head of the Communication and Public Relations Division at SNI. He holds a Master's degree in Marketing Management and Commercial Strategy from HEC-Paris , a European Master's degree in Communication Management, specializing in Advertising Strategies and Digital Communication, and a Diploma in Information and Communication Sciences and Techniques, specializing in Journalism. Since 2010, he has been managing INTER'ACTIV CONSULTING, a consulting agency specializing in communication for development.

primary_position: Director of Finance and Risk Management & Board Member
biography: Mr. Alvin Christian serves as Director of Finance and Risk Management & Board Member at Pertamedika IHC. He is a graduate of Bachelor of Science in Business Administration from Northeastern University and Master of Science in Financial Economics from Boston University.

Mr. Amin Qureshi serves as Chief Financial Officer at Sawaeed.Mr. Qureshi is a finance professional with over 20 years of experience spanning diversified verticals, include manufacturing, distribution, investments, banking and financial services. He has worked with large companies of international repute namely ExxonMobil, Procter & Gamble, Pakistan Stock Exchange, Royal Group UAE and Reem Finance in various regions such as Pakistan, Central Asia and Middle East. He holds a Bachelor's Degree in Commerce as well as a professional qualification, Cost & Management Accountant (CMA) and is a Chartered Financial Analyst - CFA Charter-holder.

Mr. Amit Arora serves as Chief Operating Officer at Arada Developments. As Chief Operating Officer, HE =oversees Arada's Hospitality and Entertainment division, which incorporates a number of rapidly growing segments including wellness, hospitality, F&B and events. He is also responsible for all Arada's new non-residential business. He is a hospitality professional with nearly three decades of experience in the hospitality industry across the UAE, Germany and USA. Prior to joining Arada, He was Chief Operating Officer at Erth Abu Dhabi, formerly known as the Armed Forces Officers Club & Hotel where he provided strategic direction and leadership to the group's diverse portfolio, covering Hotels, Recreation Clubs, Catering, Hospitality and Restaurants division, and played a pivotal role in bringing École Ducasse, the world's premier culinary institution, to Abu Dhabi. He has also served as Chief Executive Officer, Hospitality at FIVE Holdings, where he was instrumental in establishing the hotel division for the group, and as Chief Sales and Marketing Officer at Emaar Hospitality Group where he spearheaded the development and launch of three distinctive brands: The Address Hotels and Resorts, Armani Hotels and Resorts, and Vida Hotels. His 15-year journey with The Ritz-Carlton Hotel Company included senior executive roles in global locations, including Boston, Berlin, and Dubai. His final assignment involved serving as Multi Property General Manager of The Ritz-Carlton properties in Ras Al Khaimah. He is a graduate of the International College of Hotel Management at Modul University in Austria.

Mr. Amit Kaushal serves as Group Chief Executive Officer at Dubai Holding. He also serves as a Council Member at The British University in Dubai. He was appointed as the Group Chief Executive Officer of Dubai Holding in February 2018. Since then, he has led the Group's operations in 13 countries across various sectors, including real estate, hospitality, media, retail, leisure, and entertainment. During his tenure, he has led several transformational initiatives that have helped spur sustainable economic growth through diversification and investments in strategic partnerships in the UAE and internationally. These included the successful listings of TECOM Group (TECOM), the Group's operator of business districts;,and Emirates Central Cooling Systems Corporation (Empower), the world's largest district cooling service provider, on the Dubai Financial Market in 2022. Other key initiatives included the integration into Dubai Holding of Meraas, a world-class real estate master developer, and the creation of significant strategic partnerships with leading UAE and global corporations - the more recent ones including joint ventures with leading global alternative asset manager Brookfield Asset Management and leading UAE real estate developer and manager Aldar Properties, and a transaction with Emaar Properties, which resulted in Dubai Holding becoming the second largest shareholder in that listed entity. He has also been instrumental in strengthening Dubai Holding's position as a global leader in the luxury hospitality market through strategic acquisitions of flagship properties such as The Westin-Paris Vendome (France), Le Richemond (Switzerland), and Capri Palace (Italy). In addition to his executive leadership of the Group, he serves on the boards and committees of several regional and international organizations. His current board involvements include non-executive directorships on TECOM, Empower, and Azadea Group, one of the region's largest international lifestyle retailers. He also serves on the Advisory Board of Warwick Business School, a leading Russell Group university in the UK. He is also a member of TECOM's and Empower's respective Audit and Risk Committees and Azadea's and TECOM's respective Nomination and Remuneration Committees. He also chairs the Executive Committee of Shamal Holding, a diversified investment company. He has strong experience in financial services, having spent more than a decade in the earlier years of his career with leading investment banks in London and Dubai, where he worked for Goldman Sachs, UBS, and Deutsche Bank across transaction advisory, structuring, and capital markets disciplines. He holds a Master of Philosophy degree in Finance from the University of Cambridge (UK) and a BSc (First Class Hons.) in Mathematics, Operational Research, Statistics, and Economics from the University of Warwick (UK).
Mr. Anders Björe is the Owner of Arada and also serves as its CEO. He serves as Chief Financial Officer at Marine Jet Power.
Mr. Andre Jansen was the Owner at innoForce. He served as Director Owner (DGA) at IHC Vremac Cylinders.

Mr. Andrea Mollica serves as Director at Royal Group. He served as Non-Executive Board Member at Beltone Financial Holding.

Mr. Andreas Braeuer serves as Chief Operating Officer at Royal Group. Mr. Braeuer previously served as Chief Operating Officer at PKF The Consulting House. He served as a Tourism Planning and Development Teacher at American College of Management and Technology. He served as Corporate Director, Sales and Resident Manager at Valamar - All You Can Holiday.

Dr. Andreas Insam serves as Board Member at leadXpro. Dr. Andreas Insam served as Executive at INSAM FAMILIENSTIFTUNG. Dr. Andreas Insam served as Chief Executive Officer at Bendura Bank. He was previously a long-standing member of the Board of Managers of LGT Bank in Liechtenstein (Frankfurt) GmbH, responsible for the Institutional Sales division. After he obtained his doctorate in Business Administration, he served as Research Assistant at the University of Innsbruck's Institute of Mathematics and Statistics, and later became Assistant to the Executive Board of LGT Bank in Liechtenstein. Andreas Insam has been a lecturer and examiner at the University of Liechtenstein and at the University of Innsbruck for many years.
Mr. Andrei Morozov serves as Chief Executive Officer at Lunate Games. Mr. Andrei Morozov is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Simlabs.

Mr. Andrew Baker serves as Chairman and Shareholder at Primrose's Kitchen. He served as Member, Advisory Council at Trilantic Europe. Mr. Baker is the Chairman at Highland Fine Cheeses. He has worked in the global food industry since 1982. He has held senior executive positions with Cadbury Schweppes, Tate & Lyle, and Premier Brands, managing businesses in India, Middle East, France, Netherlands, Canada and throughout Africa. In the UK, Baker spent four years working for HRH The Prince of Wales, as CEO of Duchy Originals, an organic foods company, and as Director of the Prince's Social Enterprises. More recently, he became the first non-family CEO of Bettys & Taylors of Harrogate. Baker was a member of the board of MW Brands, Trilantic's former portfolio company, and currently chairs two-family food businesses in the UK, as well as a charity in Kenya.

Mr. Andrew Herrick served as Chief Executive Officer at Intense Cycles. He also served as an Operating partner and Advisor at VO2 Partners. He also served as Board Member at HLC. He is a Director of Italian cycling products conglomerate Selle Royal Group and runs Selle Royal North America, including the CrankBrothers, Fi'zi:k, Selle Royal and Brooks brands. Andrew previously ran bicycle components firm CrankBrothers; was an officer at Schwinn/GT with global responsibility for the GT brand and founded bicycle tools firm Pedros, which was acquired in 1997 by Swix Sport AS of Norway.

Dr. Andy Du serves as Chief Operating Officer at TrustAI. He co-founded & served as Chief Operating Officer at StarCross. He secured UAE G42 partnership. Also. he directed NSA-funded project, published at ACM CCS.

Dr. Andy Gunawardena is the Founder of CUvids. Dr. Gunawardena is a faculty member in the department of computer science at Princeton University. He served as an Associate Teaching Professor of Computer Science at Carnegie Mellon University from 1998-2013 and is now a courtesy faculty at CMU. He is a long time advocate of technology in education and the application of the principles of learning sciences to teaching and learning. He is the co-author of two college textbooks in computational linear algebra published by Springer-Verlag and Thompson Brooks-Cole and is the author and co-author of over 45 research articles. His textbooks have been translated into other languages. He is the co-creator of Classroom Salon, a platform to increase student engagement through annotations and analytics. He has received over US$ 1 million in funding from NSF, Qatar Foundation, Hewlett Packard, Microsoft, Google and many other foundations. His many honors include: leadership in technology award from HP, service award from Jesse Jones institute, ACM appreciation award from ACM houston chapter, and Exceptional achievement award (highest honor given to Sri Lankan expatriate) from Sri Lanka foundation. He was also a founding fellow of HP Catalyst Institute in 2010. From 2010-2013, he co-led the HP's measuring learning consortium, a multi-million dollar effort to introduce data driven learning. He is the principle inventor of US Patent 10,061,756 sponsored by Carnegie Mellon University and is the principle inventor of Princeton University based patent- machine assisted segmentation of video collections. He is currently the stream editor for learning analytics at the International Journal of innovation in online education. He typically teaches courses in data science, computer algorithms, discrete structures, systems programming, data science and pen-based computing. His research interests include technology in education, learning sciences and Human Computer Interaction.

Ms. Ann Flaherty is a Co-Founder and serves as Board Member & UK Director at Solar for Schools. Ann is a successful marketing and communications manager with a focus in recent years on solar power for the schools market. She is passionate that the children who will inherit our world have an opportunity to shape and fashion their world and Solar for Schools helps them do just that. With an MSc in Sustainable Development from the Centre for Environmental Studies and a background in media, journalism, event management, communications and marketing, she has co-created some amazing education focused projects for young people that have included working with HRH The Prince of Wales Rainforest Project and HISTORY's The People Speak with the actor Colin Firth. Within the renewable solar power sector, she has championed education charities to work with commercial organizations so schools are able to embrace the programmes that offer them all (irrespective of their financial circumstances) an opportunity to incorporate renewable power into their energy mix.

Dr. Anne Horstmann served as Vice President of Laboratory Operations at Aurora Diagnostics. Her responsibilities encompass overseeing Aurora's 22 laboratory locations' operations, safety programs, purchasing, process improvements, standardization, and quality control programs to maintain Aurora's high standards of laboratory excellence. Prior to joining Aurora Diagnostics, Dr. Horstmann served as Laboratory Manager, Laboratory of Dermatopathology, Port Washington, NY; Histology Supervisor, New York University Medical Center, New York City, NY; Histotechnologist/IHC, Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center, New York City, NY; Medical Laboratory Technician, Lab Corp, Plainview, NY. She earned a Ph.D. in health administration/management at Walden University, Minneapolis, MN; a Master of Public Administration (MPA) in health care administration at Long Island University -specializing in health systems finance, and a Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) at Hofstra University.

Ms. Anne Stockbridge is the Founder and Owner and serves as Executive Director at Family Priority. She has worked for many years as a medical-surgical, psychiatric, and community nurse. She is a licensed Registered Nurse with a bachelor's degree in nursing from George Mason University and a master's degree in counseling and psychological services from Marymount University. Anne has worked as a mental health therapist, workshop presenter, and public speaker at The Women's Center and The Center for Counseling and Development. After providing intensive in-home services as a counselor, supervisor, and director in Fairfax, Loudoun, Prince William, and Arlington counties, She developed and currently manages Family Priority LLC, which provides intensive in-home counseling services to at-risk youth and their families and Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA) services to children diagnosed with Autism Spectrum Disorders, intellectual disabilities, and other emotional /behavioral disorders.

Mr. Anthony Perkins serves as Chief Digital Services Officer at Smart Axiata Company. Anthony joined Smart Axiata in late 2016. Prior to joining Smart, he worked at Cambodian conglomerate Royal Group for a year, and before that, he was Chief Executive Officer of the Cambodian specialized bank Wing. He is a long-term resident of Cambodia, living in the country since 2008.

After starting in the technology department at Wing, Anthony eventually rose to the position of Chief Operating Officer before becoming Chief Executive Officer shortly after the takeover of Wing by Royal Group from ANZ. He would go on to lead the company to the top of the mobile money industry in Cambodia.

Born in the United Kingdom, Anthony worked in London for 11 years, holding various positions at blue-chip financial institutions such as Barclays, Aon, Bank of New York Europe, IBM Global Services, Royal Bank of Scotland and JP Morgan Cazenove. He graduated from the University of Greenwich with a Bachelor of Science (Hons) degree in Computer Science in 1997.

Mr. Anthony Quartararo serves as Board Member at Fulcrum ( Business/Productivity Software). Mr. Quartararo serves as Board Member at PlaceFund. He worked for a number of companies before starting SNI, each of them leveraging some aspect of geospatial technology, where he learned some important lessons about management, shared vision, and making a difference. He graduated from Bloomsburg University in Pennsylvania with a Bachelor's Degree in Geography/GIS and went to Portland State University in Portland, OR, for his Masters in GIS/Urban Planning.

Dr. Antony Lau serves as Board Member at Guardian Medical Solutions. He is an interventional cardiologist who treats all forms of heart disease, performing complex coronary interventional procedures. He is a senior staff specialist and interventional cardiologist at the Prince of Wales Hospital. He has visiting rights at Eastern Heart Clinic, Mater and North Shore Private Hospitals, and Northern Beaches Hospital. He is a conjoint senior lecturer at the Faculty of Medicine UNSW. Dr Lau is a research scholar who's currently researching the use of new diagnostic tools in coronary artery disease.
Mr. Ariano Fernandes served as Regional Director, Sales Team at Royal IHC.

Mr. Arie Vergunst serves as Managing Director at Steel Protection Group. He served as Chief Financial Officer and Board Member at Royal IHC. Mr. Arjan Klijnsoon served as Director Projects at Royal IHC.

primary_position: Director of Human Resources and Procurement & Board Member
biography: Dr. Asep Rohmat serves as Director of Human Resources and Procurement & Board Member at Pertamedika IHC. He graduated from the School of Medicine at the University of Indonesia (1991), completed the School of Internal Medicine Specialist at the Faculty of Medicine, University of Indonesia (2003), and continued his Gastroenterology education at the Faculty of the University of Indonesia (2014).

Mr. Ashish Koshy founded and served as Chief Executive Officer at G42 Healthcare. He served as Group Chief Operating Officer at M42. He is Chairman of the Board at Malaffi - the Abu Dhabi Health Information Exchange. Under his leadership, G42 Healthcare has accelerated from a rapidly growing start-up to becoming a leader in the region's healthcare ecosystem within a short span, recognized for its world-class infrastructure, flagship initiatives across advanced diagnostics, omics, digital health, pharma, and environmental sciences, continually building on business excellence and innovation. He has been instrumental in the merger with Mubadala Health, which has now resulted in the creation of M42, an integrated healthcare powerhouse company with more than 20,000 employees and more than 450 facilities in 24 countries. He has been directing multi-stakeholder large-scale national programs and strategic partnerships that have significantly augmented commercial and societal impact. For his leadership, he has been recognized by Forbes in 2022 and 2023 as one of the Top 100 Healthcare Leaders in the Middle East, for leading a multifaceted, growing organization with disruptive next-generation solutions. Prior to joining G42 Healthcare, he held senior roles as the Deputy General Manager - Technology Development & Innovation at Reliance Jio and Technology Planning at Ooredoo. He holds an MBA from Alliance Manchester Business School and an MSc in Computer Networks from Middlesex University, UK.

Ms. Ashling Dudley serves as Chief Operating Officer at The Prince Of Wales Hotel. She brings experience from previous roles at The Prince of Wales Hotel, Athlone, and The Callanan Hotel group. Ashling Dudley holds a Galway-Mayo Institute of Technology.

Dr. Bárbara Rolón is a Co-Founder and serves as Quality Director of Polybion. Dr. Rolón served as Board Member at Polybion. She obtained a Master's degree in Inorganic Chemistry with a specialty in Solid Complexes Chemistry, in the Faculty of Chemistry of the University of Guanajuato, and a PhD degree, with a specialty in Materials Science, in the Faculty of Sciences of the Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM). Since 1981, she carries out teaching and research work at the University of Guanajuato, where she has served as, Head of the Chemistry Laboratory from 1981 to 2007 and Head of the Materials Laboratory from 1985 to date, in the Engineering Division of the Irapuato-Salamanca Campus. She has obtained national and international awards and has also published 57 articles in high impact international magazines and 3 national peer-reviewed journals; Also, she has participated in over 35 prestigious international congresses and 15 national congresses, she has directed 42 bachelor's theses, 18 master's and 4 doctorate theses. In recent years, she has worked on projects related to the production of new materials for various applications and has collaborated in research projects related to the industry, generating new materials. She currently holds the Desirable Profile Recognition granted by SEP and she is Level I in the National System of Researchers (SNI) in addition to belonging to the CONACYT Energy network.

Mr. Benson Ajayi serves as Chief Financial Officer and Board Member at Mixta Africa. Prior to this, he worked with the Lekki Concession Company Limited, where he served as the Head of Finance for six years, before becoming the Acting Executive Director (Finance) and eventually the Acting Managing Director/CEO. Benson has also worked in various capacities in Michael Stevens & Associates, UAC of Nigeria Plc and NCR Nigeria Limited. He holds a BSc in Geography and an MBA in Financial Management from the Obafemi Awolowo University.
Mr. Bert Jan ter Riet serves as Chief Operating Officer at Royal IHC.

Mr. Bill Dollins served as Chief Information Officer at Fulcrum. As the Chief Information Officer at Spatial Networks, overseeing a multi-product team of software developers and data engineers, and ensuring SNI's technology portfolio supports operations across the company. He also built several analytical tools to help with modeling behaviors of infrastructures such as switched telecommunications, commercial rail networks, and the petroleum/oil/lubricants infrastructure. Mr. Bill Price served as Chief Financial Officer at Albiorex International Holding Company.

Mr. Blake Smith was the Founder & served as President at Smith Engineering (Consulting Services). Mr. Smith founded SMITH Engineering in October 2008 and continues his vision of excellence with the steady and strategic growth of the firm. He is an active member of the Northern Virginia Building Industry Association (NVBIA) and has contributed to the work of NVBIA's Fairfax, Loudoun and Prince William councils. Mr. Smith is also a member of the National Association of Home Builders (NAHB). From 2008 to 2011, Mr. Smith served on the Executive Board of Directors of the Engineers and Surveyors Institute (ESI), serving as Chairman in 2010. He remains active as a Designated Plans Examiner (DPE) in Fairfax and Loudoun Counties and continues to sit on the ESI Board of Directors. Throughout his career, Mr. Smith has participated on many local industry committees, including the Board-appointed Facilities Standards Manual (FSM) Committee in Loudoun County.
Mr. Bob McIlvaine served as Chief Executive Officer at The Royal Group.
Mr. Boudewijn Wentink serves as Board Member at Royal IHC.

primary_position: Vice President & Chief Information Security Officer
biography: Mr. Brad Bielawski serves as Vice President & Chief Information Security Officer at The IHC Group.

Mr. Brad Bielawski serves as Chief Information Security Officer at Independence Pet Group. He is a seasoned information security professional with extensive experience in leadership roles. He previously held various senior positions at The IHC Group, including VP and Chief Information Security Officer, as well as IT Security & Audit Manager. Earlier in his career, roles included IT Manager at Madison National Life, Network Administrator at Standard Security Life Insurance Company of New York, and IT Consultant at Advantech Consulting. He also worked as a Network Representative at Progressive Insurance and a Claims Adjuster at The Hartford. He earned a Bachelor of Arts degree in Psychology from the University of Connecticut.

primary_position: Chief Privacy Officer and Vice President of Legal
biography: Mr. Brad Neufeld serves as Chief Privacy Officer and Vice President of Legal at Dynacare. He joined Dynacare in 2007 and was appointed to his current position in 2008 bringing with him extensive experience in corporate law, regulatory compliance and litigation roles across several industries. He was called to the Bar in Ontario in 2002 and began his legal career in private practice at a large boutique law firm in Toronto. Prior to joining Dynacare, He served as corporate counsel to Telus Communications, Royal Group Technologies Ltd. and Zurich Insurance Company. In addition to a Bachelor of Commerce degree from McGill University, He also holds a Bachelor of Laws degree and a Master of Business Administration degree from the University of Windsor.
Mr. Brad Smith serves as Board Member at G42. Mr. Brad Smith serves as President at Microsoft.

Mr. Bram Roelse served as Chief Executive Officer at Royal IHC. In this role, Mr Roelse has used his in-depth knowledge and experience to determine and roll out the IHC2020 strategy under difficult market conditions. The Supervisory Board is extremely grateful for this and his enormous contribution to IHC over the past 16 years.
Ms. Brenda Dvorak serves as Division Director at SNI Companies.

Mr. Brian Pearson is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer & President at American Benefits Exchange. Mr. Pearson has served in multiple capacities in the insurance industry for nearly 30 years. Prior to joining the executive leadership team, he owned and operated Pearson & Associates which specialized in servicing active duty military members worldwide until joining Madison National Life Insurance Company, Inc. in 2000 as National Sales Manager. In 2004 he was promoted to Vice President and Director of Agencies and eventually became a SVP and Chief Marketing Officer. Mr. Pearson lead the development of specialty markets for Madison National Life which included military, federal and state government employees while overseeing the distribution of insurance and annuity products, which supplement existing government benefit plans. In addition, special emphasis on final expense and marketing to school teachers and small businesses. In 2008, he founded the IHC Financial Group, Inc. which is an IMO and a wholly owned subsidiary of Madison National Life Insurance Company. In 2016, Mr. Pearson along with an executive team of investors purchased IHC Financial Group, Inc. and re-branded the firm as the American Benefits Exchange, LLC where he now serves as President & CEO. While serving in this capacity, he is responsible for recruiting, training and overseeing licensed field agents across the United States and directs the development of relationships with various insurance carriers, government personnel, unions, associations and employee organizations. In addition to his executive leadership at American Benefits Exchange, he serves as Auxiliary Coach with the Round Rock Express, AAA Affiliate of the Texas Rangers Baseball Club and is an active Board Member at Celebration Church. He received his Bachelor of Arts (BA) degree in Pre-Law Studies at the University of Cincinnati in 1990.

primary_position: Chief Financial Officer & Chief Operating Officer
biography: Mr. Brijesh Shah serves as Chief Financial Officer & Chief Operating Officer at APM Capital. He has worked extensively with regulated firms across the UAE's Onshore and Offshore Financial Free Zones, including DIFC/DFSA, ADGM/FSRA, and DMCC/SCA. His expertise spans finance, compliance/AML, market operations, regulatory reporting, investment banking, trading strategies, and tax planning. He has held senior roles at Aarna Capital, Finior Capital, PhillipCapital, Capital Investment International, MF Global, Moneycare DMCC, SS&C GlobeOp, and Rushabh Management Services Pvt. Ltd, and K N Shah & Associates. He demonstrates strong leadership, process enhancement, and risk mitigation capabilities, with proficiency in financial tools like MS Excel. He holds an MBA from Coventry University, a Securities & Investment Operations Certificate (UAE) from CISI - London, a Securities Intermediation Compliance Officer certification from NISM-India, a CA from ICAI, a Diploma in Business Finance from ICFAI, and multiple certifications from NCFM and ICAI in mutual funds, derivatives, commodities, and investment strategies.

primary_position: Chief Financial Officer, Director of Finance & Board Member
biography: Mr. Budi Legowo served as Chief Financial Officer, Director of Finance & Risk Management and Board Member at Pertamedika IHC. He served as Managing Director of Finance and Accounting & Board Member at Siloam International Hospitals.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Co-Chief Executive Officer, Chairman & Chief Medical Officer
biography: Dr. Carl Harrell is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer, Chairman & CMO of Regener-Eyes. He founded and served as Chairman, Chief Medical Officer, and Chief Executive Officer at Albiorex International Holding Company. He has worked for over 30 years to become a pioneer and visionary in the field of regenerative medicine where his discoveries and patented platform technologies in the study of Type III human collagen, stem cells, pericytes, and novel bioengineered placental-derived biomaterials have led to the developments of first in class clinically proven regenerative medicine therapies. Dr. Harrell started his career as a research scientist at Emory University, studying immunology. He was recruited after medical school by Dr. Michael E DeBakey, the Father of Cardiovascular Surgery, to study at the largest medical center in the world, the Texas Medical Center. He did his general surgery and plastic surgery training there as well as ran a large burn and wound unit at the Michael E. DeBakey VA. Dr. Harrell also did a research fellowship in regenerative medicine where he developed the first patented regenerative human Type III Human collagen dermal filler. He is a Board Certified Plastic Surgeon and a member of ASPS and ASAPS. Dr. Harrell has co-authored numerous scientific papers and books about regenerative medicine and has lectured extensively in the US and Internationally. He also has multiple issued novel patents in the field of regenerative medicine. Dr. Harrell was nominated for the Nobel Peace Prize for his medical missionary work in Central America.

Dr. Carlos Belmonte is a Co-Founder and serves as Advisor at Innerva Pharmaceuticals. Dr. Belmonte co-founded Avizorex Pharma. He obtained his MD and PhD degrees at the University of Madrid, Spain. He is presently a Professor of Human Physiology at the Medical School, University Miguel Hernandez and a senior researcher at the Neurosciences Institute of Alicante. He is ex-President of the International Brain Research Organization, a member of the Academia Europaea and of the National Academy of Sciences of Spain and Doctor Honoris Causa of the University of Castilla la Mancha. He has been Director of the Department of Physiology and Vice-dean at the Medical School, University of Valladolid and served as Vice President for Academic Affairs and as Dean of the Medical School at the University of Alicante upon its foundation. He created and directed the Department of Physiology at the University of Alicante and in 1990 the Institute of Neurosciences, a Joint Center of the National Research Council (CSIC) and the University Miguel Hernandez, which he directed continuously until his voluntary resignation in 2007. He has been a Visiting Professor at the Universities of Harvard and Utah, an Adjunct Professor of Ophthalmology at the University of Utah, the Eye Research Institute of the Retina Foundation and a Visiting Scientist at the Prince of Wales Medical Research Institute of New South Wales University in Australia. Professor Carlos Belmonte has been awarded in Spain with the National Research Award "Rey Jaime I", the National Prize for Biology and Biomedicine "Severo Ochoa" and the National Award in Medicine "Gregorio Marañón" among others and the Endre Balazs Prize of the International Society for Eye Research, the European Vision Award of the European Vision Institute, Special Honoree of the ARVO Foundation for his outstanding contribution to vision and ophthalmology. He is an internationally recognized expert in neurosciences, particularly in ocular innervation and pain and is the author of more than 150 scientific articles and 20 book chapters.

Mr. Carlos Flores serves as Interim Chief Financial Officer at Uncle Nearest. He has done a Master of Business Administration from Northwestern University's Kellogg School of Management. Their background reflects a strong focus on financial and operational leadership, coupled with investment acumen developed across diverse industries. As Managing Partner at Fractional CFO and COO, Startup Builders, he provided fractional CFO and COO services, leveraging strategy, operational, financial, and technical capabilities. Their work history includes serving as Chief Financial Officer & Chief Operating Officer for Fame Partners, an apparel and accessories retailer, and CUPPLS.com, a provider of therapy, legal, and financial advisory services. Earlier, they held the role of Chief Financial Officer at Satoshi Capital Advisors, where they developed financial plans and valuation models for cryptocurrency funds, which was instrumental in attracting investors. They also served as Chief Financial Officer & Chief Operating Officer at InMatch. Their investment acumen is further demonstrated by their role as Managing Director, Investor at Golden Seeds, a venture capital firm, and as an Investor and Mentor at New York University. Before this, he co-founded Deal Flow Partners and served as a Member of the Board of Directors and Advisors at Seed Group, facilitating strategic alliances with global companies in the Middle East and North Africa region. His career also encompasses significant management consulting expertise. At Booz Allen Hamilton, they served as Principal, twice winning the Professional Excellence Award. Their responsibilities included business development, leading management consulting teams, and intellectual capital development. Earlier in their career, he held the position of Practice, Telecommunications Leader at Roland Berger and Partner and Vice President at Adventis. They began their career as a Member of Technical Staff at Bell Labs. He holds a Master of Business Administration from Northwestern University - Kellogg School of Management, as well as Bachelor's and Master's degrees from Stevens Institute of Technology. They also hold a certification in OpenAI GPTs: Creating Your Custom AI Assistants from Vanderbilt University.

Ms. Carola de Bie serves as Chief Financial Officer at Dümmen Orange. She joined Dümmen Orange as Head of Group Control in 2019, where she further professionalized the finance team. In 2024, Carola joined the Executive Committee as CFO, and in that role, she is responsible for Finance, Treasury, and Tax. Before joining Dümmen Orange, Carola gained years of experience as an auditor of large international companies at KPMG and subsequently as Group Controller at Royal IHC.Carola holds a master's and postgraduate master's degree in Accountancy from Nyenrode Business University (Certified Public Accountant).Carola is married and has two children. Outside of working hours, she enjoys spending time with her family and friends

Ms. Carrie DiMarzio is a Co-Founder & serves as CEO at BMI OrganBank. She has dedicated her career to advancing science and engineering through transformative leadership. She currently serves as CEO of BMI OrganBank®, where she leads a multidisciplinary team pioneering technologies in organ perfusion and preservation to improve transplantation outcomes and enable cutting-edge ex vivo research-efforts with the potential to save thousands of lives. Under her leadership, BMI OrganBank has established key partnerships with leading institutions including the Wake Forest Institute for Regenerative Medicine (WFIRM), Lawrence Livermore National Laboratory (LLNL), Duke Ex-Vivo Organ Laboratory (DEVOL), the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation, and the RegenMed Development Organization (ReMDO), where she also serves on the Executive Leadership Council Board. Additional strategic collaborations include Atrium Health's Division of Abdominal Transplant, the University of North Carolina (UNC), and the Regenerative Medicine Engine in North Carolina, a program funded by the National Science Foundation (NSF). During the COVID-19 pandemic, she led BMI OrganBank's successful emergency response efforts, guiding the development and FDA Emergency Use Authorization (EUA) approval of the SuppleVent™ ventilator in record time. She is currently steering OrganBank®, the company's proprietary organ preservation system, through the FDA clearance process. Before joining BMI OrganBank, she served as CEO of Industrial Hard Carbon LLC (IHC), a precision engineering company supporting the biomedical, aerospace, and automotive industries with advanced surface coating technologies. Her experience at IHC-leading technical teams, overseeing quality systems, and cultivating strategic partnerships-laid a strong foundation for her work in biomedical innovation. She brings deep business insight in process and capital efficiency, strategic partnerships, and human capital development. She is recognized for her operational rigor, unwavering commitment to mission and team, and her ability to lead organizations through complex landscapes.

Ms. Celia Li serves as Chief Marketing Officer at Drylab. Prior to joining the company, she served as Chief Marketing Officer and Board Member at Media Tech SPAC. Ms. Li is an international media executive and renowned TV presenter for the world's largest independent Chinese TV broadcaster Phoenix Satellite Television Holdings Ltd. Prior to Phoenix Ms. Li worked as a producer at the BBC World Service. Ms. Li set up Phoenix TV's European news division in 2004 where she heads the news team. During her broadcast career, she has conducted numerous interviews with high-profile individuals from Royal Families, global business, and political domains, including interviews with former British Prime Minister Tony Blair, HRH Prince of Wales, HRH Duke of York, Sir Richard Branson, and Rupert Murdoch. Ms. Li also has extensive experience in marketing and investor relations. She has built up the past 15 years substantial relationships with both corporations and investors across Asia, Europe, and North America.
Mr. Cem Yurdakul serves as Chief Executive Officer & Partner at SNI.

primary_position: Principal Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Nhuvahs & Treasurer
biography: Mr. Charles Coder served as Principal Officer, Chief Financial Officer, Nhuvahs & Treasurer at Novant Health UVA Health System. He is responsible for financial operations of the entire joint operating company which includes Culpeper Medical Center, Haymarket Medical Center and Prince William Medical Center, as well as the System's three ambulatory surgery centers, multiple employed physician clinics throughout the region, imaging facilities, Novant Health UVA Health System Cancer Center and Novant Health UVA Health System Caton Merchant House, an assisted living facility. Since joining Novant Health UVA Health System in April of 2016, Coder has served as the primary financial liaison to both parent partner organizations. Prior to joining Novant Health UVA Health System, Coder held executive financial leadership roles with healthcare systems across the country. At Community Health System, Coder served as market chief financial officer of the Virginia Region where he was responsible for all financial operations of the system's three Virginia hospitals. Coder also previously served as chief financial officer for South Baldwin Regional Medical Center in Foley, Alabama, and chief financial officer at Spring Hill Regional Hospital in Spring Hill, Florida. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Accounting and a Master of Business Administration from the University of West Florida.

Mr. Choi Hong-jun served as Chief Operating Officer at VA Corporation. He serves as CEO at Wethecore and former Director of The Seed Group. He served as Team Leader at KG Engineering New Business Development TF.

Mr. Wilmot served as Chairman at Aviance Ghana. He is President and Chief Executive Officer of WCW International Holding Company and Chairman of Aviance Ghana. He has extensive experience in the oil and gas industry and international business development. As Chief Executive Officer, he is responsible for corporate planning, financial acquisition, and new business development. Chris assists United States Fortune 500 companies and Global companies with negotiations regarding business opportunities in various African countries. Prior to establishing WCW International. Chris began his career in Houston, Texas as an engineer, production supervisor and held senior level management positions at Atlantic Richfield (ARCO), a major oil and gas company. His responsibilities included down hole and upstream operations, managing project budgets of up to $550 million dollars. Chris supervised major construction & program management, facilities and maintenance operations for ARCO's South Texas Seven Sisters project, Barbara's Hill engineering and construction management, Dickinson construction management, as well as handled ARCO's South Texas District United States Federal environmental regulations. Chris is currently involved as a strategic alliance partner with several major United States consulting, engineering, energy, management and security operation firms. Chris serves on numerous commissions and boards. He was a delegate to the United States Overseas Private Investment Corporation (OPIC) and the United States Agency for International Development (USAID) Trade and Investment Missions to Ghana, Cote D'Ivoire, The Gambia and Senegal. Member of the Supervisory Board of the World Trade Division Greater Houston Partnership, member of the Board of Directors of Congressman Mickey Leland Kibbutzim Foundation, and a Commissioner of the Houston Clean City Commission. Chris was the Chairman of the Mayor's International Affairs Development Council - Africa 2007-2008. He also serves as a Member of the Board of Directors for the Greater Houston Partnership and former Chairman of the Board Greater Houston Convention & Visitors Bureau 2004-2005. Chris serves as Chairman of the Greater Houston Partnership World Bank Task Force.Mr. Wilmot graduated as an Electrical Engineer from Tuskegee University, Alabama. A member of SPE, ASME, IEEE.

Mr. Christian Schütte serves as Chief Financial Officer at Crocus Labs. Mr. Christian Schütte served as Managing Director at High Tech Private Equity. Mr. Christian Schütte served as Supervisory Board Member at Vertilas. He was the Managing Director of High Tech PrivateEquity in Düsseldorf and is also on the supervisory board of Elcos, IPAG and Cor Pumps and Compressors. As an engineer with a degree in electrical engineering and economics, he also worked at an engineering consulting company, was employed for four years at an international holding company for the financing of buyouts of medium-sized companies and has been working for the last two years at High Tech Private Equity, which has been focusing on equity investments in technology companies.

Dr. Christopher Jackson is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Scientific Officer at ViewsML. He is a Co-inventor of virtual IHC technology, clinical pathologist, and AI computer scientist. Massachusetts General Hospital, Dartmouth Hitchcock Medical Center.

primary_position: Chief Technology Officer, Technical Advisor & Board Member
biography: Mr. Colin Toombs serves as Chief Technology Officer, Technical Advisor & Board Member at Vortex Biosciences. He is a Chartered Mechanical Engineer with a first-class degree from Imperial College London. He has over 30 years experience in developing products and processes across a range of industries, and in particular medical devices and in-vitro diagnostics. He was previously VP R&D at QuantuMDx responsible for developing their Q-POC and SARS-CoV-2 assay which was launched in response to the COVID-19 pandemic. Prior to that he was Director of Product Development for Thermo Fisher Scientific's anatomical pathology products developing a full suite of tissue diagnostic equipment including IHC oncology assays. He has also worked in product design consulting and developed high-throughput drug discovery systems. He is a creative problem-solving engineer and R&D technology leader passionate about delivering innovative new technologies to commercial success.
Ms. Colleen Maggi serves as Chief Financial Officer at The IHC Group.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Craig Benson is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at 4E Therapeutics. Mr. Craig Benson served as the President at Myriad Genetics. He joined Rules-Based Medicine, Inc. in January 2002 to direct its spin-off from Luminex Corporation. Until 2004, Mr. Benson also served as Chairman of the Board for Equity Resource Partners, LLC, a private investment company. From 1987 through September 2000, he was employed by Service Corporation International (NYSE: SCI), the world leader in death care-related services. During his tenure with SCI, he held various senior executive management positions, which included domestic and international merger and acquisition responsibilities, Vice-President of Marketing and Corporate Alliances, as well as President of SCI International, Ltd., SCI's International holding company. He received a BBA degree from Southern Methodist University in 1984.

Mr. Cyrus Guzder served as Chairman & Managing Director at AFL Group. He is a leading business house in global logistics and expresses courier services and international freight forwarding, He is an M.A. (Honours) in Economics & Oriental Studies from Trinity College, Cambridge University, U.K. He began his career in 1967 with ICICI, before moving to AFL Private Limited, then known as Airfreight Limited, in 1971. He is a Board Member at Mahindra Holidays & Resorts India. Since 1985 he has been the organization's Chairman & Managing Director. For 25 years till October 2003, he was also heading the DHL Worldwide Express operations in India, then a 100% owned business division of AFL Private Limited. The AFL Group today comprises AFL Logistics, a leader in Logistics and Domestic Distribution; AFL WiZ Express, offering international and domestic Express Courier services; AFL DACHSER (A JV between AFL and DACHSER GmbH & Co. KG.) offering International Freight Forwarding and, its latest venture, Cartridge World, as a master franchisee in the Indian sub-continent, for the world's largest toner replacement and cartridge refilling company. He is a Director on the Board of several companies including BP (India) Limited, the Great Eastern Shipping Company Limited, Mahindra Holidays & Resorts Limited and Carlson Wagonlit Travel India Private Limited. He is the Honorary Consul General of the Republic of Ireland for Mumbai and Western India. He is also a Member of the Board of Governors of The Reserve Bank of India's Board of Banking Codes and Standards of India (BCSBI) and a member of the Board of Governors of the Indian Institute of Information Technology and Management, Gwalior. Previously, he was also a Director on the Boards of several other companies including Air India, Tata Infomedia, Tata Honeywell and Alfa Laval. He was a Member of, the Indian Advisory Board, Barclays Bank plc, India from 1993 - 97. He was also Chairman, of the Confederation of Indian Industries (CII)'s National Committee on Transportation and Logistics. He was earlier President of, the Air Cargo Agents Association of India from 1977-79; President, of the Travel Agents Association of India, from 1983-85; Director of, Board of the Universal Federation of Travel Agents Association (UFTAA) based in Monaco, 1986-93; Chairman, Express Industry Council of India, 1987-92; and a Founder Member, World Travel and Tourism Council (WTTC), India Initiative. Outside of business, he is associated with several causes of public importance and has outspoken views on issues of public concern in social life.
