He co-founded the Bombay Environmental Action Group, which has successfully fought several public interest litigations for the preservation of the environment in Mumbai. He was formerly an Executive Committee Member of the Bombay Natural History Society and has been active in efforts to protect the natural habitat in Mahabaleshwar and Matheran, a vital eco-sensitive area in Western India. He is also an active heritage conservationist. He set up the first chapter of the Indian Heritage Society in Mumbai and, thereafter, the Mumbai Chapter of the INTACH foundation in Mumbai. As a member of the Mumbai City Heritage Conservation Committee of the Municipal Corporation of Greater Mumbai (BMC), he played an active role in the conservation of the heritage buildings and precincts in Mumbai. He was a former Trustee of the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Vastu Sangrahalaya (formerly known as the Prince of Wales Museum), nominated by the Government of Maharashtra, a member of the Board of Governors of the Mumbai Metropolitan Region Development Authority's Heritage Conservation Society and since 2009 has been re-nominated by Government of Maharashtra as a member of the Mumbai Heritage Conservation Committee.

primary_position: Chief Operating Officer & Chief Financial Officer
biography: Mr. Dan Walsh serves as Chief Operating Officer & Chief Financial Officer at SNI Companies.

Mr. Daniel Dubois is a Co-Founder and serves as President at Key (Real Estate Services (B2C)). Mr. Dubois founded at Guiides. He is also an Advisor at Animo. He previously founded and served as Chief Executive Officer at ShareShed. He serves as a General Partner at Side Door Ventures. He also served as an Advisor at Autumn AI. After creating, building, and selling his last two venture-backed companies (guiides.com and ShareShed), he joined Airbnb full-time, where he led and managed growth in their top-tier markets. His entrepreneurial talents have been recognized with the Top 30 Under 30 Award, Canada's Top Student Entrepreneur Award, and among the top three student entrepreneurs globally by the Entrepreneurs' Organization. He was named a Canadian Delegate and speaker for the G20 Young Entrepreneurs Alliance Summit and had the unique privilege of being invited for one-on-one meetings with world leaders, including Kofi Annan, Justin Trudeau, and Prince William. He has also directed a film series on the sharing economy, and spoke in front of 20,000 youth at WeDay, sharing a stage with the Dali Lama, Al Gore, and Martin Luther King III.

primary_position: Chief Executive Officer, President & Board Member
biography: Mr. Daniel Forche serves as Chief Executive Officer, President & Board Member at PreludeDx. Dan's 20-plus years of operational and commercial diagnostic experience includes positions with medical device, lab services, and molecular testing companies. Before joining PreludeDx, he was President of Pathnostics, a full-service cancer diagnostics company providing clinical and molecular pathology testing services throughout the U.S. Previous positions included General Manager of Abbott Laboratories' oncology lab company, where he oversaw P&L and designed growth strategies that led to Abbott's successful sale of PersonalizeDx; Vice President of Sales and Marketing for CombiMatrix Corporation, a national provider of molecular diagnostic services, where He developed and executed key sales and marketing initiatives; and Senior Vice President of Sales and Marketing of Netherlands-based Agendia Inc., a genomics company with the first FDA-cleared IVDMIA test (MammaPrint) for breast cancer recurrence, with Dan responsible for opening and building US operations. Earlier positions included Senior Vice President of Sales and Marketing for Insight Health Corp., a national provider of diagnostics imaging services with annual revenues of $285 MM; various roles, including Vice President of Marketing and Oncology Sales, for US LABS, where Dan was instrumental in strategies that grew revenue from $3 MM in 2000 to more than $75 MM in 2004; Worldwide Marketing Manager for Ventana Medical Systems, a manufacturer and developer of automated immunochemistry systems for cancer testing, where Dan launched the BenchMark system, today's leader for IHC testing. US LABS was sold to LabCorp for $160 MM in 2005. Ventana was sold to Roche for $3.4 BB in 2008. Dan began his career in medical diagnostics with Abbott Laboratories. He received a B.S.B.A. in marketing from Central Michigan University College of Business.

Mr. Daniel Mangan is a Co-Founder snd serves as Vice President, Business Development at Side Door. He is a two-time JUNO award winning & two-time Polaris Music Prize listed musician and songwriter. With Jesse Zubot, he scored Hector And The Search For Happiness, a feature film starring Simon Pegg. Dan has also infrequently been a contributing writer for some publications such as Huffington Post Canada, Montecristo Magazine and The Guardian (Arts section). Mangan has performed three concerts with Symphony Nova Scotia, on Parliament Hill in Ottawa for Prince William and Duchess Kate, and has spent more than a decade playing dozens of marquee festivals and extensively touring in North America, Europe, the UK and Australia. Dan got his start playing house concerts and small, intimate shows and he knows the value that brings. He began a house concert network for artists on his label in 2015. This caught the imaginations of so many that it has now expanded into Side Door.

Mr. Daniel Siger served as Chief Technology Officer at Exitus Technologies. He has over two decades of experience in technology, including web, application, and mobile development, Dan has worked with dozens of enterprise clients to bring digital products and services to life. From games to global training platforms, he has lead teams and projects of all sizes.

Mr. Dave Heyde served as Chief Executive Officer at Royal IHC. He served as Board Member at Fraser Hydraulic Power. He has been with the company since 15 December 2011. Mr. Heyde began his career in the financial sector at the Belgische Kredietbank NV. He then went on to work for the Jan De Nul Group, where he acquired extensive knowledge of the markets in which IHC operates. Before becoming CEO on 1 September 2016, he was IHC's CFO.

Mr. David Allan is a Founder & serves as Chief Executive Officer at Cysiam. Previously, Mr. Allan served as Managing Director & Chief Technology Officer at Cysiam. Prior to founding CYSIAM, he was employed by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office (FCDO) following a military career in special communications. He is a globally-recognised expert in cyber capacity building and has received the Prince of Wales award for his work in this area. He has done BS (Bachelor of Science) in Politics, Economics from The Open University.

primary_position: Senior Vice President, Southern Table Grape and Packing Operations
biography:
Mr. David Fenn served as Senior Vice President, Southern Table Grape and Packing Operations at Sun World International. Named to his current position in December 2003, he is responsible for farming and packing operations for Sun World in the Coachella Valley.Previously, he lived in Egypt with his family and managed Sun World's new Egyptian farming enterprise, a 100,000 acre venture in partnership with his Royal Highness Prince Alwaleed Bin Talal Bin Abdulaziz Alsaud and the Government of Egypt. He was responsible for the development phase of up to 100,000 acres in the South Valley of Egypt. Before that, he oversaw the company's citrus and table grape operations in the Coachella and Cadiz valleys of Southern California. He has a wealth of industry experience, which ranges from his previous service at Sun World's San Joaquin Valley operations and at Santa Rosa Ranches to his role as Executive Vice President of Operations for California Grapevine Nursery in Napa. He is a 1991 graduate of the California Agricultural Leadership Program. He graduated from the University of Arizona in 1981, earning a B.S. in Agricultural Economics and was the recipient of a full scholarship from Santa Rosa Ranches to attend the University of California at Davis where he attained his Master's Degree in Viticulture in 1982.
He was born and reared in Mexico and is bilingual and bicultural. He, his wife Kathy, and four children currently reside in La Quinta.

Mr. David Gudmundson serves as Chief Financial Officer at Source Nutraceutical. As CFO, He is a chartered professional accountant (CPA) and certified management accountant (CMA 2000) with 30 years of experience. He is responsible for all corporate services within SNI, including HR, IT, and Finance. His most recent certification, Lean 6 Sigma Green Belt (2022), enhances his skillset to manage corporate services, an area of specialty of his for almost 15 years. He earned his diploma from Red River College in 1992 graduating with hours and being awarded the top CMA entrance award.

Mr. David Harris served as Vice President at Integrated Support Decision. Dave has over 28 years of transportation industry experience. He manages the Sales Team and is responsible for all client-server sales. Prior to joining IDSC in 1998, Dave held the following positions: General Manager, Baylor Trucking Inc.; Vice President Information Services, D.M. Bowman, Inc.; Manager Technical Support, Schneider National Inc. While at Schneider National Inc., Dave was the leader of the Information Services project to combine all SNI companies into a single Transportation Management System. He also led the opening of the West Memphis Operations center. Dave developed numerous operational tools for the improvement of utilization and On-time service management winning him the recognition at Schneider National as "The Tool Maker". In his career, Dave has consulted with over 100 carriers on technology and operations issues. Dave served two years on the ATA Technology Council Board of Directors and is a frequent invited speaker at industry conferences.

primary_position: Chief Operating Officer, President & Board Member
biography: Mr. David Kettig serves as Vice Chairman at Independence Pet Group. Previously, he served as President, Chief Operating Officer and Board Member at Independence Holding. He has served IHC in various capacities since 1992. In addition, he serves as Director at Independence American Insurance Company and Chairman and Chief Executive Officer at Standard Security Life Insurance Company of New York. He is also President and Chief Executive Officer of IHC Specialty Benefits. He is a frequent contributor to trade publications and is a regular speaker at industry events on trends in the health insurance industry and the future of healthcare policy in the United States. Before joining IHC, he practiced law with a large firm based in New York City. He holds a law degree from Cornell Law School and is a graduate of Hamilton College.

Mr. David Robinson served as Chairman at PD Ports. He serves as a Board Member at TT Club Mutual Insurance. He joined the company in August 2002 as Managing Director of Teesport. He started his port career at the Port of Felixstowe and in 1994 he went to Hong Kong to manage the Hutchison Port Holdings container operations in that territory. During this period he led a major expansion programme and helped create what is now the world's largest container terminal. He was appointed Chief Executive Officer of PD Ports in 2006. In the last 12 years, he has steered the Company through some tough challenges including a difficult recession. Under his direction, the company has continued to invest in both its people and infrastructure, with more than £80M invested into expanding and enhancing the operational platform at Teesport. This investment has driven the Port's development and positioned PD Ports at the heart of growth in the UK ports sector and the Northeast economy. Due to his passionate commitment to the maritime sector, he was awarded an MBE in the New Year's Honours List in 2015 for services to international trade and the UK economy. Following his appointment as Regional Ambassador to HRH the Prince of Wales in 2012, his vision and drive to raise aspirations and improve employment prospects for young people in the maritime industry led to the creation of the High Tide Foundation in the same year. The High Tide Foundation was co-founded by PD Ports and Casper Shipping and through Charity's bespoke programmes has doubled its output year on year since 2013. He was appointed Chairman of the High Tide Foundation in 2016. In March 2017, he was appointed Director of Operations within the Brookfield Infrastructure European team and will become PD Ports Chairman.

Mr. David Scott serves as Advisor at Protium. David is the co-founder and Chair of Tribe Impact Capital, the UK's first dedicated Impact Wealth Manager. He believes that investing into businesses that seek to create a positive impact for all stakeholders, including society and the environment will produce superior financial returns over the medium to long term. Prior to Tribe, he founded Vestra Wealth in 2008, growing the business from zero to £16bn of assets under management at the end of 2020, when the Liechtenstein Princely family through the LGT Group bought the remaining share in LGT Vestra. He was previously a co-founder of Scott Goodman Harris, which he sold to UBS in 2004. He is also a non-executive director of Bulb Energy, one of the UK's largest energy suppliers, which has grown from a standing start to 1.7 million customers in the last 5 years. He is also a serial investor into early stage start ups.

Mr. David Summers served as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman at Virginia Heritage Bank. He has served as Chief Executive Officer since May 2007 and Chairman of the Board since September 2007. Mr. Summers most recently served on the Board of Directors and as an Executive Vice President of Mercantile Safe Deposit & Trust Company from 2005 to 2007. He was formerly President and CEO and a member of the Board of Directors of Community Bank of Northern Virginia (CBNV) for 13 years up until the sale of CBNV to Mercantile Bankshares Corporation in May 2005. At the time of the sale, CBNV had assets totaling approximately $900 million with 14 branch offices located in Fairfax City, Fairfax, Loudoun and Prince William counties. Prior to his employment with CBNV, Mr. Summers spent 11 years with Dominion Bank of Greater Washington. Mr. Summers earned his Bachelor of Science degree in Accounting at Virginia Tech. Mr. Summers is a Certified Public Accountant.

Dr. David Tacha Co-Founded and served as Chief Scientific Officer at Biocare Medical (California). He has been an integral part of Biocare Medical since its inception as the Vice President of Immunohistochemistry and related activities. He has developed the majority of products at Biocare Medical including PIN-4 and ADH-5, multiplex IHC technology, two-step polymer technology and mouse and rat polymer kits. Dr. Tacha has numerous publications, patents, national and international speaking engagements.

Mr. David Willcutts served as Chief Executive Officer at The Emily Program. He served as Chief Executive Officer at Veritas Collaborative. He is an accomplished healthcare executive whose career includes over 25 years leading organizations in a range of multi-site healthcare services, including specialty pharmaceuticals, home care services, radiology, managed care services and most recently, behavioral health. He founded and served as the CEO and Chairman of Ancillary Care Management, which was honored on the Inc500 list of the fastest-growing companies in the US, debuting on the list at number 9 in 2006 and 115th in 2007. He has also served as CEO of ONRAD, a full-service Radiology Provider offering physician services in 33 states and as President of Univita Healthcare's Integrated Home Care business unit (IHC), a 200 million dollar provider of home care services under exclusive managed care contracts.

Mr. David Wright serves as Advisory Board Member at GG56. He is a former British diplomat who served as the British ambassador to the Republic of Korea (1990-1994) and Japan (1996-1999). Currently, he is the Chairman of Skarbek Associates, Non-Executive Director of Rezolve, Vice-President of the China-Britain Business Council, a member of the International Advisory Board of All Nippon Airways, and a Governor of the Royal Shakespeare Company. He also serves as Chair of the Korean British Business Council. During his career, he was Private Secretary to HRH The Prince of Wales, the first CEO of British Trade International, and Vice-Chairman at Barclays.

primary_position: President of Governance and HR Committee & Board Member
biography: Ms. Denise Amyot serves as President of Governance and HR Committee & Board Member at LCI Education. She serves as Board Member at Qatar Foundation Endowment. She served as Board Member at Ontario Trillium Foundation. Denise Amyot has an outstanding record of public service. She is the President and CEO of Colleges and Institutes Canada (formerly ACCC), the voice of Canada's publicly supported colleges, institutes and polytechnics. It works with industry and social sectors to train 1.5 million learners at campuses serving over 3,000 communities in Canada. Denise was most recently the President and CEO of the Canada Science and Technology Museums Corporation, a federal crown corporation including three national museums - the Canada Agriculture and Food Museum, the Canada Aviation and Space Museum, and the Canada Science and Technology Museum. She also served as Senior Vice-President of the Leadership and Talent Management Sector at the Canada Public Service Agency (now Treasury Board). She has worked in several federal departments including Human Resources Development Canada, National Defence, Natural Resources Canada, Canadian Heritage, and the Public Service Commission. In her former two roles as Assistant Deputy Minister, she was respectively responsible for the corporate management services as well as public affairs and ministerial services. In a volunteer capacity, she is Chair of the World Federation of Colleges and Polytechnics and the Chair of the Advisory Committee of the Institute of Science, Society and Policy (ISSP). She sits on the Human Resources Policy Committee of the Chamber of Commerce and on the Advisory Council of the Schulich Centre for Excellence in Public Management, Western University. Denise is the past President of the Institute of Public Administration of Canada, past Vice-President of the Head of Federal Agencies Steering Committee, past member of the Boards of Governors at Algonquin College and at the University of Ottawa, member of the Editorial Board of the Canadian Government Executive magazine. She is also the former President of the Association of Professional Executives of the Public Service of Canada and former President of the Communications Community Office. She also was a Director for Regroupement des gens d'affaires, and an active member of United Way Committees and Director of a foundation. The recipient of several awards in leadership, Denise holds a Master's degree in Education and three Bachelor degrees in Biology, Arts and in Education.

primary_position: Founder, Board Member & Chief Executive Officer
biography: Mr. Derk Hartman is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Green Metals Refining. An experienced battery metals and mining executive with a focus on metallurgy and project delivery. Previous roles include Director Strategy & Project Delivery at MET63, President & COO of Giyani Metals, Director EPC & Project Delivery at Royal IHC, and Co-Founder of three exploration companies.

Mr. Derk te Bokkel serves as Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at Royal IHC. Mr. te Bokkel will thereby take over from Jan-Pieter Klaver, who has held this role since 1 January 2022. Derk te Bokkel will combine his role as CEO with his current role as CFO. Jan-Pieter Klaver will remain a member of the Board of Directors until March 1, 2024, and will be responsible for Custom Vessels, Engineering, and Project Management, including managing the Boskalis Project Team. A new member of the Board of Directors is being sought who, as COO, will focus on further developing our shipbuilding capabilities, managing the yards, and, in parallel, realizing the build abroad strategy, in addition to building in the Netherlands.

Dr. Detlef Pohl serves as Board Member at Transparent Energy Systems. Dr. Detlef Pohl served as Director at Next47. Pohl serves as Nominee Director at Transparent Energy Systems. He joined the Munich office of Siemens Venture Capital (SVC) in 2008. His areas of focus include Siemens Sector Industry related investments in industrial automation, drive technologies, building technologies, lightning and mobility mainly in Europe. Prior to joining SVC, he managed the worldwide mergers and acquisitions transactions for different Siemens entities. From 2004-2006 he was managing director Mergers & Acquisitons of the Siemens Communication Group, the largest division with Euro 17 bn in sales. Dr. Pohl has experience as the managing director and CFO of a Russian/German joint venture and is acting as a member several Boards of Directors. Before that he was manager of strategic planning for SBS and Siemens Nixdorf Information Systems (SNI) and has more than 5 years of experience of hands-on project management in operations. In 2000 he was a founding member of the Siemens Business Services (SBS) Venture Capital team. Dr. Pohl obtained his Ph.D. diploma in information technology, with the performance analysis of digital networks from the University of Rostock, Germany. He also served as an Advisor at Power Plus Communications.

Mr. Dhanush Arjun is a Co-Founder & serves as a Board Member at eFunder. He also serves as Director of Private Equity at Lunate. He is responsible for executing the firm's direct private equity investment strategy. He brings over 15 years of experience to the firm. Prior to Lunate, He worked as a Director at Chimera Capital. Previously, he held roles at Channel VAS, Waha Capital, The National Investor, and KPMG. He holds an MBA from INSEAD and is a Chartered Accountant.

primary_position: Founder, Chief Operating Officer & Vice President, Engineering
biography: Dr. Dominic Paulraj Founded & served as Chief Operating Officer & Vice President, Engineering at Arada Systems. Previosuly, he also served as Chief Technical Officer at Linare Corporation.

Mr. Dominic Richards is a Co-Founder & serves as Chairman at Prosper Education. He is a community-focused place-maker who believes entrepreneurship should be a force for improving the quality of people's lives. Dominic was raised in Australia and England and educated at the University of Cambridge and the Prince of Wales Institute of Architecture. Motivated to better equip our next generation to embrace the opportunities of the future, Dominic sought to create a stimulating learning environment by leveraging cutting-edge technology platforms with time-honored educational foundations. He is realising this pursuit as the Chairman and co-founder of Prosper Education Ltd, a digital education initiative based in Sydney and London.

Ms. Donna Flory served as Board Member at Fauquier Bankshares. Ms. Flory is currently the Director of Human Resources for QMT Windchimes, a manufacturing company based in Manassas Park, Virginia. In addition, as an independent contractor, Ms. Flory provides financial support to the Industrial Development Authority of Prince William County, Virginia. Ms. Flory served as the Vice President of the Flory Small Business Development Center, Inc. (the Flory Center), located in Manassas, Virginia, from 1992 to 2019 and was responsible for financial operations, human resources, payroll, employee benefits and general operations. The Flory Center was a nonprofit organization that assisted small businesses and start-up entrepreneurs in accessing capital, developing business and marketing plans, and was a resource partner with the U.S. Small Business Administration. Ms. Flory also has significant experience in hospitality management, holding various management positions with Tysons Westpark Hotel and Ramada Inn from 1982 to 1989. Ms. Flory serves her community through leadership roles in the American Red Cross, Rotary International, March of Dimes and Bugles Across America. She is a Past President of Habitat for Humanity of Prince William County, and the cities of Manassas and Manassas Park, Virginia. Through her business and community involvement, Ms. Flory brings to the Board a diverse range of professional skills and relationships.
Douglas Dunsmuir served as the President and Chief Executive Officer of Royal Group Technologies.

Mr. Duncan Byatt served as a Board Member at PeopleCert. He has been with PeopleCert since 2017. He has been the Non-Executive Director of Axelos Ltd since 2013. He joined the Cabinet Office in 2012 as a Crown Commercial Lead for commercializing parts of the UK Government as part of the Better Business Models team in the Efficiency and Reform Group and within this capacity, he was responsible for the RFP that ended up in the creation of AXELOS. In early 2009, he was invited to be responsible for planning and strategic thinking behind the launch of The Foundation of Prince William and Prince Harry. He has a very rich investment career starting in 1984 and working in several investments and asset management firms, among which Eagle & Dominion Asset Management which he founded in 1998, and Bear Stearns Asset Management where he acted as a Senior Managing Director to establish institutional global growth equity team and develop investment products and investment processes. He has a BSc in Economics and Commercial Law from the University of Edinburgh.

Mr. Eduardo Roman serves as Managing Director, Institutional Relations at Global Private Capital Association. He oversees the organization's global membership and institutional investor network. He is also responsible for activities related to GPCA's Board of Directors, and Leadership Councils. Most recently, Eduardo was Chief Operating Officer at G42 Asset Management, a subsidiary of Abu Dhabi-based Artificial Intelligence and Cloud Computing company G42. He led the firm's non-investment activities including compliance of regulatory requirements, financial management and reporting, and relationships with external service providers. Prior to joining G42, Eduardo was Director of Research at LAVCA, where he was responsible for the delivery of research products and services to LAVCA's Members and to the Latin America private capital community. Before LAVCA, Eduardo was a Senior Research and Analytics Manager at Private Equity International (PEI), leading research and analytics teams in New York, London, and Hong Kong. Previously, Eduardo served as Head of Broadband Technology and Services at Entel, the largest Chilean telecommunications operator.

Mr. Edward Attwood serves as Chief Communications Officer at Arada Developments. Mr. Attwood heads up the public relations and corporate communications functions at the company and has been with the company since its inception. He also serves as Director of Communications at KBW Investments, one of the company's parent companies.
A former journalist and editor, he joined the company from ITP, the Middle East's largest publishing house, where he ran the Executive division. In that role, he oversaw leading consumer publication Arabian Business, as well as having responsibility for the editorial output for three other magazines and ITP Executive's sizeable annual roster of events and awards ceremonies. Before joining the Executive division of ITP, he edited and worked on a number of trade titles, including Construction Week and Aviation Business.
Prior to moving to the UAE in 2008, Edward worked as an editor on the Middle East desk for political and economic forecasting company Global Insight, which is now part of IHS Markit. He also served as a legal caseworker at a local regulatory authority in the UK. He holds an honors degree in English Literature from the University of Newcastle.

Ms. Elham Qasim served as Board Member at Cambridge Medical & Rehabilitation Center. Ms. Qasim is also a Non-Executive Board Member at Amanat Holdings PJSC ("Amanat"). She serves as Digital14's Chief Executive Officer, steering the organization's strategic direction, and leading over 1,000 staff in their purpose-driven work to deliver trust in digital so that clients can innovate and fulfil their potential. Prior to joining Digital14, she enjoyed a global career with executive roles in investment and asset management. More recently, she served as CEO of Abu Dhabi Investment Office (ADIO) and Executive Director of the Ghadan 21 programme at the Abu Dhabi Executive Office where she led the strategic planning for the government's three-year, AED 50 billion investment programme aimed at accelerating Abu Dhabi's economy. Prior to this, she was a Director of Mubadala Investment Company, focusing on Mubadala's Technology and Industry portfolio. Her responsibilities included building investment/entry strategy, business development, value creation, and post-acquisition asset management in sectors including Metals & Mining, Semiconductors, and Technology. During this time, she also served on the executive leadership team of Emirates Global Aluminium and delivered a two-year post-merger integration program. She has served on a number of boards and is currently a Board Member of publicly listed International Holding Company and the Khalifa Fund, a government-owned SME Fund. Her international career includes JPMorgan Investment Bank, where she was part of the Global Diversified Industrials Team based in London handling M&A transactions in chemicals, metals and mining, and infrastructure. She holds an MSc from the School of Social Policy at the London School of Economics and a Bachelor of Business from the American University in Dubai. In April 2010, she became the first Arab woman to ski to the North Pole.

Mr. Elie Mrad serves as Chief Architectural Officer at Arada Developments. Elie Mrad is a qualified architect with more than 20 years of experience working in markets as diverse as Australia, the UAE and South Sudan. He is responsible for Arada's overall design philosophy and for developing new typologies that adhere to that philosophy. Elie focuses on an iterative and information-based design process to introduce new ideas and is also responsible for ensuring the feasibility of designs, from concept to completion.
Elie's current initiatives include fostering stronger team collaboration via the creation of a lively, sharing design studio environment and creating a mentorship network where senior staff can guide and help other employees grow and progress in their careers. As Head of Architecture and Design, Elie has been instrumental in the creation of the masterplan and unit designs for all three of Arada's record-breaking projects and worked closely with Zaha Hadid Architects on the delivery of Madar at Aljada, a new leisure and entertainment destination for the UAE. He previously served as Head of Architecture at Arcadia Middle East and as Senior Architect at Dewan Architects & Engineers. Elie's other roles have included Managing Director of Venture International and Senior Architect at Kann Finch. The projects he has worked on include Reem Mall in Abu Dhabi, Dubai Festival City and the Crowne Plaza Hotel on Yas Island. Elie holds a BSc in Architectural Engineering from Beirut Arab University and an MSc in Architecture and Urban Design from the University of Sydney.

Ms. Elizabeth Buchanan served as Advisor at Spacehive. Until December 2008, Elizabeth was Private Secretary to TRH The Prince of Wales and The Duchess of Cornwall. She had worked for The Prince of Wales since 1998 and before that she worked with Tim Bell at Bell Pottinger Communications and was the press secretary to Lady Thatcher. She was previously a Special Adviser in the Department of Transport working for two Cabinet Ministers. Elizabeth is now a special adviser to Waitrose, to Dairy Crest and to the Bell Pottinger Group, and remains a consultant to The Prince of Wales. She also co-manages the family's organic livestock farm in East Sussex. Elizabeth sits on the BBC's Rural Affairs Advisory Committee, the Experts Panel of Natural England and is a senior associate of the Cambridge Programme for Sustainability Leadership. She is a trustee of The Prince's Countryside Fund, of The Horse Trust and the Smith School for Enterprise and the Environment at Oxford University. She is a member of the Goldsmiths Company.

Ms. Elizabeth Buchanan was special adviser to Chime. She was Private Secretary to TRH The Prince of Wales and The Duchess of Cornwall until 2008 when she left to build a portfolio career. Before that she was Press Secretary to Lady Thatcher having begun her career in politics. She was special adviser to two Cabinet Ministers in Mrs Thatcher's last term in Government. Elizabeth is also an adviser to Waitrose, Dairy Crest and Nyetimber. She is a trustee of The Prince's Countryside Fund, sits on the BBC Rural Affairs Committee, is a Senior Associate of The Cambridge Institute of Sustainability Leadership and a trustee of The Smith School for Enterprise and the Environment at Oxford University. She sits on her Parochial Church Council. Elizabeth runs the family organic beef farm in East Sussex. She is a Commander of The Royal Victorian Order, a Fellow of The Royal Agricultural Societies and holds an honorary degree from the University of Wales.

primary_company: Indian Health Center Of Santa Clara Valley
primary_position: Chief Medical Officer, Medical, Meridian Site
biography: Dr. Elizabeth Mccraven serves as Chief Medical Officer, Medical, Meridian Site at Indian Health Center of Santa Clara Valley. She has been working with IHC since 2014 and is board certified in Family Medicine. She started her work at IHC as a Locum Tenens (temporary) provider, covering for another provider who was on maternity leave. That was a great way for her to get my foot in the door at a clinic I really wanted to work for. Shortly after, she started her position as Associate Medical Director and has stayed on to become the Medical Director of the Meridian site.

Mr. Enda Colfer served as the Managing Director at The Environment Partnership. He brings over fifteen years experience of working in environmental consultancy to the business. Based in United Arab Emirates for the past seven years, His experience has seen him involved in a broad range of projects including environmental impact assessments, environmental auditing and due diligence, and waste management across Europe, America, and the Middle East. During his time in Dubai, He has worked with clients including the Presidency for Meteorology and the Environment in Saud Arabia, Masdar in UAE, Qatar Foundation, GE and Goldman Sachs. He has a degree in Agricultural and Environmental Science from University College Dublin and a Masters in Environmental Engineering from Pennsylvania State University. Prior to TEP, Enda worked for a global engineering consultancy and at the European Commission in Brussels.

Mr. Eric Hanna serves as Chief Marketing Officer at Arada Developments. He is a multidisciplined marketing professional with more than 30 years of experience in the region.
He started his career in Lebanon in 1990 with Leo Burnett, then later transferred to Jeddah before moving to Dubai with Saatchi & Saatchi (then WPP), where he led MediaCom and later the Grey Group across the Middle East and North Africa. During his tenure with the Grey Group, he expanded its offering by setting up the group's networks, including G2 (Branding, Digital, Shopper and Retail Media marketing), Cohn & Wolfe (Public Relations), and Healthy People (Healthcare marketing) as well as MediaCom (Media planning and buying). He was also a member of Grey EMEA's Brand Planning team, which developed and rolled out planning tools and models across the region. As of 2018, he moved to Shamal and later BEAM Consolidated where he led Marketing for a diverse portfolio of brands. He also acted as a Marketing Consultant for the launch of Bloomberg Asharq in the region in 2021.

Ms. Esther Peters serves as Chief Marketing Officer at FYEO Medical. She worked at Leadrs as a Team Leader of Online Marketing and Operations Manager from February 2016 to November 2020. Her career also includes a role as a Communication Manager Dredging & Mining at Royal IHC. Ms. Peters completed her VWO (pre-university education) at Elzendaal College Boxmeer, and then pursued a Bachelor of Arts degree in Marketing & PR at Breda University of Applied Sciences in 1997. She also obtained a NIMA A certification and continued her education at Fontys University of Applied Sciences from 1997 to 1999, earning a Bachelor of Arts degree in Communications.

Ms. Estibalitz Servitje serves as Board Member at Pro Mujer. She is a physician with graduate studies in immunology, neurosciences, health psychology and health sciences. She has been a basic and clinical immunology professor since the year 2000. Currently, she is a professor and researcher at the School of Medicine and Health Sciences at the Tecnológico de Monterrey in Mexico and a professor in the Masters's and Ph.D. programs in Health Sciences from the Universidad Nacional Autónoma de México (UNAM). Her research interests include immune regulation during pregnancy, chronic stress and childhood obesity. She is a member of the Medical Society of the American British Cowdray Medical Center in Mexico City, the Psychoneuroimmunology Research Society and the National Researchers System (SNI) of Mexico's National Science and Technology Council (CONACyT).

primary_position: Board Member & Member of the Executive Committee
biography: Mr. Fahad Saad Al-Qahtani served as Board Member and Member of the Executive Committee at Qatar Luxury Group.

Dr. Fahed Al Marzooqi served as Chief Operating Officer at G42 Healthcare. In his role as the Chief Operating Officer of G42 Healthcare, he leads business operations, spearheading critical assignments and strategic projects that have had a transformational impact, cementing the company's position as a futuristic entity committed to inventing better healthcare every day. With a wealth of experience in healthcare and technology, and a career spanning 15-plus years across large and diverse organizations in the UAE. Prior to joining G42 Healthcare,He was the Chief Administrative Officer at Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, where he played a critical role in steering multiple high-impact strategies and innovative programs for the hospital. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Mathematics and a Doctorate in Medicine from Dalhousie University in Canada, and has completed a five-year residency program in anesthesiology at the University of British Columbia in Vancouver, Canada.

primary_position: Group Chief Marketing and Communications Officer
biography: Mr. Faheem Ahamed serves as Group Chief Marketing and Communications Officer at G42. He is accountable for building and delivering the Group's communication and brand strategies, alongside managing stakeholder communications across G42 Group and across all communications disciplines. He advises the global leadership team on all communications and brand-related matters. He has over 27 years of global experience in building organizations, and driving cross-cultural, effects-based communication solutions, including a decade in behavioral communications driving social-impact programs. Faheem has worked on client and agency side on a wide range of industries and brands including BAT, Cadbury's, Tourism Malaysia, Malaysia Airlines, Samsung, Pentax, Delsey, Scintilla, Sage and VISA. He has been a trusted advisor to Nations, Boards, CEOs and world leaders. With a Bachelor of Arts (Economics) and MBA in Strategic Management, Faheem is an active participant in sociali impact and over the years taken several industry roles. Currently serving as Vice Chairman and Board Member of The Marketing Society (Abu Dhabi Chapter), and recentlywas final jury judge for MENA EFFIE's Awards 2021.
Mr. Fahmi Abubakar serves as Investment Analyst at Royal Group.

Mr. Faleh Al-Nasr serves as Board Member at Le Tanneur & Cie. Born in 1987, of Qatari nationality, Director of direct investments of the Qatar Foundation Endowment and adminstrator of several investment companies.
Mr. Farhan Kafil serves as Chief Commercial Officer at Arada Developments.

Mr. Faris Al-Qatarneh serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Baynouna Solar Energy Company. He is a senior executive with over 22 years in leadership and management experience in both private and public sectors, including government, manufacturing, insurance, energy, real estate development and social service organizations. He is the Chief Executive Officer of The Link Group Limited, a consultancy firm based in Abu Dhabi, UAE that serves as a gateway to the region through supporting its clients in identifying the right opportunities and building successful and sustainable businesses. The Link Group also supports clients from the region in strengthening relations and doing business through its diverse partnerships globally. He is also the Vice Chairman of the Board of Northern Cement, a Jordanian publicly traded company and one of Jordan's largest cement providers with over 250 million dollars market cap. He is also an Executive Board Member of the Middle East Insurance Company, Jordan's leading insurance firm, and a Senior Advisor to Saudi Pan Kingdom Holding [SAPAC], one of Saudi Arabia's top contracting, construction and industrial entities. served as a board member of several corporations in the fields of real estate development, renewable energy, social services and various industries. In 2010, he served as a Minister of State for Cabinet Affairs. Before his term, he was appointed as the Chief of Staff to Prime Minister (PM) Samir Al Rifai, managing the PM's team and overseeing the relationship with all key stakeholders including members of the cabinet, the Royal Court as well as the Parliament, in addition to restructuring the Prime Ministry. In 2007, he was named an Ambassador by His Majesty King Abdullah II and appointed Chief of Protocol at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Before working at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, He worked as the Assistant Chief of the Royal Protocol at the Royal Hashemite Court. He is a member of the Young Presidents' Organization [YPO] Jordan Chapter, Jordan Board Association as well as the Jordan Intellectual Property Association. He received several medals including the Second Order of Independence awarded by His Majesty King Abdullah II, the Grand Officer Medal awarded by King Carl XVI Gustaf of Sweden, and decorations from the Netherlands, Hungary, and Spain. He was born in 1974 in Amman, Jordan. He attained his bachelor's degree in law from Jordan University and LLM (Intellectual Property Law) from George Washington University.

Dr. Fasong Zhou is a Co-Founder of Green Fafa. Dr. Zhou served as Chairman & General Manager at Green Fafa. He holds a Ph.D. in Plant Molecular Pathology from the Royal Danish Agricultural University. He is a national-level talent in the Talent Development Program, a member of the "Yellow Crane Talent Strategy" in Wuhan, and an expert in the Biological Chip Committee of the China National Standards Committee. Currently, he serves as the Chairman and General Manager of Wuhan Shuanglvgen Semiconductor Technology Research Institute Co., Ltd. From 1998 to 2010, he conducted research in plant biotechnology at institutions including the John Innes Centre in the UK, Cornell University in the US, Ceres Biotechnology in the US, and Mendel Biotechnology in the US. From 2010 to 2018, he served as the Director of the National Key Laboratory of Crop Breeding Innovation and Integration at the China National Seed Group Life Science and Technology Center. He successfully developed the world's first rice whole-genome breeding chip and its upgraded version, established a whole-genome breeding system and platform, created the first green multi-line rice variety, and achieved the market transformation of rice functional genomics achievements. He has published over thirty scientific papers and reviews in academic journals such as Cell, Plant Cell, Plant Journal, Molecular Plant, Plant Biotechnology Journal, Plant Physiology, and MPMI.
Ms. Fatema Rachmat serves as President Director at Pertamedika IHC.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Operating Officer & Vice President
biography: Mr. Felix Addison is a Co-founded and served as the Chief Operating Officer & Vice President at WhoseYourLandlord. Previously, he served as the Chief Operations Officer & Vice President at Untapped. He began his professional career as an intern for George Mason Recreation where he worked side by side with the Director of Mason Recreation. Felix focused on informing students and community members about the George Mason Recreational facilities and membership opportunities. With that experience under his belt and the help of a great recommendation, he became an intern for the Assistant Dean of the Prince William Campus. Together, Felix and the Assistant Dean conducted a Needs Assessment Survey that brought graduate housing and a student lounge to the students of that campus. Upon graduation from George Mason University, Felix began working for the Mott Community Center and quickly received a promotion to become the Assistant Director. In the midst of transitioning from a full time student to a full time employee, Felix and his business partner and best friend Ofo Ezeugwu began forming a company named Untapped, Inc., which was created to help artists, musicians, and small businesses manage their social brand. WhoseYourLandlord.com was created in October 2012 as the first major project from Untapped, Inc. WhoseYourLandlord soon became the main focus for the two, who eventually moved to Brooklyn New York to continue building the company and team to where it is today.

primary_position: Managing Director, Portfolio Advisor & Data Protection Officer
biography: Mr. Florian Gröschl serves as Managing Director, Portfolio Advisor & Data Protection Officer at Absolute Return Consulting. He joined Absolute Return Consulting GmbH in 2011, started the absolute return fund of fund mahi546 in October 2012, and became a member of the board of ARC as Co-CEO and CIO in January 2013. Before ARC he worked for LGT Bank Österreich AG as a portfolio manager and member of the Investment Committee, managing various Absolute Return Portfolios for High Net Worth Individuals. Before working for LGT he was a fund manager for fixed income and absolute return at Bawag PSK Invest. He started his career in his family business taking care of asset management issues. He holds a degree in International Finance from the Vienna University of Economics and Business and qualified as a Certified Portfolio Manager (CPM) in 2005.
Ms. Francesca Bigolin is a Co-Owner of Selle Royal Group.
Mr. Frank Verhoeven serves as Chairman at Royal IHC.

Mr. Fred Brouwer served as Finance Director at Royal IHC. He started working for IHC Merwede on 1 April 2000, began his career at KPMG. He then worked for Hollandsche Aanneming Maatschappij (HAM) and later as Financial Director of Kvearner Process Nederland.

Mr. G. Michael Stevens serves as Board Member at Golden Nugget. He has been a member of the Board since May 6, 2019. He was previously a board member of Landcadia I from August 23, 2016, through the consummation of the Waitr business combination. Mr. Stevens currently serves as Managing Member of MS2 Ventures LLC, an advisory and investment firm. He also serves in director and advisory capacities in several other ventures, including as Chairman of the Board and Chief Executive Officer of Impressio, Inc., an advanced materials company, a member of the audit committee of Golden Nugget Atlantic City LLC, an advisor at Footprint International, a sustainable technology packaging firm, and Winning Capital Group LLC, a developer and licensor of state lottery games. Mr. Stevens served as Senior Vice President and Chief Marketing Officer for the New York Giants from 2006 to 2019 and Senior Vice President of Sales & Marketing for the Washington (NFL) Football Team from 2003 to 2006. Mr. Stevens' prior experience includes former director of Remedy Analytics, Inc., former Trustee of Camp Dudley, Inc. (a non-profit), and Chairman of Dudley's Development Committee, as well as key marketing executive roles at eBay Inc. and the National Basketball Association. He received his Bachelor of Arts from Hobart College, where he formerly served as a member of the Board of Trustees and currently is a member of the class of 2021 Global Executive Leadership Program at the Yale School of Management.

primary_position: Board Member & Remuneration & Nomination Committee Chair and Member of the Audit & Risk Committee
biography: Mr. Gareth Llewellyn serves as Board Member & Remuneration & Nomination Committee Chair and Member of the Audit & Risk Committee at Sage Housing. He chairs the Board's Remuneration and Nominations Committee, ensuring Sage's approach to issues such as performance management, pay and succession planning reflect best practice and help the business deliver on the objectives set out in the corporate plan. He was a Chief Executive of a government trading fund providing services for over 40m customers. Before this, He held global executive roles with National Grid plc and Anglo American plc and was Executive Director at Network Rail. As a NED he floated Biffa plc and subsequently sold the company to private equity. He is also currently the chair of the Board Remuneration and Nominations Committee at Harwich Haven Authority, a Fellow at the Prince of Wales Cambridge Institute for Sustainability Leadership, and in 2005 addressed the UN General Assembly on human rights and business.

Dr. Garry Felgate is a Co-Founder & serves as Energy lead at Thermify. He also serves as a Chairman & Board Member at BHESCo. He has a strong business and policy background in energy, environment and sustainability. He was formally CEO of the Energy Retail Association, Director of the Carbon Trust, and Director of the Association for the Conservation of Energy. He supports UK Energy Start-Ups on behalf of the Department for Business, Energy & Industrial Strategy and Innovate UK. He has a strong business and policy background in energy, environment and sustainability, built-in corporate organizations (IBM, Landmark Graphics) and leading consultancies (KPMG, A.T.Kearney). He was formally CEO of the Energy Retail Association representing the big six energy companies in the UK where he was instrumental in setting up the Warm Homes Programme. He was a Founder and Director of the Carbon Trust leading the UK's carbon reduction programmes for business creating the Action Energy and Carbon Management programmes. He has been a non-exec of the Energy Saving Trust, The Ombudsman Service Limited, The UK Public Health Association and Carbon Retirement. He is an alumnus of the University of Cambridge, HRH The Prince of Wales Business & The Environment Programme.

primary_position: Senior Vice President, Specialty Health Ops & Vice President, Accounting & Finance
biography: Mr. Gary Balzofiore serves as Senior Vice President, Specialty Health Ops & Vice President, Accounting & Finance at The IHC Group. Mr. Balzofiore, Since January 2019, Senior Vice President of Specialty Health Operations; from March 2012 until January 2019, Corporate Vice President - Accounting and Finance of IHC; from March 2012 until August 2016, Corporate Vice President - Accounting and Finance of American Independence Corp. (AMIC), formerly a public company traded on Nasdaq and majority-owned subsidiary of IHC that was merged out of existence on August 31, 2016; since March 2016, President of Standard Security Life Insurance Company of New York, a wholly owned subsidiary of IHC (Standard Security Life); for more than the past five years until March 2016, and Senior Vice President of Independence American Insurance Company (Independence American), an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of IHC.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Co-Owner, Co-Chief Financial Officer, Chief Operating Officer and CAO
biography: Mr. Gene Castagnini Co-Founded and Co-Owned and served as Co-Chief Financial Officer, Chief Operating Officer and CAO at Biocare Medical (IHC instrumentation). He has a BS in accounting and an MBA in Human Resource Management from the California State University school systems. His prior experience includes 15 years as a Director/Officer of Medi-Physics Inc., formerly a Hoffmann-La Roche Inc. subsidiary; and 10 years as the CAO/CFO of BioGenex Laboratories. Inc.

Mr. Gerben Eggink served as Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at Royal IHC. He has extensive experience in successfully leading organizations in transition. He previously served as CEO at the Gardline Group and Smit Lamnalco, among others.

Mr. Gert-Jan Antvelink served as Chief Transformation Officer and Board Member at IQIP. Mr. Antvelink served as Chief Transformation Officer & Board Member at Royal IHC. He served as Chief Financial Officer & Board Member at Van Gansewinkel. Mr. Antvelink served as a Partner & Head of Restructuring at KPMG. He also serves as a Head of Restructuring at KPMG NL.
Mr. Goof Hamers served as the Chairman of Management Board and President of IHC Merwede.

Mr. Ryerson serves as Managing Director at Novumed. He co-founded and served as Managing Director at Crosstree Capital Partners. Prior to founding Crosstree, Mr. Ryerson served as Associate at the Corporate Finance group of William R. Hough & Co. (later acquired by the Royal Bank of Canada) specializing in mid- to late-stage equity capital and change-of-control transactions. Responsibilities included evaluating deals, performing due diligence, drafting offering documents, and assisting in the structuring of transactions. Prior to joining William R. Hough & Co., Mr. Ryerson was the Group Business Manager for the pharmaceutical drug retailer, Eckerd Corporation's Northeast Group and its nearly 1,000 stores. Mr. Ryerson holds a Bachelors of Science in Economics from Auburn University and a Masters in Business Administration from the University of South Florida with concentrations in Finance and International Business. He also served as Board Member at Albiorex International Holding Company.
Mr. Govert Hamers serves as President at Royal IHC. He served as President of IHC Merwede.

Mr. Greg Brenman is a Co-Founder of Drama Republic. Mr. Brenman established Drama Republic with his long-term colleagues Ms. Roanna Benn and Ms. Jude Liknaitzky in 2013. Their first production was Hugo Blick's The Honourable Woman, an eight-part political thriller for BBC / SundanceTV which transmitted in the UK & around the world to great success. In 2014, Drama Republic produced the second series of the extremely popular E4 drama My Mad Fat Diary, written by Tom Bidwell. In 2015, DR produced the multi-award-winning Doctor Foster, a psychological drama for BBC One by dramatist Mike Bartlett, as well as a one-off adaptation of J B Priestley's extraordinary play, An Inspector Calls which won the Best Single Drama Award at the Broadcasting Press Guild Awards. Mr. Brenman also executive produced the acclaimed BAFTA-nominated adaptation of Mike Bartlett's stage play King Charles III. Mr. Brenman executive produced Hugo Blick's Black Earth Rising, which broadcast on BBC Two in Autumn 2018 and was released globally on Netflix in 2019. He also executive produced David Nicholl's adaptation of his best-selling novel Us for BBC One which premiered in September 2020.

Mr. Gregory Couillard served as Chairman & President at Le Tanneur & Cie. He served as Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at Qatar Luxury Group. His move to the luxury industry came in 2001 when he joined LVMH. Since then, from Avenue Montaigne to Omotessando, his career has taken him through the most desirable luxury districts of the world's metropolis. Gregory has held executive positions at Tag Heuer, within LVMH watches and the Jewelry Division in South-East Asia, Japan and Australia, then General Management of the French and Continental Europe Divisions. This experience has given Gregory a deep knowledge of historical luxury markets and of all aspects of luxury brands management. With a passion for traditional craftsmanship and timeless luxury products, he is most inspired by creating strong teams that are able to transform a dream into a beautiful technical reality. Gregory's commitment to excellence of the highest standard is driven by his relentless focus and uncompromising demand in the workplace. Gregory established Qatar Luxury Group under the auspices of Her Highness Sheikha Mozah Bint Nasser Al-Missned in 2008.

Mr. Gregory Smith served as the Chief Financial Officer at ED MAP. As an entrepreneurial leader with solid business acumen, Greg has more than 25 years of progressive financial and operational experience and a proven track record of generating bottom-line improvement. Greg brings with him experience in numerous industry sectors including risk management, insurance, technology, healthcare, real estate and automotive. Greg also brings to ED MAP prior experience in working with both PE- and VC-funded entities. As CFO of ED MAP, Greg is a key member of the executive team who is responsible for both setting and driving the agenda of the company. Greg also oversees the accounting, treasury, budget, tax, legal, financial reporting, risk management, M&A and administrative functions for the company. Prior to joining ED MAP, Greg had a 17-year career serving as the CFO of The Frank Gates Companies. Greg was instrumental in growing Frank Gates from an Ohio entity to an international holding company by executing a series of more than ten startup entities, six acquisitions and strong organic growth. Greg began his career with Arthur Andersen & Co in Dallas, Texas. Greg is also a Certified Public Accountant. He received his BBA from Southern Methodist University and an MBA from the Goizueta Business School at Emory University.
Mr. Gurdeep Virdee served as Director, Finance at Kingdom Holding (The Savoy). Previously he served as the Director of Finance & Head of Information Technology at Swissotel The Howard London.

Mr. H.E. Mansoor Al Mansoori served as Chairman at Al Yah Satellite Communication. H.E. Mansoor Al Mansoori is a member of Abu Dhabi Executive Council and the Chairman of the Department of Health in Abu Dhabi. He brings a diverse range of experience across government and the private sector, including telecommunications, energy and technology. He was previously Chairman of Bayanat, overseeing its highly successful IPO as Group Chief Operating Officer of G42.

Mr. Hans Roth served as Board Member at Cardiolynx. He is an Economist. his previous experience includes Independent Consultant at LGT Bank (Switzerland) Ltd, Chairman of the Executive Board of STG Swiss Trust Company, Member of the Executive Board, Senior positions at Swiss Bank Corporation and Credit Suisse and 1 year at CS and First Boston New York. He holds a degree in Business Management from the University of Zurich (lic.oec.publ.) and also attended Executive Programs at (INSEAD Fontainebleau France and Singapur and University of Chicago).

Mr. Hans Smit served as Chief Executive Officer and President at Neptune Minerals. He comes to Neptune Minerals with 20 years of worldwide subsea engineering, operations and management experience. Prior to joining Neptune Minerals, he was the Managing Director of IHC Marine and Minerals Projects focused on providing services to the underwater mining industry worldwide. Prior to IHC Marine and Minerals Projects, he was the Projects Director of Marine and Mineral Projects (Pty) Ltd a company specializing in providing the subsea diamond mining industry engineering and operation solutions. During this period, he was responsible for developing and optimizing the control and instrumentation systems for a 20m3 reverse circulation drill system supplied by Wirth of Germany to NAMCO for exploration of diamond deposits. In addition, Mr. Smit's team was also responsible for the design and development of the NAMCO crawler and thereafter the new De Beers Crawler used subsea diamond mining. As the company progressed from its early specialization in the sub-sea diamond mining industry, the company expanded globally into the oil & gas services, general marine, and land based mining industries. The company employed mechanical, electrical and electronic engineers. Prior to joining Marine and Mineral Projects (Pty) Ltd, he was the co-founder, Managing and Technical Director of Delcon Marine and Industrial (Pty) Ltd later renamed Marine and Mineral Automation (Pty) Ltd. Marine and Mineral Automation specialized in providing engineering solutions to the subsea mining industry.

primary_position: Chief Executive Officer, President, Chief Operations Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Hans Smit serves as Chief Executive Officer, President, Chief Operations Officer & Board Member at Ocean Minerals. Mr. Smit was President of Neptune Minerals, Inc. from 2015 to 2017.He served as Managing Director of IHC MMP focused on providing services to the underwater mining industry worldwide. Prior to this, he was the Projects Director of Marine and Mineral Projects (Pty) Ltd a company specializing in providing the subsea diamond mining industry engineering and operation solutions. He has designed, developed, implemented, and optimized numerous underwater mining systems, in particular, the crawler technology being used by De Beers Crawler for subsea diamond mining.
Mr. Hari Nair is Co-Founder of Royal Group Plasma Fractionation.

primary_position: Chief Commercial Officer. Commercial Director & Board Member
biography: Dr. Harmeni Wijaya serves as Chief Commercial Officer. Commercial Director & Board Member at Pertamedika IHC. Previously, she held management positions at several well-known private hospitals in Indonesia. Dr. Harmeni completed her medical education at Trisakti University and a postgraduate program in Health Communication at Harvard Medical School.

Dr. Harry Hwang served as Adjunct Pathologist at PhenoPath. Dr. Hwang attended the University of Pennsylvania School of Medicine, Philadelphia, where he earned his MD and completed his AP/CP residency training at the University of Washington Medical Center, Seattle. He also completed an IHC Fellowship at PhenoPath from 2002-03 under Dr. Gown, and served as an Adjunct Pathologist prior to his full-time appointment as Director of Molecular Pathology in 2008. Dr. Hwang's expertise in molecular pathology stems from his research studies at the Fred Hutchinson Cancer Research Center (FHCRC), Seattle, in the areas of cancer and the cell cycle. Dr. Hwang brings to PhenoPath the combined strengths of extensive diagnostic pathology experience coupled with intensive knowledge of molecular pathology.
Mr. Hassan Ouriagli serves as Board Member at INWI. He served as President and Chief Executive Officer at INWI. He also serves as Board Member at Nareva Holding.

Ms. Haya Khalifa Al Nassr served as Managing Director and Board Member at Qatar Luxury Group. Ms. Al Nassr previously served as the Director of Communications at Qatar Foundation, where she was responsible for raising the Foundation's profile locally and internationally. Her achievements at QF include launching "QF Radio". Al Nassr is a member of the Board of Directors at Al Jazeera Children's Channel, and has previously carried out the role of Executive General Manager for the channel.

Mr. Haytham Kaddoura served as Chief Executive Officer at SmartStream Technologies. Haytham Kaddoura, CEO of SmartStream and serves as an advisor to the Board of Directors. He joined in 2007 bringing over 20 years of experience in investment advisory, asset management, corporate restructuring, strategy formulation and execution for boards in prominent corporations across the GCC and the greater MENA region. He started his career working with leading management consulting firms including; Accenture, Booz Allen and Hamilton, PricewaterhouseCoopers and BearingPoint. More recently, Haytham worked as an adviser for Abu Dhabi Offsets Group, Abu Dhabi National Oil Company, DUBAL, American Express, Doha Securities Market, Qatar Foundation, Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC), as well as recognised private and public sector entities across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Lebanon, Egypt, Syria and Morocco. Mr. Kaddoura holds a Masters Degree in Finance and International Business from McGill University in Canada.
Mr. Henk van Muijen serves as Managing Director at Royal IHC.
Mr. Hentry Abraham serves as Chief Accounting Officer at Arada Developments.
Mr. Hisham Al Gurg serves as Chairman at gennius xyz.

Mr. Howard Hodgson serves as Chief Executive Officer at Memoria. He also serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Amber Valley Memorial. He serves as Chief Executive Officer at South Leicester Memorial. A fourth-generation funeral director, Howard trained with James Summers of Cardiff in 1968. He took over the family business in 1975 and launched an expansion program that culminated in the flotation of Hodgson Holdings plc in 1986. Through subsequent mergers, the company formed the largest funeral/crematorium group in the UK. Howard sold his interests in 1991, having taken the company from one branch to 546 and became 'Entrepreneur of the Year 1987' in the process. He is largely recognized as the individual who transformed the funeral industry in the 1970s, 80s and early 90s. After a second career in the gift industry as chief executive of Ronson plc and Colibri International, he returned to the funeral industry as founder and CEO of Memoria and has developed it into the third largest and fastest-growing crematoria company in the UK today. In 2016 he founded Memoria Low-Cost Funeral, the direct cremation arm of Memoria and has taken that company from a standing start to the largest direct cremation company in the UK. He is the author of four books, including a detailed graph of HRH The Prince of Wales.

primary_position: Vice President, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs
biography: Mr. Ian Welsford served as Vice President, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Affairs at Autonomic Technologies. He served as Senior Vice President, Technical Operations at Autonomic Technologies. He has directed clinical trials in oncology, diabetes, metabolic disease and CNS therapies and directed regulatory strategies and submissions for a variety of devices (510k, PMA and CE Mark and other OUS licensure), including combination products, diagnostics, IVDs, drug infusion pumps, ICDs, and software systems. In the drug development space, he has experience managing clinical trials and submissions/approvals of NDAs, BLAs and ANDAs in a variety of IHC regions across a number of therapeutic areas including oncology, CNS therapeutics and diabetes. He most recently directed global regulatory and clinical strategy for Insulet. He is also the Chief Compliance Officer and Chief Regulatory Officer at Pharmaco Kinesis.

Dr. Iqbal Survé serves as Independent Media Chairperson at Belt and Road News Network. Dr Survé is a Physician, Entrepreneur and an ardent Philanthropist, born and educated in Cape Town, South Africa. He is a regular WEF Davos and Summer Davos participant and served as the first chairman of the Global Growth Companies (GGC) Advisory Board and Vice-Chairman of the Global Agenda Council (GAC) for Emerging Multinationals. He is a participant member of the G20 meeting and serves on B20 Task Teams as well as the UNGA private sector forum. On the invitation of SA Presidents, Nelson Mandela, Thabo Mbeki, Kgalema Motlanthe and Jacob Zuma, he has participated on many presidential advisory working groups and state visits. Dr Survé is a regular keynote speaker at international conferences and gatherings. He is an alumnus of the HRH Prince of Wales Business & Environment programme hosted by the HRH Prince Charles with CPI, a Fellow of the African Leadership Initiative (ALI), a patron of the South Africa-Italy Summit, until recently he was Co-chairman of the South Africa- Saudi Arabia Business Council (SASABC). He is patron of the Munich based GISSAID, a patron along with Queen Sylvia and former President Nelson Mandela of the Swedish based World Children Prize for the Rights of the Child (WCPRC), a founder member of the Siemens Global Sustainability Advisory Board, a member of the YPO Gold Cape Town chapter, patron of the South African chapter of the Soong Ching Ling Foundation, and twice honoured with the Directors award, for his contribution to tertiary education by the University of Cape Town (UCT) , Graduate School of Business where he served for several years as Chairman of the Advisory Board of the Business School. Dr Survé is an alumnus of the University of Cape Town (UCT), the Graduate School of Business (GSB), the American College of Sports Medicine (ACSM) and Harvard University with degrees in medicine, science, and business. He is also the first black recipient of the gold medal for scientific research by the South African Sports Medicine Association for his ground-breaking research on ankle injuries amongst soccer players. Dr Survé serves on the World Economic Forum Advisers Board and is a board member on the Stewardship Council for Information and Entertainment, which is one of the most prestigious System Initiative boards for the World Economic Forum.

primary_company: Indian Health Center Of Santa Clara Valley
biography: Ms. Ira Singh serves as Chief Operating Officer at Indian Health Center of Santa Clara Valley. Ms. Singh has been working at IHC since 2015 and she is deeply committed to the mission of the organization. She was trained as a physician in India and completed a Master's in Public Health from the University of Toledo. She is a Fellow of the American College of Healthcare Executives (FACHE) since 2019 which signifies her competence, commitment, and leadership in healthcare management. She is also a Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ), and a Certified HIPAA, Privacy, and Security Expert (CHPSE) and she always strives for continued professional growth. She has been integral in the development and implementation of strategies that center data-informed decisions and continuous quality improvement at IHC. Working at IHC provides her the opportunity to make a positive difference in the lives of community members.
Mr. J. H. Hylkema served as Board Member of IHC Merwede.

Mr. Jaap Huijskes served as Chairman at Royal IHC. Mr. Huijskes was an Executive Board Member at OMV. He studied mechanical engineering and began his career with Shell, where he held a number of technical and commercial positions. His last post was as Executive Vice President responsible for major projects worldwide in the Exploration and Production division. His various international positions have taken him to the United Kingdom, Norway, Oman, Australia and Russia. He has been a member of the OMV Executive Board and responsible for Exploration & Production since April 2010.
Mr. Jagadish Elumalai served as Medical Director at Prince William Medical Center.

Dr. James Barshinger is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Technology Officer & President at Sensor Networks. Dr. Barshinger is based out of Sensor Network Inc.'s Engineering & Product Design HQ office in State College, PA. Dr. Barshinger, or Jim for short, is not new to the asset integrity, inspection, or testing field that SNI serves. Jim received his Bachelors, Masters, and Ph.D. from Pennsylvania State University School of Engineering Science & Mechanics. This was the first connection to Penn State, which would eventually bloom into the robust relationship that exists now. His doctoral thesis was in Guided Wave Propagation, and he worked under Dr. Joseph Rose as his advisor. Prior to founding SNI, Jim has been working in the NDT and Ultrasound industries with Krautkramer-Branson, AGFA NDT, GE's Global Research Center and GE Inspection Technologies for 15 years. He continues in his role as president and is involved in company decisions that will only continue to benefit the employees, customers, and the mission of SNI itself.
Mr. James Chalmers serves as Chief Financial Officer at Palm Garden Healthcare.
Mr. James Chalmers serves as Chief Executive Officer at NovoPower. He is the Founder & serves as Managing Partner at BaseCamp Capital.
Mr. James Chalmers serves as General Manager at Cargoclear International.
Mr. James Chalmers serves as Chief Executive Officer at Future Services Norway.
James Lawn served as the Chief Financial Officer of Royal Group Technologies.

Mr. James Tatum serves as Board Member at The IHC Group. James G. Tatum, For more than the past five years, Chairman of the Audit Committee of IHC; for more than the past five years, member of the Compensation Committee of IHC; for more than the past five years, a director of Standard Security Life; for more than the past five years, sole proprietor of J. Tatum Capital, LLC, a registered investment advisor, located in Birmingham, Alabama, managing funds primarily for individual and trust clients; Chartered Financial Analyst for more than twenty-five years; from March 2011 until August 2016, a director of AMIC; from March 2011 until August 2016, a member of the Audit Committee of AMIC.

Mr. Jan Pieter Klaver served as Chief Executive Officer at Royal IHC. He also served as Chief Executive Officer at Kenz Figee Group. He served at Heerema for 26 years in a variety of positions, amongst others at the former Norwegian yard of Heerema and at Dockwise. In 2004 he joined the board of the Heerema Fabrication Group and in 2009 he joined Heerema Marine Contractors, first as COO and from 2010 until June 2017 as CEO.

Mr. Jared Dowling serves as Chief People Officer at Avanci. He is the Chief People Officer at Avanci, working to foster and maintain acompany culture which promotes continuous innovation, collaboration and teamwork in support of the delivery of simple and efficient solutions for the company's licensee and licensor customers. He is passionate about supporting Avanci employees, both in their professional growth and development and in the assignment of work experiences which deliver successful outcomes for the company. Bringing almost 30 years of experience in Human Resources, he joined Avanci from Hallmark, where he spent five years as an enterprise VP of H.R. leading Total Rewards, H.R. Technology Strategy and Corporate Services. Prior to Hallmark, he was SVP, H.R. Total Rewards and M&A at Scripps Networks Interactive (SNI), where he also led program design and development and employee integration activities during SNI's acquisition by Warner Brothers Discovery (WBD) in 2018. Previous H.R. leadership roles were at CHC Group and Dell, where he spent almost ten years in corporate and regional leadership roles, including two years in Singapore and two years in Shanghai, China with his family. He has a Bachelor of Arts from Southwestern University in Georgetown, Texas.

Mr. Jason Stolworthy serves as Director, Technology Development at Idaho National Laboratory. Stolworthy worked at INL from 2004 to 2013, first as a technology transfer licensing executive and then as deputy director for technology deployment. He left INL to become director of Intellectual Property Management for the Qatar Foundation, establishing Qatar's first intellectual property management and technology transfer office. It now manages more than 360 inventions, more than 300 patents, and helps more than 600 inventors advance their ideas. He returned to INL in 2016. He is a registered patent attorney and holds bachelor's degrees from Idaho State University in chemistry and biochemistry, a master's degree from University of Idaho in chemical engineering, and a Juris Doctor from University of Idaho College of Law.

primary_position: Chief Financial Officer & Vice President, Administration & Finance
biography: Mr. Jean LeBras served as Chief Financial Officer and Vice President of Finance and Administration at Qatar Luxury Group. Jean is responsible for the financial management of the company and also oversees the Facilities and Admin functions.He graduated from EDC Paris in 1980 and after completing an MBA from the University of Dallas he started in Dallas what was to become a 28 year career with Texas Instruments. After learning the company's operations in the internal audit department, he moved to Corporate Accounting and Finance, and then Corporate Tax. In 1994, he joined an elite team chartered to grow Texas Instruments' MOS Memory joint ventures in Asia and the US. He later moved to the Philippines to be the Finance Director of one of TI's largest semi-conductor assembly and test factory. When the company expanded operations in China, he relocated to Shanghai as the firm's China Finance Director. After Texas Instruments divested its Sensors and Controls division, he was promoted to the position of Asia Finance Director of the freshly divested business, Sensata Technologies. He returned to Boston in 2009 as Sensata's Corporate Finance Director. Jean is French, joined Qatar Luxury Group in September 2010. With a strong track record in the high-tech industry, Jean brings the experience and maturity required to deal with the numerous challenges of managing and growing the company's financial operations.

Mr. Jean Vitoux served as Chief Executive Officer at DomusVi. Previously, he joined SNI (Société Nationale Immobilière-Caisse des Dépôts Group) in 1998, where he served as Deputy Chief Executive Officer from 1999 to 2004 and then as member of the Executive Board from 2004 to 2010. Before joining SNI, Jean -François Vitoux spent 6 years with Bossard Consultants and Deloitte. He resigned from the Public Service in 1991. He graduated from ENA (89), a graduate of Sciences Po Paris (85), a graduate in History (82) and Sciences Eco (86)

primary_position: Member of Science Advisory Board & Chief Science Officer Consultant
biography: Dr. Jean-Louis Tayot served as a Member of Science Advisory Board & Chief Science Officer Consultant at Albiorex International Holding Company. He is CEO of Khorionyx, a French Human Biomaterial Company. He retired December 2005 as the Chief Scientific Officer of Floreane Medical Implants, a leading French medical device company, and General Manager of its subsidiary Imedex Biomatériaux. Dr. Tayot has 20 years of R&D experience dedicated to collagen and to the extraction and commercialization of valuable biomaterials from human placentas. Through Imedex, he spent $20 million and 15 years developing and refining the collagen manufacturing process technology that is now exclusively available to Albiorex. He holds numerous medical device patents related to the production, manipulation and use of collagen in numerous medical applications and has successfully launched products in the U.S. and other regulatory environments. He also led Aventis-Pasteur's R&D and enzyme production operations where he eventually sourced and processed 20 tons of human placentas per day..

Dr. Jeffrey Ross is the Founder & serves as Medical Director at Foundation Medicine.
