Dr. Ross is the Cyrus Strong Merrill Professor and Chair of the Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine at Albany Medical College, where he directs an extramurally funded research laboratory in molecular pathology. Between 1999 and 2004, Dr. Ross served as Scientific Fellow and Head of Molecular Pathology at Millennium Pharmaceuticals before co-founding Syfr, Inc. an RFID Specimen Management and IHC/ISH/FISH autostainer company. Prior to that Dr. Ross served as Medical Director for Managed Care for Roche Biomedical Laboratories and Laboratory Corporation of America. Since 2000, Dr. Ross has been a member of the NIH Clinical Oncology Study Section. He serves on the editorial boards and reviewer lists of numerous scientific journals and is Associate Editor for Basic Science of the American Journal of Clinical Pathology. He has served in multiple leadership positions for the American Society of Clinical Pathologists, the College of American Pathologists, the International Academy of Pathology, the Association of Pathology Chairs and the American Society of ClinicalOncology. He is a graduate of Oberlin College, Oberlin, Ohio and The State University of New York at Buffalo School of Medicine in Buffalo, New York. He served as an intern resident and fellow in Anatomic and Clinical Pathology at the Massachusetts General Hospital in Boston, Massachusetts.

Mr. Jeffry Jacobsen Co-Founded and served as a Lead Developer at GuestNetix. He has over 30 years of software development experience. On the web he's known as coderjeff. He's worked for GE, IHC, Siemens, LDS Tech, and spent the last decade as an independent software consultant. He's completed hundreds of software development projects across multiple industries over his career.

Mr. Jeroen Dool serves as Controller at Attema. He brings experience from previous roles at Boerman Groep, IHC Systems BV and Grontmij Group. He holds a 2014 QC certification as HOFAM Qualified Controller NIVE Opleidingen, with a robust skill set that includes business control, cost accounting, dutch, investments and insurance.

Mr. Johny Zhang is a Co-Founder and serves as Director and Chief Executive Officer at Singlera Genomics. He was previously the Vice President/General Manager for Greater China Thermo Fisher Scientific Healthcare, where he was awarded the annual global CEO award for outstanding performance. During his tenure at Gene Company, Ltd, Mr. Zhang introduced numerous molecular diagnostic technologies into China, including Dako IHC, Abbott FISH, Qiagen Nucleic Acid Detection, and Affymatrix Gene Chip. Mr. Zhang co-founded and was COO of ebiotrade, the first Chinese universal life science website of its kind. Mr. Zhang received his MBA and B.S. in Biochemistry from Fudan University.

Mr. Jim Samples served as Chief Executive Officer at TVN. He oversees the strategic development and current activities of the international division Scripps Networks Interactive, which distributes the five international brands - Asian Food Channel, Fine Living, Food Network, HGTV and Travel Channel - in Europe, the Middle East, Africa in Asia and the Pacific and in Latin America. In addition, Samples sits on the Board and manages relationships with partners in joint ventures: UKTV in the UK and Shaw Media in Canada. Also supervises the activities in the area of international licensing programs. Prior to assuming responsibility for the international division of SNI, in 2007-2011, he served as President Samples HGTV. Prior to joining Scripps Networks, Samples spent nearly 14 years w Turner Broadcasting System in various management positions in sales partnerships, marketing, software and digital media. Starting his career in 1993 in international business development department w Turner, after he became President of Turner International Argentina, based in Buenos Aires. In 1999, the Samples returned to the US as the First Vice President and General Manager of TNT and Cartoon Network Latin America. In 2001, the Samples promoted to the position of Vice President and General Director of Cartoon Network Worldwide.

Mr. Joel McKeever served as Executive Vice President, Underwriting at IHC Risk Solutions. Joel began his insurance career with The Prudential and has been involved in the insurance industry for almost thirty years. During his career, he has held positions with an insurance carrier, a benefit consulting firm, a third party administrator and a stop-loss MGU. He has been a stop-loss underwriter for the past nineteen years. Joel has been a member of the IHC team since 2003. He currently holds the position of Executive Vice President of Underwriting for IHC Risk Solutions.
Mr. Johan de Bie served as a Managing Director at IHC Hytech. He served as a General Manager at Seatec Underwater Systems B.V.

Mr. Johannes Meran serves as Board Member at RiceTec. Mr. Meran has worked for the Liechtenstein Group since 2020 and, from 2018 until 2020, was a member of the Board of Trustees for the Foundation Prince Liechtenstein. Until 2018 he was CEO of Gxp German Properties AG and until 2014 Chairman of the Board of Directors & CEO of Conwert Immobilien Invest SE, both stock-market-listed real-estate companies in the DACH region with real estate assets totalling over EUR 3 billion. Prior to that, he worked for the private equity fund Cognetas, the US investment bank Goldman Sachs, and strategic consulting firm Roland Berger & Partner. He is Chairman of the Advisory Board of Lieco and a member of the Board of Directors of RiceTec AG. He holds a BSc in Economics from the London School of Economics and an MBA from Harvard Business School.

Mr. John Callanan serves as Managing Director at The Prince Of Wales Hotel. He brings experience from previous roles at Callanan hotel group. John Callanan holds a 1989 - 1992 Bachelor of Arts - BA in Economics at Maynooth University.

Mr. John Duke served as the Chief Operating Officer at Healthe Care. John joined Healthe Care as the Chief Operating Officer and NSW Regional Manager in August 2011. He has 30 years experience working in senior management positions across the Australian and international health care sector. John's previous roles have included Chief Executive Officer at Lake Macquarie Private Hospital (Newcastle), Prince of Wales Private Hospital (Sydney) and the Mater Private Hospital (Sydney). John has also held senior management positions with Health Care of Australia, which was Australia's largest private hospital group at the time and the Dusit Hospital Group - the largest private hospital operator in Thailand with 28 sites

Mr. John Frisch was the Founder and served as President at Alliant Wealth Advisors. Licensed as a CPA, he also holds the Personal Financial Specialist designation from the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants. In addition, he is a CFP professional, Accredited Investment Fiduciary and Professional Plan Consultant. He holds a degree in accounting and information systems from Geneva College in western Pennsylvania. He is strongly committed to community service. He founded the Prince William Financial Institute to provide networking and education opportunities for financial professionals in Prince William, Virginia. He served on the three-county Battlefield Advisory Board for Branch Bank & Trust Co. (BB&T) for 15 years and was a recent four-year member of the Finance Committee for the Prince William Chamber of Commerce. Previously, he served as treasurer and as a member of the Board of Directors for the Prince William Regional Chamber of Commerce and was the accounting chair on the Capital Campaign Steering Committee for Potomac Hospital (currently Sentara Hospital) in Prince William.

Mr. Houldsworth was Chief Technology Officer and Co-Founder at PowerPrecise. He was previously the CTO and Founder of Duality Semiconductor, Inc where he invented and patented Virtual Analog technology - a breakthrough system -to- silicon approach for implementing signal processing solutions. As VP Technology and VP R&D for Eurotherm Companies he was responsible for new product development for more than 20 years. He has authored and been granted numerous patents in Battery Management, Signal Processing, Instrumentation, Actuators, Communications and Computer Graphics. Awards include the Prince of Wales Award for Industrial Innovation - one of the highest awards granted in the UK. He holds a B.Sc.EE with first class honors from Imperial College, London, UK.

Mr. John Kelly serves as Chairman at Buzz Bingo. He also served as Chairman at Gala Coral Group. He is Chairman of the Advisory and Investment Boards of Kings Park Capital, a private equity fund specializing in investments into the leisure and hospitality sector. He was the Founder of Gala Coral Group Ltd (formerly Gala Group Ltd) where he led a management buy-in from Bass plc of its bingo division in December of 1997 for £300 million. He then served as CEO until 2004 and was then Executive Chairman until leaving the Group in 2007. Mr. John served as a Director of Mecca Leisure plc from 1984 to 1992. He has been a Non-Executive Director of Ladbrokes Coral Group plc since 1 September 2010 and served as its Senior Independent Non-Executive Director since 1 September 2010 until 4 December 2015, when he was appointed Chairman. He served as a Board Member of The Prince of Wales Business in the Community charity from 2003 to 2010. He was appointed an OBE in the Queen's New Years Honours List 2007 for services to the gambling industry.
Mr. John Manusu is a Co-Founder of Royal Group Plasma Fractionation.

Mr. John Neill served as Chairman & Group Chief Executive at Unipart Group. He joined Unipart Group of Companies from General Motors in 1974 and set out to establish a more independent and broadly based role for what was then British Leyland's Parts Division. In 1987 he led the management buyout of the company and began the process of changing not only the culture of the company but also the whole philosophy by which the business was run. He was formerly a Director of the Court of the Bank of England and a Non-Executive Director of the Royal Mail, Charter International plc and Rolls-Royce plc. John was appointed Prince's Ambassador for the South East for 2009 by HRH The Prince of Wales. He serves as a Chairman at SIMEC Atlantis Energy.
Mr. John Smith serves as Chief Executive Officer at SNI Companies.

Mr. Jonathan Smith is a Co-Founder and serves as Director and Board Member at Skylark Works. Jonathan has been a long-term advocate of values-based business practice. A former Business Ambassador working with HRH Prince of Wales at Business in the Community, he has over 30 years' director-level experience in the marcomms and construction sectors. As Head of Social Purpose for a UK investment manager, he developed an energetic multi-million-pound charitable program that focused on core-costs support - supporting the business of charity. Jonathan co-founded The Oxford Institute of Charity, alongside the think tank, Charity Futures, and purpose-led learning platform, Utopy.

Mr. Joop Hylkema serves as Supervisory Board Member at Royal Eijkelkamp. He also serves as Supervisory Board Member at Airborne Oil & Gas. He has worked with Royal IHC, builder of Dredging and Offshore Equipment and Vessels for a long time and was lately - as board member - responsible for the division Technology & Services. Today he is active as supervisory board member of several Dutch company's, as a private investor and involved in a number of foundations as chairman of the advisory board. He has degrees on civil engineering, organisational development/HR and change management.

Mr. Joost Vulto is a Co-Owner & serves as Board Member of Leemberg Pijpleidingen & Apparatenbouw. He has 25 years of experience in executive roles in industrial and project companies, including at IHC, Driessen Aerospace and Bluewater.

Dr. Jorge Roa serves as a Board Member at the National Autonomous University of Mexico. He is currently a Senior Researcher C at the Center for Interdisciplinary Research in Sciences and Humanities at UNAM, with more than 43 years of academic experience. Professor and Tutor of the Postgraduate Programs in Political and Social Sciences and Latin American Studies at UNAM; he has taught classes at FLACSO-Mexico, at the Dr. José María Luis Mora Research Institute, at the Tec de Monterrey, Mexico City campus, at the Universidad Autónoma Metropolitana-Iztapalapa, and at Universidad Mayor de San Andrés (Bolivia). National Researcher Level III of the SNI; Level D of PRIDE; Regular Member of the Mexican Academy of Sciences. Founder and coordinator of the Laboratory for the Analysis of Social Organizations and Movements of the CEIICH (http://laoms.org/), member of the Institutional Academic Seminars: Democratic Perspective and Movements and Institutions of the Institute for Social Research of the UNAM. Executive Secretary of the Mexican Council of Social Sciences (http://www.comecso.com), a civil association that currently groups 97 entities dedicated to teaching and research in social sciences in the country. From that position, he has organized three congresses and five national weeks of social sciences. He is a member of the Academic Advisory Committee of the University Program of Government of the UNAM. He was Academic Secretary of the Center for Interdisciplinary Research in the Humanities (1986-1993) and has participated in several collegiate bodies of the UNAM, including the Review Committees of the Center for Research on North America and the Institute for Social Research; the PRIDE Evaluation Committee of the Faculty of Economics and the Faculty of Political and Social Sciences; the PRIDE Special Commission of the Academic Council of the Area of Social Sciences, Evaluating Peer of the Association for Accreditation and Certification in the Social Sciences, the Fulbright-García Robles Scholarship Selection Committee and the Review Committee of Area VI: Social Sciences of CONACyT. He was a member of the Board of Directors of the Research Committee on Social Movements, Collective Action and Social Change of the International Sociological Association (2006 to 2014) and Principal Advisor representing the Academic, Professional, Scientific, and Cultural sectors on the Technical Advisory Council of the Development Commission created by the Federal Law for the Promotion of Activities Carried Out by Civil Society Organizations (2011-2014). He was a fellow of the Faculty of Economics to pursue undergraduate studies at the National University; a fellow of the Institute of Social Research for master's studies; a Fulbright-García Robles and CONACyT fellow to pursue master's and doctoral studies in Sociology at the University of Wisconsin-Madison; and a Graduate Student Fellow of the Contentious Politics Seminar, at the Center for Advanced Study in the Behavioral Sciences, Stanford University.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Technology Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. José Manuel Aguilar co-founded and served as Chief Technology Officer and Board Member at Polybion. In 2012 he was awarded for his work by MIT Technology Review, as one of the 10 outstanding innovators of Mexico (TR35 award in the category of Biomedicine). Technology Review is the oldest technology magazine in the world, published by MIT (Massachusetts Institute of Technology). Among the winners from other countries are Konstantín Novosiólov (Graphene pioneer and later Nobel Laureate in Physics). Although most of his work has been for industry and is therefore confidential (forbidden for publication or patent application), he has 14 scientific papers and 2 granted patents and 3 patent applications. For his public contributions to the scientific community and his work with graduate students, he received an appointment as a member of the National Science Program in Mexico (Sistema Nacional de Investigadores, SNI) in 2013. Since that time, he has held an affiliation to the Advanced Medical Research Institute of Canada (AMRIC), where he was invited to continue his research on vaccines against influenza and other infectious diseases. During that period one of his main focus areas was the use of induced Pluripotent Stem Cells for immunotherapy. After coming back to Mexico in 2015, Manuel became a full time professor at Tec de Monterrey, Campus Monterrey. He joined Polybion's board in 2019 and in 2020 he became Polybion's part time CTO, he is currently in charge of the genetic engineering strategy behind Polybion®'s first recombinant strains.

She has over two decades of management experience. She holds a Bachelor's degree in Communication, Public Relations & Advertising. She has served as a Managing Director at Universal Graphic Design, where she worked on projects. She later ventured into automotive and media, gaining valuable experience. Before that she served as Executive Director at CLUB LA MARINA, as a General Manager at OFFSET, as Recreational Manager at InterContinental Jordan - IHC and as Project Manager at DAR AL CHAER.

Mr. Jubran Rahal serves as Chief Executive Officer at One Prepay. He served as Chief Financial Officer at Injazat Data Systems. Prior to joining Injazat, Jubran was the Senior Vice President for Finance for Dubai-based events group Armada. He also worked as Chief Financial Officer for Zabeel Investments and as Director of Finance for Tecom Investments and performed extensive auditing work across multiple industries for Arthur Andersen.
Mr. Kareem Shahin served as Chief Business officer at G42 Healthcare.

Mr. Karim Saada served as Board Member at Al-Ismaelia. Mr. Saada served as Executive Vice President and Country Head at Amwal AlKhaleej. He also serves as a Board Member at Al-Ismaelia. Prior to that Karim was the General Manager of Gulf Arab Investment Company, a $75 million private equity investment company based in Egypt. Karim was also a Finance Director at Kingdom Holding. Karim serves on the boards of several Amwal portfolio companies including Arab Cotton Ginning, Contact Cars, EPPC, Samay Hills, as well as Gulf Arab Investment Company. He holds an M.S. in Finance (U.K.), and a Bachelor of Business Administration from the American University in Cairo.

primary_position: Private Equity Director and Board Member
biography: Mr. Karim Souid serves as Private Equity Director and Board Member at ChimHaeres. He serves as Director, Private Equity at Lunate. He served as Managing Director at Chimera Capital. He served as an Executive at Veni Vidi Group. He served as Head of Middle East Private Equity and Dubai Office at Swicorp. Previously, He co-founded an investment advisory boutique that provides bespoke investment services to international investors, family offices, and privately owned businesses. Before that, he spent 9 years with the investment team of WENDEL, a leading European Private Equity firm, where he led leveraged buy-outs in various sectors and geographies. He started his career in Investment Banking at Deutsche Bank and UBS in Paris and London. He leads Chimera consumer, luxury, and lifestyle investments globally with a focus on the Europe / GCC corridor. Before Chimera, he was Head of Private Equity for Swicorp, a UAE-based PE firm where he concentrated on investments in the Middle East and Africa. Previously, he was a Director at Wendel, one of the largest European investment firms with permanent capital where he focused on investments in the consumer and services sectors. He held board positions in private and public companies in both developed and emerging markets. He had completed an MBA from INSEAD and a Master's in Strategy and Finance from HEC Paris.

Ms. Katherine Jenkins is a Co-Founder of Cygnet Distillery. Ms. Jenkins has earned her 'National Treasure' status not only through her dedication to her music but because of her massive charitable efforts. She is global patron of The Wilderness Foundation (conservation) as well as being an Ambassador for Prince William's TUSK Trust. She is an ambassador for cancer charity Macmillan, a trustee of The British Forces Foundation (she has travelled to Iraq, Afghanistan, Kosovo, Cyprus & Northern Ireland to entertain the troops and was presented with an OBE by HRH Prince of Wales in 2013 as a result). Katherine sits on the arts advisory board of the Nehru Centre which encourages artistic development between India and the UK and is an ambassador for Number 10's GREAT campaign. Jenkins spent 2020 creating free 'at home' performances to boost morale and bring people together virtually during the pandemic. She performed 25 'lockdown live' concerts every Saturday night to millions of people, performed a VE Day BBC concert from a deserted Buckingham Palace as well as a highly publicised 'Behind Closed Doors' concert at the Royal Albert Hall - a first in the iconic venue's 150 year history.
Mr. Kees Korevaar serves as Board Member at Royal IHC.

Mr. Kenneth Gumbiner served as Executive Vice President, Sales at IHC Risk Solutions. His sales and management experience in the employee benefits and insurance industry spans almost three decades. He began his career with a highly rated national insurance carrier in sales and sale management and went on to spend several years in Third Party Administration sales and sales management. In 1997, he transitioned into the stop-loss industry where he has focused on building key relationships with brokerage, consulting and Third Party Administration organizations nationally. Ken began working with IHC in 2008 and currently serves as the Executive Vice President of Sales for IHC Risk Solutions.

primary_position: Founder, President, Chief Executive Officer, Director of Operations & Senior Business Operations Analyst
biography: Mr. Kevin Kilkeary is the Founder & serves as President, Chief Executive Officer, Director of Operations & Senior Business Operations Analyst at Prospera Hospitality Services. Mr. Kilkeary served as President and Chief Operating Officer at Interstate Hotels Corporation. He served as President & Chief Operating Officer at Interstate Hotels Corporation. He served as President and Chief Operating Officer at Crossroads Hospitality (Interstate Hotels Mid-Market Division). He also served as Corporate Vice President of Sales and Marketing at Interstate Hotels North America. He brings to the company more than 40 years of experience in the hotel and restaurant industries paired with a personal passion for the true meaning of hospitality: serving others. A true industry veteran, he started his career in 1972 working as the Director of Sales and Marketing for Interstate Hotels at their full-service Marriott in Pittsburgh. He moved into the role of General Manager, opening and managing hotels with IHC in Charlotte, N.C., Harrisburg, Penn., and Pittsburgh again before moving into IHC's corporate office. He spent 15 years in the corporate office filling several leadership roles: Regional Vice President of Operations, Vice President of Sales and Marketing for a portfolio of 250 hotels, President of Crossroads Hospitality (an internal company overseeing 100 select serve hotels) and finally as Chief Operating Officer for all of IHC. He helped manage several company mergers and took IHC public in 1996.
Mr. Kevin Miller serves as Chief Executive Officer at The Royal Group.

Mr. Khaldoon Al Mubarak serves as Chairman at Emirates Global Aluminium. Mr. Al Mubarak serves as Chairman at Manchester City FC. He serves as Chairman at Melbourne City Football Club. He is Chairman of the Board at the Abu Dhabi Investment Council. He is one of the Middle East's most prominent and globally-engaged business leaders. He is also an influential UAE government policymaker, and an accomplished international envoy. He is the Managing Director and Group CEO of Mubadala, the $276 billion innovative and disruptive sovereign investment firm with assets in more than 50 countries across six international offices. He has led the company from its inception in 2002 and, through organic growth, acquisitions, and mergers, overseen the continuous generation of sustainable financial returns for Mubadala's shareholder, the Government of Abu Dhabi. He also Chairs the Boards of several significant companies, including Abu Dhabi Commercial Bank, Emirates Global Aluminium and the Emirates Nuclear Energy Corporation. He is Vice Chairman of MGX, an investment company to enable the advancement and deployment of leading edge technologies, and serves on the Board of Abu Dhabi National Oil Company (ADNOC), and G42, the Abu Dhabi headquartered global AI company. He holds a degree in Economics and Finance from Tufts University in Boston, USA.

Dr. Khaled El Naggar served as Board Member at Al Najah Education. He has worked with several top tier banks and is currently a Board Member of Al Najah's sister company, Healthcare MENA Ltd., another private equity platform managed by Al Masah Capital. Previously, Dr. Khaled was a Managing Director, Head of Middle East region at LGT Bank (Switzerland). Prior to that, he was an Executive Director at Deutsche Bank Private Banking & Wealth Management.
Khaled Mubarak Al Kuwari served as board member at Qatar Luxury Group.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer & Executive Chairman
biography: Dr. Khalid Al-Ali is a Co-Founder and serves as Executive Chairman & Chief Executive Officer at Senseta. He was a Co-founder at Space Bridge Partners. He brings deep experience and expertise to his roles in various organizations, having spent much of his career in Silicon Valley. He is also the Co-Founder and Chairman of the Silicon Valley Space Business Roundtable (SVSBR). He was the Executive Director of the University of California Office for NASA Partnerships (UCONP) and the University Affiliated Research Center (UARC). He was the Science Advisor for the Office of the Center Director at NASA Ames Research Center (ARC) and was the principal investigator, project lead, and program visionary at NASA ARC and NASA Jet Propulsion Laboratories (JPL), on key projects involving advanced aircraft and spacecraft technologies, intelligent avionics, novel power systems, planetary rovers and robots, spacecraft and intelligent exploratory vehicles for Lunar, Martian and Antarctic missions. He was the Director of Research at Carnegie Mellon University - Silicon Valley Campus and founded the Carnegie Mellon Innovations Lab (CMIL). He was in charge of developing Qatar Foundation's Qatar Science and Technology Park Project (QSTP). He was the advisor to the Board of Directors of Qatar Foundation and was a founding member of both Qatar's Information Technology and Communication Committee and the Steering Committee of the Information Technology and Communication Project. He is the principal inventor of U.S. and worldwide-patented technologies, along with a multitude of disclosed inventions not yet patented. He holds a Ph.D. in Mechanical and Electrical Engineering from the University of California at Berkeley.

Mr. Khurem Farooq serves as Board Member at ViceBio. He serves as Chairman at Navigator Medicines. Mr. Farooq is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Verdiva Bio. Mr. Farooq also served as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Gyroscope. Mr. Khurem co-founded and served as Chief Executive Officer at Aiolos Bio. He has more than 20 years of experience in drug development and operational leadership to Gyroscope. He previously served as the Senior Vice President of the Immunology and Ophthalmology business unit at Genentech, a member of the Roche Group. During his eleven-year tenure at Genentech, he led the commercialization and launch planning of a number of medicines in the Immunology and Ophthalmology area and helped move a number of medicines into the pipeline as a member of the Late Stage Portfolio Committee. He also was actively involved in a number of business development assessments for the organization. He began his career at Aventis in the United Kingdom holding various roles in sales and marketing, including leading several pan-European business initiatives at the European Headquarters in Paris. He holds a Masters's Degree in Business Administration as well as an Honors degree in Biological Sciences.

Ms. Kim Lembo Co-Founded and served as Vice President of Marketing at Ripcord. Kim is responsible for building the Ripcord brand, all go-to-market activities and company growth. Kim brings nearly 15 years of enterprise marketing and business development experience to Ripcord. Most recently, she ran partner marketing at Puppet and product marketing at Elastic. She has held both marketing and business development roles at NASA and was part of the NASA team that created OpenStack. Prior to NASA, she spent 3 years working in finance in China, most notably for Kingdom Holding Company. Early in her career, she was a Brookings Institute Fellow on Capitol Hill.

Mr. Kiril Evtimov serves as Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at Core42. Mr. Evtimov serves as Group Chief Technology Officer at G42. He is a seasoned technology and business leader with global experience across start-ups and Fortune 500 companies. Throughout his career, he has been successful in delivering cutting-edge cloud, analytical, and decision-support products, as well as massively scalable data platforms. His contributions have spanned a range of industries, including healthcare, financial services, and technology, leading to clients' success and significant business impact. He is a technology advisor for G42 Cloud. He is also a co-founder, board member, and CEO of Fair Signals Inc. In the past, he has held leadership roles in Teradata, MicroStrategy, and eBay. As CEO of Fair Signals, he has a broad range of responsibilities, including - vision setting, financial management, product development, people management, and leading all externally facing interactions for the financial technology startup. Previously, as Teradata's Vice President and General Manager of Unified Data Architecture Platform Technologies, he was responsible for establishing the strategic direction and leading the execution efforts of the analytical ecosystem research and development organization. I

Mr. Krisda Kamolvarinthip serves as Chief Executive Officer at Grand Royal. He has been the CEO of Grand Royal Group International since October 2024, after joining the company as Chief Marketing Officer on March 16, 2020. With over 20 years of experience in the FMCG and premium wines & spirits industries, Mr. Krisda has a robust background in multinational markets. He is a business leader with a demonstrated ability to lead diverse teams, build successful organizations, and create significant shareholder value in challenging business environments. Mr. Krisda earned his bachelor's degree in economics from Boston University and an MBA from Bentley College in the USA. He began his career in 1996 as a Corporate Finance Analyst at Schroders, then transitioned to Unilever Thailand as a Brand Manager in 1999. From 2002 to 2019, he worked with Pernod Ricard in Thailand and Hong Kong, holding various roles including Marketing Manager in Thailand, Regional Marketing Manager (Asia) in Hong Kong, Regional Sales Manager in Thailand, and Senior Marketing Manager in Thailand. He served as Marketing Director for Pernod Ricard Thailand from 2011 to 2019.

primary_position: Anchor & London-Based Correspondent, Bloomberg TV & Radio
biography: Ms. Kriti Gupta serves as Anchor & London-Based Correspondent, Bloomberg TV & Radio at Bloomberg. Ms. Gupta has conducted approximately 400 interviews with notable figures across business and politics since joining Bloomberg as an anchor. With a knack for making complex money matters and geopolitical news digestible for a global audience, she interviews top CEOs and other notable figures like US Ambassador Rahm Emanuel, Former US National Security Advisor H.R. McMaster and Valentino and Balmain Chairman Rachid Mohamed Rachid.

primary_position: Chief Life and Annuity Actuary & Senior Vice President
biography: Mr. Larry Graber served as President at Madison National Life Insurance Company. He served as a Chief Life and Annuity Actuary and Senior Vice President of Independence Holding Company. He has more than 30 years of experience in life and annuity acquisitions. He has been involved in more than 130 acquisitions of life and annuity blocks or companies, dealing with state insurance departments, state guaranty associations, NOLGHA, and insurance companies. Prior to joining IHC, he owned an acquisition consulting firm and was President of Hill Country Life Insurance Company.

Dr. Lia Partakusuma serves as Medical Director & Board Member at Pertamedika IHC. Previously, Dr. Partakusuma held management positions at several leading hospitals in Indonesia. She completed her medical education at Padjadjaran University, a specialist in Clinical Pathology at the University of Indonesia, a Master of Management at the Institute for Research and Community Service, a Master of Hospital Administration at the University of Indonesia, and earned a Doctorate/S3 degree at Gajah Mada University.

Ms. Lissa Walls serves as President & Chief Executive Officer at Southern Newspapers. .She has been in the newspaper business since 1980. She began her career as a reporter for the Rosenberg (Texas) Herald Coaster owned by Hartman Newspapers, Inc. and became COO of SNI in 1985. She was elected CEO in March 2014. She serves on the boards of the Southern Newspaper Publishers Association Foundation, Mutual Insurance Company, PAGE and Trinity University. She was born in Guntersville, Alabama and moved to the Houston, Texas area with her family in 1973. She is a 1980 graduate of Trinity University in San Antonio, TX. Walls lives in Houston, TX.
Dr. Lucia Aceves co-founded Phd Talks. Dr. Aceves is a specialist in entrepreneurship and innovation. She is a research professor, Tecnológico de Monterrey, Campus Guadalajara (SNI candidate level).

Ms. Lucia Bakulumpagi-Wamala is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Bakulu. In a traditional and male-centric industry, Lucia Bakulumpagi-Wamala's focus is on developing and implementing collaborative renewable energy projects that engage communities, empower women and contribute to environmental sustainability. As CEO & Founder of Bakulu Power, a renewable energy service provider based in her native Uganda, Lucia's goal is to power our tomorrow with projects and initiatives that foster social, environmental and economic development in her native country and throughout Sub-Saharan Africa. In 2020, Institiute Choiseul named Lucia one of the 100 African Economic Leaders for Tomorrow. Lucia has appeared on BBC, Al Jazeera, Africa News, CNBC Africa, CBC and NBS. Lucia has been profiled in Brussels Airline's in-flight magazine b.inspired, Le Pointe, Forbes, Forbes Afrique and has addressed heads of state during the United Nations General Assembly and African Union Summit. As a member of the Africa-Europe High Level Platform for Sustainable Energy Investments (SEI) Lucia represented Africa's private sector among 50 experts working with the European Union and Africa Union. Lucia has given keynote speeches at the Planet Earth Institute and the Berlin Energy Transition Dialogue. Lucia has lectured at the Yale School of Management, worked with the University of Michigan, RWTH Aachen and Oxford University. Lucia holds a degree in Public Administration with a specialization in Community Intervention from the University of Ottawa and is a graduate of the Prince of Wales Business and Sustainability Programme at the University of Cambridge. Lucia is a thought-provoking presenter and panelist on topics concerning renewable energy, entrepreneurship, women in business and youth empowerment.
Ms. Lucia Bigolin serves is a Co-Owner of Selle Royal Group.

Mr. Lukman Ma'ruf serves as President & Board Member at Pertamedika IHC. Having a strong educational background, he completed his studies in Medicine and Neurosurgery Subspecialty at Padjadjaran University, Law at STIH IBLAM Jakarta, and earned a Masters in Health Law from UPN Veteran Jakarta, Hospital Management at the University of East Indonesia, and a Doctorate in Law from Borobudur University. He is known as a Neurosurgeon at RSPAD Gatot Soebroto and before serving as President Director of IHC, he was Deputy Head of RSPAD.

Mr. Lynn Neff serves as Chief Operating Officer at HealthTrackRx. Mr. Lynn Neff served as Chief Operating Officer at Histo-Scientific Research Laboratories. He has over 25 years of pathology (histology, cytology, IHC) and clinical laboratory (chemistry, hematology, toxicology) management experience at healthcare industry leaders including Dominion Diagnostics, Southcoast Health, Inova Health System and University of Pittsburgh Medical Center. His diverse experience in multidisciplinary performance improvement and integration benefits our expanding portfolio of client-focused programs. He has an AAS in Medical Laboratory Technology & Histology from Community College of the Air Force, has certifications as MLT, HT (ASCP) and received his BBA and MBA from Colorado Technical University.
Mr. Mansoor Al Mansoori serves as Group Chief Operating Officer at G42. He also serves as Board Member at AIQ.
Mr. Marc Beldman serves as Managing Director at Contour Covering Technology. He served as Managing Director at IHC Vremac Cylinders.

primary_position: Chief Medical Officer, Senior Vice President of Clinical Development & XenoLung
biography: Dr. Marc Lorber serves as Chief Medical Officer, Senior Vice President of Clinical Development and XenoLung at Lung Biotechnology. Prior to joining Lung Biotechnology, he served in several drug development roles at Novartis, most recently as Vice President and Therapeutic Area Head, responsible for transplantation, nephrology, and autoimmunity indications in the IHC Global Development Franchise. Prior to joining Novartis in 2007, he was Chief of Organ Transplantation and Immunology at Yale University School of Medicine for nearly 21 years, where he was also Professor of Surgery and Pathology. He was an active researcher and busy clinical transplant surgeon; he has published extensively and delivered scientific addresses in his areas of expertise throughout the world. Also notable, he is the Past President of the American Society of Transplant Surgeons, a past member of the Board of Directors, and Secretary of the United Network for Organ Sharing, and he served on the Advisory Committee for Organ Transplantation, U.S. Department of Health and Human Services.

primary_position: President, Board Member & Chief Executive Officer
biography: Dr. Mariam Maghribi serves as President, Board Member & Chief Executive Officer at Tioga Cardiovascular. Mariam has over fifteen years of experience in increasingly responsible roles within business strategy, finance, R&D, and operations in the medical device and diagnostic sectors. Currently, she is Chief Business Officer of Shifamed and CEO of Atia Vision and Tioga Cardiovascular, both portfolio companies of Shifamed. Prior to Shifamed, she served as the Chief Operating Officer for deltaDOT QSTP-LLC, a joint venture between Imperial College of London and Qatar Foundation. Prior to that, she was Principal Engineer at Johnson & Johnson, where she co-founded JJ MeMs, an early stage medical microsystems incubator. Prior to Johnson & Johnson, Mariam was a Research Scientist at the Center for Micro and Nano Technology at Lawrence Livermore National Laboratories where she was a technical lead on the Department of Energy's Retinal Prosthesis Project. Mariam is an inventor on 21 issued US patents.

Dr. Mariette Awad is a Co-Founder of Holexp. Ms. Mariette is the director of the Artificial Intelligence, Data Science and Computing Hub at American University of Beirut (AUB), Lebanon, a tenured associate professor at the ECE department. Awad's academic contributions are recognized globally. She is among the top 2% of influential scholars in 2022 and 2023, by Stanford University and has earned the 2024 Abdul Hameed Shoman Award for Arab Researchers in the field of engineering and technological sciences - computational modeling in data analysis. Awad also won in 2024 the Intissar Ahdab award for Women's Excellence and Impact in Research. She is an Authorized Assessor for ethical AI, has contributed to the drafting of the Munich Convention on AI, Data and Human Rights and is in the 2024 CAIDP AI Policy Clinic Research Group. She has published over 130 manuscripts and had secured more than 4.4 millions USD from different funders such as META, NIH, Qatar Foundation. Her best seller book "Efficient Learning Machines" was one of the 5 most downloaded books by Springer Nature in Sept 2020. Springer Nature, is a leading authority in publishing textbooks and academic books for more than 175 years. BookAuthority listed her work as "#1 among the 41 Best-Selling Machine Theory books of all time" in 2020. Dr. Awad promotes women in engineering and she is a co-organizer and an ambassador for the AUB Women in Data Science (WiDS) Conference, a technical conference organized in close collaboration with the Stanford Institute for Computational and Mathematical Engineering. Since 2017, the conference attracted 4600+ attendees from more than 300 organizations, 20+ sectors, and 40+ countries. Beyond academia, Dr. Awad is actively involved in industry collaborations and consulting projects. She has worked with many UN organizations such as UNESCO, UNICEF and ESCWA as an AI Expert for the National AI plan and the Arab Vision 2040.

Mr. Mario Alovisi serves as Chief Marketing and Product at Trenitalia. He served as Lecturer at LUISS Business School, Professor in Pricing and Revenue Management at Chaire ESCP Economie Circulaire, Vice President Global Revenue Management, Itinerary Design and Transportation at Costa Crociere S.p.A., Director of Revenue Management Planning, Forecasting, Distribution and Reporting at Costa Crociere S.p.A., Director of Consumer Credit Cards and Lifestyle Development at American Express, Chief Commercial and Strategy Officer at Roma Formula Futuro - FG Group, Executive Board Member at Federcongressi&eventi, Chief Commercial Officer at Royal Group Hotels & Resorts, Pricing and Revenue Management Director at Alitalia Società Aerea Italiana S.p.A.

primary_position: Co-Founder & Chief Strategic and Manufacturing Officer
biography: Dr. Marissa Morris is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Strategic & Manufacturing Officer at Regener-Eyes. She served as Vice President, Marketing at Albiorex International Holding Company. She is a former news anchor for major network affiliates, our spokesperson, press representative and media (video, still and audio) producer.
Mr. Mark Brettell serves as Board Member at Arada.

Mr. Mark Hassinger serves as President & Founding Partner at Hassinger Real Estate Development Services. He has over 30 years of real estate development and management experience. He is a founding partner of Hassinger Real Estate Development Services. He was previously president of WestDulles Properties, where he was responsible for the firm's development activities concentrated in Fairfax, Prince William, and Loudoun Counties in the Northern Virginia area of Metropolitan Washington, D.C. Before joining WestDulles Properties, he was a senior vice president within the Land Design and Survey Division of Dewberry, a 1,600-person professional services firm operating nationally. He is currently a member of the Executive Committee of the Board of Directors and is Chairman of NAIOP Northern Virginia. He has served on several citizen advisory master plan committees for local Washington area jurisdictions and the Loudoun County Economic Development Advisory Commission. His expertise includes development management; land search and acquisitions; and marketing, with a concentration on commercial real estate projects. He has extensive experience in the land use entitlement process of local jurisdictions throughout the Washington, D.C. metropolitan area. He has done a Master's in community planning from the University of Rhode Island.

Mr. Mark Schuermann served as Senior Vice President, ERM and Treasurer at Scripps Networks Interactive. Prior to assuming this role, he served as Assistant Treasurer for the company's former parent, The E.W. Scripps Company. Schuermann began with E.W. Scripps in 1998 as Senior Auditor in the audit and consulting services department, and was promoted to Audit Manager in 2000. He was promoted to Director of Treasury Management in 2002 and Assistant Treasurer in 2006. Before joining SNI, Schuermann held internal audit positions with Fifth Third Bank and U.S. Bank. Schuermann holds an MBA from Xavier University and has a bachelor's degree in finance from the University of Cincinnati. He is also a certified treasury professional, certified risk manager and certified merger and acquisition advisor.

Mr. Mark Shaaber is a Co-Founder of Phase II. He was born in Reading Pennsylvania. He obtained a Bachelor of Science Degree in Electronics Engineering Technology from DeVry University in 1988 where he concurrently attended the Ohio State University Army R.O.T.C. program. He was commissioned as an active duty officer and subsequently completed a Master of Arts degree in Computer Resources and Information Management in 2000 while attending the Army Command and General Staff College in residence. He served 20 years of active duty service before retiring at the rank of Lieutenant Colonel. In 2008 He co-founded SCS Integrated Support Solutions (SCS) a workplace interiors and government contracting company. SCS was awarded small business of the year by the Prince William Chamber of Commerce 2013, small business supplier of the year by VSE Corporation 2013 and the HON Company fastest growing dealership 2013. In late 2015 He and his wife established Vision Finders a business consulting firm designed to help small businesses start, grow and thrive. In 2017, Vision Finders was awarded a contract for him to serve as the Interim Executive Director of Leadership Prince William. In 2018, Vision Finders was awarded a contract for him to serve as the Interim Executive Director for Serve Our Willing Warriors.

Mr. Mark Taylor serves as President and Chief Executive Officer at Lactalis Canada. Mark Taylor is President & CEO of Lactalis Canada Inc., the Canadian dairy leader behind iconic brands like Cracker Barrel, Black Diamond, Balderson, Astro and Lactantia and a subsidiary of the world's leading dairy group, headquartered in Laval, France. Since assuming the role of President & CEO in 2018, Mark has been instrumental in driving the company's growth and transformation including leading the CDN$1.62 billion acquisition of Kraft Heinz's natural cheese business in Canada in 2019, the biggest of its kind in Canadian dairy history. This transaction was followed by the acquisitions of Ultima Foods Inc. from Agropur and the Kraft Heinz Grated cheese business in Canada in 2021. Today, Lactalis Canada is the third largest country by turnover in Lactalis Group, third largest branded CPG manufacturer in Canada and consistently named on Forbes' list of Canada's Best Employers. Within the industry, Mark has played an instrumental role in the advocacy and creation of a Grocery Code of Conduct for Canada. In 2023, Mark was named Most Influential CEO 2023 - Toronto Food & Beverage Manufacturing by international publication CEO Monthly Magazine. Mark brings over 30 years of experience in CPG, specifically in the dairy category through various leadership roles across the supply chain from farm to consumer. Before locating to Canada, Mark was Group Managing Director of Lactalis U.K. and Ireland from 2015 to 2018. He also served as Chair of the Board of Directors of U.K.-based Muddy Boots Software Limited, an agri-food sector supply chain and quality compliance software company sold to Telus Agriculture in 2021. Mark was also a Board member of Zenith International Consulting in the U.K. focused on M&A and international business. He has set up and managed a number of joint venture relationships with large and small partners in the U.K., EU and U.S. and has worked with Private Equity businesses on a myriad of M&A projects in the food sector. Prior to enrolling in Diageo's graduate training scheme in 1988, he gained practical experience on farms in the U.K., Germany and New Zealand and various senior leadership roles at Express Dairy PLC, Northern Foods PLC, Unigate PLC and Dairy Crest PLC including being part of an MBO team and Board member of Wexford Creamery, Ireland. In the U.K., Mark was involved in drafting the U.K. Agriculture & Food Strategy, served as a member of the Sustainable Agriculture and Food Innovation Platform Steering Group and worked with the Technology Strategy Board (Innovate UK) as a Monitoring Officer and Assessor. Mark's wider community interests have also included working with Cambridge University's Natural Capital Leaders Program; he is Fellow of the Royal Agricultural University 100 Club and past Chairman of HRH The Prince of Wales Rural Action Program Dairy Group. Mark is currently a Board Director of Dairy Processors Association Canada (DPAC), Food, Health & Consumer Products of Canada (FHCP) and The Grocery Foundation where he also Chairs the Donations Committee. Mark has also been appointed as cabinet member of the Feel Out Loud with Kids Help Phone campaign, the largest youth mental health movement in Canada. Mark holds an MBA.
Mr. Mark Wilson serves as Chief Executive Officer at Joint Venture (International Holding / BlackRock / Lunate). Mr. Mark Wilson serves as Chairman at Policy Expert.

Mr. Markus Schneider serves as Chief Financial Officer and Commercial Director at MairDumont. He also serves as Managing Director at Mairdumont Ventures. Previously he served as a Senior Project Manager at Horváth & Partners Management Consultants. After his bank apprenticeship, he studied business informatics and business administration. This was followed by various positions in control at well-known companies. His last position was as a consultant at Horváth und Partner before he was appointed Commercial Director at MAIRDUMONT GmbH & Co. KG. In 2015, he was appointed Managing Director of Hallwag Kümmerly and Frey in Switzerland, followed shortly afterward by the management of Kompass in Austria and Gestalten Verlag in Berlin. On 1 April 2020, he was appointed Managing Director of DuMont Reiseverlag, VARTA-Führer, MAIRDUMONT international holding company as well as MAIRDUMONT, with major responsibility for finance, human resources, IT, strategic purchasing, and logistics.

Dr. Marshall Stoller is a Co-Founder & serves as Advisory Board Member at Moonstone Stone Stopper. Dr. Stoller is a Co-Founder of Applaud Medical. He graduated from the University of California at Berkeley in 1976 and went to medical school at Baylor College of Medicine in Houston, Texas. Following medical school, he returned to the SF Bay Area, where he was a general surgical intern and resident at UCSF from 1981-1983 and a urology resident from 1983-1985. The following year he was a clinical instructor and research fellow at the University of New South Wales at Prince Henry and Prince of Wales Hospitals in Sydney, Australia. He returned to UCSF as a chief resident in the Department of Urology, joining the faculty thereafter. He presently operates at Moffitt-Long Hospital, San Francisco General Hospital, and the San Francisco Veterans Affairs Medical Center. His practice emphasizes surgical management of urinary stone disease and minimally invasive endourology.

Mr. Martin Beaumont served as Deputy Chairman at Kind Consumer. He has been Chairman of the company since January 2009 having been part of the small body of investors that made the initial seed investment. Until his retirement in October 2007, he was The Chief Executive of the Co-operative Group, a multi-billion pound turnover enterprise employing in excess of 85,000 people across a diverse portfolio of businesses. During his tenure, he continued extensive restructuring and modernization of the group - which spans food stores, funeral services, pharmacies and financial services. A Cambridge University graduate, he spent the first 16 years of his career with KPMG, becoming a partner with general practice and management consultancy responsibilities. Amongst several non-executive and advisory roles, he is Chairman of Chester Race Company and a member of the board of The Duchy of Lancaster.

Mr. Martin Edelman serves as Group General Counsel at G42. Mr. Edelman serves as a Board Member at MGX. He is a Nomination and Remuneration Committee. As the Group GC, Marty leads G42's legal in-house operations and advisory team. Marty is also a partner in the world-leading law firm of Paul| Hastings and has more than 30 years of experience in corporate mergers and acquisitions transactions, with a focus on large and complex deals, including cross-border transactions. He has been involved in all stages of legal development of pioneering financial structures, including participating debt instruments, institutional JVs in real estate, and JVs between U.S. financial sources and European companies.

primary_position: Board Member & Member of the Remuneration Committee
biography: Mr. Martin Edelman serves as Board Member & Member of the Remuneration Committee at NOVA Chemicals. He is Senior Counsel to Paul Hastings LLP and has 40 plus years of experience with a concentration on large complex international real estate, including the hospitality sector, corporate mergers and acquisitions transactions. He has been involved in all stages of legal development of pioneering financial structures, including participating debt instruments, institutional joint ventures in real estate, and joint ventures between U.S. financial sources and European real estate and industrial companies. He has carried out extensive work in Europe, Canada, Mexico, Japan, China, the Middle East and Latin America. Marty's Board affiliations include BXMT, Aldar, Equity Commonwealth, G42, GlobalFoundries and Manchester City, New York City & Melbourne City football clubs. He is an advisor to Mubadala Investment Company and the Related Companies and is also a founding member of The Jackie Robinson Foundation and The Intrepid Fallen Heroes Fund. A frequent speaker at international conferences, in 2011, he was selected by the National Law Journal as one of the 34 most influential lawyers in the country and has been recognized for his work with the United States Military and military families by being awarded the Department of the Army Public Service Award. He graduated from Princeton University in 1963 and Columbia Law School in 1966.

Mr. Marwan Juma served as Board Member at Development Alternatives. He was the Jordanian Minister of Information and Communications Technology and, previously, Chief Executive Officer of Xpress Telecommunications, one of Jordan's leading mobile operators. He is also the founder and Chairman of Sama for Integrated Systems, better known as dot.jo, one of Jordan's leading web development houses, and Kinz for Information Technology, the country's leading corporate data provider. In addition, Marwan is the founder and Chairman of Oasis 500, the region's leading IT fund and accelerator. He has held prominent positions in the past as CEO of Batelco Jordan, the country's second fixed-line operator and leading data communication provider. He chaired the local chapter of the Young Arab Leaders Organization, the region's leading nongovernmental organization focused on the youth of the region. Marwan serves on several prominent boards, including those of The King Abdullah II Fund for Development, the King Abdullah Center for Excellence in Government Performance and Transparency, Princess Sumaya University for Science and Technology, Al Mamlaka Television, Capital Investments, and Jordan International Insurance. He served on the National Agenda's Royal Steering Committee, entrusted with developing Jordan's national strategy for the coming 10 years. Marwan was re-elected in mid-2009 as Chairman of INTAJ, but resigned following his ministerial appointment in late 2009. He is a founding contributor to the REACH Initiative, a five-year action plan to advance Jordan's nascent IT sector and strengthen its ability to compete in local, regional, and global markets. Marwan has lobbied for the establishment of a world-class telecom infrastructure in Jordan and for increased private-public partnerships to accelerate the country's economic development. He holds an M.B.A. from North Carolina State University and bachelor's degrees in business management and economics.

primary_position: Senior Vice President of Sales & Vice President of Business Development
biography: Mr. Matthew Tate serves as Senior Vice President of Sales & Vice President of Business Development at PreludeDx. He has over 18 years of development and commercial experience in the diagnostics market, including novel testing for device and lab services companies. Matt comes to PreludeDx from Pathnostics where he served as Vice President of Business Development responsible for the training, sales strategy, and business partnership models for the anatomic pathology lab services product lines. Prior to Pathnostics, Matt was the Director of Sales for PersonalizedDx, a division of Abbott Molecular specializing in partnership models empowering the local pathologist to control the read of genetics testing through innovative imaging tools. Matt also served as a Regional Manager for Agendia, leading the sales team responsible for selling the genetic profile Mammaprint for breast cancer recurrence. Earlier positions include Director of Sales and Marketing for Vassol Inc., an MRI imaging company focused on measuring blood flow to the brain, Marketing Manager at US Laboratories, where he was in charge of IHC and imaging for the diagnosis of Breast Cancer and Lieutenant, Supply Corp, United States Navy. He is a graduate of the United States Naval Academy where he played Division I football.

biography: Ms. Maymee Kurian serves as Group Chief Human Capital & Culture Officer at G42. Known for being result-oriented with sustained value while taking bold decisions to build capacity at all levels within anorganization, extending true partnership to help business leaders achieve their long-term and short-term business goals.

Mr. Menno Snel serves as Chairman of Supervisory Board at Royal IHC. Mr. Menno Snel served as State Secretary for Finance at Government of the Netherlands.

Mr. Meredith Marshall is a Co-Founder & serves as Managing Partner at BRP Companies. He is responsible for executing BRP's investment strategy including deal origination, acquisition, finance and development. He has also led the firm's strategic partnership initiatives such as the firm's decade long partnership with Goldman Sachs Urban Investment Group and BRP's active relationships with all of the New York City Agencies. Prior to co-founding BRP, he was a Managing Director at Musa Capital Advisors, an emerging markets private equity and financial advisory firm based in New York City. Musa Capital managed a Separate Account for Kingdom Holding Africa, HRH's Prince Alwaleed Bin Talal's Investment vehicle for Sub-Saharan Africa. At Musa Capital, he was instrumental in executing cross-border transactions including the $37 million development of a mixed-use office complex and mall in Harare, Zimbabwe. He also led successful investments in the Telecommunications and Financial Services sectors. Prior to Musa Capital Advisors, he was a Senior Associate at Wasserstein Perella & Co., an investment banking firm based in New York City. While at Wasserstein, he was an integral member of the firm's Telecommunications and Media, Mergers and Acquisitions practice, where he assisted in transactions exceeding $15 billion.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Medical Officer & Executive Board Director
biography: Dr. Michael Biggs is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Medical Officer & Executive Board Director at Atomic Oncology. He OAM is a highly experienced Neurosurgeon (MBBS, University of Sydney) specializing in brain tumours, base of skull tumours (including meningioma and acoustic neuroma), treatment of trigeminal neuralgia and hemifacial spasm, spinal surgery, and peripheral nerve surgery including carpal tunnel release, ulnar nerve decompression, meralgia paraesthetica, common peroneal nerve palsy, brachial plexus reconstruction and neurogenic tumours (schwannomas and neurofibromas). He was selected for advanced neurological training to be completed at St Vincents, Royal North Shore and Prince of Wales Hospital, Sydney, after which he undertook overseas fellowships in Toronto, Pittsburgh, Phoenix and New Orleans.

Mr. Michael Burns co-founded Blue North Fisheries. He grew up in Syracuse, New York and came to Alaska in 1978 after graduating from Syracuse University with an architecture degree. He went to visit his brother, Patrick, who was fishing in Cordova, Alaska. The brothers crewed on salmon seiners and fished halibut out of a 26' Charley Moore Skiff in Prince William Sound. In 1979 they pooled their crew shares, bought a 1967 Volvo 122 Sedan, and traveled to every port between Bellingham and San Francisco looking for a boat to longline halibut and black cod. They bought an old wood Chesapeake Bay oyster buy boat that was laid up in a slough in Longview, WA and converted it to a longline. The longlines in the Gulf of Alaska and tendered salmon in Prince William Sound. In 1983 they bought their second boat, the '86 power scow Seldovia. They tendered salmon and herring from Ketchican to Nome. They rapidly built their fleet of tenders to 5 vessels and started in the Bering Sea Crab Fisheries in the early 90's. They pursued the Freezer Longline Fishery when they bought the laid-up Blue North from Tyson in 1994. Patrick and Michael specialized in buying dysfunctional longliners and turning them into working, profitable vessels. By 2005, they had a fleet of five crabber/tenders, one crab catcher processor boat, and seven longliners as well as a vessel that worked for the tuna canneries in American Samoa. In the late 90's, Michael started a small real estate development company on Bainbridge Island. The present portfolio consists of mixed-use commercial buildings and multi-family residential on Bainbridge Island and Poulsbo. In 1994, the brothers had an opportunity to purchase some property on the Grande Ronde River in Eastern Oregon. Here thy had their chance to become ranchers in one of the most beautiful areas of the Northwest. The property quickly grew to one of the largest Angus cattle ranches in the area with an emphasis on grass fed beef. It's a traditional family-run ranch with most of the cattle work done on horseback. In 2010, he had the opportunity to purchase a bankrupt saw mill in Kamiah, Idaho. the mill had been shut down for 2 1/2 years. This was yet another opportunity to buy a distressed asset and participate in another natural resource business. The mill is located on the beautiful Clearwater River and presently employs 65 people.

primary_position: Chief Financial Officer & Chief Operating Officer
biography: Mr. Michael Capel serves as Chief Financial Officer and Chief Operating Officer at Country Hill International. Mr. Capel served as Senior Vice President and Chief Operating Officer at Qatar Luxury Group. He graduated from Cornell University, New York, USA, where he received Bachelor of Science and Master of Public Administration degrees. Prior to joining Qatar Luxury Group, he spent over ten years at KPMG/BearingPoint in management consulting, focusing on business strategy, operational improvement, IT strategy, human resources, shared services, economic and statistical analysis, and project management. He led many projects in public- and private-sector organizations in the United States and Middle East. Since 2006 he was dedicated to his company's Middle East practice, working on missions in Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Qatar, and U.A.E., among other countries. This experience empowered him with a deep knowledge of a wide variety of business practices the region. Among his projects were consolidating back-office and ERP processes for a national government, studying the feasibility of an IT park for a real estate investment company, and supporting the modernization of a security agency in a regional country. As VP for Corporate and Strategic Planning, he manages QLG's corporate roll-out plan, making sure that the group's resources are aligned toward its business objectives. He is also responsible for acquisitions, business development, and other strategic projects. He manages the group's corporate governance, government relations, legal services, information.

primary_position: Managing Counsel and Head of Global Mergers & Acquisitions, Legal and Core Legal Functions
biography: Dr. Michael Chan served as Managing Counsel and Head of Global Mergers & Acquisitions, Legal and Core Legal Functions at Binance. He previously served as Associate General Counsel and Senior Legal Counsel at VimpelCom. He served as Senior Transaction Counsel at Qatar Foundation Endowment. He served as Transaction Counsel at Qatar Foundation Endowment. He served as a Senior Associate at Dewey & LeBoeuf. He served as an Associate at Hogan Lovells.

Mr. Michael Jackson serves as Advisor at Electrogenics Labs. He is the Director of Radiation Oncology at Prince of Wales Hospital in Sydney, a Conjoint Associate Professor at the University of New South Wales and an Honorary Principal Fellow, School of Engineering Physics, University of Wollongong. He has worked at the Royal Prince Alfred Hospital as Head of Department, served on the Board of the Faculty of Radiation Oncology of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Radiologists and as Chairman of the Radiation Oncology Group of the Clinical Oncological Society of Australia and the Australasian Brachytherapy Group as well as being an active member of the Trans-Tasman Radiation Oncology Group. He is currently the Chair of the Radiation Oncology Chapter of NSW Branch of the Royal Australian and New Zealand College of Radiologists.

Mr. Michael Kaplan served as Chief Financial Officer at SOAP Health. Mr. Kaplan has 25+ years of healthcare finance/accounting experience as Chief Financial Officer, at HealthDrive, a two time INC. 500 start up, where he orchestrated the sale of the company to a private equity firm, and Vice President, Finance Operations for a major metropolitan health system, South Shore Health System. His previous experience includes venture capital with DCC, Plc, a publicly traded international holding company, and accounting roles at two large international public accounting firms. He is a CPA and earned his MBA from the Wharton School at the University of Pennsylvania.

Mr. Michael Kemp served as President at IHC Risk Solutions. Michael A. Kemp is Chief Underwriting Officer and Senior Vice President of Independence Holding Company (NYSE: IHC). Mr. Kemp has over 30 years' experience in the life and health insurance and reinsurance industry. He has assumed actuarial and underwriting roles at consulting firms, insurance companies, and a reinsurance management firms. In 2003, he founded ReAct Consulting International where he provided actuarial and underwriting consulting services to many clients, including IHC since 2005. Mr. Kemp has been a Fellow of the Society of Actuaries since 1985 and is also a Member of the American Academy of Actuaries and a Fellow of the Conference of Consulting Actuaries.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chairman, President & Chief Executive Officer
biography: Mr. Michael Keresman Co-Founded and served as Chairman, President & Chief Executive Officer at CardinalCommerce. Mike has consistently used his expertise and knowledge to grow CardinalCommerce from a start-up company to the worldwide leading enabler of payment brands. He has helped create a new industry with a global reach with operations in Europe, Africa, North and South America, and distributions in Asia and Australia. Under his direction, CardinalCommerce has developed strategic partnerships with various payment brands including Visa, MasterCard, Amazon Payments, BillMeLater, Google, and PayPal, as well as merchant service providers/processors such as Chase, CyberSource, Fifth Third, First Data and others. Mike's success with CardinalCommerce has earned him recognition as one of Ernst & Young's Entrepreneurs of the Year in 2004 and 2005. Before founding CardinalCommerce, he was one of the earliest employees and co-founder at STERIS Corporation (NYSE: STE), holding several senior management positions from 1988 to 1999, including Senior Vice President, CFO, and CIO, as well as the primary operations executive. In 1981, he was an early employee and the CFO of HealthAmerica of Ohio. In his role he helped to establish the first statewide HMO network in the country. His leadership and dedication helped to grow HealthAmerica of Ohio more than 500% in less than three years. Between his tenures at STERIS and HealthAmerica, Mike held senior management positions at International HealthCare, Inc. (IHC) and Western Reserve Health Plan as well. Mike graduated from John Carroll University with a BSBA in Finance. He is on the Board of Directors for The Secure Remote Payment Council, is a member of the Cleveland Federal Reserve Advisory Board, and is as a member of the Lake Erie College Board of Directors, where he serves on the Finance and Assets and Institutional Advancement Committees.

Stevens joined us in May 2001 as Controller, became Treasurer in January 2002, was appointed Vice President and Chief Financial Officer in March 2005 and appointed Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer in March 2015. From 1993 until May 2001, he served in various positions including Chief Financial Officer, Controller, Secretary and Treasurer at Inland Resources Inc., a company engaged in oil and gas exploration and development. He spent seven years in public accounting with Coopers & Lybrand in Minneapolis, Minnesota. He is a graduate of Mankato State University of Minnesota and is a Certified Public Accountant.

Mr. Michael Stevens serves as Chief Sales Officer at Workera. He served as Vice President, Sales at Affinity. Mr. Stevens served as Chairman at BHR. He serves as Vice President Sales at Affinity.

Prior to joining UTS he was a Treasury Analyst with Enbridge Inc., after holding the position of Commercial Account Manager with HSBC Bank Canada. Mr. Michael Stevens serves as President at Capitol Riverfront Business Improvement District. As president of the BID, Mr. Stevens has worked for the past 17 years to achieve the vision of a vibrant waterfront Capitol Riverfront community, which will contain 37 million square feet of development at build-out. His efforts led to the 2007 establishment of the BID, which is currently in its fourth 5-year operating cycle. He is responsible for overseeing a staff of over 25 full-time professionals, a 21-member board of directors, all external relations, development of work programs, and budget oversight. He helped coordinate the Center City Action Agenda of 2007 & 2010 - a new strategic plan and framework to guide development and public investment in the center city neighborhoods of Washington, DC. From 2000-2006 he served as the President & CEO of the Washington, DC Economic Partnership and built that organization from a start-up to a full partner in the District's economic development initiatives.Prior to coming to Washington, He was the VP of Development for the Memphis Center City Commission, a combination of BID and economic development authority. He oversaw the planning and economic development section that administered financial incentives for downtown development projects such as the Memphis Redbird's new Triple A baseball stadium, hundreds of units of new housing, the South Main Arts District, and a new downtown public elementary school.He has been involved in the economic development, urban planning, and downtown/neighborhood development fields for the majority of his 41-year career. He has worked for public planning agencies, private planning firms, BIDs, and economic development entities. He has participated in numerous downtown redevelopment efforts for cities such as Wichita, KS; Lubbock, TX; Dallas, TX; Nashville, TN; Memphis, TN; Jackson, MS; Washington, DC; and San Antonio, TX. He holds a Master's degree in Urban Planning/Urban Design from Virginia Tech in Blacksburg, VA, and a BA in Urban Sociology from Millsaps College in Jackson, MS. He serves in a volunteer capacity in the District by participating on boards such as Barracks Row Main Street; the Leadership Council for a Cleaner Anacostia; DC Sustainable Transit; DC Building Industry Association; the DC BID Council; and Friends of the National Arboretum. He has participated in numerous Technical Advisory Panels for ULI, IDA, and APA. He is also an adjunct professor at Georgetown University's College of Continuing Studies where he teaches a class on economic development in the Masters in Urban Planning program.

Mr. Michael Stevens serves as Board Member at Llusern Scientific.

primary_position: Account Manager and Business Development Executive
biography: Mr. Michael Stevens serves as Account Manager and Business Development Executive at Antech Direct. He has worked in the esports industry for over five years, previously managing events such as the Insomnia Gaming Festival.
Mr. Michael Stevens is the Founder of Of Kos.
Mr. Michael Stevens is the Founder of Sticklr. Mr. Stevens has received an education from Victoria University of Wellington.

Ms. Michelle Hancic serves as Chief People Officer at Arada Developments. She is responsible for overseeing the development and execution of Arada's people strategies and practices across all the Group's businesses and verticals, both in the UAE and internationally. Ms. Hancic has 25 years of extensive global HR and leadership experience, with previous roles at leading organizations including ANZ, LinkedIn/Glint, and most recently Microsoft, where she led the adoption and change management practice for Copilot partners.
As a psychologist she is passionate about improving the lived experience for employees across the entire talent lifecycle and transforming the performance of organizations as a result. She has also led consulting teams supporting Fortune 500 companies to build effective culture and people transformation processes. she has a special interest in the intersection of evidence-based people practices and technology and has advised government bodies such as the Singapore Personal Data Protection Council (PDPC) and the Australian Human Rights Commission. Ms. Hancic holds a Masters degree in Occupational Psychology from Monash University, Melbourne, specializing in the drivers of employee engagement and retention.
Mr. Miguel Arias serves as Co-Chief Executive Officer and President at Logiscenter. He also serves as an Advisory Team Member at Arada Capital Partners. He served as a partner at Candor Equity.
Mr. Miguel Montero Quevedo served as Board Member at Arada Systems.

primary_position: Founder, Chief Executive Officer & Board Member
biography: Mr. Mike Feerick is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at Alison. He was a Founder & served as Chief Executive Officer. He is an internationally recognized and award winning social entrepreneur. Among his Awards are an Ashoka Fellowship 2010, the UNESCO King Hamad Bin Isa Al-Khalifa ICT in Education innovation Diploma Award 2010, an Arthur Guinness Social Fund Award Winner 2012, WISE Award, 2013, (Qatar Foundation). He was a runner up in the World Economic Forum Social Entrepreneur of the Year Awards 2016. First conceiving the idea that education and skills training could be made free online using a advertising / certification model in late 2005, he changed the business model of a paid online learning business focused on IT Desktop training called Advance Learning, into the free online learning platform Alison is today, launching the free learning platform in April 2007. He also quotes the vision of a world of free education within the UN Declaration of Human Rights, Article 26 "Education shall be free" as a personal source of motivation. He is a frequent and popular international speaker on innovation in online education, workplace skills and related entrepreneurship. He is the founder and Chairperson of Ireland Reaching Out, an Irish government-sponsored non-profit Irish Diaspora Initiative with the goal of reunifying 80 million people of Irish descent worldwide. He was also the founding Chairman of the International Advisory Board of the University of Limerick Business School, and is a Director Emeritus of the University of Limerick Foundation. He was previously the Chairperson of the Irish Support & Advice Service in London, UK, where he pioneered outreach programmes to assist marginalized elderly Irish immigrants in the UK. He also served on the Board of Bertelsmann Music Group (BMG/RCA) UK. He holds degrees from the University of Limerick (BBS 89) and an MBA from Harvard University (94).

Mr. Mike Still serves as Advisor at IamYiam. Mike has over 30 years of experience in the risk management and insurance industry serving a broad range of clients by size and business sector. Mike cares passionately about making a difference to people, businesses and communities and has been a long time supporter of The Princes Trust and Business in the Community (BITC). He is Chairman of BITC, Scotland and Trustee and Director of the UK BITC which is a business-led charity where members work together to tackle a wide range of issues that are essential to creating a fairer society and a more sustainable future. As part of this Mike is Chairman of the Business Emergency Resilience Group (BERG), a leadership group of BITC, which is an initiative established by HRH The Prince of Wales to help businesses and communities across the UK become more resilient, supporting them to prepare, respond better and recover faster from crisis. Members across business, government bodies and charities, collaborate and take action to help tackle some of the key issues facing society. Through his exceptional work and contribution towards BITC and BERG, Mike was appointed the prestigious role of HRH The Prince of Wales Ambassador for Responsible Business in Scotland from June 2015 to 2017. In addition he has provided leadership and support as chairman of YPO Scotland (2013 to 2016) to support better leaders through learning and ideas exchange and continues to chair the annual business school for members utilising world class resources including LBS and Harvard to develop his and others leadership and business skills.

primary_position: Chief Executive Officer, Director of Operations, President Director Board Member
biography: Ms. Mira Wahyuni served as Chief Executive Officer, Director of Operations, President Director & Board Member at Pertamedika IHC.

Mr. Javed Baig is the Co-Founder and serves as Principal Broker at Prince William Realty. Mr. Baig is a self made business leader that is focused on providing his fellow man the most amount of respect, honesty and financial wealth. He is a full time real estate Broker and is very passionate about everything that he does. Javed Baig works constantly to help increase the knowledge and wealth of his clients, fellow Realtors®, and friends.
