Javed is very active in the local community as well and currently serves as the Director of Prince William Associations of REALTORs, President of Ridgefield Homeowners Associations, President of County Center Homeowners Association, Director at Large in Prince William Committee of 100, Board Member of Advisory Committee of Virginia International University.

Mr. Moe Harrison served as President at SNI Companies. Mr. Harrison served as Regional Vice President, Texas and Minneapolis at SNI Companies. He graduated with a BBA from Baylor University and began his recruiting career with the Dallas office of The Lucas Group where he earned President's Club Honors as a producer in addition to managing the direct hire division. He then worked for Robert Half International in the accounting and finance search division and was a top producer in the Dallas office. Moe joined Q&A as a partner in 1998. He oversees all operations for the six specialty divisions within Q&A and focuses heavily on the execution of the long-term growth strategies of the firm.

Mr. Mohamed Bensalah serves as Chief Executive Officer and Chairman at Holmarcom. Born in 1970, He holds degrees in management and finance from the Sorbonne University and the Ecole des Cadres de Paris. He has been Chairman and CEO of the Moroccan group HOLMARCOM since 1993. He is also a President of the Moroccan Insurance Federation (FMA); Member of the Board of Directors of the General Confederation of Moroccan Enterprises (CGEM), the Professional Group of Moroccan Banks (GPBM) and Casablanca Finance City; Member of the Board of Directors of the Mohammed VI Foundation for Environmental Protection, the Mohammed V Foundation for Solidarity and the Alaouite Foundation for Sustainable Human Development; Member of the Economic, Social and Environmental Council. In 2004, he was awarded the title of Knight of Wissam Al Arche by His Majesty King Mohammed VI, may God assist him.

Mr. Mohamed Dobashi served as Chairman at Le Tanneur & Cie. He is consultant for Qatar Foundation Endowment after having assisted the President of Qatar Foundation in achieving the overall goals and objectives of the Foundation. Prior to working at the Qatar Foundation, he was the Chief Operations Officer of Amlak Holding (100% Qatar Foundation Subsidiary). Previously, he was Group Chief Operations Officer (COO) for Al-Faisal Holding Company. Dr. Dobashi was an Associate Professor for Carnegie Mellon University campus (of which he took part at the origin) in the Gulf country of Qatar. Dr. Dobashi is an experienced professional with a wealth of experience not only in higher education but also international experience in the oil and gas sector, public sector and finance. Working for big five consulting firms, he has been on a number of startup projects through out the world including Europe, North America, the Middle East and the Arabian Gulf. Dr. Dobashi is bilingual Arabic and English. He earned Doctorate in Law from Northwestern University School of Law, Chicago, IL, an MBA from Thunderbird (American Graduate School of International Management), Glendale, AZ and a double BA in Economics and International business from Pacific Lutheran University, Tacoma, WA. He has the American nationality.

Mr. Mohammad Yasera serves as Board Member at Canal Sugar. He is a distinguished financial leader with over 18 years of experience in finance, accounting, mergers & acquisitions, investments, and financial management strategies. As a Board Member at Canal Sugar, he plays a vital role in guiding the company's financial strategy and governance. Currently serving as Group Chief Financial Officer at Alpha Dhabi Holding PJSC, Mr. Yaser oversees the company's financial operations, supporting top management in devising strategic financial plans and driving sustainable growth. He is also a Board Member at Sandstorm Motor Vehicle LLC and Mawarid Holding Investment LLC, reflecting his extensive influence across the investment and financial sectors. His career began in finance and accounting, where he honed his expertise in corporate finance and strategic investment planning. Since joining International Holding Company (IHC) in 2011, he has been instrumental in supporting executive leadership, enhancing corporate finance functions, and shaping the financial direction of key organizations in the UAE. A Certified Management Accountant (CMA) and Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Mr. Yaser combines technical acumen with strategic foresight, driving financial excellence and operational efficiency. His wealth of experience and leadership continue to support Canal Sugar's vision for sustainable growth and financial resilience.

Mr. Mohammed Al-Suwaidi serves as Chief Executive Officer at Aspire Zone Foundation. Mr. Al-Suwaidi leads the implementation of Aspire Zone Foundation's (AZF) overall strategic direction under the supervision of the President's Office, ensuring that AZF's business strategy and objectives are reflected in the AZF's business processes and that they are delivered in a professional and proactive manner. He was working as Executive Director - Operations at Qatar Foundation since July 2013. Prior to this, he was Procurement Director for three years. He has15 years of experience in various aspects of Procurement and Supply Chain Management at Qatar Foundation and RasGas. He holds a bachelor's degree in Business Administration and has attended several technical, management, and leadership training. The latest addition to his knowledge portfolio is Senior Management Leadership Program conducted by Qatar Foundation in association with Oxford University. He is a result-oriented inspirational leader capable of building and developing effective teams and leading people to achieve their fullest potential. During his tenure at Qatar Foundation, he has implemented innovative solutions to streamline the processes, re-structure the organization and develop systems to achieve operational efficiency and enhance customer service. He holds a bachelor's degree in Business Administration.

Mr. Mohammed Ibrahim Al-Shaibani serves as Board Member at Nakheel. He is the Director General of H.H. The Dubai Ruler's Court and Managing Director of the Investment Corporation of Dubai, the principal investment arm of the government of Dubai. He is also the Vice Chairman of the Supreme Fiscal Committee of Dubai which oversees the Emirate's fiscal policies and is a member of Dubai's Executive Council, an entity charged with supervising and supporting Dubai's government bodies. In addition, he serves as the Deputy Chairman of the Higher Committee of World Expo 2020 and Chairman of the Supreme Committee for the Supervision of International Humanitarian City (IHC), founded in 2003 in Dubai by H.H. the Ruler of Dubai as global center for humanitarian emergency preparedness and response. His Excellency also serves as Chairman of the Board of Directors of Kerzner International, the world-leading property developer of landmark projects in Dubai, including the award-winning iconic Palm Jumeirah, as well as Chairman of the Board of Directors at Dubai Islamic Bank and Meydan City Corporation. He is also a member of the board of several government-related organizations including Dubai World and Dubai Aerospace Enterprise Limited.
Mr. Mohd Loay serves as Chief Investment Officer at Royal Group.

Mr. Morgan Porter serves as Chief Operating Officer at Molecular Designs. Mr. Porter served as Chief Operating Officer at Biocare Medical (IHC instrumentation). He served as Chief Compliance Officer at Mentis Neuro Rehabilition.

Ms. Nancy Wildfeir-Field served as Chief Executive Officer and President at GBC Health. Having worked across the public, private and nonprofit sectors, she passionately believes in collaboration, cooperation and communication as the impetus for innovative, scaled and sustainable solutions for business and development challenges. Nancy brings extensive international experience in both global health and the private sector. Most recently, she served as Director, Global Partnerships for BSR (Business for Social Responsibility) where she oversaw the highly regarded HERproject. Prior to BSR, she brokered and managed a portfolio of partnerships for USAID in the Caribbean, Eastern Europe and Eurasia, while developing organizational capacity to create public-private partnership, achieving shared value for the private sector, the US government and national governments. She spearheaded the development of the Jamaican Business Council on HIV/Aids to fight stigma and discrimination in the workplace, collaborating closely with the Ministry of Health, the National AIDS program and committee, NGOs, business organizations and local and international business; this successful model was later expanded to other Eastern Caribbean islands. Earlier, Nancy served as Managing Director for The Prince of Wales International Business Leaders Forum (IBLF), where she was architect, for the 'Engage' campaign, launched across four continents with the support of leading businesses and NGOs to share best practices and encourage alignment and consistency between CSR, employee engagement and country-based initiatives. Nancy has also held joint management responsibility for the health issues group at Burson-Marsteller, served as communications director for one of the UK's largest medical associations, and as an independent consultant, managed a project implementation strategy for the UK Ministry of Health. She has lived in the U.K, Jamaica, Ukraine and Hungary, and has worked in more than 30 countries across multiple regions and industries, on a portfolio of issues. Nancy is a graduate of Boston University.

Mr. Nasser Al-Naimi serves as Chief Administrative Officer at Qatalum. Mr. Al-Naimi received his Bachelor Degree in Business Administration from Qatar University and holds notable professional certificates in Human Resources. He started his career at Hamad Medical Corporation, followed by Qatar Gas in the HR Department. Nasser moved to Msheireb Properties, the real estate investment arm of Qatar Foundation in 2011, where he held the position of Senior Manager of HR and Corporate Services. In 2015 he joined Qatalum as HR Manager.

Mr. Nasser Saleh is the Founder and serves as Chairman at MadfoatCom. Before launching MadfooatCom, he was the CIO of Jordan's second fiscal reform program. Previously, he worked at Al Rajhi, one of Saudi Arabia's largest banks, where he managed programs for retail, commercial, and corporate banking divisions, as well as e-trading and payments programs. Previously, he worked as a senior advisor at Accenture in Saudi Arabia and was a senior engineer at Microsoft in the USA. He's led numerous strategic initiatives to develop and modernize electronic payment processes that promote safe, reliable, and efficient e-commerce in the region. In 2017, Jordan's King Abdullah II ibn Al Hussein awarded him with the distinguished Medal of Excellence for establishing the country's acclaimed electronic billing and payment gateway with the support of the Central Bank of Jordan. He holds a B.Sc. in Electrical Engineering from the University of Jordan.

Mr. Nicholas George co-founded KGR Capital Management. Mr. George served as Director at Nutmeg. He served as Board Member ar euNetworks. He has spent over 30 years in the financial services industry. He has held senior positions in several roles at BZW, JPMorgan, and HSBC in the UK and Asia. In 2002 Nick established KGR Capital, a funds management business based in Hong Kong that he sold to the LGT Group in 2008. He remains an advisor to LGT and sits on the boards of Millennium and Copthorne and Aberdeen New Dawn Investment Trust in the UK and GK Goh. Nick is a Fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants. He served as a Board Member at EuNetworks in Singapore.
Mr. Nick Calisi served as Manager, Business Development at SNI Companies.
Mr. Nick Waterdrinker served as Managing Director at IHC Marine and Mineral Projects.

Dr. Nicola Feuerstein served as Chief Executive Officer at LGT Treuhand. He is a Partner at Swiss ALP Asset Management. He is a Partner at Feuerstein Schelling & Partner. He was a Head of Trust Services at LGT Group.

Ms. Nicole Naum is a Co-Founder & the Owner and serves as Partner at Battlefield Law Group. Ms. Naum is a trial attorney who has dedicated her career to protecting the rights and interests of her clients in the area of criminal and traffic defense. She attended the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor where she received a Bachelor's of Science in Mathematical Sciences. Upon completing this degree in 2004, she worked as a paralegal for one year at Carmel & Carmel, PC, a small real estate law firm in Washington, DC which focused on out-of-state land sales. In December 2008, Ms. Naum graduated in the top 25% of her class from the University of Detroit Mercy School of Law. While attending school, Nicole excelled in course work relating to criminal law and choose electives in this area: Advanced Sentencing, Death Penalty Law, Criminal Procedure, Criminal Law, Juveniles in the Law, and Evidence.
Her career as an attorney began at two small law firms: one in Fairfax, VA and at Mansoor Law Firm in Loudoun, VA where she represented clients in all Northern Virginia jurisdictions in criminal and traffic cases. In May 2012, she joined the firm of Price Benowitz, LLP where she was able to focus her practice on matters in Prince William County and Culpeper County. During these years of practice, she successfully litigated hundreds of criminal matters including, misdemeanors and felonies, and traffic cases with favorable results.

Mr. Nitin Saksena served as Chief Scientific and Technical Officer at Aegros. He trained at the Pasteur Institute, Paris, France; and Regional Oncology Centre, SUNY (Syracuse, NY, USA), with some of the top eminent virologists, and is an internationally recognized virologist and genomics scientist with over 25 years of academic/clinical, research and teaching experience in the infectious diseases, oncology, neurodegenerative diseases, genomics, and plasma proteomics. With several patents and a licensed drug formulation, he led the development and patenting of a small RNA biomarker for neurodegenerative diseases and an immuno-therapy for HIV, in addition to conducting several clinical trials in virology with top-tier pharmaceutical companies. He is widely published, and serves on the editorial board of several scientific journals of repute. As a Chief Scientific Officer, he managed scientific, clinical, and business strategy portfolios for three biotech companies and served as the Director of the OMICS Centre of Excellence at G42 Healthcare, Abu Dhabi (UAE), heading the largest sequencing project worldwide on one million human genomes from the Emiratis. He is an Adjunct Professor at Victoria University, Melbourne and also a Senior Research Fellow at La Trobe University, Melbourne. He is a Scientific Advisor and consultant to the renowned and largest Genomics Institute in the world- the Beijing Institute of Genomics (BGI), China.

primary_position: Executive Vice President & Chief People & Strategy Officer
biography: Mr. Nj Pesci serves as Executive Vice President & Chief People & Strategy Officer at Savage Services. He joined Savage in 2024 as our Executive Vice President, Chief People & Strategy Officer. Prior to joining Savage, He served as President and Founder of the Ovid Groupe. Through this consulting firm, he's offered strategic guidance designed to enable organizations and executives to transform their businesses since 2017. He also served as Chief Strategy Officer for KLAS Research from 2021 through 2023. In this role, He was responsible for the development of the firm's business strategy as well as the growth of each of its business units. Additionally, he was the managing director of KLAS' new consulting business. Before founding the Ovid Groupe and driving the strategy at KLAS Research, he was the Executive Vice President, Chief Human Resources Officer for Scripps Networks Interactive (SNI) - one of the leading developers of lifestyle content for television and the Internet. At Scripps, he oversaw SNI's global human resources operations and aligned the company's long-term strategic growth priorities with its design and objectives. He also introduced the company's process for developing and delivering its business strategies, worked with the Board, and focused on executive compensation. Prior to joining Scripps, he spent 19 years in a number of line and human resources roles at The Procter & Gamble Company, including leading the human resources team that supports P&G's largest organizational unit, Global Supply Chain and Labor Relations. He also completed a three-year assignment in Frankfurt, Germany where he played a prominent role in integrating the Wella Professional acquisition. Before venturing into a career in human resources, He worked as an analyst for the United States Department of Defense in Washington, D.C. he earned a master's degree in organizational behavior from Brigham Young University and serves as a member of the HR/OB advisory board.

Mr. Nouman Mirza serves as Managing Broker at Prince William Realty. He currently serves on the board for the Realtors Association of Prince William (PWAR) and has chaired the Young Professionals Network (YPN) at PWAR. As a chair for YPN, he helped organize many community fundraising events such as 5K, silent auctions, casino night, and happy hours and taught social media and other technology classes. In his current role as managing broker for Prince William Realty, he mentors his team to be the best real estate agents in the industry while helping his own clients achieve their real estate goals.

primary_position: Chief Executive Officer & Chairman of the Board
biography: Mr. Oleg Mykhayloych Blozovskiy served as Chief Executive Officer & Chairman of the Board at KSG Bank. Oleg Blozovskyi was born on April 8, 1962. In 1983, he got his higher economic education, graduating from the Ternopil Finance and Economics Institute. He began his professional career at the leading industrial enterprises of the Lviv region. From 1985 till 1986 he worked as an engineer of planning and economic department of "Miskbudtrest" PE, and in 1986-1993 he worked as a deputy head of supply department in Zolochivsk Radio Factory. In 1993-1994, Oleg Blozovskyi worked in the public sphere, dealing with privatization of communal property. During this period he was a deputy chairman of the Foundation Communal property of Zolochiv District State Administration. Since 1994, he has been in management positions at leading financial institutions of Ukraine. 1994-2001 - Director of the carrying branch of "PrivatBank" PJSC. In 2001-2004 - Head of the branch network of "Ukrsotsbank" JSCB, one of the top-five Ukrainian banks. In 2004-2005 Oleg Blozovskyi was a manager of the "financial supermarket" project of "Interpipe" holding company. In 2005 - 2008 - Deputy Director of the National Directorate of "Oranta" NJSIC. Oleg Blozovskyi continued his career as a director of a regional network of "BTA Bank" JSC in 2008-2009, and being the head of executive director of "IMG International Holding Company" and adviser of the chairman of the insurance company "IC "Oranta-Life" JSC in 2009-2010. Since 2010, Oleg Blozovskyi has been working in the banking sphere. From 2010 to February 2014 - Advisor of Chairman of the Board, head of sales channels of banking products of "Unex Bank" PJSC. Since March 2014, he is a Chairman of KSG BANK, and is a shareholder of the Bank.

Mr. Oliver Brind serves as Head of Business Development at Aperio Intelligence. Mr. Brind joined Aperio in 2018 as Head of Business Development. Oliver was previously at GPW, where he was responsible for business development and case management. Oliver began his career at Cazenove, where he first worked in the institutional sales and research department, before being appointed Managing Director of Cazenove Australia. On his return to London, he was responsible for Cazenove's relationships with the private equity industry. Oliver worked for The Prince of Wales as Director of Development for The Prince's Charities Foundation (2004 - 2010), with particular responsibility for its international programme. In 2010, Oliver joined Credit Suisse's private bank in the UK, where he was responsible for managing private clients' assets and leading a team of relationship managers, and then moved to Walker Crips, an independent investment manager in 2012. Oliver has an MA in History from the University of Cambridge. He has a working knowledge of French and Italian. He knows Africa well, having lived in Uganda, Mauritius, Somalia and Malawi.

Mr. Olivier Perregaux serves as Advisor at Liqid. He is CEO of LGT Private Banking and has been part of the LGT Group since 1999. He was previously CFO and a member of the Senior Management Board of the LGT Group. The Swiss national also spent several years at Zurich Financial Services and McKinsey & Company. De Perregaux graduated with a degree in business administration from the University of St. Gallen with a degree in economics.

Mr. Oluwasegun Olatona serves as Chief Compliance Officer at Keystone Bank. Oluwasegun started his commercial banking career with Commercial Bank (Credit Lyonnais Nigeria) where his excellent performance got him referred to Fortune International Bank plc. At Fortune Bank he was the pioneer Head of Foreign Operations, he set up the department and got Central Bankof Nigeria Examiners commendation at their first Forex examination of the bank. Thereafter, he left for first Bank of Nigeria where he had a stint before joining Diamond Bank Plc. At Diamond Bank Plc, he spent over a decade and rose to Head several strategic business divisions; International Operations, Branch Operations and Internal Control. He is a member of Nigeria Institute of Management and Chartered Institute of Bankers Nigeria. He has attended training programmes locally and international amongst which are Financing International Trade and Advanced Documentary Credit by Michael Stevens & Associate in association with BPP Bank Training & Financial Consulting UK, Senior Management Program (SMP 40) Lagos Business School, Correspondent Banking Training in Deutsche Bank London & Germany, Centralised Cash Collateral Process know-how Citibank London, Trade Finance Training at BHF Germany and HSBC, SWIFT customer Credit Transfer Course Belgium, Executive Programmes: Driving Strategic Impact University of Colombia and High Impact Leadership Berkley Haas, California.

Mr. Ondřej Svoboda serves as Chief Financial Officer at InterGen (UK). He has over 15 years of experience as a Chief Financial Officer and in strategic and executive management roles in an international environment, with a proven record in maximizing financial performance, managing all financial aspects of business operations, driving business growth, and overseeing risk management with a focus on increasing profitability. Prior to joining InterGen, he held senior finance, acquisitions, and business project development roles at the Sev.en holding group, the second-largest producer of electricity in the Czech Republic, within the power and heat generation industry. He has also held senior finance and investment management positions at an international holding company specializing in financial services, development, and consultancy

Ms. Pam Reynolds serves as Chief Executive Officer at TASC. He served as Chief Service Offering Officer at TASC. She came to TASC with several years of experience in business and financial management. Her work in the aerospace and manufacturing industries focused on strategic planning, performance measurement, process management, and financial analysis. Since joining TASC, Pam has worked on new product development and market analysis and has been responsible for the development of many new products and services, including DirectPay Health Reimbursement Arrangement (HRA), COBRAToday, TASC Health Savings Account (HSA), and the TASC Card. She has also been instrumental in the development and management of TASC's Strategy System of Management and assists the organization and leadership in charting and executing the plan to realize TASC's future. In 2014, Pam was recognized for outstanding leadership and innovative healthcare benefit solutions by the Institute of Healthcare Consumerism (IHC).

Ms. Pamela Butcher serves as Board Member at Pilot Chemical Company. Ms. Butcher joined Pilot Chemical Company's Board of Directors in 2016 and served as Pilot Chemical's CEO until December 2020. Pam joined Pilot Chemical after a successful 29-year career with The Dow Chemical Company, where she held a variety of leadership positions including Business Vice President of Specialty Chemicals, Vice President of Corporate Marketing & Sales and Vice President and General Manager of Adhesives and Sealants. She was also a distinguished recipient of Dow's Genesis Award for people excellence, which is Dow's highest recognition for people leadership. An active leader in the chemical industry, Pam was president of the Board of Trustees for the Chemical Educational Foundation and served on the Boards of the American Cleaning Institute, the Ohio Manufacturing Association and the Regional Advisory Board of U.S. Bank. Pam holds a Bachelor's Degree in Agronomy and a Master's of Science Degree from Purdue University. She also is a graduate of the Northwestern University Marketing Executive program and has participated in the Prince of Wales Sustainability Conference and the Asian Master Class on Asian Business. She is a member of the National Association of Corporate Directors and has completed the Director Professional Master Class. She also serves as an independent Director on the Boards of Gruden Topco Holdings and of Trecora Resources.

Dr. Pascal Bamford serves as Chief Clinical Officer & Senior Vice President, R&D and Laboratory Operations at Akoya Biosciences. He served as Chief Scientific Officer and Head of Laboratory Operations at Epic Sciences. Dr. Bamford obtained his Ph.D. from the University of Queensland, Australia, and researched how cancer-associated changes in DNA structure, detectable in digital images, could be used to automate the process of distinguishing cervical cancer from normal cells. His early career was spent developing automated cytology imaging systems at CSSIP in Australia in collaboration with Accumed International of Chicago. He subsequently took on the role of director of Imaging at MonoGen, where he developed an all-digital, microscopy-based, cervical cancer screening product, which was recognized as the first "killer app" for the field of digital pathology. For the past five years at Ventana-Roche, Dr. Bamford has held various roles of increasing responsibility in research, digital pathology and assay development, working on fluorescence multiplexing imaging systems and driving several bright field IHC algorithm CE-IVD and 510(k) clearances. Most recently Dr. Bamford led the detection reagent development of Ventana's next generation staining platform. He is the author of six patents and more than 18 scientific publications. He earned Ecole Nationale Supérieure des Télécommunications, France.

Mr. Paul Cuttill serves as Deputy Chairman at Drenl. Paul has worked in the UK energy Sector for over 30 years. During his career, he held a range of senior appointments with EDF Energy plc, including Chief Operating Officer, Power Networks. This business unit employed around 5500 people, had a regulatory asset value of c. £3.0bn, and distributed electricity to 7.8m customers across London, East Anglian and the South East. Paul is a Board member of Strategy International Limited trading as The D Group, one of the UK's leading business networking organizations, and holds a number of other appointments both business and societal, including being a Board Member (Governor) of Legacy Trust UK Limited - a company entrusted to oversee and manage £40m endowment of National Lottery and Government funds to promote participation and enthusiasm for the Olympic and Paralympic Games. In June 2004, Paul was appointed by HRH The Prince of Wales as an Ambassador for Corporate Responsibility in the London Region.

Mr. Paul Kahn is a Co-Founder & serves as Non-Executive Director at SmartIR bringing decades of global leadership experience across the aerospace, defence, space, and advanced technology sectors. A leading industrialist, He has held executive roles at some of the world's most prominent engineering and defence companies, guiding multi-billion-dollar organizations through transformation, growth, and innovation. He most recently served as President of Government Solutions International at KBR, Inc., where he led a $1.3 billion global business across the UK, Australia, the Middle East, and Asia, delivering critical services in defence, infrastructure, energy, and consulting. Prior to this, he was President of Communications & Connectivity at Cobham plc, a FTSE 250 aerospace and defence company, where he delivered a successful operational turnaround before its acquisition by Advent International. From 2014 to 2017, He was President and CEO of Airbus Group UK, overseeing Airbus's UK operations across satellites, civil aircraft, helicopters, cyber solutions, and defence systems. Under his leadership, Airbus UK became the largest employer in the UK space sector and secured major government contracts, including the introduction of the A400M military aircraft. Earlier in his career, He held numerous senior positions at Thales SA, including CEO of Thales Canada and Global VP of Navigation and Airport Solutions, with roles spanning France, Italy, the UK, and Canada. He also served in leadership roles within the UK Ministry of Defence, building his expertise in procurement, systems architecture, and secure communications. He is a Chartered Engineer and holds an MBA from London Business School. He is a Fellow of the Royal Aeronautical Society, the Institution of Mechanical Engineers, and the Institution of Engineering and Technology. In addition to his industrial roles, he has served as a UK Government Business Ambassador for Advanced Manufacturing and Aerospace, an HRH Prince of Wales Ambassador for Industrial Cadets, and a former President of ADS, the UK trade association for Aerospace, Defence, Security, and Space.

Mr. Paul Manheim served as the Chairman at Shanghai Red Star Optical. He currently serves as a member of FutureFuel board since July 15, 2011. Mr. Manheim also serves as chairman of FutureFuel audit committee and as a member of FutureFuel nominating/corporate governance committee. Mr. Manheim is currently the CEO of HAL Real Estate Inc., which develops and owns a portfolio of real estate in the Pacific Northwest consisting of multi-family, office, and mixed-use assets. HAL Real Estate Inc. is a subsidiary of HAL Holding N.V. Mr. Manheim joined Holland America Line, N.V., the predecessor of HAL Holding N.V., an international holding company traded on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange, in 1982 and filled various positions in the financial and corporate development areas. From 2005 to 2015, Mr. Manheim was the chairman of the board of Shanghai Red Star Optical Company, which owns a portfolio of optical retail outlets in China and is affiliated with Europe's largest optical retailer. Mr. Manheim has served as a director and chairman of the audit committee of WPT GP, LLC, the general partner of World Point Terminals, LP since 2013. Mr. Manheim received a bachelor of commerce degree with honors from the University of New South Wales, Australia, and qualified as a Chartered Accountant in 1976.

primary_position: Founder, Chief Executive Officer and Board Member
biography: Dr. Paul Morrill is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at CellRx. He served as Chief Business Officer at bit.bio. He served as President, Reagent Products at Horizon Discovery. He has over 30 years of experience in the biotechnology and pharmaceutical sectors having held senior positions at Microgenics, Boeringher Mannheim, Acumen Biosciences, and, most recently, Horizon Discovery plc. In addition, over a 3-year period working in conjunction with Novo Nordisk, he worked on the downstream process of Factor VII. He has a strong and proven track record in business, commercial, and product innovation/ development and, as a business entrepreneur, has helped to found numerous biotechnology and technology companies over the past 14 years, including a commercial founder of Horizon Discovery Group plc. Over the past 9 years, as President of Products at Horizon Discovery Group, plc, he was instrumental in forming a bioprocessing group that focused on creating gene-edited CHO cell lines that could impact the growing need within the industry for improved producer cell lines. In addition, he led the efforts of standardization within the Molecular Diagnostics (including NGS, FISH, and IHC) industries by creating a range of highly characterized cell-based reference standards that allow for platform/assay/operator comparison and standardization. He originated and built the products group at Horizon Discovery, which encompassed Diagnostics, Bioproduction, and Engineered cell lines. He holds a Ph.D. in Biotechnology from the University of Cambridge, and is the author and contributor of several peer-reviewed papers and patents in the fields of diagnostics, down-stream processing, and imaging arrays.

Mr. Paul Van Der Harten serves as Chief Financial Officer & Board Member at Royal IHC. He has extensive international experience with energy-related companies. He previously worked as CFO of AEG Power Solutions, and held various financial positions at OMV and Royal Dutch Shell.

Mr. Paul Verheul serves as a Member of the Supervisory Board at Van Oord. He previously served as Chief Operating Officer at Van Oord. Previously, he served as the chief executive officer at Driessen Aerospace Group. He served as Executive Director of MerweOord (Van Oord family's holding company) and Supervisory memberships: AutoBinck Group, Acta Marine (voorzitter), MARIN, Advisory Board DOB Ecology, Foundation Board Royal IHC.
Mr. Peng Xiao is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Play Weekends.

Mr. Peng Xiao serves as Group Chief Executive Officer at G42. Mr. Xiao is a Board Member at MGX. He is the Chairman of the Board Executive Committee, Chairman of the Nomination and Remuneration Committee, and Member of the Audit and Risk Committee. He also serves as a Board Member at Yahsat and AIQ. He is the Chief Executive Officer of Group 42 Ltd. (G42), where his responsibilities include shaping G42's business and product strategies and overseeing G42's operating companies across numerous industry verticals, including smart city, healthcare, energy, finance, and education. Prior to this, he served as Senior Executive Vice President, Chief Technology Officer, and Chief Information Officer of MicroStrategy, where he was responsible for the management of over 1,000 engineers and led the R&D function of MicroStrategy's entire product portfolio, including Business Intelligence, Secure Identity, and Mobile Commerce. He also serves as a member of the Board of Trustees of the Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence. Mr. Xiao earned his Master's Degree in International Affairs from George Washington University and his Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science and International Business from Hawaii Pacific University.
Mr. Peng Xiao is the Founder & serves as Chairman at CSUN New Material.
Mr. Peng Xiao is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at nako.
Mr. Peng Xiao serves as Chief Executive Officer at G Forty Two General Trading.

Mr. Pete Langlois served as Chief Operating Officer at SNI Companies. Pete brings many years of experience in all aspects of staffing and consulting to his role. His mission is to keep the company ahead of trends, enhance brand recognition, and establish best practices and deliver consistent revenue growth for the company. Pete has a long history of hiring, training, and retaining top talent while simultaneously delivering positive business results. Many current staffing industry leaders recognize Pete as a mentor as he has wide range of experience in technology, accounting/finance, administrative/clerical, and legal staffing. Through the years, Pete has placed many qualified candidates in temporary and consulting engagements, temp-to-perm, contract-to-hire, and direct placement. Pete comes to SNI Companies with a proven record of building successful consulting practices from the ground up. During his eight year tenure with a large international staffing and recruiting firm, Pete took an underperforming IT consulting business in Florida to a perennial, world-wide Top 10 producing division. Pete earned the distinguished President's Club award for his performance and was also recognized as the number one, top performing Branch Manager and received the Chairman's Club award. Pete was a multi-million dollar producer and held the titles of Division Director, Branch Manager of Professional Staffing Services, Branch Manager of Consulting Services, Vice President and Regional Manager, and Vice President of Major Accounts while at a large international staffing and recruiting firm. Pete went on to launch a very successful technology practice for Solomon Page Technology Partners that achieved profitability within months of inception. Pete has also developed Electronic Performance Support Systems (EPSS); managed large Training & Development departments; and facilitated the Dale Carnegie courses in Human Relations and Sales.

primary_position: Founder, Chairman, President & Chief Executive Officer
biography: Mr. Phil Harrington is the Founder and serves as Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer at Kuder. Mr. Harrington established Career Assessment Centers in 1997 to provide integrated assessment, career guidance, and education planning tools to all students and adults. Assembling a faculty of leading experts in career development theory, he directed extensive research among 100,000 key stakeholders throughout the United States to develop the first research-based, comprehensive career development system of its kind, the Kuder Career Planning System® (KCPS). Under his leadership, the company - renamed Kuder, Inc. in 2007 - has become one of the most respected and innovative in the industry, serving as a leading voice and resource for issues surrounding education and career planning. A sought-after speaker at industry events, he has conducted lectures, workshops, and seminars for the Qatar Foundation, the American Counseling Association, the National Association of State Directors of Career Technical Education Consortium, the National Career Development Association, and the U.S. Department of Labor's Employment and Training Administration, among many others.

Mr. Phil Pattison serves as Chief Financial Officer at Manus Neurodynamica. He is a finance and commercial professional, who has held positions as director or senior manager for numerous blue-chip companies including; General Electric, Rolls-Royce, Marks and Spencer, Newcastle Science City and Royal IHC. In 2005 he and other fellow directors set up a specialist skincare company and floated on AIM. He is a Fellow of the Institute of Management Accountants, a Chartered Banker and holds an MBA from Newcastle University. Whilst at GE he was Compliance Leader and a Black Belt in Six Sigma, business process improvement. His projects generated an additional $1m in profit and $3m in cash in six months.

primary_position: Chief Executive Officer and Board Member
biography: Mr. Philip Harting serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at HARTING. Mr. Harting completed an apprenticeship as an industrial electronics technician, specializing in equipment technology in 1998. He studied industrial engineering, specializing in Electrical Engineering, in Braunschweig, and Economics and Business Administration in Cologne. He graduated in Business Administration (M.Sc) in 2005. He was Managing Director Asia, HARTING (HK) Ltd., Hong Kong from 2005 to 2008. He was a Board Member of Connectivity and Networks, HARTING Technology Group from 2008 to 2015. He has been Chairman of the Board, HARTING Technology Group, since 2015. He has achieved Manager of the Year (Markt&Technik) for 2015. 2017 and 2019. Since 2014, he has been a Member of the Board at the Association of the Electrical and Digital Industry e. V. (ZVEI) and, since 2023, also a Member of its Board of Directors. He became a member of Presidium of the Association for Electronics, Electrical Engineering and Information Technologies (VDE) in 2023. At Deutsche Messe AG (HANNOVER MESSE), he has served as a Member of the Trade Fair Advisory Board for Industrial Automation since 2008 and became a Member of the Hannover Messe Exhibitor Advisory Board in 2020. He has been the Chairman of the Advisory Board for the Munich Trade Fair Centre (electronica) since 2021. He has also been associated with the Association of the German Trade Fair Industry (AUMA), serving as a board member since 2008 and becoming Chairman of the Board in 2019. He is a member of the Rotary Club Lübbecke-Westfalen since 2009 and has held the position of Secretary since 2015. He has been a partner of the Handball Bundesliga team GWD Minden since 2015 and a Member of the Presidium of the IHC Industrie- und Handelsclub Ostwestfalen-Lippe e.V. since 2019.
Mr. Praveen Singh served as Executive at Arada Systems (Wireless Product Operations).

Mr. Prince Maximilian serves as Advisor at Liqid. He is the Chairman of the Board of Directors of the LGT Foundation. He is the founder of Lightrock, a venture capital fund with assets under management of over three billion euros. His career was founded in the private equity industry. He was CEO of the LGT Group until the end of 2020. Prince Max of Liechtenstein has an MBA from Harvard Business School and previously studied business administration at the European Business School.

Dr. Quentin Reeves is a Co-Founder & serves as Managing Partner and Principal Consultant at Specialist Radiology. He is a Musculoskeletal Radiologist at both SRG and Auckland City Hospital. After completing the Radiology programme at Auckland, Quentin received his subspecialty training in MRI and musculoskeletal radiology at UCLA. He subsequently worked in Sydney in private practice and at Prince of Wales Hospital. He has a particular interest in MRI, musculoskeletal ultrasound and spinal procedures. Well respected within the medical community, Quentin has worked in Sydney, Los Angeles and Auckland, with career highlights including working as a Radiologist at the 2000 Sydney Olympic Games.

primary_position: Founder, Owner and Chief Executive Officer
biography: Mr. Rachid Essehli founded, owned, and served as Chief Executive Officer at American Advanced Membrane Technology. He left his position as a Senior Scientist at the Qatar Foundation in March 2019 to join Oak Ridge National Laboratory, where he continued his work on developing next-generation cobalt-free cathodes for lithium-ion batteries. He completed a Ph.D. (Doctor of Philosophy).

Mr. Raffaele Breschi serves as Chief Operating Officer at Arsenale Group. He served as Group Chief Growth Officer at G42. He serves as COO of Arsenale Group, multi-brand company operating in the luxury hospitality through its two main divisions: hotels & resorts, and luxury train crusing. Arsenale represents a unique reality on the Italian market, offering the first Italian model of luxury hospitality by rail. In his role, Raffaele focuses on international expansion, corporate strategy, and business development, as well as building a modern organization. Before Arsenale, he was the Group Chief Growth Officer at G42, an AI conglomerate based in Abu Dhabi with a focus on smart city solutions. In this capacity, Raffaele managed the portfolio of companies, investments, and internationalization efforts. Earlier in his career, Raffaele was a partner at McKinsey & Company between Milan and Dubai, where he led the Real Estate practice. His responsibilities involved providing advice to real estate developers, hospitality groups, shopping mall operators, and sovereign wealth funds on various aspects of their businesses, including organization, operations, strategy, and marketing. Raffaele was also a board member at Khazna, the largest data center operator in the Middle East, and a visiting professor at IE Business School, where he taught courses on Management Consulting and Critical Thinking skills. Raffaele holds an MBA from IE Business School, a master's degree in business from Bocconi University, and a professional certification in Data Science applied to Real Estate and Smart Cities from MIT.

primary_position: Founder, Owner, Chief Executive Officer, Designer & Creative Director
biography: Ms. Raishma Islam is the Founder, Owner & serves as Chief Executive Officer, Designer & Creative Director at Raishma. She is a true pioneer in the British-Asian fashion industry and specializes in bridal and evening wear with her contemporary cuts and innovative styling. She has worked alongside some of the biggest names in the fashion industry, from Elizabeth Emmanuel to Bruce Oldfield with an unrivaled reputation for her unique signature designs and trend leadership. She has created a buzz in the industry, dressing celebrities such as Mel B, Ffion Hague, HRH Princess Eugenie, and Beatrice. Most recently Raishma designed a dress for a young homeless teenager called Shozna, who was invited to the royal wedding by Prince William and Kate Middleton in April 2011. Raishma received worldwide press coverage, including BBC World, Japanese Nippon TV, and nationally in Hello magazine, OK magazine, and the Daily Mail amongst others.

Dr. Raj Pannu is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Emergence Creative. Mr. Pannu is an expert at adapting private sector approaches to behavior change for application in the public sphere. He serves as a Strategic Partner and Advisor at Global Futures Group. has implemented large-scale communication strategies with a range of clients including the Coca-Cola Company, Sesame Workshop, and PEPFAR. As Director of Global Health at McCann Health, he facilitated collaborations with multinational companies, and NGOs including the Bill and Melinda Gates Foundation, USAID, and UNICEF. A former member of the UN Essential Medicines Working Group, he has been an invited speaker to Harvard University, Columbia University, and the Qatar Foundation. He holds an MS in Immunology and a PhD in Biochemistry from the University of Alberta.

Mr. Rajiv Wahi serves as Board Member at Chai Point. Wahi served as Operating Partner at Gaja Capital. He serves as Board Member at Chai Point and Veeba. He also serves as Advisor at DSG Consumer Partners. He served as the President of Asia Pacific Operations and Vice Chairman of Mondelez India Foods Limited (Formerly known as Cadbury India Limited). Rajiv has more than 30 years of experience in the food industry. He serves as the Chairman Prince of Wales Bhumi Vardaan Foundation, a charitable foundation launched by the Prince of Wales to promote organic farming in India. Rajiv holds a B.A. Economic Studies from Newcastle University.

Mr. Rakib Ahmed is a Co-Founder and serves as Operations Executive at Loadshare. He is an economics graduate, previously founded Lunate Technologies, a startup that offers hardware for last-mile solutions to the logistics industry.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer and Board Member
biography: Mr. Ramachandran Venkataramanan co-founded and served as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Karkinos. He is currently engaged as an Advisor to the Chairman, of Reliance Industries Limited, India's largest private-sector company. Before his association with Reliance, He spent more than a decade and a half with the Tata Group in various capacities. His last assignment in the Tata Group was as Managing Trustee of the Tata Trusts wherein he was responsible for the operations, oversight, and coordination between the various Tata Trusts. From early 2007 to the end of 2012, he was Executive Assistant to Mr Ratan N. Tata, the former Chairman of the Tata Group. Before his stint with Mr Tata's office, he was associated as Head of Business Support at the Qatar Foundation, a not-for-profit entity engaged in Education, Science and Community development based in Doha, wherein he played a key role in establishing partnerships with several leading US universities. He was also the CEO of the UC-RNT Fund. He is a Science graduate and has done his MBA from the Sri Satya Sai University, Puttaparthi. He is also a Law Graduate from Mumbai University and has completed his Advanced Management Program (AMP) at the Harvard Business School. He is currently pursuing his EngD from the University of Warrick, the UK in the role of Technology in Health Care Systems.

Ms. Rana Mattar serves as Chief Legal Officer at Arada Developments. She is a seasoned legal professional with over 25 years of experience in both private practice and senior in-house legal roles. Her career spans prominent organizations such as Emaar Properties PJSC and Majid Al Futtaim Properties, where she played a key role in advising on complex corporate, commercial, and real estate transactions across multiple regions. With expertise in corporate governance, regulatory compliance, mergers and acquisitions, and contract management, She brings a wealth of knowledge and leadership to our legal and government relations department. She holds two Master of Laws (LL.M.) degrees-one in U.S. Law from Washington University in St. Louis, and another in Business, Banking, and Finance Law from Université Saint-Joseph in Lebanon in partnership with Paris-Panthéon-Assas University, where she graduated with honors.

Ms. Randa Ayoubi founded Rubicon Group Holding. She previously served as Chief Executive Officer of Rubicon Group Holding. She completed her post-graduate studies at Harvard. Among her many official distinctions, she was recognized by the United Nations for her educational efforts in Africa. Currently, she serves on the board of trustees of the King's Academy, a Jordan-based progressive coed boarding high school founded by His Majesty King Abdullah II. She has many awards and public recognitions, such as the Entrepreneur of the Year Award by YEA in 2000, and the regional Entrepreneur Award by Arabian Business in 2004. The Businesswoman of the Year Award at the CEO Middle East Awards 2010 and the Ernst Young.
Mr. Rasheed Mohammad Rasheed served as Board Member at Qatar Luxury Group.
Rashid Fahad Al-Naimi served as board member at Qatar Luxury Group.

Ms. Rebecca Barnes serves as Publisher at Brides & Weddings. She has more than 30 years experience as an entrepreneur and leader in the business community. Specializing in communications and marketing, she has won numerous awards, including business of the year three times from the Prince William Chamber of Commerce.
Mr. Reggie Thomaes serves as Director at IHC Fundex Equipment.

Mr. Rem Koolhaas is a Co-Founder of OMA . In 1995, his book S,M,L,XL summarized the work of OMA in "a novel about architecture". He co-heads the work of both OMA and AMO, the research branch of OMA, operating in areas beyond the realm of architecture. His built work includes the Austrian House (2023), Taipei Performing Arts Center (2022), Axel Springer Campus in Berlin (2020), the Qatar National Library and the Qatar Foundation Headquarters (2018), Fondation Galeries Lafayette in Paris (2018), Fondazione Prada in Milan (2015/2018), Garage Museum of Contemporary Art in Moscow (2015), the headquarters for China Central Television (CCTV) in Beijing (2012), Casa da Musica in Porto (2005), Seattle Central Library (2004), and the Netherlands Embassy in Berlin (2003). Koolhaas directed the 2014 Venice Architecture Biennale, is a professor at Harvard University, and curated Countryside: The Future (2020), an exhibition about the non-urban areas around the globe that opened in February 2020 at the Guggenheim Museum in New York.

Mr. Rich Driggs serves as Operating Partner at Atlas Holdings. He serves as President and Chief Executive Officer at North Wind. He serves as a Board Member at Erickson Construction. He served as Chief Operating Officer and Executive Vice President at Michael Baker International. He is the former executive vice president of Lend Lease Corporation, a diversified property group with market-leading positions in the United States, Canada, and Latin America. Lend Lease operates out of four key sectors: public-private partnerships, residential property development, property investment management, and construction/program management. Throughout his career, which has included roles in both large engineering firms and construction companies, he has established himself as a prominent figure in the built environment, championing a series of successful ventures and pioneering initiatives. Demonstrating the ability to collaborate effectively with management teams, he has consistently driven the evolution of these organizations, leveraging emerging markets to introduce pioneering solutions that have set them apart from their competitors. His strategic foresight has led to sustainable growth, yielding benefits for both shareholders and the dedicated staff who aspire to advance their careers within the business. Beyond his professional endeavors, he remains deeply committed to the betterment of his community, actively striving to make a positive impact on society. Alongside his family, he has provided a nurturing home for numerous foster children, establishing a safe haven for some of the community's most vulnerable members. This experience has instilled within him a profound appreciation for diversity, both in thought and within his teams. His leadership philosophy is firmly rooted in fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and ultimately, high performance. He has a Bachelor of Science in Construction Management with National Honors from Purdue University, West Lafayette, Indiana. He has completed an Executive Program from Columbia University, Executive Education (Global) from Wharton School of Business, University of Pennsylvania and The Prince of Wales Business and Sustainability Programme (BSP) from the University of Cambridge.

Mr. Richard Blundell serves as Entrepreneur-in-Residence at Rotman School of Management. He serves as Advisor at GroundBreak Ventures. Mr. Blundell served as Interim Chief Executive Officer, Executive Programs at Rotman School of Management. Mr. Blundell has over 35 years of senior executive management and consulting experience in the global environmental services and technology sectors. His experience includes operations management, corporate and market development, mergers and acquisitions, new business initiation, and consulting. Mr. Blundell's international experience includes running businesses in East and West Europe, North and South America, Africa, and Asia (12 countries from India to China). He has significant experience in new business creation and management of growth-stage businesses in global markets. He has completed over $500 million in combined corporate M&A transactions and private equity funding for early-stage companies. From 1989-2004, Mr. Blundell held senior leadership positions with Laidlaw Inc., Canada's largest waste management company, as Director of European Business Development; SGS SA, a global company in inspection, testing, and certification services as SVP of the Global Environmental Services Division; and Hagemeyer Cosa Liebermann, a technology marketing company in Asia Pacific as EVP of the Technology Division. During this period and since 2004, Mr. Blundell has held founder and/or executive management positions in ten early-stage, cleantech companies, including a number of Board of Directors appointments. He joined the MaRS Discovery District in 2018 to lead the development of applied innovation networks for global, corporate partners. In 2019, he was appointed Managing Director of the Cleantech Venture Services group. MaRS is Canada's largest innovation hub with 1M ft sq of office space in downtown Toronto serving over 1,400 startups, from early-stage to high growth companies in the Cleantech, Health Sciences, Fintech and Enterprise Software, including a focus on AI, IoT, AR and other fourth industrial revolution technologies. He is an Executive-in-Residence at the Rotman School of Management at the University of Toronto. He joined the Rotman faculty in 2016, where he teaches MBA, Executive MBA and Global Executive MBA courses in sustainability and entrepreneurship. He is also an advisor to the Prince of Wales Accounting for Sustainability charity.

primary_company: Indian Health Center Of Santa Clara Valley
biography: Mr. Richard Grooms served as Chief Financial Officer at Indian Health Center Of Santa Clara Valley. Mr. Grooms earned a Bachelor's Degree in Accounting and an MBA in Healthcare Management. He has been in accounting for more than 25 years and in Healthcare for the last 12. He found his calling when he was offered a controller position in an FQHC in Wisconsin. Like everyone at IHC, He is dedicated to increasing access to care and removing barriers to wellness. As a senior leader, he works across departments to achieve the most efficient and cost-effective way to provide and collect for services. He holds a Bachelor's in Accounting and an MBA in Healthcare Management.

primary_position: Senior Vice President & Chief Marketing Officer
biography: Mr. Richard Levy serves as Senior Vice President & Chief Marketing Officer at Lehigh Valley Health Network. In this role, he oversees all marketing, strategic communications and community engagement activities and LVHN's physician and EMS liaison program. He is accountable for inspiring healthy lifestyles and positioning LVHN as the market leader to drive awareness, demand, advocacy and engagement among LVHN colleagues and community members. He joined LVHN in 2019 as Vice President, Marketing and Public Affairs. Prior to LVHN, he served as Chief Executive Officer (CEO) of Myelin Health. In this role, he was responsible for all companies operating under Myelin Communications (Partners & Simons, HYConnect, Avid Design and Dodge Communications) and led a team that achieved two successful acquisitions and produced an active pipeline of acquisition targets. During his extensive healthcare career, he was President and CEO of Partners & Simons (Baird Capital), President of IHC Communications and Executive Vice President of inVentiv Health, Inc., President of CommonHealth: Ferguson, and President of HealthSTAR Advertising. He also held numerous leadership roles, including President and CEO, at Adair-Greene Healthcare Communications. He received a Bachelor of Science in Marketing and Finance from Syracuse University. He serves on the Boards of the IronPigs Charities and Boy Scouts of America Minsi Trails Council.
Mr. Richard Pizzi served as Managing Director at SNI Companies.

Mr. Ricky Thirion serves as Group Chief Financial Officer at G42. Mr. Thirion oversees the Group Finance and Investments of G42. Prior to G42 Ricky spent 16 years in aviation as Group Treasurer and CFO of Etihad Airways and South African Airways. He also has experience in the banking, mining and technology sectors with leading listed companies such as Standard Bank, Gold Fields and Dimension Data. He holds a Masters Degree in Mechanical and Aeronautical Engineering, is an Honorary Fellow of the Association of Corporate Treasurers (UK), and has won numerous international awards as Treasurer and dealmaker.

Ms. Roanna Benn is a Co-Founder & serves as Co-Chief Executive Officer at Drama Republic. Ms. Benn established Drama Republic with her long-term colleagues Mr. Greg Brenman and Ms. Jude Liknaitzky in 2013. Ms. Benn most recently executive-produced Life, a 6-part series by Mike Bartlett which aired in September 2020. She executive-produced Pure, a 6-part series for Channel 4 by Kirstie Swain, which broadcast in early 2019 and is currently streaming on Netflix. In 2018, she executive-produced Wanderlust by Nick Payne for BBC One and Netflix. Ms. Benn previously developed and executive-produced two seasons of Mike Bartlett's BBC One hit series, Doctor Foster. It was the highest-rating new show in all genres in 2015 and was awarded Best New Drama & Best Drama Performance for Suranne Jones at both the 2016 and 2018 National Television Awards; Best Drama at the Broadcast Awards; Best Drama at the South Bank Show Awards; Best Actress for Suranne Jones at the RTS, Broadcasting Press Guild, and BAFTA Awards. Ms. Benn also executive-produced the first two series of BAFTA-nominated My Mad Fat Diary by Tom Bidwell for E4 and King Charles III, the acclaimed adaptation of Mike Bartlett's stage play. At Tiger Aspect, Ms. Benn script-edited four series Playing the Field by Kay Mellor for BBC One, Births, Marriages and Deaths by Tony Grounds/BBC Two, BAFTA-award winning White Girl by Abi Morgan/BBC Two, and the multi-BAFTA-winning & Oscar-nominated feature film Billy Elliot by Lee Hall. As either producer, series producer, or executive producer Ms. Benn made: the BAFTA-nominated Coming Down the Mountain by Mark Haddon/BBC One; Aftersun by David Nicholls/BBC One; Royal Wedding by Abi Morgan/ BBC Two; four series of Secret Diary of a Call Girl by Lucy Prebble & others/ITV2 & SHOWTIME and two series of Prisoners' Wives by Julie Gearey/BBC One.

Mr. Robbie Blakeman serves as Joint Managing Director at Osbit. Robbie has over 20 years of experience in leading the development and implementation of pioneering engineering systems in the offshore wind, oil & gas, and automotive industries. A formative member of the Osbit team, after joining in 2011, he became a director in 2013. Prior to this, Robbie was Head of EB Solutions at IHC Engineering Business (now Royal IHC) and held key technical roles in a number of world-first offshore wind projects. Robbie holds an MEng in Mechanical and Automotive Engineering from Newcastle University and is dedicated to developing engineering talent and technical excellence.

Mr. Robert Carroll served as the Chairman and CEO of the Biofriendly/Green Plus group. He also was a Board Member at Titan Oil Recovery. An active inventor, co-inventor of Green Plus® combustion catalyst along with William F. Carroll, Noel Carroll, and Michael T. Carroll. Co-inventor of the original Vortoil oil-water separator system and other environmental products. Co-founder of BWN Automatic Doors, BWN Vortoil, and Live Oil Services, all originally Australian-based. The Vortoil oil-water separator won the Prince of Wales Award in the 1980s for being an innovative product, and then later in the mid-1990s won the Queen's Award for being the best new technology introduced to the North Sea that enabled the oil companies to protect the ecosystem while easily handling their produced water and increasing their oil production. It was stated that without the Vortoil oil-water separator the North Sea would not have been able to enjoy its high-level production. He managed a family-owned industrial paint company in 1966. During that time the revenues grew by almost 50% and the family received and accepted an attractive offer to sell the business to Australia's largest household paint manufacturer. In this company, he, William, and Noel were trained in all facets of the business. They were also trained in industrial chemistry under Hilton Stevens who at the time was the professor of organic chemistry at Melbourne University.

Mr. Robert Fardi serves as Strategic Partnerships Advisor at REQ. He was a Co-Founder and served as the President at Unison Partners. He is a 21-year veteran of marketing and business development. In 2003, he co-founded Unison, a leading integrated brand agency that combines strategic, creative and technology services to help clients build and strengthen their brands. A specialist in developing comprehensive communications campaigns, Robert draws upon his deep global experience to identify key business opportunities where Unison's brand and digital offerings present an exceptional fit with the branding needs of sovereign governments, corporations and NGOs. In his broad duties as President of Unison, Robert leads and works closely with interdisciplinary teams serving Unison's diverse clients on a daily basis. Robert is a results-oriented professional who begins every client engagement by developing a keen understanding of a client's long-term goals and then defines a strategic course of action to achieve them. His key insight experiences have been instrumental in numerous successful collaborations with some of the world's most prestigious brands. Robert has delivered strategic counsel to notable clients across many industries and regions, such as: GE Capital, United Nations, United Arab Emirates, the Combined Federal Campaign of the National Capital Area (CFCNCA), MAN Group, the Global Fund, Contrack International, GoldToeMoretz, Abu Dhabi Authority for Culture and Heritage, CRDF Global, GLORIAD, Sweetgreen, Qatar Foundation, M&CSaatchi, MICROS, US-UAE Business Council, USAID, Smithsonian Institution, Sands Capital Management, Recoup, Verizon, Ogilvy, DMSAS, CORE and DFT. Prior to co-founding Unison, Robert worked at the International Republican Institute, Smith Barney, Inc., Abu Dhabi International Bank, Inc. (Washington DC), Bixler and Accenture. Robert holds a B.A. in International Studies (with Highest Distinction) from George Mason University and a minor in International Business at George Washington University. In addition, Robert holds a M.A. in International Commerce and Policy from George Mason University's School of Public Policy and completed graduate studies at St. Peter's College, Oxford University while working at Abu Dhabi International Bank.

Mr. Robert Lamoureux served as Chairman at Foresters Financial Services. During his 35-year career with PricewaterhouseCoopers, Bob served as auditor for a wide range of private and public companies and developed a keen interest in corporate governance. He has served as Chairman of the Board of Royal Group Technologies and as a Director of M.R.S. Trust and Augen Gold Corp. He has served as Chair of the Audit Committee of Consonus Technologies. Bob has been a member of numerous accounting industry and professional Committees. He lives in Toronto, Ontario, with his spouse, Ann, and they have one son, Geoff, who is an attorney in Los Angeles. Bob is an avid golfer and skier and is currently a Director of the Canadian Seniors' Golf Association and past President of the Mississauga Golf and Country Club.

Mr. Robert Mason served as Board Member at BondMason. He has 30 years of experience in Private Equity, as a banker to buyout transactions at JPMorgan, where he founded and ran the European Leveraged Transaction Group; the founder of a General Partner investing in European small businesses; and advising clients of Sandaire on investments in all types of Private Equity. He started his career in the Army where, among other appointments, Equerry to the Prince of Wales and Adjutant of the Welsh Guards in the Falklands conflict. Robert is a graduate of Oxford University, where he rowed in three Boat Races against Cambridge. He currently sits on a number of fund Advisory Boards and the Boards of several small businesses.

Mr. Robert Whalen served as Executive at Albiorex International Holding Company. He is a Quality Assurance services consultant (fully insured LLC, 1099 Independent Contractor) with 18 years of operational & industry experience combined with excellent analytical, organizational, and communication abilities. He is logically able to create and effectively implement efficient systems and processes.
Mr. Rodney Norman served as Area Director at Royal IHC. Previously he also served as the company's Managing Director. He currently serves as Director of Deep Sea Mining at Royal IHC.
Mr. Rogier Schurink serves as Director Corporate Development at Royal IHC.

Mr. Roland Matt served as Chief Executive Officer at LGT Bank Deutschland. He served as Group Chief Executive Officer and Member of Management Board at Liechtensteinische Landesbank. He was Head of Research at VP Bank AG, Vaduz, 1999. Head of Asset Management Division at VP Bank AG, Vaduz, 2000 - 2001 and Family Office Project Head at VP Bank AG, Vaduz, 2002.
Mr. Roland Schubert served as Chief Executive Officer at LGT Bank Deutschland.

primary_position: Senior Vice President & Chief Financial Officer
biography: Ron Goegan served as the Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Royal Group Technologies.

Mr. Ronald Smith co-founded of SNI Companies and served as its Chairman and Chief Executive Officer. Mr. Ron is a seasoned staffing executive with over 24 years in the industry. His experience began with Robert Half International ("RHI") as a permanent recruiter, he was promoted to regional manager and ultimately owned several "RHI" franchises. Upon leaving RHI in 1992, Ron founded Staffing Edge. Through an aggressive growth plan Staffing Edge became a $36 million company within six years. Inc. Magazine recognized Staffing Edge in 1997 as the 17th fastest growing private company in the United States, and in 1998 Ernst & Young recognized Ron as Entrepreneur of the Year for the Nebraska/Iowa Regions. Staffing Edge was sold in 1998.

Ms. Rosa Piro serves as Senior Business Development Director at Arada Developments. Her responsibilities includes the expansion of Arada's interests via new projects, as well as evaluating investments in new business segments. She also oversees and maintains commercial and institutional partnerships in hospitality, healthcare, education and entertainment, adjusting the anchor strategy for each based on the needs of Arada's communities. She is also responsible for creating and implementing the retail leasing strategy across Arada's assets, as well as their management and operations. Recent initiatives include the proposal and execution of Arada's CSR programme during the recent Covid-19 crisis, and she is currently working on establishing a research vertical to make data-driven decisions. She previously served as Country Head for emerging markets research and consultancy firm Oxford Business Group, working in the UAE, the Philippines and Indonesia. In that role, she oversaw the company's first-ever production of The Report: Sharjah Annual Investment Guide. She holds a bachelor's degree in International Economics from Bocconi University in Milan and a master's in International Management from Instituto de Empresa in Madrid.

Ms. Rosa Santana is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Santana Group. Ms. Santana serves as Board Member at Latino Business Action Network. She is a top-tier minority- and woman-owned group of companies whose transformational solutions differentiate industry-leading companies through more efficient, effective, and competitive service. Since its founding in 2002, the Santana Group today includes Integrated Human Capital, Workforce Management Mexico, Diversa, Oveana, and Forma Automotive. Each of these companies was founded to address clients' specific challenges. Tapping into her bicultural upbringing as a Mexican immigrant to the United States from the age of 5, she has been a driving force within the U.S./Mexico outsourcing industry. Her passion for community and entrepreneurship has inspired her to create thousands of jobs across the United States and Mexico, contributing to the economic prosperity and well-being of the diverse communities in which she does business. Realizing this passion early in her career at a Fortune 500 Company, she made a substantial impact by delivering extraordinary results in response to client challenges. She expanded the company's footprint into Mexico, earning her a senior leadership role as corporate Vice President. Several years later, she was offered an executive leadership position at a competing international services company and again successfully established operations in Mexico while continuing to lead their U.S. division. In 2002, she reached a turning point in her career when downsizing presented her with the opportunity to start her own business. She launched Integrated Human Capital (IHC), a staffing company, in El Paso, Texas, and simultaneously opened a cross-border company, Workforce Management, in Cuidad Juárez, Chih., Mexico. Always seeking growth opportunities, she set in motion plans to expand into the surrounding metro markets, and three years later, IHC began servicing clients in Austin and San Antonio, Texas. Today the Santana Group continues to demonstrate their expertise in developing solutions for their clients' unique business challenges, resulting not only in the growth of the Santana Group companies but also in the creation of high-quality jobs. Santana credits her numerous mentors for her success and has completed two Minority Business Executive programs at the Tuck School of Business at Dartmouth University as well as the Advanced Management Education program at the Kellogg School of Business at Northwestern University. Utilizing these experiences, Santana has dedicated countless hours to empowering other minority- and women-entrepreneurs through mentoring and service in various organizations that are committed to fostering diversity and inclusion, such as the United States Hispanic Chamber of Commerce (USHCC), the Latino Business Action Network (LBAN), and the Women's Business Council Southwest (WBCS).

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer and Board Member
biography: Mr. Ross Dunlap is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at Ceres Nano. He is responsible for directing strategic and operational activities, capital fundraising, product sales and marketing, and industry collaborations and partnerships. He brings 20 years of experience working in operational and strategic business development. He also serves as Chairman of the Virginia Biotechnology Association. He began his career with Arthur Andersen's Business Consulting practice, working with start-up technology companies, and developing solutions to establish and maintain critical business operations. Following this, He spent five years with Washington Consulting, Inc., a DC-based consulting firm, which he helped start from the ground up and grow into a successful and profitable consulting organization. Throughout his business career, he has worked across a range of industries, technologies, and processes to help organizations successfully achieve operational capability and profitability. He is active in the business and life sciences community in Virginia. He is on the board of the Virginia Biotechnology Association serves as an adviser to Prince William County's economic development office and is a member of the county's Life Sciences Leadership Group. He graduated with a BS in Commerce from the McIntire School of Commerce at the University of Virginia.

Mr. Roy Thung serves as Chief Executive Officer, President & Chairman at The IHC Group. He has served IHC in various capacities since its founding in 1980. He also serves as Chief Executive Officer, and as a director of The Aristotle Corporation. He holds an M.B.A. from the Stern School of Business at New York University.

Mr. Roy Totemoff serves as Chief Executive Officer & Board Member at The Tatitlek. Roy leads in managing the operations, people and resources of The Tatitlek Corporation. Roy was elected to the board in 1992 and became CEO in 2006. Prior to his leadership at TTC, Roy was Vice President of the Tatitlek Village IRA Council and was the owner and operator of a successful commercial fishing boat operation based in Prince William Sound. He also has prior training as a tribal court judge and was a manager for maintenance for North Pacific Rim Housing Authority. Copper Mountain Foundation - Trustee, Prince William Sound Economic Development Council - Board member, representing The Tatitlek Corporation and the Tatitlek Village IRA Council, Sits on all boards of The Tatitlek Corporation's subsidiary companies.

Mr. Roy Yih serves as Chief Executive Officer at BioCheck. Mr. Roy Yih is a Co-Founder of Biocare Medical. He previously served as Chief Executive Officer and President at the company. He serves as Chief Executive Officer and President at DRG International. He is primarily involved with developing and implementing the vision of Biocare and business development activities. Mr. Yih brings more than 30 years of successful leadership in his previous company, Biocare Medical LLC - an IHC company of innovated reagent chemistries and instrumentation, delivered to hospitals, pharmaceutical companies, reference labs and research institutions around the globe. Biocare is recognized as a provider of the highest quality IHC products that give accurate timely results specifically in the area of cancer diagnostics. Mr. Yih holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Biochemistry from U.C. Davis and a Master of Business Administration from Santa Clara University.

Dr. Ryan Anderson is the Owner and serves as Physician at Foot and Ankle Specialists. He specializes in sports medicine and chronic foot conditions. A Utah native, he sees patients at Foot and Ankle Specialists' convenient clinics in Bountiful and Draper, Utah. Dr. Anderson treats patients in their teens to their golden years. Fluent in Spanish, he prioritizes compassionate care and patient education. Dr. Anderson is board-certified by the American Board of Podiatric Surgery. He attended medical school at California College of Podiatric Medicine in San Francisco and completed his residency in reconstructive foot and ankle surgery in Orange County, California. He is currently an attending physician in the IHC residency program.

Mr. Ryan Chapman is a Co-Founder and serves as Board Member at All Counseling. Mr. Ryan Chapman is a Co-Founder of Sale Day. Mr. Ryan Chapman serves as Managing Partner at Chapman Capital (Investor). He served as Executive Chairman at Premier Parking Management Company. He is the owner of Chapman Land & Cattle, a Hereford cattle ranch committed to the highest standards of quality and integrity. Ryan's experience buying and selling cattle led him to recognize a need for a more efficient and mobile-friendly online auction solution. Ryan is excited to contribute to the growth of the agriculture industry through his commitment to innovation, customer service, and ethical business practices. Ryan Chapman is the Executive Chairman of Integrative Life Center, a Nashville-based treatment center that provides trauma focused support for those on their recovery journey., Begin Again Institute, a center focused on recovery from sexual addiction and Integrative Health Centers. IHC enables healthcare providers in offering specialized psychiatric and behavioral health services via telehealth.Integrative Health Centers. IHC enables healthcare providers in offering specialized psychiatric and behavioral health services via telehealth. Formerly, Ryan was the CEO of Premier Parking for 15 years, where he was instrumental in its growth from a single location to locations in over 40 cities.
