Ryan credits his own experience with treatment and recovery as foundational to his successes in life; with the impact mental health support has had on him it made sense for him to seek opportunities to invest in the industry. Integrative Life Center and the Begin Again Institute have both grown substantially since Ryan came on board, expanding staffing and residential treatment options to ensure more people have access to a tailored recovery approach. Ryan founded Integrative Health Centers and their presence has grown to multiple clinics in several states.

Mr. Ryan Cush serves as Chief Revenue Officer at data.world. Previously, he co-founded Loanables. He served as Vice President of Client Services at SmarterHQ. He is also a Founder at Loanables.com. Bringing more than 15 years of leadership experience in client relations, Ryan is an expert in increasing client retention, reducing costs, and scaling business. As Vice President of Client Services, Ryan oversees implementation, campaign services, client success, and support with the help of his team. He also works alongside the SmarterHQ sales team to grow the company's existing client base and services. Based in Austin, Texas he previously served in a variety of executive roles at Bazaarvoice (NASDAQ: BV) where he gained experience running the North American client success team and agency partnership program. Ryan scaled the client services team to serve more than 1,000 clients and aided the company's public offering in 2012. As vice president of client success, Cush drove significant improvements in client retention while increasing upsell rates and reducing costs. Most recently, Cush led business development for consumer startup Food on the Table, which was acquired by the popular Scripps Networks Interactive (NASDAQ: SNI). Ryan earned his Bachelor of Science degree in Materials Science and Engineering from the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT).

Mr. Ryan O'Connell is the Founder & Owner of Switched on Bikes. He's ridden bikes for competition, transport and while traveling, but mostly for fun. Ryan's working background has been in the community sector previously working for IHC NZ and Kaibosh Food Rescue.
Saad Ibrahim Al Muhannadi served as board member at Qatar Luxury Group.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Executive Officer, Managing Director, & Chairman
biography: Mr. Sajeev Viswanathan is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer, Managing Director, & Chairman at New Street Tech. He also served as President, Global Head of strategy, and Product & Executive Director at Visa Payments. He is an accomplished banker, investor, and entrepreneur Sajeev Viswanathan joined Visa Paymentsin June 2014. Sajeev has responsibility for global network expansion and product development and is spearheading Visa Payments's expansion strategy into Asia including India. Prior to Visa Payments, Sajeev held the position of Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Bhartiya Samruddhi Financial Services, a well-known microfinance company in India, and served on the board of micropayments company BASIX Sub-K transactions. Sajeev spent a successful 18 years with multi-national financial institution, Citigroup as Managing Director in the Global Transaction Services (GTS) business in charge of global receivables and trade finance and earlier as Chief Administrative Officer, GTS EMEA and Risk Director on the Board of Citicorp Trustee Company. Sajeev divides his time between London and India. He has an MBA from Thiagarajar School of Management and a BSc in Physics from Loyola College, Chennai, and is an alumnus of the Business In the Community Programme run by the Prince of Wales Trust and Cambridge University. He served as Chief Executive Officer and Managing Director at Bhartiya Samruddhi Finance.

Mr. Salah Al-Qahtani served as Board Member at KCA Deutag. Mr. Al-Qahtani served as Board Member at Dalma Energy. Mr. Al-Qahtani has been a director of KCA Deutag Group since 2018 as part of the KCA Deutag Group's combination with the KSA and Omani businesses of Dalma Energy. He joined the business community in early 1995 as one of the Senior Executives of Abdel Hadi Abdullah Al-Qahtani & Sons (Group of Companies) (AHQ), a reputable and well recognised family conglomerate in Saudi Arabia, contributing with his skills to develop and expand the businesses of the family by playing a pivotal role as Vice Chairman of the AHQ group. The AHQ group consists of 27 companies serving the oil & gas industry, steel pipe manufacturing, pipe coating industries, water and chemicals, food supply items, heavy vehicles and machinery and a private airline. The AHQ group also holds a number of Joint Ventures in Saudi Arabia. In 2007, Mr. Al-Qahtani was a leading figure in the acquisition of Dalma Energy and was then involved directly with the management team to participate and run the business as Vice Chairman. Mr. Al-Qahtani has a degree in business administration from the University of Houston, Texas, USA.

Mr. Sameer Kulkarni serves as Chief Community Officer at Arada Developments. Sameer Kulkarni has managed mixed-use master developments in the UAE, Canada and Saudi Arabia. He previously worked at Amaala/The Red Sea Development Company in Riyadh, where he served as an Executive Director. In the UAE, he has managed large diverse portfolios mainly during his 17-year tenure with Emaar Properties. In the past, he strategically helped resolve challenges involving property handover, maintenance, service fee budgets, communications and homeowner relations for developments that included Downtown Dubai, Arabian Ranches, Emirates Living and The Greens. Kulkarni holds an MBA in Hospitality from the Sydney Graduate School of Management, Australia and a Digital Marketing diploma from Cornell University, USA.
Mr. Sander Korving served as Executive at Royal IHC.

primary_position: Principal & Associate Director of Hematopathology & Clinical PCR Services
biography: Dr. Sandra Bohling served as Principal & Associate Director of Hematopathology & Clinical PCR Services at PhenoPath. She is involved in the entire range of PhenoPath diagnostic hematopathology testing, including IHC, flow cytometry, FISH, and PCR. Dr. Bohling attended the University of Utah School of Medicine where she earned her MD. She completed her residency in Anatomic and Clinical Pathology as well as fellowships in Surgical Pathology and Hematopathology at the University of Washington Medical Center. Prior to medical school, she worked in the Research and Development Department at ARUP Laboratories in Salt Lake City, Utah. Dr. Bohling is board-certified in Anatomic and Clinical Pathology, as well as Hematopathology.

primary_position: Executive Vice President, Chief Finiancial Officer & Treasurer
biography: Ms. Sandra Sandra is a Co-Founder of Acumen and also serves as its Executive Vice President & Chief Financial Officer. Previously, as an executive for the international holding company of the Independent Grocers Alliance, Sandra managed logistic performance centers and inventory-related audits. During the prime growth period of one of the nation's largest catalog showroom retailers, she managed sales-related audits on a national scale. She sat on various systems deployment advisory councils for the firm including the Security department's Information Systems Strategic Steering Committee. In several executive positions, Sandra has worked with inventory optimization helping companies begin their growth strategies for technology. An alumnus of OU and Virginia Commonwealth University, Sandra has a strong financial background and is an accomplished graphic designer and marketing pro. As the editor of an award-winning APICS newsletter, she received the prestigious award in the "Fit To Print" category of journalism. Sandra is also a member of the Gold Key Honor Society. As a community leader, she served as President of Central Virginia's Educational Society for Resource Management (APICS) chapter for several years.

Mr. Sanjiv Jain serves as Group Chief Accounting Officer at G42. Mr. Jain brings with him over 25 years of global experience in strategic finance, business set up, and restructuring. He has held several leadership roles across a wide spectrum of industries, including defense, cybersecurity, construction, and oil & gas. Before joining G42, he held the position of Vice President of Finance for a key government entity in Abu Dhabi, where he was responsible for the entire finance function worth AED 2 billion and the organization's business transition.
He holds an MBA from SP Jain, UAE; and degrees in Chartered Accountancy, Cost Accountancy, and Company Secretary from prestigious institutions in India. His areas of expertise also include financial planning, business acquisition and divestment, pricing, enterprise risk management, policy development, treasury fundraising, and banking, among others.

Ms. Sarah Scace serves as Chief Marketing & Communications Officer at pureLiFi. Ms. Sarah Scace served as Business Manager at Old College Capital. She worked on marketing and projects for company formation. Her role is to build and deliver a cohesive approach to internal and external communications within the Company Formation team at Edinburgh Research and Innovation. Before joining the University of Edinburgh, Sarah spent the previous 5 years managing the Glasgow Region of The Prince's Scottish Youth Business Trust, helping young people start-up and continue in business. She is an experienced Marketing & Communications leader with 20 years of experience across various industries. Her career began in the craft brewing industry before transitioning to working on brand development and digital presence for a range of companies across North America within finance, oil & gas, and telecommunications. After relocating to Scotland from Toronto, she worked with one of King Charles III Charities, PSYBT, before joining Edinburgh Innovations, the commercialization arm of the University of Edinburgh. In 2016, Sarah joined pureLiFi, to lead the development of their Marketing and Communications efforts.

Mr. Scott Longhurst serves as Non-Executive Director at Arqiva. He served as Executive Director at Anglian Water Group. Between 1991 and 2000, he held a number of financial and commercial roles with Shell encompassing corporate, operating company, and joint venture activities across Europe, the Far East, and the Middle East. He is a Fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales and a founding member of HRH The Prince of Wales Accounting for Sustainability CFO Leadership Network. He also serves as a Board Member at Infinis Energy. Appointed to the board in February 2023, Scott has over 25 years of experience in Infrastructure and Utility businesses. He was formerly Group Finance Director of Anglian Water Group (AWG) and Managing Director of its non-regulated business until 2019. Prior to AWG, he was Chief Accounting Officer of TXU Corporation and CFO of its regulated electric and gas businesses. Scott also held a number of financial and commercial roles with Shell encompassing corporate, operating company and joint venture activities across Europe, the Far East and Middle East. He is currently also on the boards of FCC Aqualia S.A., EVOS BV (Audit Chair), Infinis Energy Management Limited (Audit Chair), and a Senior Adviser to Igneo Infrastructure Partners. He is a Fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales, and a founding member of the Accounting for Sustainability CFO Leadership Network.

Mr. Scott MacKenzie serves as Chief Executive Officer at Athena Cloud. Mr. MacKenzie also serves as Chief Executive Officer at Cloud Carib (Bahamas)He is a visionary leader in the technology services industry with over 25+ years' experience operating as a senior executive and industry expert for AT&T, PSINet and Qatar Foundation. He has demonstrated success growing startups to billion-dollar valuations.

Mr. Scott Parker serves as a Board Member at Bloxr Solutions. He is the President Emeritus of Intermountain Healthcare (IHC). He was the founding president of IHC since April 1975 and served in that position until his retirement in 1998. Under his direction, IHC has been named the number-one integrated health care organization in the US by Modern Healthcare magazine and the SMG research firm. Mr. Parker received his bachelor's degree in business from the University of Utah in 1960 and his master of hospital administration degree in 1962 from the University of Minnesota in Minneapolis. He also serves or has served on a number of other corporate boards, including the Huntsman Cancer Foundation, First Security Corporation, B.M.W. Bank of North America, and Questar Corporation, among others.

Mr. Scott Parker served as Board Member at Carefx. He was president of Intermountain Health Care (IHC) from 1975 until his retirement in 1998. Under his direction IHC developed into an integrated health system with hospitals, health insurance plans and employed physicians. IHC has been named the country's top integrated system five of the past six years and is considered a national model. Prior to IHC, Mr. Parker headed hospitals and health systems in Minnesota, Arizona and California. He served as the chairman of the American Hospital Association, president of the International Hospital Federation, chairman of the Hospital Research and Development Institute and was a trustee for the National Committee for Quality Health Care. He has also served as a member of the Institute of Medicine of the National Academy of Sciences. In 2005, Mr. Parker was inducted into the prestigious Philadelphia-based Health Care Hall of Fame. He received his bachelor's degree from the University of Utah in 1960 and a master's degree in hospital administration from the University of Minnesota in 1962.

primary_position: President, Board Member & Chief Executive Officer
biography: Mr. Sean Connaughton serves as President, Board Member & Chief Executive Officer at Virginia Hospital & Healthcare Association. Prior to joining VHHA, Mr. Connaughton served as Virginia's Transportation Secretary from 2010-2014 in the Cabinet of Governor Robert F. McDonnell. In that role, he led efforts to pass a major transportation funding package for the Commonwealth in 2013. Connaughton served in a Presidentially-appointed, U.S. Senate-confirmed position as Administrator of the United States Maritime Administration from 2006-2009, and was Corporate Vice President of Government Affairs for the American Bureau of Shipping. Connaughton's public service also extends to elected office - from 2000-2006, he was Chairman of the Prince William County Board of Supervisors, which is the chief elected position in Virginia's second largest country and the armed forces. Connaughton served as a commissioned officer on active duty with the United States Coast Guard, and later joined the United States Naval Reserve, retiring from that service with the rank of Commander. Connaughton is a licensed attorney admitted to practice in Virginia and the District of Columbia. He practiced law for 15 years with private firms and has appeared before the United States Supreme Court. He has a Bachelor's degree from the United States Merchant Marine Academy, a Master's degree from Georgetown University, a law degree from George Mason University, and he graduated from the United States Naval War College. Connaughton has received numerous awards over the years, including Alumnus of the Year from George Mason University, the Distinguished Service Award from the National Association of Counties, the Vincent T. Hirsch Maritime Award for Outstanding Leadership from the Navy League of the United States, Maritime Person of the Year from the Propeller Club of the United States, the Maritime Samaritan Award from the Apostleship of the Sea of the United States, and Government Man of the Year from the Maritime Port Council of Greater New York. He also has been designated a Henry Toll Fellow by the Council of State Governments, a Virginia Institute of Political Leadership Fellow, and recently was named a Fellow by the Virginia Law Foundation.

Mr. Seif Fikry served as Chief Executive Officer & Executive Director at Adc Acquisition Corp. He is a leading C-Level Capital Markets professional with over 25 years of experience in securities, coverage and origination, unrivalled market and regulatory knowledge as well as business development acumen in the field. Mr. Fikry joined Chimera Capital as a board member and CEO in November 2018 and helped launch the first SCA (Emirates Securities & Commodities Authority) umbrella fund and the first SCA ETF in 2020. In 2017, Mr. Fikry founded Sthenos Management Consultancy - a consultancy service which works closely with the financial services industry, markets and regulators in developing and enhancing the industry in the MENA region. In December 2015, he founded Afkar Capital - an incubator for fund start-ups and the first licensed entity in ADGM, where he launched the first UCITS physical in-kind ETF in the MENA region with S&P and BNY Mellon.

Mr. Sep Bogdan serves as Chief Financial Officer at RAVAS Mobile Weighing. Sep Bogdan has extensive work experience in finance and control roles. Before that, they worked at Forbo Flooring Systems from 2019 to 2023 as the Finance Director of Benelux, leading finance and control activities for the Benelux region. Sep also held various roles at ABB, including Finance Integration Manager for intrusion from 2018 to 2019, Division Controller for Power Grids Benelux from 2017 to 2019, and Division Controller for Robotics and Motion Benelux from 2013 to 2019. Before joining ABB, they worked as the Group Controller at IHC Merwede from 2011 to 2013, and as an Advisor Transaction Services and Transfer Pricing Consultant at PricewaterhouseCoopers from 2005 to 2011. Sep Bogdan's expertise lies in financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, financial integration, and operational excellence.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Director & Medical Editor, Review Team
biography: Mr. Serge Kozak is a Co-Founder and serves as Director & Medical Editor, Review Team at DearJane. He joining DearJane Dr Kozak worked as a primary care physician at the Prince of Wales Hospital and was an assistant professor of medicine at University of Sydney, Australia where he focused on quality improvement and implementation of science training. Serge also was the site lead for a national VA pilot program aimed at improving care for veterans at high risk for hospitalisation or emergency care. His work centered on managing an interdisciplinary health care team that coordinated care between home, hospital, and office settings for these high-risk patients.

primary_position: Founder, Chief Executive Officer and Director
biography: Mr. Sergio Blando is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer and Director at Seed Group.

Dr. Shahin Iqbal serves as Chief Operating Officer & President at BioGX. Dr. Iqbal has over 25 years of experience in clinical molecular diagnostics. Before joining BioGX, Dr. Iqbal led the Abbott Diagnostics Global Service & Support specifically for informatics, core lab automation, immunoassay and clinical chemistry systems. He was also responsible for design and development of FISH automation systems at Abbott Molecular. He is the recipient of the President awards and multiple service & innovation awards at Abbott. Dr. Iqbal holds multiple patents on optical sensors, automation systems development, RFID applications and robotics for system dispensing. Prior to joining Abbott, Dr. Iqbal was Head of operations, quality & regulatory, systems development and manufacturing of IHC systems at BioGenex in California. Dr. Iqbal has an MBA and Ph.D as well as a Masters in Electrical Engineering degree from the University of Texas in San Antonio.

Leadership with Innovation, Visionary, and Strategic in delivering Financial Services in Consumer Lending businesses.

Right from managing the daily nuances of administration, finance and accounts, to catering to the in-depth needs of customer relations and HR, Shamal plays a key role in the decision-making processes. Known as the happy-go-lucky-guy amongst all his friends, he is well known in his circles as the "guy with the evergreen smile".

Mr. Shamal Perera serves as Chief Executive Officer at Axionent. He is a Group Director of the Access Group of Companies and oversees the strategic business direction of Axionent in his capacity as the CEO. His primary focus is in the healthcare sector, technology-enabled healthcare and next-generation medical equipment. He began his career at Access, taking responsibility for the Healthcare Sector within the Group and has successfully driven the business to be among the top three companies in Sri Lanka in this field. Having completed several leadership and entrepreneurial programs by EY and the INSEAD School of Business he also holds an MBA from the University of Buckingham, UK.

Mr. Shamal Ranasinghe serves as Chief Business Officer and Advisor at Audius. He serves as Board Member at Envelop. He co-founded and served as Managing Director & Board Member at Topspin. He also co-founded Sol System and Giveback. Mr. Ranasinghe received a Bachelor of Arts degree in economics and political science from Northwestern University and a Masters degree in Business Administration from Stanford University.
Mr. Shamal Wijesuriya is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Neoex Solutions.
Ms. Sharon Sharminie serves as Chief Executive Officer at Royal Group.
Mr. Sheikh Abdul Aziz Al Nuaimi serves as Chairman at Ajman Holding.

full_name: Sheikh Abdullah bin Khalifa Al Thani
biography: Mr. Sheikh Abdullah bin Khalifa Al Thani served as Board Member at Amyis. He has served as Special Advisor to the Emir since his appointment in April 2007, and was Prime Minister of Qatar from October 1996 to April 2007. He has served as Chairman of the board of directors of Qatar Investment and Projects Development Holding Company, a Qatari investment group, since March 2011 and as Chairman of the board of directors of Specialized International Services (SIS) Qatar, a business investment company, since October 2011. biography: Mr. Sheikh Ahmed Bin Khalid Bin Hamad Al-Thani served as Chairperson at Qatar Luxury Group.
