full_name: Sheikh Salman bin Hassan Al Thani
biography: Mr. Sheikh Salman bin Hassan Al Thani serves as Board Member at Qatar Stock Exchange. Mr. Hassan Al Thani serves as Board Member at Katara Hospitality. Mr. Hassan Al Thani is the Chief Financial Officer (CFO) at the Qatar Foundation and oversees the Finance and Strategy functions. Key responsibilities include QF Strategic Planning, business planning; budget development, performance management and insurance activities in order to ensure alignment with the QF Strategic Plan under the Vice-Chairperson and CEO leadership. Prior to his appointment in April 2016, Sh. Salman held the roles of the Chief Strategy and Business Development Officer as well as the Chief Financial Officer & Director of Tax at the Qatar Financial Center Authority (QFC Authority). Between 2010 and 2014, Sh. Salman was with the Qatar Central Bank in various roles culminating in his role as the Risk Management Director. He also served on the board of the Qatar Securities Depository & the Chair of the Financial Markets Development Sub-Committee as well as on the Financial Stability & Risk Control Committee. He joined Qatar Petroleum Project Finance Department after completing his undergraduate degree in Banking and Financial Studies from Qatar University where he received H.H. the Heir Apparent's Golden Award in Education Excellence and an academic excellence medal from Qatar University.
Mr. Sheikh Tahnoun Al Nahyan is a Co-Owner & serves as Chairman at G42.

primary_position: Senior Vice President & Chief Financial Officer
biography: Ms. Sherrie Ross served as Senior Vice President & Chief Financial Officer at Symcor. She oversees Symcor's administrative, financial, and risk management operations in alignment with building and executing the company's strategic vision. She entered her current role in 2016 after ten years with the company. Before joining Symcor, she brought a wealth of experience from her former posts as Senior Manager of Financial Reporting at both Royal Group Technologies and Hollinger Inc. She received her Bachelor of Arts with Honours in Economics from York University.

primary_position: Founder, Chairman, General Manager & Chief Executive Officer
biography: Mr. Shige Yu is the Founder and serves as Chairman, General Manager & Chief Executive Officer at Siger Data. Mr. Yu has worked as a Six Sigma Master and Senior Quality Engineer at Nestea Motors, Trina Motors and China CNR, completing over 100 projects and saving over $50 million in total.

Mr. Shimmy Mathew serves as Chief Financial Officer at Arada Developments. He serves as Chief Financial Officer at Raimondi Cranes. He serves as Group Chief Financial Officer at KBW Investments. He is a Chartered Accountant with more than two decades of practical and theoretical experience across numerous commercial segments, specializing in financing and relevant strategic measures associated with business acquisitions and their administration. Appointed in 2013 as Chief Financial Officer of KBW Investments, he was additionally Chief Financial Officer of the company. His functional expertise in fields including auditing, strategy development and execution, finance, and corporate structuring and implementation, is utilized across the company in addition to the development and implementation of all of the company's financial systems, policies, procedures, mandates, and standards. He has also been instrumental in securing the support of leading UAE banks for several large-scale financing packages that are supporting the construction of the company's projects.

Ms. Shradha Dahotre co-founded Artbugs.in and also served as its Chief Creative Officer. Artbugs has been conceptualized by our Founder & award winning artist Shradha Dahotre. She has been featured on CNBC, Bombay Times and other publications. She has also featured in India's Next 100 Women Artists at the Coomerswamy Hall, Prince of Wales Museum, Mumbai in 2012. Shradha specializes in sculptures and digital art creations.

Mr. Shrikant Kabboor serves as Chief Technology Officer at Arada Developments. Mr. Kabboor has more than 22 years experience of in developing successful digital technology strategies, processes, policies and procedures, and has demonstrated the ability to translate emerging technologies into business solutions to create value. He has served in executive leadership roles in a number of property development firms such as Emaar, Majid Al Futtaim and Union Properties. Prior to coming to the UAE, he worked at a number of large-scale technology-driven companies including Idea Cellular (AT&T/Vodafone), Oracle and Agilent Technologies. He holds a BSc from Karnataka University and a post-graduate MBA specializing in finance from VAMNICOM, Pune. Other certifications include CISA, CGEIT, PMP, Six Sigma and Beyond Smart Cities Technologies from MIT.
.

Mr. Shukai Jiao served as Co-Chief Executive Officer at Kaiima Bio-Agritech. He worked in the Chinese seed industry for more than twenty years. He served as Director of the Corn Research Institute of Jilin Provincial Academy of Agricultural Sciences, R&D Lead of Monsanto China, one of the Co-Heads of China National Dekalb Seed Co. (a joint-venture company between China National Seed Group and Monsanto). Mr. Jiao also served as Greater China National Sales Lead of Seminis. Mr. Jiao got his Master Degree in Plant Breeding and Genetics from Jilin University of Agriculture.

Mr. Siger Spaas serves as Chief Financial Officer at Borealis Hotel Group. He served as CFO of Albert Heijn, Etos and Gall & Gall. Before that, Siger also served as CFO for Delhaize in Belgium and Luxemburg and as CFO of Albert in the Czech Republic. He holds a master's degree in business economics from the Erasmus University in Rotterdam and a post-master's degree in Finance and Control from the Neyenrode University.

Mr. Simon Cliff served as General Counsel at City Football. Mr. Cliff serves as Board Member at Girona FC. He is also a trustee of City in the Community, Manchester. Before this, he was a corporate finance lawyer in the City of London, working on international mergers, acquisitions, and equity capital markets transactions. He was part of the legal team representing Abu Dhabi United Group in acquiring Manchester City FC in 2008. He was then asked to join the club on secondment from his law firm, making the permanent move to Manchester in early 2009.

Mr. Simon Tay served as Non-Executive Independent Director & Member of the Board's Risk Management and Investment Committees at Hyflux. He is appointed as Commissioner at PT Oasis (Indonesia), in which Hyflux has 50% indirect interest. He is Chairman of the Singapore Institute of International Affairs, the country's oldest think tank and founding member of the ASEAN network of think tanks. He is concurrently Associate Professor, teaching international law at the National University of Singapore. He is also a Senior Consultant at WongPartnership, a leading Asian law firm. He is a Global Advisor to the Mitsubishi United Financial Group and an Independent Director on private boards for LGT Bank of Liechtenstein and Far East Organization. He is also an Independent Director of Top Glove Corporation Bhd, a Bursa Malaysia listed company having a secondary listing on SGX. From 1992 to 2008, he served in public positions for Singapore, including Chairman of the National Environment Agency, Nominated Member of Parliament, and coordinated the Singapore Volunteers Overseas. He continues to serve Singapore in a number of roles including as an Expert and Eminent Person in the ASEAN Regional Forum, a member of the government's Climate Change Network and as vice chairman of the Asia Pacific Water Forum. He graduated in law from the National University of Singapore (1986) and with a Masters in Law from Harvard Law School (1993).

Mr. Sok Kosal serves as Chief Information Officer at AMK Microfinance Institution. He joined AMK in April 2015 as Chief Information Officer (CIO). Kosal has more than fourteen years of experiences in IT Career, moving from IT support level to a senior IT Manager in many multinational companies, such as Imperial Tobacco Vietnam (Imperial Tobacco Group), Sotelco Ltd. (Vimpelcom Group) and One TV (GS Group partners with Royal Group Cambodia). It had been a long journey where lots of challenges and changes had happened and been adapted successfully. Kosal holds a Master's Degree in IT Management from INNOTECH-CBAM.

Mr. Stas Verichev is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Vibrotwist. After doing his Postdoc at TU Delft he was a small business owner. He has also worked as Mechanical Engineer at Schlumberger. He was a Project Manager at Royal IHC and Senior R&D Engineer at Allseas.
Mr. Stefan Huber served as an Executive Director at Centrum Bank. Previously, he served as a Vice Director at LGT Bank in Liechtenstein AG.

Mr. Stefan Meierhofer serves as President, Chief Executive Officer & Director at Telos Capital Management. Mr. Meierhofer serves as a member of the Investment Advisory Committee (IAC) for the City of San Diego. He joined LGT Bank in Liechtenstein AG as Equity Trading Manager. As a member of their Investment Committee, he was actively involved in analyzing and trading European companies and gained a broad insight into global investing. In 1990 Mr. Meierhofer completed six months of educational training with various brokerage firms in New York, after which he moved to San Diego. Mr. Meierhofer completed the rigorous requirements to earn some of the most prestigious designations in the financial services industry. In 1996, he obtained his CFA® designation and became a member of the CFA Institute and the CFA Society of San Diego, where he served as Society President during the 2001-2002 fiscal year. He earned his CFP® (CERTIFIED FINANCIAL PLANNERTM) certification in 2006 and became a member of the FPA (Financial Planning Association) of San Diego. Mr. Meierhoferalso received formal training in investment fiduciary responsibility and attained the AIF® (Accredited Investment Fiduciary) designation in 2011. He formerly held Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA) Series 3, 4, 7, 24, and 63 licenses. Mr. Meierhoferearned his degree in Banking and Finance in 1981 and joined Bank Oppenheim Switzerland AG as an Institutional Sales Representative on the floor of the Zurich Stock Exchange. He earned his "Swiss-Certified Banker" diploma

Mr. Stephen Brown served as Director of Finance and Operations at Inspired Teaching Demonstration School. He is responsible for overseeing the day to day financial operations of Inspired Teaching and for providing senior staff with monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports. He has worked in the accounting profession for 12 years, gaining experience as an auditor, senior accountant, and Director of Accounting/Controller. During the course of his accounting career, he also taught business education to middle school students before returning to the accounting profession in the non-profit sector. He received his Master's Degree in Accounting from Liberty University and his BS in Accounting from Hampton University. In addition, he received a Master's in Christian Education from The Carolina University of Theology and completed 12 graduate credit hours of education courses at Old Dominion University as part of his teacher certification for Prince William County, Virginia. He is excited to bring his passion for accounting and the teaching profession to support the mission of Inspired Teaching.

Dr. Stephen Norris served as Advisor at Radpay. He served as Managing Director at Washington Investment Partners. Mr. Norris also served as a Chairman at Stephen Norris & Co. Capital Partners. He was involved in the decision-making process in essentially every major Carlyle investment decision from its beginning as a $105 million fund that made investments of more than four times that amount through extensive use of co-investors and strategic partners. Those investments yielded an annual return on investment in excess of 40%. He also served on the boards of directors of major Carlyle portfolio companies. He was actively involved in recruiting all of Carlyle's current senior partners and played a major role in recruiting President George W. Bush to serve as a director of one of its portfolio companies and in enlisting former Secretary of State James Baker III and former Secretary of Defense Frank C. Carlucci to be senior partners of Carlyle. Mr. Norris acted as a principal financial advisor to Prince Al-Waleed bin Talal Al Saud of Kingdom Holding Company, in structuring and negotiating the re-capitalization of Citibank, which returned over $15 billion in profits on about $590 million of equity invested. He also advised or played a key role in other Kingdom Holding Company investments. He was appointed by former president George H.W. Bush and confirmed by the U.S. Senate to serve as one of five governing members of the $100 billion Federal Retirement System Thrift Investment Board. Since 1997, Mr. Norris, and certain members of his team, have worked on a number of investments including real estate investments in Europe and the United States. They were involved in amongst others the privatization of Thompson CSF, the recapitalization of Suez, the acquisition of portions of Credit Foncier's real estate portfolio in Paris by the German firm IVG, the formation of Nomura's (London) bid for a Dutch mortgage bank, the offer by a major Saudia Arabian investment firm for Lamborgini in Italy, and the formation of a bid by Leucadia International's for the Labouchere Bank in Holland. He also negotiated and structured investments in Synxis Corporation, which was backed by George Soros and Mr. Norris, and MARC Global Holdings. Mr. Norris served as a law clerk on the U.S. Tax Court and earned a B.S. and J.D. from the University of Alabama, was a fellow at Yale Law School and earned an L.L.M. in Taxation from New York University.
Mr. Stephen Patchin served as President at Royal Group.
Mr. Steve Borowycz serves as Chief Technology Officer at SNI Companies.

Dr. Steve Kussick serves as Medical Director at PhenoPath. He is Director of Contract Research, and Director of Flow Cytometry at PhenoPath Laboratories. He has extensive experience in the use of morphologic, immunophenotypic, and molecular methods in the diagnosis of hematolymphoid neoplasms. Dr. Kussick received his M.D. and Ph.D. from the Medical Scientist Training Program at the University of Washington, where he also completed his Anatomic Pathology Residency and Hematopathology Fellowship. He is board-certified in Anatomic Pathology and Hematopathology. Prior to joining PhenoPath, he was Attending Hematopathologist and Associate Director of Hematopathology in the Department of Laboratory Medicine at the University of Washington. At PhenoPath, Dr. Kussick established our 9-color flow cytometry laboratory in 2005, and transitioned the methodology to 10-color analysis in 2010. He has overseen the validation of numerous new IHC assays related to hematopathology. In addition to 14 years of attending experience in diagnostic hematopathology, Dr. Kussick has a broad research background, with over 35 peer-reviewed research publications in areas including flow cytometry, hematopathology, basic cancer biology and chronic disease epidemiology.

primary_position: Chief Operating Officer & Chief Legal Officer
biography: Mr. Steve Siger served as Chief Operating Officer & Chief Legal Officer at Otter.

Dr. Steven Gordon serves as a Podiatrist at Reston Podiatry Associates. Previously, he owned the company. He is Board Certified by the American Board of Foot and Ankle Surgery and a Fellow of the American College of Foot and Ankle Surgeons. He currently serves as chairman of the podiatric surgery section of Reston Surgery Center, where he sits on the Medical Executive Committee. In addition, he serves as a member of the Infection Control Committee at Reston Hospital Center. He is continually involved with training surgical residents at the Medstar Washington Hospital Center Podiatric Surgical Residency Program and serves as the liaison for the Residency Program at the Reston Surgery Center. His special interests include reconstructive foot and ankle surgery and all aspects of medical and surgical management of the diabetic foot. He is a member of the American Podiatric Medical Association, the Virginia Podiatric Medical Association, the American Diabetes Association's Foot Council, and regularly participates in the Novant Health Prince William Medical Center's Diabetes support group meeting and annual Diabetes Fairs. He is currently on the staff of Reston Hospital Center, Reston Surgery Center, Novant Health UVA Prince William Medical Center and Inova Loudoun Hospital. He graduated with a Bachelor of Arts from the University of Pennsylvania in 1987 and received his doctorate degree from Temple University College of Podiatric Medicine in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania in 1991. He completed his residency in Reconstructive Surgery of the Foot and Ankle as well as Postgraduate Training/Fellowship in Lower Extremity Reconstructive Plastic Surgery at the Northern Virginia Podiatric Residency Program in 1994. In addition to sponsorship by the Medical College of Virginia, this comprehensive surgical residency involved training at multiple affiliated hospitals including Georgetown University Hospital and Inova Fairfax Hospital.

Mr. Steven Lahr Co-Founded & served as Chief Executive Officer at Silverback7. He has served as the CEO of SB7 since March 2005. Prior to founding SB7, Mr. Lahr served in the U.S. Army for 22 years. As a Special Forces officer, he was responsible for planning, resourcing and leading sensitive, complex, nationally directed operations for the Department of Defense and other government agencies. He served in eight distinct combat or hostile fire zones during his military career; often deploying to those areas more than once. He supervised high-risk operations with the Special Operations Command and the Joint Inter-Agency community including work with the CIA, DoS, FBI, U.S. Marshals and U.S. Customs. He commanded Special Operations forces engaged in a variety of combat, special operations and intelligence related missions during the Global War on Terrorism. As an active member of the community, Mr. Lahr is a proud volunteer for local programs. He is a member of the Veterans of Foreign Wars, the American Legion, the Region's Government Contractor Council (Prince William County Chamber of Commerce), the Virginia Tech Athletic Boosters, and is currently serving as the Vice Chairman of a local Veteran's organization (Vigilant Torch Association). His benevolent activities include religious charities, and support to several veteran's non-profit organizations such as the Marine Corps Association Foundation, Special Operations Warrior Foundation, Fallen Warriors Foundation and the Warriors on the Water tournament program. Mr. Lahr holds an M.A. in international studies from Georgetown University and a B.S. in business management from the University of Maryland.

Mr. Steven Lapin serves as Board Member at The IHC Group. He For more than the past five years, Vice Chairman of the Board of Directors of IHC; for more than the past five years, Chairman, Chief Executive Officer, President and a director of GHI; for more than the past five years, Chairman, Chief Executive Officer, President and a director of Geneve; for more than the five years prior to August 2016, a director of AMIC; for more than the five years prior to November 2018, a director of Madison National Life; for more than the five years prior to October 2018, a director of Standard Security Life.

primary_position: Chief Financial Officer & Chief Accounting Officer
biography: Mr. Steven Mullins serves as Chief Financial Officer at Percipient.ai. He served as Chief Financial Officer and Chief Accounting Officer at PROOF Acquisition I. He also is an advisor to the family office of Saudi Prince Khaled bin Alwaleed bin Talal Al Saud. Mr. Mullins was the Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer of InteliData Technologies Corporation which was publicly traded on the NASDAQ from 1999-2002 after serving as its Director of Finance and Controller. He has also served on the Board of Visitors at his alma mater, George Mason University, where he was Chairman of the Audit Committee for 2 years and Vice Chairman of the Finance and Land Use Committee for 2 years. He also served as Chief Financial Officer at Qmulos, Bloom, EarthOptics, RedJack, ReturnBuy, Q-Mobile, Secure Elements, Intelliworks, Rollstream, InteliData Technologies Corporation, Contactually, Pascal Metrics, and AppTap. Mr. Mullins serves as Chief Financial Officer at Rebellion, Framebridge, Koofers, Farragut Capital Partners, Bisnow Media, KZ0 Innovations, and Bloom Protocol. He also serves as Managing Director and Chief Financial Officer at KBW Ventures. He served as Advisory Board Member at Farragut Capital Partners, and Accountant and Finance Consultant at Framebridge. He serves as Board Member at ACell, and President at SPM Consulting and performs financial consulting services to a number of other companies on a part-time basis. He is also the President of SPM Consulting. Mr. Mullins has served as a Board Member of several different organizations including Transition Committee for Technology Policy, Office of the Governor-elect, Secure Elements, Northern Virginia Technology Council's TechPAC, Appointee to the Hunter Mill District Plan Review Committee, the boards of the Annandale/Springfield National Little League and the Turnpike Basketball Club and Treasurer of the McLean Wine Festival. He holds a BS degree from George Mason University.
Mr. Steven Siger is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Operating Officer & CLO at CNaught.

Mr. Strive Masiyiwa is the Founder & serves as Chairman of Econet Wireless Global. He serves as a Board Member & Chair of the Corporate Responsibility Committee at Unilever. He is the Founder & serves as Executive Chairman at Cassava Technologies. He serves as a Board Member of Netflix. Mr. Masiyiwa is a United Kingdom-based Chairman and founder of Econet Wireless, a diversified telecommunications group with operations and investments in Africa, Europe, North America, Latin America, and Asia Pacific. He also serves as a Board Member at the Gates Foundation. He is an Executive Director on the board of Econet Wireless Zimbabwe Ltd and is Chairman of Liquid Telecom Holdings (an Econet Group company). Also, through Econet's subsidiaries, the Group funds one of the largest scholarship programs for orphaned and vulnerable children in Africa. Masiyiwa serves on several international boards including Netflix Inc., National Geographic Society, Asia Society, the Global Advisory boards of Bank of America, the Council on Foreign Relations (in the US), Stanford University, the Bloomberg New Economy Forum, and the Prince of Wales Trust for Africa. Strive is a juror of the Hilton Foundation's Humanitarian Prize. He is also one of the founders of the Carbon War Room and a founding member of the Global Business Coalition on Education. He served as Emeritus Chairman at Alliance for a Green Revolution in Africa.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Chief Transformation Officer & Board Member
biography: Dr. Subir Jossan is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Transformation Officer & Board Member at Medvanta. He is a board-certified orthopedic surgeon who specializes in treating upper extremities in pediatric, adolescent and adult patients. He is a founder and Chief Transformation Officer at MedVanta. In addition to his responsibilities with MedVanta, he is the Treasurer for The Centers for Advanced Orthopaedics (CAO), which was founded in 2013 to preserve private practice medicine in orthopedics. He practices at CAO's Prince William Orthopaedics, Hand Surgery & Sports Medicine care center, which he founded in 1999 in Prince William and McLean, Virginia. He is a member of many orthopedic and medical associations, including the American Academy of Orthopaedic Surgeons, the American Medical Association, the American Society for Surgery of the Hand, the Medical Society of Virginia, the Washington Orthopedic Society, the Washington Metropolitan Society for Surgery of the Hand and the Yale Orthopaedic Association. He earned his medical degree from The Medical College of Virginia in Richmond, Virginia, where he also completed his orthopedic surgery residency. He completed his fellowship in Hand and Upper Extremity Surgery at Yale University in New Haven, Connecticut.

primary_position: Chairman of the Board of Directors
biography: Mr. Sultan Al Qasimi serves as Chairman of the Board of Directors at Invest Bank. He is the Deputy Ruler of the emirate of Sharjah, Deputy Chairman of the Sharjah Executive Council, and chairman of Sharjah Media Council, serving under the supervision of this Council: Sharjah Broadcasting Authority, Sharjah Government Media Bureau, Sharjah Media City "SHAMS Free Zone Authority", also H.H is occupying the position of chairman for Sharjah Petroleum Council. He has chaired Basma Group since 2005, and chaired the Board of Directors of Sharjah National Oil Company since 2010, Tilal Properties LLC since 2014, and Arada Real Estate Development Company since 2017, also His Highness chaired the Board of Directors of Invest Bank since 2019. He has held many key leadership positions in sectors of economy, tourism and sports at the emirate of Sharjah, most highlighted: Chairman of Board of Directors for Sharjah Pipeline Company "Anabeeb" (2003-2019), Vice Chairman of Board of Directors for Sharjah Liquefaction Gas Company (SHALCO) (2004-2011), Member of Board of Directors for Dana Gas (2005-2019), Vice Chairman of Board of Directors for Sharjah Equestrian and Racing Club (2002-2011), and Chairman of Sharjah Commerce & Tourism Development Authority (2006-2012). His Highness has many contributions to the preservation of the environment, through his chairmanship of the Board of Directors of "Green Planet" LLC since 2005, and Medical & Hazardous Waste "Weqaya" LLC since 2010. He received the Arab League's Media Personality Award of the Year 2016 from the League of Arab States, and H.H has been elected as the Humanitarian Envoy for The Big Heart Foundation since 2017. Under his leadership, a lot has been achieved in two sectors of Government Communication and Media, including the establishment of the Sharjah Media Council, Sharjah Media City "Shams" Free Zone Authority, Sharjah Government Media Bureau "formerly Sharjah Media Center", and the restructuring of Sharjah Broadcasting Authority, establishing several new television channels including "Al Sharqiya" channel from Kalba and "Al Wousta" channel from Al Dhaid, in addition to the establishment of new radios including "Sharjah Quran", "Plus 95" and "Watar" radio stations. Also, he established; the online news website "Sharjah 24" in 2015, and launched the first and largest digital media and communications platform "OMNES Media" in 2017. At the level of the region, he launched pioneering and first-of-its-kind initiatives, most highlighted: the International Government Communication Forum in 2011, the Sharjah Government Communication Award in 2013, the International Photography Festival in 2016, and the establishment of the International Government Communication Centre in 2017. He holds a Bachelor of Science degree in Business Administration from Arkansas State University of the United States of America, and a Masters degree in Computer Information Systems from the University of Detroit Mercy, in Michigan, USA.
Mr. Sultan Qasimi is a Co-Founder & serves as Chairman at Arada Developments.
Mr. Sung-hoon Kim is a Co-Founder & serves as Chief Executive Officer at Taesung SNI.

Ms. Susan Peterson serves as Board Member at Craigs Investment Partners. She served as Chairman at Organic Initiative. She is an experienced business leader with a particular interest in helping companies to drive growth through technology, innovation, and organizational culture. She is currently the Chairwoman of Vista Group and a Director on the boards of Xero, Trustpower, Arvida, and Property for Industry. She is a Tribunal Member of the NZ Markets Disciplinary Tribunal. Her past directorships include ASB Bank, The NZ Merino Company Limited, and Compac Sorting Solutions. She is also a past member of the IHC board and the National Advisory Council for the Employment of Women.

Mr. Sylvain Picard served as Chief Financial Officer & Secretary at Ranaz. He has over 15 years of experience with manufacturing and service companies, primarily in the food industry. Before joining Ranaz in January 2008, he worked for McCain Foods Limited, Royal Group Technologies and Pâtisserie de Gascogne as director of accounting and administrative services, where he was responsible for financial, accounting and budget management. In addition to his solid production cost experience, he was a member of the ERP system implementation team from 2002 to 2005 and part of the team responsible for integrating the financial and accounting systems in 2006 and 2007 at McCain Foods Limited. He is a CMA and has a BAA in professional accounting from HEC Montréal.
Mr. Tahnoon Bin Zayed Al Nahyan serves as Chairman at Royal Group. Mr. Al Nahyan serves as Chairman at MGX. He served as Chairman of Board at First Gulf Bank. .

Mr. Tamer Osman served as Board Member at FalconViz. He served as Senior Advisor at Frontier Path. He served as a Board Member and Senior Advisor at NuVX Venture Capital. He serves as a Board Member &and Senior Investment Advisor at NuVX Venture Capital. He is an investment manager at KAUST Innovation Fund responsible for screening and evaluating investment proposals and managing a portfolio of seven startups in different sectors such as energy, renewables, power & water desalination, new materials & nanotechnology, and Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. Before working for KAUST, he served as an advisor to the CEO of Qatar Development Bank, a governmental financial entity tasked to develop long-term socio-economic benefits in Qatar. During his time there, he was tasked to lead the restructuring of the bank portfolio over a five-year interval in order to contribute towards the diversification of the Qatari economy away from hydrocarbons. He was also previously responsible for the structuring and implementation of one of the first SME MENA regional initiatives, sponsored by Sheikha Moza bint Nasser through SILATECH. This initiative was considered the first of its kind in the region and promoted employment creation for Arab youth. Previously, he was a Senior Principal Investment Officer in one of the leading Islamic investment banks in the Middle East based in Bahrain. He also previously worked with Bank of America & Merrill Lynch and has a wealth of experience in government bond trading, hedge management, fixed-income derivatives, equity derivatives, and emerging markets trading. He holds a B.S. from the University of North Carolina and an MBA from Wingate University in Finance. He is fluent in English, Arabic, and Spanish.

Mr. Tamer Rashad Co-Founded and served as Co-Chief Executive Officer at Humtap. He served as Advisor at Silkroad Images. Mr. Rashad also served as a Board Member at Plan International USA. Prior to these positions, Mr. Rashad served as CEO of LGT Middle East for LGT Bank in Liechtenstein, Managing Director & Head of Middle East for Merrill Lynch, and Head of Corporate Strategy for Countrywide Financial Corp. He holds a Master's in Finance from London Business School, MS from the University of Surrey, and BS from Alexandria University.

primary_position: Chief Financial Officer & Senior Vice President
biography: Ms. Teresa Herbert serves as Chief Financial Officer and Senior Vice President at Independence Holding. He has served IHC in various capacities since 1988. Prior to joining IHC, Ms. Herbert worked for KPMG. She holds an accounting degree from Rutgers University and is licensed as a Certified Public Accountant in the state of New Jersey.

Mr. Thomas Mahon was the Founder of English Cut. Prior to founding English Cut, Tom had been the youngest cutter at Anderson & Sheppard where he was also the personal cutter for one of the company's most important clients, His Royal Highness the Prince of Wales.

Mr. Thomas Pecenka served as Director at Le Tanneur & Cie. Mr. Thomas Pecenka been a Director at Le Tanneur & Cie SA since June 15, 2011. He is Vice Chairman of Qatar Luxury Group Fashion. He graduated from European School of Business in Reutlingen and ESC Reims. He joined the Richemont group as Product Manager for Cartier International. He was responsible for the development of leather goods for men from 2004 to 2009. He joined Qatar Luxury Group in March 2009.

Ms. Tokunboh Ishmael serves as Board Chairman at Prudential Zenith Life Insurance. As co-founder and Managing Director of Alitheia Capital, a female-led private equity firm, she is one of the first in Africa to pioneer impact investing private equity that embodies her philosophy of profit with a purpose. She also co-founded Alitheia IDF, where she raised over $100 million to invest in female-led businesses in Africa. She was a Panelist on the popular Dragons' Den Nigeria TV show. She is a mentor to entrepreneurs of small-to mid-sized businesses, helping them grow and scale their companies to reach their full potential. She is a sought-after collaborator and a partner to African and European governments, helping them to tackle intractable problems resulting from a lack of access to essential products and services. She is also a staunch advocate for financial literacy and the creator of Yellow Cowries, a platform that employs gamification to teach kids and entrepreneurs how to achieve financial freedom. She is a Yale World Fellow and a member of the inaugural class of the Aspen Institute's Finance Leaders Fellowship. She sits on several boards, from Fintech to fast-moving consumer goods companies to the Earthshot Prize, launched by Prince William, Duke of Cambridge, and David Attenborough to support and scale solutions to some of the world's greatest environmental problems.

primary_position: Vice President, Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance
biography: Mr. Tony Lam served as Vice President, Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance at Advanced Cell Diagnostics. Over the course of his long career, he has served in many critical management positions, including VP and Director roles for regulatory and quality assurance with leading pharmaceuticals, biologics, and diagnostics companies like Thermo Fisher, Siemens, Johnson & Johnson and Novartis. Most recently, he served as VP of Regulatory and Clinical Affairs for Qiagen in Molecular Diagnostics. Within in vitro diagnostics, Tony specialized in immunodiagnostics, clinical chemistry, IHC, molecular diagnostics, pharmacogenomics and companion diagnostics. In addition to these managerial roles, Tony has also overseen many successful FDA premarket approvals, from DAKO's HercepTest companion diagnostic to Genentech's Herceptin, as well as molecular diagnostics for pharmacogenomics from companies such as Celera Diagnostics and GE Healthcare. He was also instrumental in working with Precision Therapeutics, LabCorp and Quest CLIA labs. As an expert in quality management, Tony accomplished efficient turnaround compliance with quality systems of US QSR and ISO 13485 for Hologic, Agilent Tech, Novartis, Quest, Thermo Fisher, and Life Technologies. Tony received a BS in Microbiology/Molecular Biology and a MS in Immunology and Genetics from the University of Oklahoma.

Mr. Torsten de Santos served as Non-Executive Director at New Look Retailers. Mr. Torsten de Santos served as Chief Executive Officer at Rianta Capital Zurich. He served as Chief Executive Officer, Traditional Asset Management at LGT Group. Torsten is Chief Executive Officer of Rianta Capital, a family office and investment advisory firm based in Zurich and London. Prior to joining Rianta in 2013, Torsten was CEO of LGT Capital Management, a director at Barclays Capital and an Executive Director with Goldman Sachs. Torsten holds a master's degree in International Management and B.Sc. in Mathematics and Physics.

Mr. Tsvetan T. Lazhanski serves as Board Member at Teach For All. He CEO of Devin Ltd. from 2004 to 2010. He began his career in 1996 as an investment analyst and manager at the Bulgarian-American Enterprise Fund. He was CEO of Ameta Holding and CEO of Royal Group JSC. He has a Bachelor degree in International Finance from the Higher School of Utrecht, Netherlands, Master degree of Business Administration from Sofia University "St. Kliment Ohridski ", and Master degree of Business Administration from INSEAD in France and Singapore.

Dr. Usama Fayyad is the Founder and serves as Chairman at Open Insights. Dr. Fayyad serves as an Advisor at Glasswing Ventures. He serves as an Advisory Board Member at Synapse Partners. He serves as a Board Member at PostProcess and Filtered. He served as Advisor at Izif. He co-founded and served as Chief Technology Officer at OODA Health. He is Yahoo!'s chief data officer and executive vice president of Research & Strategic Data Solutions. Prior to joining Yahoo!, He co-founded and led the DMX Group. He joined Yahoo!'s senior executive team as part of an acquisition of DMX Group by Yahoo in 2004. He serves as an Advisor at Sadara Ventures. He served as an Advisor at Jamalon. He presently serves as a Board Member at MiNeeds. He served as an Advisor at RapidMiner. He serves as an advisor at Sadara Ventures. He also served as Founding Executive Chairman at Oasis500. From 2010-2013, he was the co-founder of OASIS-500, a tech startup investment fund, following his appointment as Founding Executive Chairman in 2010 by King Abdullah II of Jordan. Up until joining Barclays in 2013, he was also Chairman, Co-Founder, and Chief Technology Officer of Blue Kangaroo Corp, building a mobile search engine service for offering personalization and activation, and AI Chatbots for shopping activation with large retailers based in Silicon Valley. In 2008, he founded Open Insights, a Seattle-based Data strategy, technology, and strategic consulting firm that helps enterprises deploy Data-driven solutions to grow revenue from Data assets. The company also provides services and products in open-source Data and AI/ML/Data Science solutions. In 2004 Yahoo! acquired His second startup (DMX Group which he started in Seattle in 2003) and he became Yahoo!'s Chief Data Officer and Executive Vice President of Research and Strategic Data Solutions where he ran Yahoo!'s global Data strategy, architecting its Data policies and systems, and managing its Data analytics and Data processing infrastructure. He has a Ph.D. in Computer Science & Engineering from the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor, earned in 1991. He also holds an MS in Mathematics (1989), an MS in Computer Engineering (1986), and a BS in Engineering (1984), all from the University of Michigan, Ann Arbor.
Vic De Zen served as the Chairman of Royal Group technologies. He previously served as the CEO of the company.

Dr. Vijay Reddy serves as Chief Scientific Officer at AgriGenome. He holds a Doctorate Degree in Rice Functional Genomics from the University of Hyderabad. His expertise includes genomics, molecular biology, molecular genetics, bioinformatics, and applied aspects of agricultural research for crop improvement. He has more than 6000 submissions at the NCBI-EST division and >1600 dbSNP submissions. Dr.Vijay has worked at various levels with Vibha Seed Group like DGM, General Manager, and Sr. General Manager. His contribution includes the establishment of various divisions in biotechnology like Molecular Diagnostics, Marker Assisted Selections, Candidate Gene Identification, Gene Cloning, Construct development, Genetic Transformation, etc. More than 150 Markers have been established by him, which are being extensively utilized in various breeding programs and more than 30 commercial hybrids were developed using these technologies. He was instrumental in attracting several funding bodies like DBT, USAID in collaboration with CIMMYT, ACPFG, ICRISAT in his earlier organization. He has more than 7 years of experience in biotechnology before joining AgriGenome.

Mr. Vincent Furfaro serves as President at Healthinsurance.org. Mr. Vincent Furfaro serves as President, SB Holding at The IHC Group. He served as Senior Vice President, Corporate Development & Chief Information Security Officer at Independence Holding.

Mr. Vincent Lombardo serves as Chief Financial Officer at Summit 7. He served as Chief Financial Officer at the company. He served as Chief Financial Officer at Hospitality Staffing Solutions. He has a broad career as a senior financial executive, including 15 years of experience serving as CFO for public and private companies. His career spans 30 years and includes diverse experience in strategy, operations, IT, reengineering, workers' compensation and risk management. Since 2011, he served as CFO of two staffing companies, SNI Companies and MDT Personnel, LLC. Prior to that, he was CFO at private-equity-backed TRAKAmerica, Capstone Tropical Holdings, Inc. and publicly traded staffing company Ablest, Inc. He also served in executive financial positions with Fleetpride Inc., General Binding Corporation and Interlake Material Handling, Inc. He is a graduate of Northern Illinois University and later received his MBA from DePaul University.

Mr. Vincent Rivaz serves as Board Member at ACWA Power International. He served as Chief Executive Officer at EDF Energy. He is a graduate of the Ecole Nationale Supérieure d'Hydraulique de Grenoble. In 1977, he joined EDF's Exterior Engineering Centre within the International Affairs Division. From 1985 to 1992, he participated in EDF's development in China within the International Division, of which he became Director of the Far East Division in 1989. From 1992 to 1994, he was the Head of the National Center of Hydro Equipment within the Equipment Division. He was appointed Deputy Head of the International Division in 1995 and became Head of Projects in 1996. He joined the Finance Department in 1999 as Deputy Chief Financial Officer and became Head of Financial Strategies and Operations in 2000. He was appointed Chief Executive Officer of the London Electricity Group in early 2002. He led the merger transactions of companies acquired during the first six months of 2002 (Eastern and Seeboard networks) and created in mid-2003 EDF Energy and has since been its Chief Executive Officer. Mr de Rivaz was awarded The Energy Institute's 71st Melchett Award in June 2006. He was named National Ambassador by HRH the Prince of Wales, in July 2009, for his significant contribution to the Prince's Business in the Community projects. In November 2009 Mr de Rivaz became an Honorary Fellow of the Institute of Mechanical Engineers as recognition for the major contribution he has made to engineering. He is Chevalier de la Légion d'Honneur.

primary_position: Chief Legal Officer & Senior Vice President
biography: Ms. Virginia Robinson serves as Chief Legal Officer & Senior Vice President at Chugach Government Solutions. Previously she served as an associate at law firms Greenberg Traurig and Walsh, Colucci, Lubeley & Walsh and as a clerk to Judge William Hamblen of the Prince William County Circuit Court in Manassas, Virginia. She holds a Juris Doctor degree from Washington and Lee University School of Law.

Mr. Wade Chandler serves as Chief Architect at Lirio. He served as Head of Development at Lirio. Wade Chandler is a technical leader with over 20 years of experience using various technologies to lead, engineer, and develop software in various sectors, industries, and domains such as government, health, defense, education, child assessment, retail, and beyond. He has employed many technologies, programming languages, and soft skills to successfully lead and implement different types of projects across various profiles, including the web, mobile, desktop, and the cloud. Wade has spent most of his career operating as a cross-functional leader, which requires various facets of software leadership, design, architecture, and development. His technical skills range from development environments, programming languages, frameworks, cloud, and databases to project management, writing, and graphics. At Lirio, he leads a team of software developers in building a solution that will harness behavioral intelligence to achieve better outcomes for healthcare and energy organizations and the people they serve. Prior to joining Lirio, Wade was Team Leader at Scripps Networks Interactive (SNI), where he led multiple teams and projects to meet corporate goals. He served as Associate Director for Virtusa at SNI, Consulting Developer & Leader at SNI, Consultant & UI Team Leader for Army Researcher Laboratory, Team Leader at Decision Dynamics, Inc., and several other leadership positions throughout his career. He has contributed to open source most of his career through projects such as the NetBeans IDE and helped transition it to The Apache Software Foundation, where it is known as Apache NetBeans. Wade's skill set, outlook, and experience make him an excellent mentor who motivates his team to meet development goals for Lirio and our clients.

Mr. Walid Sowaidan serves as Group Chief Legal Officer at Alameda Healthcare. With nearly 30 years of distinguished legal leadership and cross-border advisory experience, he has worked extensively across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, South Asia, and the United States. Throughout his career, he has held prominent roles, including: Founder & CEO of LexDesk360 an innovative legal services platform serving clients across EMEA and South Asia. Chief Legal Officer at several major entities under G42, Abu Dhabi. A 16-year tenure with 3M serving as General Counsel for MEA, Head of Trade Compliance for EMEA, and General Counsel for CEEMEA. Earlier legal leadership positions at Pfizer Pharmaceuticals, Citigroup, and Kharafi Group. He holds an LL.B. from Ain Shams University and has completed executive legal training at NYU Stern School of Business. At Alameda, he leads the Group's strategic legal agenda with a focus on M&A transactions in MEA, strategic partnerships, governance and compliance frameworks, corporate structuring across jurisdictions, investor and shareholder legal relations, and board secretarial practice. He is also driving the operationalization of the Group's Holding Company Office in Dubai. With his broad expertise, regulatory insight, and entrepreneurial acumen, he plays a key role in advancing Alameda's growth, institutional strength, and global expansion ambitions.

Mr. Walid Tahabsem is a Co-Founder and serves as Chairman at VentureX. Mr. Tahabsem serves as Board Member at BeyondCapital. He is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer, President, and Board Member at Integrated Technology Group (ITG). After receiving his B.Sc. in Computer Science from Yarmouk University in Jordan, he founded Integrated Technology Group back in 1989. Today, as ITG President & CEO, Mr. Tahabsem leads one of the most successful IT companies offering quality end-to-end products and services for the education and public sectors in more than 20 countries worldwide. Through the combination of his passion for technology and vision, he was able to grow ITG not only by size, geographic representation, and revenue but also in technological innovation and in the application of technology in various fields. His innovations include the development of the first Arabic artificial intelligent parser, and the creation of an Electronic Data Interchange solution, implemented in many large European institutions, in addition to one of the top education solutions; EduWave® which currently holds the largest base countrywide deployments and users worldwide. Over the years, Mr. Tahabsem has been an active member of a number of key national boards, councils, and associations including; Jordan's National Agenda, Jordan's Board of Education, Jordan University for Science and Technology (JUST) Advisory Council, German Jordan University (GJU) Advisory Council, Information Technology Association of Jordan (INT@J) Board, and Jordan's Youth Development Program INJAZ. Mr. Tahabsem currently serves on the Prince Hamzah Bin Al Hussein School Board and Jordan's ICT Advisory Council and is also a member of the Jordan Strategy Forum (JSF). He also serves on the "Endeavor" Board of Directors, due to his belief in the active role they play in enhancing the country's entrepreneurial ecosystem. He is also a co-founder and a board member of the Oasis500, the region's premier education and counselor-driven seed investment program. In addition, he is an active member of Saudi Al-Aghar Thinktank, a nonprofit and independent Think-Tank aiming to transform Saudi Arabia into a Knowledge Society. Recently, in recognition of his outstanding efforts and leadership in the improvement of the information technology and education sector in Jordan, he was awarded by His Majesty King Abdullah II Bin Al Hussein with the Order of Independence to become the first Jordanian honored in this category. He is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer President and Board Member at ITG.

Dr. Walid Zaher is a Co-Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at Carexso. Dr. Zaher brings a profound wealth of experience and expertise to the forefront of CareXso, a journey that seamlessly interweaves clinical excellence, advanced education, and groundbreaking research leadership. Dr. Zaher's vision for CareXso transcends geographical borders, envisioning the Middle East and Africa (MEA) as integral players in the global clinical research network. His resolute commitment to fostering diversity and inclusivity within the healthcare industry and his tireless pursuit of health innovation exemplify his transformative leadership. As he continues to shape the healthcare landscape, Dr. Zaher stands as a beacon of progress and a driving force in the quest for a healthier, more equitable world. In the United Arab Emirates (UAE), Dr. Zaher emerged as a transformative figure, directing pioneering research initiatives at SEHA and subsequently serving as Chief Research Officer at G42 Healthcare and CEO at IROS. Amid the unprecedented challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic, he demonstrated unwavering resilience by establishing the UAE's inaugural Contract Research Organization, building upon the resounding success of the 4Humanity Clinical Trial. Before his UAE sojourn, Dr. Zaher held prestigious positions, including Director of the College of Medicine Research Centers and an assistant professorship in regenerative medicine and stem cells at King Saud University in Riyadh. His expertise extended to consulting on the Saudi 2020 National Biotechnology and Infectious Disease plan at KASCT. Fuelled by an unrelenting desire to expand the horizons of medical knowledge, Dr. Zaher embarked on an academic odyssey, earning a Bachelor of Medicine and Surgery in Saudi Arabia. His yearning for innovation led him to pursue further education, culminating in a Master's in Medical Education, Anatomy and Embryology, and Bioscience Technology. This foundation enabled him to transcend conventional boundaries, culminating in a Ph.D. in Regenerative Medicine from Denmark. His quest for excellence also led him to Harvard-MGH, Boston, where he acquired specialized training in laser-medicine application.

Mr. Will Bax served as Chief Executive Officer at Retirement Villages Group (UK). Will has a passion for building communities and supporting them to thrive. He joined RVG in 2019 to pursue a new strategy of urban, socially connected, community building. Prior to RVG, Will was Executive Director at Grosvenor, where he was responsible for the London Estate. He is currently a Trustee of the Blenheim Palace Estate and a Board and Steering Group member of ARCO (the Association of Retirement Community Operators). Away from work Will spends most of his time in nature and is particularly interested in helping wildlife to flourish, starting with rewilding his home farm in Kent.

Mr. William Joseph is a Co-Founder and serves as Co-Chief Executive Officer & Principal at Potomac Healthcare Solutions. Mr. Joseph is a recognized leader in the healthcare industry with more than 40 years of experience managing complex healthcare operations in the military, government, and private sector. He entered the private sector after 28 years of Navy service as a Hospital Corpsman and Medical Service Corps Officer. He held progressively more responsible healthcare administration and operations positions culminating with a tour of duty as Commanding Officer, Naval Medical Clinics Command, Washington DC, a network of ambulatory care clinics providing more than 200,000 outpatient visits per year. Prior to forming Potomac Healthcare Solutions, he served as the Executive Vice President and Director of Veterans' Services for a large, privately held healthcare contractor. He also served as Deputy Chief Operating Officer, Managed Care Division for a large, publicly traded healthcare organization. He was responsible for the operation of a large, integrated health system. Earlier, he served the same corporation as Vice President, Long Term Care Division. He received his Bachelor of Science degree from Southern Illinois University, Carbondale, lL in 1975 and his Master of Science in Health Care Administration degree from The George Washington University in 1985. He served as the Prince William County representative to the Health Systems Agency of Northern Virginia established under Virginia law to plan for the balanced and orderly development of healthcare facilities and services in Northern Virginia.

Mr. Xiaoping Zhang served as Group Chief Investment Officer at G42. As G42's Group CIO, Mr. Zhang oversaw the company's investment strategy, with a focus on strenghtening G42's technology portfolio, while also producing financial returns. Xiaoping has more than 25 years of experience in consulting and general management positions. He is also a renowned Al business expert. Before joining G42, Xiaoping was the COO of Yitu Tech, a leading global Al player. He was also Managing Partner of Financial Services Industry at Deloitte, Managing Partner of Energy and Resources Industry at Ernst & Young, and Consulting Partner at PwC.
Mr. Yahya Al Jasmi serves as Chief Executive Officer & Managing Director at Ajman Holding.

Mr. Yehoyada Mandeel is the Founder & serves as Chief Executive Officer at Marzipan Tech. Mr. Mandeel is the co-founder of NXTleap, he spearheads the development of AI-driven solutions that enhance customer engagement and optimize corporate processes. With a wealth of experience in executive leadership in global companies, he has successfully scaled businesses, expanded market reach, and driven digital transformation across industries and continents. His career spans leadership roles in Marzipan Strategy, Presight (G42), Israel Tech Challenge (ITC), SodaStream International, and Yeda Education (Time To Know), where he led growth, innovation, and business transformations. He holds an LL.B and LL.M from Hebrew University (Summa Cum Laude) and Georgetown University, as well as an MBA (Cum Laude) from Hebrew University.

Dr. Yixian Lin is the Founder & serves as Chief Executive Officer at Centremedical. Dr. Lam Yat-yin is the founder and director of Cardiology at Canossa Hospital, Hong Kong, the director of the Asian Cardiology Centre at Canossa Hospital, Hong Kong, the founder of the Hong Kong Structural Heart Society, the chief medical consultant of Hong Kong Magnetic Heart, the associate consultant of Prince of Wales Hospital and the consultant of Kiang Wu Hospital in Macau. He was also an associate professor at the Department of Medicine and Therapeutics at the Chinese University of Hong Kong from 2008 to 2014. Dr Lam received his Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery from the University of Hong Kong in 1999 and was awarded the John Anderson Grey Medal. He then received his cardiac training at the Prince of Wales Hospital and the Royal Brompton Hospital in London, UK, and was awarded his Doctor of Medicine in 2011. Dr. Lam has held various academic positions at the Chinese University of Hong Kong and has actively organized numerous international seminars and conferences. He has served as the project director for several international seminars on congenital and structural heart disease in the Asia-Pacific region (such as LAA Hong Kong/Shanghai (2012), LAA Seoul (2013), CSI LAA Asia Pacific (2013 - 2017), APCASH (2013 - 2017), and has been invited to give academic lectures and surgical demonstrations in many countries in Europe, America and Asia. Dr. Lin also holds several positions, including the chairman of the Asia Pacific Structural Heart Club and leadership positions in various professional societies. He is also one of the initiators of China Structural Heart Week. In addition, Dr. Lin co-developed the left atrial appendage occluder LAmbre™ with LifeTech Scientific (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. Dr. Lin is currently the deputy editor of JACC Asia, the journal of the American College of Cardiology. He was also the deputy editor of the internationally renowned journal International Journal of Cardiology - Cardiac Interventions and has published more than 300 peer-reviewed research articles and abstracts.
Ms. Yolanda Bolleurs served as Chief Financial Officer & Board Member at Royal IHC. She has extensive experience in large transformations within several energy related companies.

Ms. Yolanda Surjan founded Creatures and Co. She received her radiation therapy degree from the University of Newcastle. In addition to other jobs and travels, she worked at Prince of Wales Hospital in Sydney for a number of years before returning to Newcastle with her husband, first to work and then to do her PhD.

Mr. Yonathan Ast serves as Chief Operating Officer at Cesium. He provides comprehensive organizational support to Cesium. The operational systems he builds optimize efficiency and value creation for all levels of the company. He has extensive business experience developed from an early age while working in his family's company, the only private officially licensed reseller for Neuhaus, the international luxury Belgian chocolate brand. From risk management, customer relations and sales, and team management, to luxury aesthetics and branding, He developed many skills as the business grew into one of the most successful sales channels in the US. He is also passionate about Japanese language and culture. He received a FLAS scholarship to study intensive Japanese applied language at ICU in Tokyo, Japan, and also attended the University of Virginia as a FLAS scholar, where he graduated with a degree in East Asian Studies. He's since used his expertise in many cross-border business ventures. He worked with a full consulting firm helping Japanese food and beverage companies export their brands overseas, and he managed a diverse set of cross-border portfolio projects, including art, real estate, and technology for an international holding company. He also supported cross-border product development, strategy, and project management for the Smart Construction initiative at Komatsu, Ltd., and as a consulting director of corporate strategy for Earthbrain, Ltd. While there he advised on the development of scalable market strategies, operational systems, product development roadmapping, and the building of the entire North American launch team. He has also spent over 20 years studying the history, cultivation, and making of Japanese and Chinese teas.

primary_position: Chief Technology Officer and Director of Engineering
biography: Mr. Zac McCormick serves as Chief Technology Officer and Director of Engineering at Fulcrum. Zac McCormick is the Chief Technology Officer at Spatial Networks, overseeing and leading the technical aspects of our products. He was asked to join the SNI team under contract to work on an iOS app in 2011 and ended up joining full time as a mobile engineer. Before that, he worked as an engineer for Mangrove Software building a SaaS HR and payroll product which was later acquired by Asure Software.

Mr. Zhi Zhang serves as Executive President, General Manager & Director at Zhongtian Financia, formerly known as Zhongtian Urban Development Group Company Limited since January 16, 2012. He is also serving as Director in an international holding company and another company. He was Vice President of the Company, Chief Executive Officer in a Guizhou-based property development company, Chief Engineering Officer in an international holding company and General Manager in a Guiyang-based urban construction company.

Ms. Mays Jaradat serves as Senior Director at Jordan Capital and Investment Fund. Ms. Jaradat served as Director of SME Investment Fund at SME Investment Fund. She joined the SME Investment Fund in March 2018. She is a Director of Al Amal Hospital, Crystel, Japanese Flavor, Sands National Academy, and Arabian Development for Food Industries Co. Prior to that, she was a Senior Director of the Corporate Finance Department at Capital Investments. She was also Head of the Business Development Department responsible for strategy/ business development as well as a member of the Senior Management Committee and has been involved in various deals across a broad range of industry verticals. She has also served as a Director of the Consultant and Investment Group, a publicly listed Jordanian healthcare company, and as a member of the Board of Directors of King Abdullah II Design and Development Bureau ("KADDB"). She started her career in 2005 when she was part of the Corporate Finance and Equity Research Departments at Jordan Investment Trust PLC. She holds a Bachelor of Commerce in finance from Concordia University (Canada) and is currently enrolled in the Global MBA program at the University of London.
Mr. Abdulwahab Wazzan serves as Chairman at National International Holding Company.

primary_position: Independent Director and Director with Authorized Signature
biography: Mr. Achporn Charuchinda is Independent Director and Director with Authorized Signature of Bangchak Corporation. Education/Training- Bachelor of Laws, Thammasat University; Thai Barrister-at-Law, Institute of Legal Education of the Thai Bar Association; Director's Briefing - Corporate Strategy beyond the Crisis, a Chairman/Board Perspective, Bain & Company, Inc.; Law Drafting Certificate, India; Certificate, National Defence Course (NDC46), The National Defence College. Experience- Present Member of the Council of State, The Office of the Council of State; 2017 - 2020 Board Member, Office of Insurance Commission; 2017 - 2019 Chairman, National Reform Committee in Justice Process, National Reform Committee; 2017 - 2019 Board Member in Legal, Office of the National Economic and Social Development (NESDB); 2016 Director, Thailand Tobacco Monopoly, Ministry of Finance; 2015 - 2020 Board Member, Office of the National Economic and Social Development (NESDB); 2015 - 2018 Board Member Highland Research and Development Institute (Public Organization); 2013 - 2021 Director, PTT Exploration and Production Public Company Limited; 2013 - 2017 Board Member, The Bank of Thailand; 2013 - 2016 Director, Thai Smile Airways Company Limited; 2013 - 2015 Chairperson, the Securities and Exchange Commission; 2012 - 2015 Member of the Legal Committee, Thai Airways International Public Company Limited. Non-listed companies- Executive Board Life Insurance Fund; Advisory Board, The Crown Property Bureau; Special Advisory Committee, Highland Research and Development Institution (Public Organization); Member of the Risk Oversight Committee, The Bank of Thailand; Member, Constitution Drafting Committee; Member of the Council of State, The Office of the Council of State.

primary_position: Chairman of the Board of Directors
biography: Mr. Ahmad Almujalham serves as Chairman of the Board of Directors at Shamal Az-Zour Al-Oula. Prior to joining the Board in April 2021, he held multiple roles at the Kuwait Fund for Arab Economic Development for 23 years where he handled the project development of high dams, irrigation schemes, resettlements, and flood protection and has represented the Fund in many international donors and consultative group meetings. He returned to the Kuwait Fund in 2014 and presently serves as a Senior Engineering Advisor for the Appraisal of Roads and Social Projects. Mr. Almujalham has also previously held a role as Mega Project Manager at Almal Investment Company where he oversaw the development of the Hail Economic City in Saudi Arabia. He holds a degree in Civil Engineering and an MBA from Kuwait University, Kuwait.

Mr. Ahmed El Salamouny serves as Chief Financial Officer & BOD Secretary at National International Holding Company. Mr. EL Salamouny is the Chief Financial Officer for the group, responsible for all company's financial functions, including accounting, audit, treasury, and corporate finance. Mr. EL Salamouny holds B.Sc. Degree in accounting from Alexandria University and enjoys more than 35 years of work experience in the financial field. Beside his financial responsibilities, Mr. EL Salamouny is BOD Secretary

Dr. Elmagarmid is the inaugural Executive Director of Qatar Computing Research Institute (QCRI), a national research institute and member of Qatar Foundation. Since his appointment in 2010, Dr. Elmagarmid has driven the Institute's vision to bring positive impact to citizens and society by focusing on large-scale computing challenges that address national priorities for growth and development. Before joining Qatar Foundation, Dr Elmagarmid held a number of prestigious posts in academia and industry. He has held faculty positions at Pennsylvania State University, the University of Padova, and Purdue University, where he had been actively involved in teaching and research for 25 years. Dr. Elmagarmid served as a chief scientist in HP's Office of Strategy and Technology and has worked with or consulted for Telcordia Technology, Bellcore, IBM,CSC, Harris, D. H. Brown and Associates, MCC, Bell Northern Research, Molecular Design Labs, SOGEI (Italy) and UniSql. Dr. Elmagarmid serves as the Chair of the IT Executive Committee of Sidra Medical and Research Centre. Early in his career he received the NSF's Presidential Young Investigator award from President Ronald Reagan. He is an IEEE Fellow and an ACM Fellow, and is also a member of Sigma Xi American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS). The University of Dayton and Ohio State University have both named him among their distinguished alumni. Dr. Elmagarmid has chaired and served on several program committees and editorial boards. Dr. Elmagarmid is an accomplished and wellpublished scientist, authoring six books and more than 180 papers, and has run several well-funded research programs. Dr. Elmagarmid received his B.S. in computer science from the University of Dayton (1977) and his M.S. (1981) and Ph.D (1985) from Ohio State University.

Mr. Alejandro Fonseca serves as Group Chief Operating Officer at ESG EMIRATES STALLIONS GROUP. He has more than 15 years of vast experience in architecture, project management and real estate development having been involved with international projects across 15 countries. Alejandro also a former Board Member for 6 years in one of UAE's leading construction company. Having joined Royal Group in 2008, being involved in the development of several companies within the group. His previous international experience in Europe and America as well as his knowledge in the Private and Public Sectors both as a Consultant and Client representative, all provide him with the in-depth understanding and vision required to lead the operation of the organization.

primary_position: Chief Compliance Officer & Investor Relations Manager
biography: Mr. Ali Abdulsalam serves as Chief Compliance Officer & Investor Relations Manager at Shamal Az-Zour Al-Oula. He was joined the company in September 2020 and was promoted to the Chief Compliance Officer and Investor Relations Manager in July 2024. In his role, he oversees and manages the essential investor relations and the company's standing at the Capital Market Authority (CMA) and Boursa Kuwait. He brings with him over 9 years of experience in compliance and risk management in his previous role as a registered Risk Officer at Kuwait's Middle East Financial Brokerage Company.

Dr. Andrew Barron is a Co-Founder and serves as Technical Consultant at Natcore Technology. Currently the Charles W. Duncan, Jr.-Welch Chair of Chemistry and Professor of Materials Science at Rice University, as well as a visiting Professor at the University of Wales. Dr. Barron is the author of numerous publications in the area of materials preparation via chemical pathways and more than 350 peer-reviewed scientific papers, with nearly 100 focusing on developments in nanotechnology. Professor Barron was also the first faculty member hired for the Smalley Institute for Nanotechnology. Before joining the Rice faculty in 1995, Dr. Barron received his undergraduate and doctorate degrees in chemistry from the Imperial College of Science and Technology in London, performed postdoctoral work at the University of Texas at Austin, and served on the faculty at Harvard University. He was the inaugural recipient of the prestigious Norman Hackerman Award in Chemical Research from the Welch foundation and is the first Prince of Wales Visiting Innovator.

Mr. Andrew Frain serves as Chief Executive Officer at Shamal Az-Zour Al-Oula. He is an executive Director of the Board of Directors. Joining the company in November 2017, he also serves as Chief Executive Officer. Mr. Frain's previous role includes Plant General Manager for the Az-Zour North Operations and Maintenance Company. He brings with him over 25 years of experience in the power generation and water production industry, and has a background in design, project management, business development, and operations, and has previous experience working for consultants, EPC contractors, and equipment manufacturers in Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia Pacific.

Mr. Frain holds an MSc in Energy from Heriot-Watt University in Edinburgh, UK, and a BSc in Integrated Engineering Systems from Manchester Metropolitan University, UK.

Mr. Annie Liang Bentley, is our independent non-executive Director since December 2017. Ms. BENTLEY is a member of the audit committee of the Company. Ms Annie Liang BENTLEY is the founder of Bentley Communications and a pioneer of the branding, corporate and marketing communications profession in Hong Kong. Ms. BENTLEY holds a bachelor of arts degree in English Literature and Chinese Translation (1971) from the University of Hong Kong, an advanced certificate in Education from the University of Oxford (1976) and a master's degree in Buddhist Studies from the University of Hong Kong (2010). Ms. BENTLEY was made an Honorary Fellow of the University of Hong Kong in 2013. Ms. BENTLEY began her career in educational publishing for Oxford University Press working on their ESL books and the Oxford English Chinese dictionary. In 1981, she joined the public relations industry working for a financial services banking and securities group in Hong Kong. In 1987, she established her consultancy in partnership with Omnicom, one of the world's largest public relations and advertising conglomerate, and grew Bentley Communications to be one of Hong Kong's reputable communications agencies with coverage in Singapore, Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou by 2007. Ms. BENTLEY is Chairman of Robert Black College HKU. She is a trustee of the China Oxford Scholarship Fund, board member of Action for Epilepsy, Heifer International (Hong Kong) and committee member of the Boys and Girls Clubs Association of Hong Kong. Ms. BENTLEY has been a member of the Hospital Governing Committee of the Prince of Wales Hospital, and has served on the Executive Committee of Project Vision since the inception of the charity in 2006. Ms. BENTLEY has no relationship with any Directors, senior management or substantial shareholders (as defined in the Listing Rules) or controlling shareholders (as defined in the Listing Rules) of the Company. Save as disclosed above, Ms. BENTLEY does not hold any other positions with the Company or other members of the Group. Save as disclosed above, Ms. BENTLEY has not held any directorship in other listed public companies in the last three years.

Ms. Arada Jaroon-Ek, Academic Degree: Master of Business and Administration, Major in Banking and Finance, Thammasart University; Master of Commerce, Commerce and Accountancy Faculty, Sydney University, Australia; Bachelor of Business Administration, Major in Banking and Finance, Chulalongkorn University. biography: Bang Young-Min served as Senior Executive Vice President and Head of SNI at Samsung Securities.

primary_position: Chairman of the Board of Directors
biography: Mr. Basim Alothman serves as Chairman of the Board of Directors at Coast Investment. He also serves as Chairman of a private company, and the Vice-Chairman of National International Holding Company, and a member of the board of directors of National Investment Company From 2007 until 2012 . He graduated from the Faculty of Arts at Kuwait University in 1983.

Mr. Ben Errez is a Co-Founder and serves as Chairman at RYVYL. Mr. Errez serves as Chairman, President & Chief Executive Officer at Coyni. He has acted in these positions since July 2017. From August 2004 until August 2015, he formed the start-up IHC Capital, where he held the position of Principal Consultant from founding to the present date, through which he advises clients in the South Pacific region with market capitalizations ranging from $50M to $150M on matters such as commerce, security, reliability, and privacy. From January 1991 to August 2004, he served as Software Development Lead for the Microsoft International Product Group. He also served as an Executive Representative of Microsoft Office and was a founding member of the Microsoft Trustworthy Computing Forum, both within the company and internationally. At Microsoft, he was responsible for the development of the first Microsoft software translation Software Development Kit ("SDK") in Hebrew, Arabic, Thai and Simplified Chinese, as well as the development of the first bidirectional extensions to Rich Text Format ("RTF") file format, all bidirectional extensions in text converters for Microsoft Office, and contributed to the development of the international extensions to the Unicode standard to include bidirectional requirements under the World Wide Web Consortium ("W3C"). He received his Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics and Computer Science from Hebrew University.

primary_position: Chief Executive Officer, Chairman and Executive Director
biography: Dr. Bernard Tuch served as Chief Executive Officer, Chairman and Executive Director at Living Cell Technologies. Professor Tuch is an Honorary Professor at The University of Sydney and Monash University. He is also supervising a bioengineering diabetes cell therapy project at the University of Technology Sydney. Previously, he was a senior scientist with CSIRO Australia. He is a director of Sydney Cell Therapy Foundation Pty Limited, the not-for-profit Australian Foundation for Diabetes Research, and is a Specialist Practitioner, Endocrinology, at the Prince of Wales Private Hospital & St Vincent's Private Hospital, Sydney. His experience includes capital raising to support his considerable research team and a large international scientific publication list. He has had previous scientific collaborations with LCT and knows the company's direction intimately. Professor Tuch was chairman of the Remuneration and Nomination Committee until he became interim CEO on 16 July 2021. He was appointed to the board on 20 July 2011 and appointed interim chairman on 31 August 2018.

primary_position: Chief Credit Officer & Chief Risk Officer
biography: Mr. Dan Thakkar served as Chief Credit Officer & Chief Risk Officer at Chimera Investment. Prior to becoming Co-Chief Investment Officer in December 2022 (and subsequently our Chief Investment Officer in March 2024), Mr. Thakkar served as the Company's Chief Risk Officer starting in December 2020. Prior to joining the Company, Mr. Thakkar headed the Fixed Income Trading Desk at Genworth Financial from 2012 to 2020, where he was responsible for overseeing Trading for IG Corporates, High-Yield, Municipals, Emerging Markets and Structured Product Sectors, including RMBS, ABS, CMBS and CLOs. Prior to this job, Mr. Thakkar headed Trading for Genworth's Structured Portfolio from 2008 to 2012 that included RMBS, CMBS and ABS. Prior to Genworth, Mr. Thakkar was with Hyperion Brookfield Asset Management for from 2005 to 2008, one of the original asset managers of residential mortgage-backed security funds, where he traded RMBS and managed a Mortgage REIT fund. Mr. Thakkar also spent nine years at MetLife, where he was an Agency and Non-Agency RMBS trader. Prior to that job, he traded Government and Agency Debt, and had stints at Portfolio and Risk Management units within MetLife. On April 2, 2025, Chimera Investment Corporation and Dan Thakkar mutually agreed that Mr. Thakkar will step down from his position as the Company's Chief Credit & Risk Officer, effective July 1, 2025. He holds MBA from University of Hartford and BA from Delhi University, India.

Mr. Darwin Green is the Founder and serves as President, Chief Executive Officer & Director at HighGold Mining. He also serves as a Director at Evergold. He has experience as Sr. management advancing mineral deposits in Alaska. business & capital market strength, exploration acumen, and jurisdiction knowledge. Most recently, he served as Vice President of exploration for Constantine Metal Resources advancing the Alaska Palmer zinc/copper deposit to the preliminary economic assessment stage. Prior to that, he oversaw resource expansion and underground development programs at the Niblack deposit on Prince of Wales Island, for which he received the Commissioner's award for Project Excellence from the state of Alaska. He drives the strategy, oversees the exploration processes and leads the business development and corporation marketing for HighGold. He holds both a B.Sc. and an M.Sc. in economic geology.
