She also oversees stakeholder relations, and various other aspects of the wider Group interests.

Ms. Fiona Murray serves as a Board Member at Oxford Science Enterprises. She is the Associate Dean of Innovation at the MIT School of Management and William Porter (1967) Professor of Entrepreneurship. Recognized as an international policy expert on global innovation, she served on the British Prime Minister's Council on Science and Technology and was awarded a CBE (Commander of the British Empire) for her services to innovation and entrepreneurship in the United Kingdom. She was appointed Dame Commander of St Michael and St George (DCMG) by His Majesty King Charles III for services to science, technology, and diversity. She serves as the Vice Chair of the NATO Innovation Fund - the first multi-sovereign venture fund to support deep tech ventures in defense, security, and resilience focus across Allied nations - and is a member of the Ministry of Defence Innovation Advisory Panel. She received her BA '89 and MA '90 from the University of Oxford in chemistry. She subsequently earned an AM '92 and PhD '96 from Harvard University in applied sciences.

Mr. François Aird serves as Limited Partner at Diagram Ventures. He Co-Founded & served as Chairman & President at CEDROM-SNi. After studying management at École des hautes études commerciales in Montreal, he joined forces with Philippe Gélinas in 1984 to create A&G Conseil, a technology consulting firm. After being renamed Proximi-T, the company became part of Cossette in 2000. In 1988, the development of graphical user interfaces and the arrival of a new storage medium - the CD-ROM- led them to found CEDROM Technologies. The company would merge several years later with Société nationale d'information (SNI) to become CEDROM-SNi. In January 2000, he and his associates launched IXIASOFT, a company that stemmed from CEDROM-SNi's expertise in document indexing. IXIASOFT marketed software tools for managing XML and DITA documents. In addition to serving as Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Computer Research Institute of Montreal (CRIM), he has also chaired the Board of Directors at IXIASOFT and the Quebec Technology Association (AQT).

Mr. Fritz Backus served as General Counsel at KBW Ventures. Fritz has more than 14 years overseeing legal affairs in the in vitro diagnostics industry, with experience encompassing FDA registration, CE marking, advertising, sales, biologics, and other licensing and acquisition, compliance, clinical trials, IP and other issues faced by life sciences companies operation both domestically and globally. Also a Partner at Outside GC, Fritz has focused on healthcare law, with extensive experience as a member of senior management advising on key strategic and organizational decisions and collaborating across functions to implement successful solutions. Prior to this, he was General Counsel and Chief Compliance Officer for Diagnostics Products Corporation (DPC), a NYSE listed, Global IVD medical device manufacturer, which was acquired in 2007 by Siemens Healthcare Diagnostics Inc., where Fritz remained as Vice President until 2015. Fritz began his legal career in Houston at the law firm Baker Botts LLP and also served as an attorney in the Boston offices of Goodwin Procter, LLP and Seyfarth Shaw. His broad practice has encompassed M&A, securities laws (1933 and 1934 Acts) matters, venture capital investments, fund formation, FCPA and antikickback compliance, FDA compliance, tax law, and various business ventures. Fritz earned his law degree at Harvard Law School, where he was a Teagle Foundation Scholar. Fritz is also a graduate of the University of Chicago.

Dr. Gary Wood is the Founder and serves as Managing Director at Concorde Investment Management. Mr. Wood serves as Managing Director & President at Omnimed Capital. He was the Co-Founder of eOriginal and served as Executive Chairman. Dr. Wood also serves as Chairman of the firm's Investment Policy Committees. His investment and business activities include domestic US and North America as well as Asia, Europe, and Latin America. Before founding Concorde, Dr. Wood worked for an independent trust company in Houston, Texas, as an investment and financial advisor. Dr. Wood is a co-founder and Chairman of the Board of the International Hospital Corporation (IHC), founded in 1991 to develop acute-care hospital facilities, specialty hospitals, and specialty clinics that are uniformly managed and branded in three countries in Latin America. Additionally, he is Chairman of the Board of eOriginal, Inc., a leading provider of comprehensive business-to-business digital transaction management (digital signatures and vaulting) and e-commerce solutions based in Baltimore. He has extensive business experience relating to healthcare, software, manufacturing, and investment management. He is also active in civic and charitable organizations in Dallas. He is currently a member of the Endowment Foundation Investment Committee and Advisory Board for the Children's Oncology Service of Texas (aka Ronald McDonald House) and a board member of Leader Formation International, an International Christian Leadership Development Mission. In February 2005, he completed six years serving on the board of the Parkland Health and Hospital System (Dallas County Hospital District), where he served on the Pension Investment oversight committee. He has twice served as past chairman (in 1988 and 1999) of the Society of International Business Fellows, a leadership organization consisting of 1400 senior business executive level, government officials, and NGO members in four regional networks in 45 countries, where he is a member in good standing. He was the founder and initial chairman of The Health Industry Council (1988-1998) in the Dallas Ft Worth region, a nine-county industry promoter and advocacy organization in North Texas, and he served as a board member for the Baylor Medical Research Institute (1987-2000). He received his bachelor's and master's degrees in electrical engineering from Texas Tech University and went on to receive only the third interdisciplinary Ph.D. awarded by Tech, emphasizing law, business, and statistics. He was named a Distinguished Graduate in Engineering in 1993.

Mr. H.E. Hisham Al Gurg serves as Advisory Board Member at Arab Angel. With over 18 years of experience in setting up and running new ventures in the MENA region, He is a pioneer for his visionary approach, high profile networking, and for concluding and managing large regional projects and investments worth more than 1.06 Billion USD. Presently he is managing the private investments and strategic partnership activities of Sheikh Saeed Al Maktoum. He is also the Executive Counselor of Al Fajer Investments & Development, an investment division of Al Fajer Enterprises, a holding group of companies owned by His Highness Sheikh Hasher Al Maktoum. Both Sheikhs are members of the royal family of Dubai. Currently, his main day-to-day activities are focused on managing SEED Group. As a Group C.E.O., he manages 8 growing companies in 6 diversified industries. The group's core activities are Telecom Services, Media Production, Legal Services, General Trading, Business Services, Interior & Architecture Design, and Real Estate Investment and Management. He is also the UAE sponsor of the Chinese petroleum giant "Sinopec Petroleum". Sinopec is one of the five largest energy corporations in the world, headquartered in Beijing.

Ms. Jenny Shoemaker serves as Financial Controller at Green Seed Group. With over 15 years of experience in accounting, She has worked across all accounting functions in businesses at various stages of growth. She has worked in several full-cycle accounting roles in addition to working as an accounting consultant in the finance and technology fields supporting SaaS companies, portfolio management firms, and cloud-based web applications to name a few.

primary_position: Co-Founder, Managing Partner & Chief Investment Officer
biography: Mr. John Backus is a Co-Founder and serves as Managing Partner & Chief Investment Officer at PROOF. He serves as Senior Advisor at KBW Ventures. He also serves as Senior Advisor at Blue Heron Capital. He also served as a Board member at Spotflux and Two Six Labs. He also serves as Senior Advisor at Blue Heron Capital. He is also a Co-Founder and serves as Managing Partner at NAV.VC. Before becoming a venture capitalist, he co-founded US Order, which revolutionized online banking, went public in 1995, and was sold to Visa. He began his career at Bain & Company and Bain Capital, where he was the first management consultant to take a full-time operating role in a portfolio company. He is currently serving on the NVCA Board of Directors. Additionally, he is Chairman Emeritus of the Northern Virginia Technology Council (NVTC) Board of Directors, the founding Chairman and current Board member of the NVTC TechPAC, and Chairman Emeritus of the Wolf Trap Foundation Board of Directors. He has served as a technology policy adviser to Virginia governors Gilmore, Warner, and McDonnell. He holds a B.A. in Economics from Stanford University and an M.B.A. from Stanford University Graduate School of Business.

Mr. Karan Maheshwari serves as Managing Director at Maheshwari Investors. Maheshwari presently serves as a Director of Samsonite India and was a former Director of Quadrum Solutions, RJ Investments and Baby Chakra (Infomoko Technology Private Limited). He currently serves as the Managing Trustee of the Triveni Sodani Foundation and was the former Chair Person of the YPO- Next generation Mumbai Chapter. Prior to joining the family business, Maheshwari worked at McKinsey and Company as a management consultant for several years where he advised corporations and governments focusing on the Infrastructure, Education and Healthcare sectors. Maheshwari also founded Ignite Education and has served as an adviser to the Government of Bhutan, the Qatar Foundation, the National Skill Development Institute, Pratham, Nandi and the Emergency Management and Research Institute. Maheshwari has graduated from Duke University and has a Diploma from Oxford University.

Mr. Karim Kawar is a Co-Founder and serves as Board Member at Oasis500. Mr. Kawar co-founded and served as President at Bridges of Understanding. He serves as Chairman at Kawar Energy. He is the President of Kawar Group, entrepreneur, former diplomat, and angel investor. He is also Chairman of Kawar Energy and is a Co-Founder and Chairman of IrisGuard, and has served as Jordan's Ambassador to the US from 2002-2007. He led the EDAMA Initiative: Jordan's blueprint for a green economy. He was appointed by Royal Decree to the Board of Trustees of the King Abdullah II Fund for Development, appointed on 21 September 2010 as the Chairman of the Board of Trustees of King's Academy, and previously appointed to the Economic Consultative Council by His Majesty King Abdullah II. Founder of ten companies in the field of information and communication technologies (ICT), He is an architect of the REACH Initiative, Jordan's blueprint for a knowledge economy, Founder and Chairman of the Information Technology Association of Jordan, Former President of the Jordan Computer Society, and a founding member of several business associations and NGOs, including AmCham and the Jordan Intellectual Property Association. He is also a Member of the Advisory Board of Talal Abu Ghazaleh College for Business and a Member of the Boards of Trustees of Madaba University. He is a principal shareholder and advisor to Optimiza. He serves as a member of the board of two additional Jordanian public shareholding companies, namely the Jordan Ahli Bank and the Jordan Wood Industries Company (JWICO). He is a Member of the Global Agenda Council; Young Global Leader; Global Leader for Tomorrow of the World Economic Forum; Eisenhower Fellow; Member of the Young Presidents' Organization (YPO); Founder and Board Member of the Jordan River Foundation, headed by Her Majesty Queen Rania Al-Abdullah; and Founder and President of Bridges of Understanding Foundation. He graduated from Boston College in 1987 with a BSc in Management, Finance, and Computer Science.

Mr. Kevin Vyse serves as Special Advisor, Sector Specialist at Archipelago Ventures. He is advocate of the Circular Economy and has worked with the UK Government's Advisory Committee on Packaging, Ellen MacArthur Foundation on the New Plastics Economy, The HRH Prince Of Wales Sustainability Unit and also with the UN Transforming Tourism programme. In his current role he manages a team that continues to push the frontier on sustainable packaging and the applying of circular design principles to the creation of packaging solutions. He has a degree in Engineering and is a qualified Industrial Designer and Packaging Engineer.

Mr. Khaled Bin Alwaleed is the Founder and serves as Chief Executive Officer at KBW Ventures. He serves as an Advisory Board Member at BlueNalu. He is the Founder and serves as Chairman at KBW Investments. He serves as Chairman at Raimondi Cranes. He also serves as an Advisor at KittyHawk. He serves as an Advisor at TurtleTree Labs. He also served as Chairman at Crestmount Capital. Today, with holdings on five continents, he stands at the gateway between the Middle East's evolving economies and the Western world. He is the Founding Chairman of KBW Investments and a board member at Hampton Creek. He invests in an array of successful, but diverse global businesses - from promising technology start-ups to established companies. Consistently, his focus is on ventures and ideas at the intersection of innovation and economic growth. He is an Angel Investor. He also served as an Advisor at Big Idea Ventures. In the real estate and property markets, he serves as Executive Vice Chairman and co-founder of Arada, a UAE-based development company, and is the Chairman of Raimondi Cranes. As a venture capitalist who views nascent and emerging technologies as the path to alleviating many of today's pressing global issues, his sector agnostic investments in technology span several different disciplines including fintech, AgTech, food technology, B2B SaaS, aviation and transportation technologies, energy technology, biotechnology, entertainment and broadcast technologies, and more.

Ms. Kripa Joy serves as General Counsel at Elevar Equity. She serves as Board Member at BettrCredit. She has close to fifteen years of experience in legal transactional work, including in the impact investment space. She has previously worked with Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas in Mumbai and Paul, Weiss, Rifkind, Wharton & Garrison LLP in New York. Immediately prior to joining Elevar, she was general counsel at Lightrock India, the impact investing initiative of the LGT Group. She has worked in diverse practice areas such as private equity, financing, and investment management, and has represented various stakeholders. She also headed the learning and training function at Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas, and has taught a seminar course at the National Law School of India University. She has completed an integrated Law and Arts degree from the National Law School of India University, Bangalore, a Master's degree in Law from Columbia Law School, New York, and a management degree from the Indian Institute of Management, Ahmedabad.

Ms. Linda Montecalvo serves as Director, Finance at Green Seed Group. She comes to Green Seed having spent the prior twenty years serving in senior multi-disciplinary positions across management, finance, and strategic planning. When not managing financials at Green Seed you can find her locating unusual travel destinations near and far, meditating, cooking, doing yoga and enjoying nature and wildlife every available moment. She lives in Connecticut.

Ms. Madison Marks served as Portfolio Strategist at UNICEF Venture Fund. Before joining UNICEF, she was Managing Director of the Johns Hopkins Social Innovation Lab, a mission-driven incubator for social ventures aimed at bettering livelihoods in Baltimore and beyond. Before this, most of her career was spent between Washington D.C. and the Middle East working with philanthropic funds, NGOs, the public sector, and the private sector on initiatives related to youth engagement, enterprise development, and driving tech innovation. These organizations include Expo 2020 Dubai, Rainmaking Innovation, Womena, SMEX, Qatar Foundation International, and American Councils for International Education.

Mr. Mark Müller serves as Member of the Board at Xlife Sciences. He has 20 years of experience in the financial services industry at LGT Bank AG. There he was mainly responsible for looking after wealthy private clients. From 2009 to 2015 he was responsible for the business development of the LGT subsidiary in Zurich as a representative of the Swiss Financial Market Supervisory Authority FINMA. Since September 1, 2015, he Müller has been looking after wealthy clients independently. With RRB Unternehmungsberatung AG, he Müller focuses on a multifamily office approach. His consulting services include asset management, wealth management and structuring. He performs the functions of foundation board member, board of directors and client advisor. He Müller has a broad network in the financial services industry in Switzerland. In addition, he is actively involved in political consulting and in promoting Switzerland as a business location.

Mr. H.E. Marwan Juma is a Co-Founder and serves as Chairman of the Board of Directors at Oasis 500. Mr. Juma is the founder and Chairman of the Board of Kinz for Information Technology, the country's leading corporate data provider, and dot. jo, one of Jordan's top web application providers. He also served as the country's Minister of Information of Communications and Information Technology from Dec 2009 till Feb 2011. Prior to his government service, he was the Chief Executive Officer of Xpress Telecommunications, one of Jordan's leading mobile operators. Prior to his tenure at Xpress, he was the Chief Executive Officer of Batelco Jordan, the country's second fixed-line operator, and a leading data communication provider. Today he chairs Oasis500, the region's leading IT fund and accelerator, as well Urdon Shop, specializing in the promotion of local heritage products. In addition, he serves on several boards including King Abdullah II Fund for Development, King Abdullah II Center for Excellence, the Jordan Education Initiative, JEI, Princess Sumaya University for Technology, the recently established public broadcast TV station, Capital Investments, and Jordan International Insurance. In addition, he serves on the board of DAI, a US firm working in the global development arena. He also served on the "National Agenda's" Royal Steering Committee entrusted with developing the country's ten-year strategy for the years 2006 to 2015. In addition, he is a founding contributor to Jordan's national initiative for establishing Jordan's IT Industry, known as the "REACH Initiative". The REACH Initiative is a five-year action plan to advance Jordan's nascent IT sector and strengthen its position to compete in local, regional, and global markets. Holder of a Masters in Management from North Carolina State University, and two Bachelor degrees in Business Management and Economics from the same school, he has been an active player in Jordan's Information Technology sector since 1990. Upon completing his studies, he joined Ideal Group, (the Apple Computer and Compaq distributor in Jordan), and moved up the ranks to become Vice President. In 1995, he took over as the General Manager of NETS, Jordan's first email and second Internet Service Provider. Six years later, NETS, and a second data provider, Firstnet, and Bahrain Telecom, a regional leading telecom provider completed the first IT merger in Jordan and formed Batelco Jordan. An outspoken character, he has lobbied long and hard towards the establishment of world-class telecom infrastructure in Jordan and has been an ardent supporter for increased private-public partnerships to further enhance and accelerate the country's modernization and economic development.

Mr. Matthew Greathouse serves as Investment Director at KBW Ventures. Mr. Greathouse is a recent graduate of U.C. Berkeley, where he received a Bachelor's degree in Physics. During his time at Cal, he was an active member of the entrepreneurship organization Sigma Eta Pi and focused his academic career on courses that supported his passions at the intersection of sustainability, technology, and society.

Mr. Mohammed Ali Rashed Mohammed Alrashdi serves as a Board Member at Mair Group. Bringing more than 10 years of experience, he sits on the Board of Directors at MAIR Group and is a member of its strategic investment committee. He also serves as the Chief Executive Officer of International Resources Holding (IRH), a subsidiary of 2PointZero/International Holding Company (IHC), overseeing the day-to-day operations. As well as serving as Chairman of the Emircom Board of Directors MW Energy Limited, Al Seer Marine Supplies & Equipment Company PrJSC, and Abu Dhabi National Hotels PJSC. His previous roles include Acting Director for First Integrated Properties at Abu Dhabi Financial Group (ADFG). He holds a Bachelor of Science in Financial Economics and an International Relations and Business degree in International Relations and Business from the University of Rochester. He also has an MBA in Finance from Abu Dhabi University.

Ms. Mukami Wainaina served as Investment Officer at Al Mada Ventures. She serves as Associate Director at Novastar Ventures. She served as Investment Associate at Aldridge Wealth. Her cross-functional role sits across our Investment and Finance functions. She supports the Managing Investment Director in the sourcing, due diligence and execution of strategic opportunities, and in evaluating the ongoing performance of portfolio companies. She works with the Head of Group Finance on the accounting and finance functions of the business. She holds an LL.M. Master's degree in International Business Law from the London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE). Her studies focused on the Law and Practice of International Finance, M&A and Restructuring, and Business Taxation. Prior to this, she achieved an LL.B (Hons) Law degree from the University of York. During her studies, she also found time to gain a wide variety of experiences, including working for an Investment Fund in Kenya, Corporate Law Firms in Zambia and Kenya, and a Legal Clinic in Washington D.C. She is an ICAEW qualified Chartered Accountant.

She brings with her over two decades of financial expertise with a focus in debt engineering, cash optimization and profitability monitoring as well as a strong track record of leading highly structuring IT projects and redesigning processes in order to support business growth and operational efficiency. She holds a master's degree in Finance and an MBA from Ecole des Ponts Business School.

Mr. Nichin Sreekantaswamy serves as VC Investor Fellow at Advaita Capital. He works on due diligence, technical analysis, deal analysis in Advaita Capital. Albert also started the Zurich TR Product & Technology team based on his expertise in technology, process & methodology design that operationalizes the global 'software factory'. Prior to TR, Albert spent nearly a decade in management consulting between Accenture's Center for Strategic Technology (authored several award-winning white papers & client deliveries), ZEFER Consulting (eBusiness clients including Amazon, Microsoft, Paul Allen & others), and Deloitte Consulting (doing M&A, eBusiness strategy and delivering the first engagement using Clayton Christensen's Innovator's Solution). Albert was on an academic scholarship at Oxford where he completed his Ph.D. in Aerospace Engineering thereby solving problems and delivering solutions that are operating today in both commercial aerospace & defense industries. Albert also holds an Aerospace B.S. (Honors) from Syracuse University and is a member of Tau Beta Pi (eng) and Sigma Gamma Tau (aero).
Mr. Alberto Clavarino serves as Head of Business Development at ERG.
Mr. Alberto Fusi served as Chief Human Capital Officer at ERG.

Mr. Alejandro Grande served as Chief Human Resources Officer at DIA Group. With a Law degree from the UNLZ in Buenos Aires, Alejandro Grande has worked in the distribution sector for more than 20 years. He began as a store manager for EKI, the Argentinian supermarket company, and then moved into sales management roles. In 2007, he was appointed as the Human Resources Director of DIA Argentina, and his responsibilities grew over the years, leading him to head up the Franchises and Expansion Management team. In 2013, Alejandro was appointed Executive Director of DIA Argentina, a position he has held up to now.

Mr. Aleksey Orel serves as Board Member at NOVATEK (Russia). Mr. Orel, Born in: 1953. In 1975, Mr. Orel graduated from the Gubkin Institute of Oil and Gas in Moscow, with a degree in Geology, Prospecting and Exploration of Oil and Gas Fields. In 1982 he received PhD in geology and mineralogy. From 1975 to 1987, Mr. Orel was an engineer and senior researcher at the All-Union Research Institute of Natural Gases (VNIIGAZ). From 1987 to 1989, he served as a chief project engineer at Zarubezhneft, the Syrian State Oil Company. From 1987 to 1991, Mr. Orel was a senior research fellow at the Institute of Geology and Development of Combustible Minerals (IGIRGI). From 1992 to 1994, he was a manager for natural resources and business development at Hyundai Corporation (Moscow office). From 1994 to 1999, Mr. Orel was Deputy Head of the Representative Office, coordinator of the Prirazlomnoye project from the foreign investor's side, BHP Petroleum. From 1999 to 2000, he held the position of Deputy Head of the Department for Licensing and Production Sharing Agreements at the Ministry of Natural Resources of the Russian Federation. From 2000 to 2001, Mr. Orel held the position of Deputy Head of the Department for Preparation and Implementation of Production Sharing Agreements at the Ministry of Natural Resources of the Russian Federation. From 2001 to 2002, he served as Deputy Head of the Department for Preparation and Implementation of Production Sharing Agreements at the Ministry of Economic Development and Trade of the Russian Federation. From 2002 to 2004, Mr. Orel occupied the position of Deputy Director for Government Relations at ExxonMobil Russia Inc. From 2004 to 2009, he was Director for Development and Government Relations at the mining company Anglo American Services (Russia) Ltd. From 2009 to 2011, Mr Orel held the position of Director of the Moscow office at Imperial Energy Group (ONGC). From 2011 to 2022, he was the Director of Department of State Policy and Regulation in Geology and Subsoil Use of the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment of the Russian Federation. Since 2019, Mr. Orel has been a Member of the Supervisory Board, the Russian Gas Society. Since March 2022, he has been the Advisor to the General Director of the All-Russian Research Geological Petroleum Institute.

Mr. Alessandro Chieffi served as Board Member at EuKedos. Mr. Alessandro Chieffi has been Studio Chieffi at Murelli since July 2014. Mr. Chieffi served as In house Counsel at Cariplo from February 1989 to November 1997, focusing primarily on Company Law, regulatory and financial services; main transactions: listing of Cariplo shares, takeover of ROLO shares, IPOs of Reno de Medici, CSP, Idra Presse. Mr. Chieffi served as Legal Counsel at Credito Agrario Bresciano from December 1997 to July 1998. He served as Director at Borsa Italiana in charge of Legal Affairs from August 1998 to July 2008 ; also in charge of the Listing Department from 2003 to 2006. His main transactions and projects: acquisition of the control of CC&G and Monte Titoli; co-ordination of the drafting of the Italian Corporate Governance Code (2006). From September 2008 to June 2014, he was Independent Lawyer in Milan. From February 2009 to September 2012, he was Special Counsel at Orrick, Herrington & Sutcliffe LLP. From October 2012 to June 2014, he was employed at Studio Legale Mazzoni e Associati. He serves as an Independent Director of EuKedos S.p.A. and ERG SpA. He served as a Board Member at Cassa di Compensazione e Garanzia S.p.A. from 2000 to 2003; Monte Titoli S.p.A. from 2004 to 2006; Adriano LEase Sec. S.r.l. since 2011 and Board Member at Eukedos S.p.A. since 2013. He served as Secretary at the Italian Corporate Governance Committee since 2011; Representative of the Bondholders at Arkimedica S.p.A. from 2011 to 2012 and of the Bondholders at Cogeme Set S.p.A. since 2012. He has teaching experinece : Course of Corporate Governance at Università Bocconi di Milano (2007) and Frequent speaker at conferences and seminars. He was admitted to Milan Bar Association. He has Law Degree at Parma University with highest honors in 1986 and has Notary and Lawyer training.

Alessandro Garrone was born in Genoa on April 28th 1963. He graduated in Economics in 1991. In 1989 he married Carola Bozzo and they had three children named Maria, Filippo and Olimpia. Appointed Cavaliere del Lavoro on the 2nd of June 2021. Since April 2012 he has been Executive Deputy Chairman of ERG SpA and Chairman of the Strategic Committee of ERG SpA. Since April 2015 Director responsible for overseeing the internal control and risk management system. From April 2012 to April 2016 Chairman of the Board of Directors of ERG Renew SpA. From December 2002 to April 2012 Chief Executive Officer of ERG SpA. From August 2002 to December 2002 he held the post of Central Finance and Control Manager. From January 1999 to December 2001 he was responsible for Refining Management Control, within the Management Control department. From January 1997 to December 1998, at ERG Petroli SpA in Genoa, he took on assignments regarding the company restructuring, in connection with the company's quotation on the Stock Exchange. From August 1994 to December 1996, at ERG Petroli SpA in Genoa, he had duties within the Supply and Sales Management department, dealing with ship freighting and crude oil purchasing. From August 1992 to July 1994, at ISAB SpA in Rome, he was responsible for company Management Control. From September 1991 to July 1992 at ISAB SpA in Genoa and Syracuse he held the post of operative programming of the ERG Group refineries, via the use of linear programming models. From January 1988 to April 1989 at ERG Petroleum USA (New York) he managed ERG Group international relations.

primary_position: Chief Financial Officer, Finance & Board Member
biography: Mr. Alexander Krane serves as Chief Financial Officer at Harbour Energy. He previously served as Chief Financial Officer at Premier Oil. He served as Investment Director at Aker. Mr. Alexander Krane served as Chief Financial Officer at Aker BP. Prior to joining Det norske, he held the position of Corporate Controller with Aker ASA. He has also worked as a public accountant with KPMG, both in Norway and in the US. Mr. Krane holds a Bachelor of Commerce degree ("siviløkonom") from Bodø Graduate School of Business and an MBA degree from the Norwegian School of Economics in Bergen. He is also a state-authorized public accountant in Norway.

Mr. Alexander Kurilov serves as Chief Financial Officer & Director, Finance at Pharmacy Chain 36.6. From 2008 to 2011, he was responsible for project and structured finance at VTB and UniCredit banks. In 2011, he took the position of CFO of Binnopharm, one of the largest full cycle biopharmaceutical companies. In 2013, he became a member of the Management Board of Binnopharm, in 2015 he was appointed General Director of Binnopharm Distribution. Later, he held executive positions in pharmaceutical companies within the framework of the joint pharmaceutical holding AFK Sistema. He got educated from the Financial Academy under the Government of the Russian Federation, specialty "Finance and Credit".

Mr. Alexander Natalenko served as Chairman and Chairman of the Strategy Committee at NOVATEK (Natural Gas Producer). Mr. Natalenko completed his studies at Irkutsk State University in 1969 with a primary focus in Geological Engineering. Subsequently, he worked with the Yagodinskaya, Bagdarinskaya, Berelekhskaya, Anadirskaya and East-Chukotskaya geological expeditions. In 1986, Mr. Natalenko headed the North-East Industrial and Geological Association and, in 1992, he was elected president of AO "Magadan Gold & Silver Company". He subsequently held various executive positions in Russian and foreign geological organizations. From 1996 to 2001, Mr. Natalenko held the position of Deputy Minister of Natural Resources of the Russian Federation. Member of OAO Rosgeologia Board of Directors. From 2004 till present, he has been the Chairman of NOVATEK's Board of Directors. Mr. Natalenko is the recipient of the State Prize of the Russian Federation and an Honored Geologist of Russia.
Mr. Alexander Nazarov serves as Head, Investor Relations at NOVATEK (Russia).

Dr. Alexander Obermeister served as Chief Financial Officer at CarMoney (Online Auto Loan). He has been in the field of finance for more than 17 years. An extensive successful practice is from starting from scratch all of the company's financial business processes (CarPrice et al. Before preparing a group of companies for an IPO (AFK Sistema). Founder of the Club of Financial Directors, member of the expert councils of the magazines "IFRS: application practice" and "financial director". Candidate of economic sciences, has a certificate of CMA (IMA, USA) and a certificate of a bank auditor.

Mr. Alexander Oetker serves as Director at Navigator Holdings. He has been a member of the Board since September 2006. Mr. Oetker is the founder and chief executive officer of AO Schiffahrt GmbH & Co., a shipowning company based in Hamburg, Germany. Before founding AO Schiffahrt, Mr. Oetker was employed as chartering manager of Hamburg Sued and was employed by Hutchinson Port Holdings.

Mr. Alexander Osminin served as Chief Financial Officer at En+ Group. He joined En+ Group in April 2009. His core responsibility is to maintain security for the Company's assets and resources, as well as to coordinate the activities of the security departments within the Group.Prior to joining En+ Group, Alexander Osminin, Major General, was First Deputy Head of the Central Office of the Ministry of Internal Affairs of the Russian Federation, and Deputy Head of the Economic Crime Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Internal Affairs. In 1993-2003 Alexander Osminin held several senior positions in the Russian tax police, including the position of the Deputy Head of the Central Operations Department of the Federal Tax Police Service. He graduated from the Higher School and the Academy of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, and the Finance Academy under the Government of the Russian Federation.

Mr. Alexander Sergeev serves as Managing Director at En+ Group. He serves as Managing Director of Energy Power Business at En+ Management. He is also the Director at South Yakutia Development. In the past, he worked as the Director at Irkutskenergo and Director & Head-Sales Business Unit at Federal Hydro-Generating Co. RusHydro. He also served as the Director at Irkutskaya Elektrosetevaya Kompaniya. He is responsible for relationships with the group's Asian partners. Prior to joining En+ Group in November 2009, he was a Board member and head of the Sales business unit of OAO RusHydro in the period from February 2005 to July 2009. In 2002-2004, he was one of the RAO UES of Russia officers responsible for drafting the competitive electricity market regulations; his experience prior to his employment with RAO UES includes a position at OAO SverdlovEnergo. He is a Board member of Krasnoyarsk Kray Development, South Yakutia Development and Transbaikalia Development. He graduated with honors from the Economics and Management Department (Fuels and Energy) of the Urals State Technical University.

Ms. Alexandra Bouriko serves as Chief Executive Officer at Rusal. Bouriko had been Rusal's Chief Financial Officer since October 2013. She is responsible for the financial planning, auditing and preparation of financial reports and the execution of the company's investment programs. From June to October 2013 Alexandra Bouriko had been served on the boards of UC RUSAL. From November 2012 to October 2013 Alexandra Bouriko had been En+ Group Deputy CEO. She was responsible for En+ Group operational management, enhancement of business effectiveness and improvement of the Group's financial performance. Prior to joining En+ Group Alexandra Bouriko spent 16 years with KPMG in Russia and Canada; since 2005 she held the position of KPMG Partner. At KPMG Alexandra Bouriko worked with major Russian and international companies with focus on metals, mining, oil and gas industries. Alexandra played key roles in audits of IFRS, US GAAP and Russian GAAP financial statements of major Russian groups. Alexandra was in charge of IPO planning and preparation of major Russian metals and mining companies on London Stock Exchange and Hong Kong Stock Exchange. Alexandra graduated from the economic faculty of Lomonosov Moscow State University. She is a member of the Canadian Institute of Chartered Accountants and the American Institute of Certified Public Accountants.

Mr. Alfredo Ramos serves as President at Atlas CON Mining. Mr. Ramos has been a member of the Board of Directors ("BOD") of AT since 1989, and has served as its Chairman and President since 2 April 2013 until his resignation from the latter's post on 1 April 2015. He is concurrently the incumbent (i) Governor of the National Book Development Board; (ii) Chairman of the BOD of Carmen Copper Corporation ("CCC"), Anglo Philippine Holdings Corporation ("Anglo"), Anvil Publishing, Inc., and NBS Express, Inc.; (iii) Chairman of the BODs and President of Alakor Corporation ("Alakor"), National Book Store, Inc. ("NBSI"), The Philodrill Corporation,Vulcan Industrial & Mining Corporation, and United Paragon Mining Corporation("UPMC"); (iv) Vice-Chairman of the BODs of MRT Development Corporation and Shang Properties, Inc.; and (v) President of Abacus Book & Card Corporation, MRT Holdings Corporation, Power Books, Inc., TMM Management, Inc., and Zenith Holdings Corporation. Mr. Ramos obtained his bachelor's degree from the Ateneo de Manila University.

Mr. Alistair Cowden serves as Chairman & Board Member at Firefinch. Dr. Cowden served as Managing Director at Vulcan Resources. He has more than 40 years of experience as a mining executive, director and geologist in the mining industry in Australia, Africa, Asia and Europe. Dr. Cowden has been part of the discovery, development and operation of numerous mines in Australia, Africa and Europe and has extensive experience across all aspects of the mining industry including mergers, acquisitions and financing that created significant wealth for shareholders. Dr. Cowden has an Honours degree in Geology from Edinburgh University and a PhD in Geology from the University of London.

Mr. Allan D. Schoening serves as Senior Vice President, Canada at Civeo. Prior to his appointment as Senior Vice President, Mr. Schoening served as Senior Vice President, Corporate Affairs from June 2017 to November 2018. From April 2014 to May 2017 he served as Senior Vice President, Human Resources & Health, Safety and Environment. From June 2012 to April 2014, Mr. Schoening served as Senior Director and then Vice President, Human Resources and Health, Safety and Environment for PTI Group, Inc., a subsidiary of Oil States. From June 2009 to May 2012, Mr. Schoening was self-employed as an independent business consultant. Prior to 2009, Mr. Schoening was based in London, England where he served as Senior Vice President for Katanga Mining Limited, a Canadian listed mining company with operations in Africa, for the period from 2005 to 2009. From 1995 to 2004, Mr. Schoening served in senior and executive management positions with Barrick Gold Corporation and Kinross Gold. Mr. Schoening's career also includes domestic and international assignments with the completions division of Schlumberger Limited. He holds a B.A., Psychology (Spec.) from the University of Alberta.

primary_position: President, Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer & Director
biography: Ms. Allan Rimland served as Chief Financial Officer at NeuroPsychiatric Hospitals. Mr. Rimland served as the President, Chief Executive Officer, Chief Financial Officer & Director at AdCare Health Systems. From 2011 through February 2015, he served as a Managing Director at Stephens Inc., a financial services firm, within its Investment Banking Group. In part, he was responsible for originating and leading AnchorAnchormergers and acquisitions and capital raising transactions for healthcare services clients. During the three years prior to working at Stephens Inc., he was a Managing Director at JMP Securities LLC, an investment bank, where he served as Co-Head of it's Healthcare Services and IT Investment Banking Group. At JMP Securities LLC, he focused on AnchorAnchormergers and acquisitions and public and AnchorAnchorprivate equity capital raising for healthcare services clients. Prior thereto, he was an investment banker at a number of investment banks including: Wachovia Capital Markets, Banc of America Securities and Morgan Stanley Dean Witter. He graduated from the University of Pennsylvania's Wharton School and Moore School of Electrical Engineering and earned a Master of Business Administration from the University of Chicago's Graduate School of Business. His expertise and background in investment banking, particularly in AnchorAnchormergers and acquisitions and capital raising, and his knowledge and relationships in the healthcare services and related REIT sectors provide experience that the Board considers valuable.

primary_position: Chief Services Officer and Portugal Executive
biography: Mr. Amando Falcón served as Chief Services Officer and Portugal Executive at DIA Group. He joined DIA in 2012 as Chief Corporate Officer with responsibility over the financial, legal, external relations and investor relations departments. With more than 20 years' work experience in the financial area, previously, Mr Sánchez was the CFO and Strategy and Corporate Manager at Abengoa, where he worked from 1998. Since May 2015, he is the Chief Services Officer and Portugal Executive.
Ms. Ana Llopis served as Chairwoman at DIA Group. She previously served as President at the company.

Mr. Andrea Mangion serves as Chief Financial Officer at Trident Estates. Mr. Mangion Joined Trident Estates plc in 2018. He completed his ACCA qualification while working with a leading firm in the financial services sector, specifically within transaction advisory services. He has experience in conducting due diligences, preparing business plans, projections and feasibility studies for entities including property companies, local banks and gaming companies. He was also seconded to a major local bank for a year as a financial analyst in the corporate section, where he reviewed some of the largest local companies and assessed their capability of repaying debts. He also structured loans and other facilities for clients, conducted market research, and carried out sensitivity analyses on prospective clients.

Mr. Andrea Navarra serves as Group General Counsel at ERG. Mr. Andrea Navarra served as General Counsel (Head of Legal & Corporate Affairs). at ERG. Previously, he served as a Senior Associate - Corporate, M&A, Energy & Project Finance Department at Chiomenti Studio Legale.

Mr. Andrea Pinarel serves as Executive Vice President, Strategy & Business Development at Harbour Energy. He serves as a Vice President at BofA Merrill Lynch. Previously, he served as an Associate Director at UBS Investment Bank.

Mr. Andrei Akimov serves as Member of Strategy Committee at NOVATEK (Russia). Mr. Akimov graduated from the Moscow Financial Institute in 1975 where he specialized in international economics. Between 1974 and 1987, Mr. Akimov held various executive positions in the Bank for Foreign Trade of the USSR. From 1985 to 1987 he served as Deputy Chief General Manager of the Bank for Foreign Trade branch in Zurich (Switzerland) and between 1987 and 1990, Mr. Akimov was the Chairman of the Management Board of Donau Bank in Vienna (Austria). From 1991 to 2002 he was Managing Director of financial company, IMAG Investment Management & Advisory Group AG (Austria). Since 2003, Mr. Akimov has been the Chairman of the Management Board, the Deputy Chairman of the Board of Directors of Gazprombank (OAO). He is a member of Board of Directors of PAO Gazprom, AO Rosneftegaz.

Mr. Andrei Sharonov serves as President at NOVATEK (Russia). Mr. Sharonov graduated from the Ufa Aviation Institute and the Russian Presidential Public Service Academy Between 1989 and 1991, he served as USSR People's Deputy and led the Russian State Duma Committee on Youth Affairs up until 1996. Between 1996 and 2007, Mr. Sharonov was Head of the Department Deputy Minister of Economic Development and Trade, and a State Secretary of the said Ministry. Between 2007 and 2010, he was Managing Director and Chairman of the Board of Directors of Troika Dialog Investment Company and led the Investment Banking stream. Between 2010 and 2013, he was Deputy Mayor of Moscow for Economic Policy being in charge of budgeting, public procurement, industrial policy, and support for entrepreneurship as well as regulating the goods and service markets. Mr. Sharonov was Chairman of the Regional Energy Commission. Since September 2013, Mr. Sharonov has been Dean of the Moscow School of Management SKOLKOVO and Advisor to the Mayor of Moscow. Mr. Sharonov is a member of the Supervisory Board of OAO Alrosa, a member of the Board of Directors of Bank of Moscow, a member of the Board of Directors, Strategy Committee and Innovative Development and Technical Policy Committee of OAO Sovcomflot, Chairman and Independent Member of the Board of Directors of NefteTransService Management Company, Chairman of the Board of Directors of Ecosistema Management Company. Mr. Sharonov holds a Ph.D. in Social Sciences and is an Honored Economist of the Russian Federation. Mr. Sharonov received the 2009 Aristos Awards as Independent Director and 2009 Director of the Year. He was also awarded the 2012 Person of the Year in the Business Reputation Category. He is the recipient of the Russian Federation's Order of the Badge of Honor.

Andres Finkielsztain is the Founding Managing Partner of FinkWald LLC, a private investment office specializing in private equity, real estate, media, and technology. Andres is also the co-head of the Special Situations division at Banco Industrial in Argentina, where he analyzes and provides financing solutions to Argentinean-based companies and institutions. Andres previously served as a financial advisor for Soros Brothers Investments (SBI), a private investment office founded in 2011 by Alexander and Gregory Soros, and as an analyst for Emerging Markets at Soros Fund Management LLC. Andres also worked at J.P. Morgan for over 10 years in various capacities within Asset Management, including the role of Global Investment Opportunity and Emerging Markets Specialist. Andres graduated with a BA in Economics from Bard College where he served as the President of a Latin American organization.

Mr. Andrew Crowley served as President, Markel Ventures at Markel Group. Before Markel Ventures, He worked as an investment banker with Stephens Inc. and Goldman, Sachs & Co. and as a management consultant with Bain & Company. He received his B.B.A. in Finance and Risk Management & Insurance from The University of Georgia Honors Program and his M.B.A. from The Darden School of Business where he was named a Shermet Scholar and the recipient of the Samuel Forest Hyde Memorial Fellowship.

Mr. Langham has served as General Counsel of Icahn Enterprises L.P., a diversified holding company engaged in a variety of businesses, including investment, automotive, energy, food packaging, metals, real estate and home fashion, since 2014. From 2005 to 2014, Mr. Langham was Assistant General Counsel of Icahn Enterprises. Prior to joining Icahn Enterprises, Mr. Langham was an associate at Latham & Watkins LLP focusing on corporate finance, mergers and acquisitions, and general corporate matters. Mr. Langham is a director of: Cheniere Energy, Inc., a developer of natural gas liquefaction and export facilities and related pipelines, since 2017; Welbilt, Inc. (formerly known as Manitowoc Foodservice, Inc.), a commercial foodservice equipment manufacturer, since 2016; and CVR Partners LP, a nitrogen fertilizer company, since 2015. Mr. Langham was previously a director of: CVR Energy, Inc., a diversified holding company primarily engaged in the petroleum refining and nitrogen fertilizer manufacturing industries, from 2014 to 2017; CVR Refining, LP, an independent downstream energy limited partnership, from 2014 to 2019; Freeport-McMoRan Inc., the world's largest publicly traded copper producer, from 2015 to 2018; and Newell Brands Inc., a global marketer of consumer and commercial products, in 2018. CVR Partners, CVR Refining and CVR Energy are each indirectly controlled by Carl C. Icahn. Mr. Icahn also has non-controlling interests in Cheniere, Welbilt, Freeport-McMoRan and Newell Brands through the ownership of securities.

Mr. Andrew Michelmore, Executive Director and Chief Executive Officer of MMG Limited from December 2010 to February 2017; Chairman of the International Council on Mining and Metals from April 2016 to June 2017; Chairman of the Minerals Council of Australia from June 2013 to June 2016; Chairman of the Council of Ormond College at the University of Melbourne from 2003 to 2020; Chairman of the Jean Hailes Foundation since 1996. Mr. Michelmore rejoined the Board in September 2018 after previously serving on the Board from June 2010 through September 2015. Mr. Michelmore adds valuable metals and mining expertise to the Board by virtue of his experience as Chief Executive Officer of MMG Limited and previous experience as Chief Executive Officer of Zinifex, OZ Minerals, EN+ Group and WMC Resources. Mr. Michelmore also adds valuable engineering and international business experience to the Board by virtue of his positions as a Fellow of the Institution of Chemical Engineers and the Australian Academy of Technological Sciences and Engineering and a member of the Business Council of Australia. In addition, as an Australian citizen and having lived and worked in a number of different countries, Mr. Michelmore provides international diversity and perspective to the Board.

The company has appointed Andrew Skobe as the Company's Interim Chief Financial Officer, effective immediately. Prior to Ankura, Skobe was EVP and Chief Financial Officer for Radisson Hotel Group from 2017 to 2019. Previously, he spent four years as EVP & CFO for Croscill Home-Excell-Glenoit, a portfolio of private equity owned companies and five years as CFO for Icahn Enterprises. During his tenure with Icahn, Skobe was Chief Financial Officer for portfolio company WestPoint Home. Earlier in his career, Skobe held senior financial positions with Columbia House, a $1 billion video and entertainment company owned by Blackstone Private Equity, Dun & Bradstreet, Marvel Entertainment, General Motors New York Treasurer's Office and JP Morgan Chase. Skobe holds a B.S. in Economics and Business Administration from Boston University and an MBA in Accounting and Corporate Finance from Columbia Business School.

primary_position: Chief Financial Officer, Finance & Board Member
biography: Mr. Andrew Smith serves as Chief Financial Officer & Board Member at Playtech. Having qualified as a solicitor with Ashurst in 2001, Andrew moved into investment banking, first with ABN AMRO and then with Deutsche Bank, specializing in both the Technology and Leisure sectors. Andrew joined Playtech in 2015 as Head of Investor Relations. Andrew Smith serves as Head of Investor Relations and Corporate Communications at Temenos. Previously, he served as Director, Corporate Banking at Deutsche Bank.
Mr. Andrey Petrushinin served as a Project Director at En+ Group. He serves as a Director Corporate Affairs at EuroSibEnergo.

Mr. Andrey Yashchenko served as Chief Financial Officer at En+ Group. He held this same position since July 2013. He has deep experience in En+ Group's financial function, with executive oversight for corporate finance and treasury, budgeting and control, tax planning, audit. Mr. Yashchenko was in charge of raising finance for En+ Group's recent acquisitions and debt restructurings aimed at the interest rate reduction and maturity profile extension. Also, he leads the Group's project for ERP implementation. Prior to joining En+ Group, Mr. Yashchenko was Chief Financial Officer at Russian Platinum Group for two years. In 2006-2010, Mr. Yashchenko was Deputy CFO and Corporate Finance Director at Basic Element. In 2000-2006, he was Head of Capital Markets at RUSAL. In 1999-2000, Mr. Yashchenko held various corporate finance and strategy positions at TNK, one of the largest oil companies in Russia. In 1994-1998, he was Senior Auditor at Deloitte and then Research Analyst at MC Securities and Montes Auri. Andrey Yashchenko graduated from the M.V. Lomonosov Moscow State University with a degree in economics with honours. Mr. Yashchenko is a CFA charterholder and member of CFA Institute.
Mr. Andriy Bahlay served as Senior Corporate Development Manager at Playtech. Previously, he served as a Senior Consultant at Ciklum Consulting.

Mr. Andy Torrance serves as Non-executive Chairman & Executive Director at Angling Direct. Mr. Andy Torrance served as Chief Executive Officer and currently serves as Board Member & Executive Director at Angling Direct. He also serves as Chairman at Eden Mobility. Having previously held COO positions at Dunelm and Holland & Barrett, as well as a number of executive roles during a 12-year tenure at Halfords, Andy has a wealth of specialist retail experience. Commercially astute with demonstrated leadership skills, Andy has successfully grown brands across multiple geographies, driving sales and delivering EBITDA growth by implementing customer centric omni-channel strategies. In his position as COO of Holland & Barrett, Andy had executive accountability for Leadership, Customer Experience and Store P+L in 1,064 stores in UK, Eire, the Netherlands, Belgium and Sweden.

Dr. Anelise Lara serves as a Board Member at TotalEnergies. Ms. Lara serves as Board Member at Trident Energy Management. She will be appointed to the board as non-executive director with effect from AGM 2023. She is a chemical engineer with an MSc in Petroleum Engineering and a Ph.D. in Earth Sciences from "Université Pierre et Marie Curie," France. She was also certified in ESG Competent Boards Program, including climate change risks, in 2021. Mrs. Lara has 37 years of experience in the energy industry. In 1986, she joined Petrobras, the most important company in the energy segment in Brazil. She began her career in the Research and Development Center. In 2003, she joined the Exploration and Production Department as General Manager for the Reservoir Team at the corporate level. In 2011, after the first pre-salt discoveries, she was appointed General Manager for pre-salt development projects. Then in 2013, she was invited to become the Director of the Libra Joint Project Team. In 2016, she was appointed as Head of M&A, responsible for a portfolio of more than 40 projects of divestments and strategic partnerships in Brazil and abroad. During this period, Mrs. Lara was also a member of the Company's Investment Committee. In 2019, she was appointed as Chief Executive Officer for Refining, Natural Gas, and Power, responsible for the strategic, risk management, HSE, and operational results of Refining, Gas & Power areas, covering the areas of refining, biofuels, petrochemicals, fertilizers plants, distribution and transportation of natural gas, regas terminals, and thermal power plants. She left Petrobras in January 2021. Mrs. Lara served as President of the Society of Petroleum Engineers (SPE) - Brazil Section from 2005 to 2008. She also joined the International Board of SPE from 2014 until 2017 as Regional Director for Latin America and Caribe. She also served as Chair of the Brazilian Petroleum Institute (IBP) from 2019 to 2021. Mrs. Lara volunteers for the cause of D&I (diversity and inclusion). She is a board member of WILL (Women Leadership in Latin America) and has already mentored many young women interested in working in the energy segment.

Ms. Angela Luger serves as a Non-Executive Director at Sofa Carpet Specialists. She seres as Board Member at Jet2. Her contributes general management experience with retail, digital and customer focus. Other appointments Angela was Chair of The Paint Shed Holdings Limited and Non-executive Director of ScS Group plc, The Hiring Hub Holdings Limited and New Look Retail Holdings Limited. Formerly, she held positions as Non-executive Director of Distribuidora Internacional de Alimentacion, S.A. (DIA Group) and Manchester Airport Group. Her previous executive positions included Chief Executive of N Brown plc, CEO of The Original Factory Shop Limited and senior executive positions at Debenhams PLC, ASDA Group Limited and Mars Corporation.

Ms. Korologos is a former U.S. Secretary of Labor. She is Chairman Emeritus of The Aspen Institute, a nonprofit organization, and previously served as the Chairman of the Board of Trustees of the RAND Corporation from April 2004 to April 2009. Ms. Korologos has significant public company board experience and currently serves as a director of Host Hotels & Resorts, Inc. She previously served on the boards of AMR Corporation (and its subsidiary, American Airlines), Kellogg Company, Harman International Industries, Inc. and Vulcan Materials Company, among others.
Ms. Anna Artamonova served as Vice President, Ecosystem Products at Mail.Ru Group.

primary_position: Chief Human Resources Officer & Member of the Executive Committee
biography: Ms. Anna Ryzhova serves as Chief Human Resources Officer & Member of the Executive Committee at Oerlikon. Anna Ryzhova was appointed Chief Human Resources Officer effective October 10, 2016. Ms. Ryzhova has over 21 years of experience in leading HR functions, 13 of which were at the Renova Group in senior HR executive roles. Most recently, Ms. Ryzhova was Chief Human Resources Officer at Witel Ltd., Zurich, Switzerland. From 2010 to 2015, she served as HR and Corporate Relations Director at the Renova Group Corporate Center in Moscow, Russia. Ms. Ryzhova holds a Master's degree in Economics from the National Research University Higher School of Economics in Moscow and an Executive MBA from IMD, Lausanne, Switzerland.

Ms. Annabel Roedhammer serves as Vice President Communications & Investor Relations at Vulcan Energy Resources. She brings over 18 years of experience as a global senior marketing, strategy, and commercial leader working in green energy, agriculture, and engineering industries across Australia and Europe. Powering and sustainably feeding the world has always been her core focus and this is exactly what she will continue to do at Vulcan Energy. Most recently she worked at Fortescue Future Industries as Head of Corporate Affairs and previously European Hub Marketing Lead for Nufarm, based in Germany.

Dr. Annalisa Jenkins serves as a Board Member at COMPASS Pathways. Dr. Jenkins served as a Board Member at AgeX Therapeutics. Dr. Jenkins served as a Board Member at AVROBIO. She serves as a Board Member at GEMMABio. She serves as a Non-Executive Director at LetterOne. She served as a Board Member at iOx Therapeutics. She serves as a Board Member at Etira and Oncimmune. She serves as Non-Executive Director at Cancer Research Horizons. She is a Member of the Advisory Board. She also serves as Trustee at The King's Fund. he serves as Board Member at Skye Bioscience. She serves as an Advisor at Actimed Therapeutics. She serves as an Advisor at Global Bio Fund. She serves as Chairman of the Board at Conduit Connect. She also served as a Board Member at Prospectus. She also serves as a Board Member at Ori Biotech. She served as a director at Arcturis Data. She serves as Chairman at Phaim. She serves as Chairman at RYSE Asset Management. She serves as Chairwoman at Kuur Therapeutics. She serves as Board Member and Chairman at Cocoon Biotech. She served as Chief Executive Officer and Board Member at PlaqueTec. She served as a Board Member at Biothera Pharmaceuticals. She served as a Chairman & Board Member at Sensyne Health. She is a life science thought leader with over 20 years of biopharmaceutical industry experience. Prior to joining PlaqueTec as CEO in November 2017, she served as president and CEO of Dimension Therapeutics, a leading gene therapy company that was acquired by Ultragenyx in November 2017. Prior leadership roles have included the head of Global Research and Development and executive vice president of Global Development and Medical Affairs at Merck Serono, and several senior positions at Bristol Myers-Squibb over 15 years, including Head of Global Medical Affairs. Earlier in her career, she was a medical officer in the British Royal Navy during the Gulf Conflict, achieving the rank of surgeon lieutenant commander. She is also a committee member of the Science Board of the U.S. Food & Drug Administration (FDA), and chairs or serves on the boards of a number of private and public biotech and life science companies. She holds a degree in Cardiovascular Medicine from St Bartholomew's Hospital and an MBBS in Medicine from University of London.

Ms. Anne Devereux-Mills serves as Chairman & Chief Executive Officer at Marchex. She served as Chief Strategy Officer & Director at Lantern. Currently, she also serves as Chairman of the Board at Marchex. She has over 30 years of experience in the marketing and advertising industries. Before these current roles, Ms. Devereux-Mills served as Chairman of LLNS, a division of Omnicom Group Inc. (NYSE: OMC) from May 2006 to April 2012 and served as Chief Executive Officer of LLNS from May 2006 to September 2010. LLNS is a leading healthcare communications agency. Before joining LLNS, from February 2003 to May 2006, Ms. Devereux-Mills was the Chief Integration Officer as well as Managing Director of all health-related assignments within BBDO New York, an advertising agency. Before joining BBDO New York, from April 2002 to February 2003, Ms. Devereux-Mills was President of Dugan Valva Contess, an independent communications agency. From January 1996 to April 2002, Ms. Devereux-Mills was President and Founder of Consumer Healthworks, which then became Merkley Newman Harty Healthworks, one of the first agencies to specialize in direct-to-consumer advertising for healthcare brands. Ms. Devereux-Mills received a B.A. degree from Wellesley College.

primary_position: Board Member, Chair of the Remuneration Committee and the Sustainability Committee and Member of the Audit and Risk and Nomination Committees
biography: Anne brings to the Board significant operational, commercial and transformational experience in global businesses. Anne is an engineer and started her career in the chemical industry with Exxon Corporation before moving to automotive with the Ford Motor Company (1990-2006). During her 16-year tenure at Ford, Anne held a number of senior positions, culminating in her being the Chief Operating Officer for the Americas. On retiring from Ford, Anne joined Carpenter Technology Corporation (2006-2009) as its Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer. Anne has extensive Non-executive Director experience and has previously served as Chairman, CEO and Principal of SA IT (2011-2014), as a Non-executive Director on the board of XL Group and Lockheed Martin before joining GKN plc as a Non-executive Director where she was briefly CEO during the hostile takeover by Melrose plc in 2018. Anne received a BS in Materials and Mechanical Engineering from Drexel University in 1980 and was elected to the National Academy of Engineering in 2004. External appointments Harbour Energy plc (Non-executive Director and Remuneration Committee Chair)

primary_position: Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer
biography: Mr. Anthony James served as Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer at Galena Mining. He has previous experience at the Managing Director level of three ASX-listed companies, with two of those companies successfully guided through a merger and takeover process to the benefit of the shareholders. He has a strong mine operating background (examples being the Kanowna Belle Gold Mine and the Black Swan Nickel Mine) and a strong feasibility study/mine development background (examples being the Pillara Zinc/Lead Mine and the Trident/Higginsville Gold Mine).

Mr. Anthony Williams serves as Executive Vice President & Chief Human Resources Officer at Akamai Technologies. He leads global HR strategy including workplace management, employee development, talent acquisition, inclusion and diversity and compensation and benefits across Akamai's more than 40 offices around the world. He assumed the role effective January 1, 2020 after five years with Akamai. He began his Akamai career with the task of developing a world-class global recruiting function and was the company's first diversity and inclusion leader. He led the human resources function for Akamai's growing populations outside of the U.S., reflecting the company's expanded footprint. He played an essential role in the Akamai Foundation's transition from private funding to an official corporate philanthropic entity. He serves as its president and hired its first executive director. Further, he launched the company's employee resource groups ("ERG"), voluntary associations that represent the needs of Akamai's global employee population. He also launched the Akamai Technical Academy, a training program designed for people who have an interest and aptitude for technology but may not come from a traditional technical background. The unique program empowers diverse talent with technical work-ready skills while offering opportunities for prepared graduates to become full-time employees of Akamai. Prior to Akamai, he held a wide range of global human resource positions at First Data Corporation, Newell Rubbermaid and Time Warner - Turner Broadcasting System. He holds a Bachelor of Science in Business Management from Norfolk State University and a Master of Business Administration from the University of Georgia, Terry College of Business.

primary_position: Chief Executive Officer, President, and Chairman
biography: Mr. Antoine Castro serves as Chief Executive Officer, President, and Chairman at Paref. He has more than 20 years of experience in real estate management and management within international companies, such as Fosun Hive Holding, Quantum Global Real Estate, Morgan Stanley Real Estate, and Archon Group (Goldman Sachs subsidiary). He joined PAREF Group in 2017 to inject new dynamism and develop the Group in Europe. He holds a degree in Finance from the University of Paris I Panthéon-Sorbonne and in Corporate Finance from the University of Evry-Val-d'Essonne.
Mr. Anton Antropov serves as Chief Information Security Officer at Mail.Ru Group.

primary_company: Research and Production Corporation United Wagon Company
primary_position: Deputy Chief Executive Officer & Chief Operating Officer
biography: Dr. Anton Ustinov serves as Deputy Chief Executive Officer and Chief Operating Officer at United Wagon Company. He joined the Company in June 2014. Prior to that, he was deputy CEO at the logistics division of En+ Group, which provided logistics support of business units with freight turnover more than 60 mln tons per year. Previously, Anton supervised Transport office of Organizational Committee at XII Olympic Winter Games in Sochi, which was responsible for planning transfers of client groups during the Olympic Games and developing technical requirements of Sochi's transport infrastructure to meet these demands. Prior to that, Anton served as CEO of SoyuzVneshTrans Concern, which specialized in freight-forwarding services to companies needing to transport cargo by all types of transport. Anton Ustinov graduated from the Moscow Engineering Physics Institute with a degree in Solid-state Physics. He also has a degree in Finance and Lending from the Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation. Anton holds a PH.D in Physical and Mathematical Science and an Executive MBA degree at University Antwerp Management School (Belgium, 2009).
Mr. Antonio Gutiérrez served as Chief Executive Officer at DIA Group. The company appointed him as the CEO, who until today was responsible for the company's business in Argentina and Brazil.
Mr. Antonio Martin served as Director, Finance at DIA Group. Previously he served as a Director Financiero at DIA,S.A.(Carrefour Group).

primary_position: Group Corporate Director & Chief Strategy, Mergers & Acquisitions and Digital Officer
biography: Mr. Antonio Serrano serves as Group Corporate Director and Chief Strategy, Mergers & Acquisitions and Digital Officer at DIA Group. Mr. Serrano serves as Board Member at Grão Direto. He has a degree in Electronic Engineering from the Technological Institute of Aeronautics of Brazil and an MBA in Business Administration, Finance and Marketing from the Booth School of Business (University of Chicago). Subsequently, he completed an Executive Program at the IMD business school in Switzerland. His professional career began at Banco ITAÚ in 2001 and later at Bain & Company, where he worked for 11 years in charge of evaluating different large-scale projects within the field of strategy and mergers and acquisitions throughout LATAM. In 2014 he was appointed General Manager of Votorantim Cimentos, a position he held until 2018, when he founded and began managing "Juntos Somos Mais", the largest digital ecosystem in the construction sector in Brazil, making it one of the main startups in the country. He combines running the company with business mentoring at Endeavor. He also has extensive expertise as a Board Member of various companies.

Anu Dhir has appointed as independent non-executive director to the board with effect from 15 November 2023. Ms Dhir currently serves as a non-executive director on the Board of TSX-listed Montage Gold Corp. and TSX/NYSE-listed Taseko Mines Limited. Over the last decade, Ms Dhir's board positions have included Lead Non-Executive Director for Lomiko Metals Inc., Non-Executive Director of Golden Star Resources Ltd, in addition to other Canadian listed companies. Ms Dhir has over 20 years' experience in the resources sector, most recently, as a co-founder and executive of ZinQ Mining, a private base and precious metals company which focuses on the Latin American Region. Prior to ZinQ Mining, Ms Dhir was Vice President, Corporate Development and Corporate Secretary at Katanga Mining Limited. Ms Dhir is co-founder of Wshingwell, a for-profit community relationship platform that allows individuals, communities and organizations to micro-fundraise around experiences and events. Ms Dhir is a graduate of the General Management Program (GMP) at Harvard Business School and has a law degree (Juris Doctor) from Quinnipiac University and a Bachelor of Arts (BA) from the University of Toronto.

Mr. Aris Kekedjian served as Chief Executive Officer at Icahn Enterprises. Mr. Aris Kekedjian served as Chief Investment Officer & Head of Corporate Development at General Electric. He served as Managing Director, Mergers & Acquisitions & Global Business Development & Vice President at General Electric Capital. Aris is a graduate of Concordia University in Canada. He also serves as the Board Member at Mubadala GE Capital.

Mr. Arnaud Breuillac serves as Board Member at Trident Energy Management. Term of office: Director since March 2023, re-election required at AGM in 2026. Experience: Mr. Breuillac had a 40-year career with TotalEnergies SE, including as President Middle East, Senior Vice President E&P, Continental Europe and Central Asia, and seven years as President Exploration & Production before his retirement at the end of 2021. From 2021 to 2022, Mr. Breuillac continued as Senior Advisor to the Chair and Chief Executive Officer of TotalEnergies. Current directorships/other interests: Director: Trident Energy Ltd (since 2022) and Geosel Manosque SAS (since 2022). Member: Board of ACL (Association des diplomes de l'ECL). Other: President of ECL (Ecole Centrale de Lyon) Endowment Fund. MSc Engineering.

Mr. Arthur Lau serves as President at The9. He is a seasoned finance professional with experience spanning across private equity, hedge fund and investment banking sectors. He is currently the Co-Founder and Partner of Ark Pacific Capital Management ("Ark Pacific"), a multi-strategy alternative asset manager focusing in Greater China. Mr. Lau sat on the board of multiple portfolio companies and is experienced in developing new business initiatives. Prior to joining Ark Pacific, he was an investment director of Elliott Advisors, the Asian office of Elliott Associates, a global hedge fund managing over US$30 billion of assets. Before that, Mr. Lau was a technology, media and telecom investment banker at Citigroup and an investment banker at JPMorgan. Mr. Lau graduated from The London School of Economics and Political Science with a Bachelor of Laws degree and holds a Master of Economics degree from The University of Hong Kong.

Ashley has worked in the financial services sector for nearly 30 years. He trained as a Chartered Accountant with McIntyre & Co in London, before moving to KPMG's financial services sector upon qualification in 1996. Ashley moved to Guernsey in 2002 and in 2008 developed a Channel Islands advisory practice for KPMG, growing it into a full taxonomy of services across transactions, restructuring, management, and risk consulting. He has provided transactions and valuations support to clients on buy and sell sides across the regulated finance sectors, including as lead advisor to Heritage's funds and fiduciary businesses, disposed of in 2017 to Estera (backed by Bridgepoint), and to Ardel, which was disposed of to Equiom in 2015 (backed by LDC). Ashley has also led a number of high profile and innovative transaction related engagements for government. Ashley has gained deep sectoral specialism supporting the London listed fund sector throughout his 23 years with KPMG, as audit partner, as lead partner on capital market transactions, and various formal restructuring appointments. He retired from the firm in 2019. During his KPMG career, Ashley worked on various advisory assignments with a strong ESG focus, including leading KPMG's Guernsey Green Fund certification for Bluefield Solar Fund Limited, the first company to adopt Guernsey Green Fund Rules and be certified. Ashley is a non-executive director to three other London listed entities, Chair of TwentyFour Select Monthly Income Fund Limited, Chair of the Audit and Risk Committee for Downing Renewables & Infrastructure Trust plc (an Article 9 fund pursuant to the EU taxonomy and the EU sustainable Finance Disclosure Regulations) and JZ Capital Partners Limited. Ashley also plays an important role in the local third sector as Chairman of the Youth Commission for Guernsey & Alderney. Ashley is a Fellow of the Institute of Chartered Accountants in England and Wales and a full-time resident of Guernsey. He holds an Economics degree from the University of Warwick.

primary_position: Senior Vice President, Chief AI Officer & Chief Data Officer
biography: Dr. Ashok Srivastava serves as Senior Vice President, Chief AI Officer & Chief Data Officer at Intuit. Dr. Srivastava serves as Advisory Board Member at Synapse Partners. Dr. Srivastava served as the Chief Data Scientist at Verizon Wireless. He previously served as an Advisor at Trident Capital. Prior to joining NASA, he served as a Senior Director at Blue Martini Software and a Senior Data Analytics Consultant at IBM. In these roles, he consulted for numerous Fortune Global 500 companies in the finance, retail, manufacturing, and internet sectors, in the areas of data mining and optimization. He has served on the advisory boards of several internet companies. Srivastava has won numerous awards including the IEEE Computer Society Technical Achievement Award for "pioneering contributions to intelligent information systems," the NASA Exceptional Achievement Medal for contributions to state-of-the-art data mining and analysis, the IBM Golden Circle Award, and the Department of Education Merit Fellowship. Dr. Srivastava is the author of many research articles on data mining, machine learning and text mining, and has edited the book, "Text Mining: Classification, Clustering, and Applications" (with Mehran Sahami, 2009).

primary_position: Vice President, North America Small Business & Global Co-Lead, Unity - PayPal's Women ERG
biography: Ms. Ashwini Kumar serves as Vice President, North America Small Business & Global Co-Lead, Unity - PayPal's Women ERG at PayPal Holdings. Ms. Kumar served ainGlobal Corporate Strategy at Paypal. Previously she served as a Manager - Management Consulting at Accenture. She holds a BE in Industrial Engineering from the University of Toronto and an MBA in Strategic Management from the University of Pennsylvania Wharton School.

primary_position: Manager, Public Affairs and Corporate Communications
biography: Mr. Atisthan Roach serves as a Manager, Public Affairs and Corporate Communications at Vulcan Materials Company.
Mr. Aviad Kaufman serves as Chief Financial Officer at Quantum Pacific Group.
Mr. Aviv Nankin serves as Vice President at Playtech. He was the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Playtech.

Bamdad Bastani will be appointed to the board as an Independent non-executive director with effect from 01 January 2024. Bami Bastani joins with a wealth of experience in the semiconductor industry, having spent seven years at GlobalFoundries, first as Senior VP and GM of the Mobile & Wireless Infrastructure Business Unit and then Senior VP and Senior Advisor to the CEO. Bami also spent seven years as a board member of the Global Semiconductor Alliance (GSA) and has held President and CEO roles at Meru Networks, Trident Microsystems and ANADIGICS.

Ms. Beate Holzwarth served as Chief Communications Officer, Germany at Vulcan Energy Resources. Ms. Holzwarth has over 20 years' experience in various communication and marketing roles within Mercedes-Benz Cars and Daimler Trucks. As a direct report of the divisional Board of Mercedes-Benz Cars Operations, she was responsible for national and international ground-breaking events of new production sites with the involvement of state representatives and local politicians. She studied business administration, management and marketing in Ludwigshafen on the Rhine and communication strategies in Berlin.

primary_position: Chief Financial Officer, Finance & Chief Accounting Officer, Accounting
biography: Mr. Bill Roeschlein served as Chief Financial Officer at Perceptron. He serves as Chief Financial Officer at Tigo Energy.
